点击查看摘要

Abstract:Computational pathology (CPath) analyses increasingly depend on multi-step computational workflows that require substantial programming expertise, limiting their accessibility to pathologists and other domain experts without extensive coding experience. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a promising natural-language interface for constructing such analyses, hallucinated operations and incorrect workflow specifications limit their reliability in scientific settings. We introduce Tissue Image Analysis Agent (TIAgent), an automated CPath workflow generation framework that, given a natural-language prompt specifying a complex analytical task together with an input dataset, automatically constructs a verifiable computational graph employing existing CPath operations. The resulting graph can be inspected and executed, enabling natural-language construction of complex CPath workflows for applications including automated biomarker discovery and tissue analysis. We demonstrate end-to-end workflow generation and execution and systematically benchmark 14 backbone LLMs across 90 unit tasks spanning 18 CPath operation types. The ability of each LLM to generate a complete and correct unit workflow is quantified using Unit Workflow Success (UWS). Performance varied substantially across backbone models, with Kimi-K2.7-Code achieving the highest UWS of 0.967 (95% CI: 0.907-0.989). Analysis of node and parameter correctness further revealed that selecting the appropriate computational operation and correctly configuring it represent distinct challenges for LLM-based workflow generation. TIAgent provides a foundation for making complex CPath workflow construction more accessible while enabling systematic evaluation of LLM-driven scientific workflow generation.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决进化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）中更新机制的直观理解问题，即如何从几何角度准确解释ES的参数更新过程。传统方法将ES更新视为平滑梯度的估计，但本文提出一种全新的几何解释：将每个扰动后的模型视为一个具有质量的粒子，其奖励值即为粒子的质量。在评分前，所有粒子质量相等，系统质心位于群体中心；评分后，系统平衡于奖励加权的质心。研究证明，经过均值减除的ES更新方向恰好等于这一质心位移，且被一个依赖于平均奖励的标量因子所缩放，该结论对任意有限规模种群均成立。该几何视角要求奖励非负，可通过常数平移实现而不影响更新方向。在大种群极限或采用反向采样（antithetic sampling）条件下，群体质心与当前模型位置重合，此时ES更新可简化为：模型从当前位置朝其自身种群的奖励加权质心移动。同时，减去平均奖励的作用被解释为改变位移测量的参考点——从模型本身变为采样质心。本文的核心贡献在于提供了一种精确适用于任意有限种群的直观、物理化的几何视角，深化了对ES更新机制的本质理解。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35865
作者: Akshat Gupta
机构: UC Berkeley(加州大学伯克利分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations. This update is usually presented as an estimate of a smoothed gradient. We present a geometrical interpretation of this update instead. Treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle’s mass. Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid. Once rewards are assigned, it balances at its reward-weighted center of mass instead. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population. The physical reading needs nonnegative rewards, which can always be arranged by adding a constant to every reward without changing the update. In the limit of a large population or under antithetic sampling, the centroid sits on the model itself, so ES has an even simpler geometric interpretation: from its current location, the model moves towards the reward-weighted center of mass of its own population. The same picture explains what subtracting the mean reward does: it changes the point from which the displacement is measured, from the model to the sampled centroid. Our contribution is an intuitive, geometric way to visualize an ES update, exact for any finite population.

[NLP-1] Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM -Based ASR

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言自动语音识别（ASR）系统在扩展至新语言时面临的挑战，即在不回放已有源语言训练数据的前提下，如何有效保持原有语言的性能。其核心问题在于：在连接器驱动的语音大语言模型（Speech LLM）架构中，如何在微调可训练连接器以适应新语言的同时，避免对已支持语言造成严重遗忘。解决方案的关键在于设计合理的参数更新构造与合并策略。研究发现，在单目标扩展场景下，仅对目标语言进行微调或采用标准TIES合并会导致严重的源语言遗忘；而基于SSU-Wanda+TIES的更新策略能够在目标语言学习与源语言保留之间取得最佳平衡。在多目标扩展场景中，更新合并策略能实现稳定的源语言保留，而递归扩展虽可在理想顺序下提升目标语言适应性，但对语言添加顺序高度敏感。因此，该研究揭示了多语言ASR扩展需在目标语言获取、源语言保留以及各目标语言更新间的相互作用之间实现精细权衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35846
作者: Yuchen Zhang,Haralambos Mouratidis,Ravi Shekhar
机构: Institute for Analytics and Data Science, University of Essex(埃塞克斯大学数据分析与科学研究所); School of Computer Science and Electronic Engineering, University of Essex(埃塞克斯大学计算机科学与电子工程学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.

[NLP-2] Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）中持续存在的选择偏差（selection bias）问题，尤其关注在多选项任务中，基于Jev风格决策结构的模型是否能够有效降低此类偏差。其核心问题是：Jev式决策结构是否真正减少了选择偏差？为此，作者提出一种简单但有效的测试方法——在保持问题与候选答案内容不变的前提下，对选项顺序进行随机洗牌，并对比不同呈现顺序下的模型表现。研究覆盖了两个Jev版本、十二个Jev复现模型及六个生成式LLM，在来自两个基准数据集的1,700个问题上进行实验。结果显示，尽管Jev模型在原始顺序下的准确率波动小于2个百分点，但在洗牌后其累积失败集扩大了27%–29%，且初始正确的判断在后续呈现中仍频繁失效；这一现象显著优于固定顺序重复下的表现，即便对于高度可重复的Jev复现模型亦然。此外，Jev并未展现出相对于生成式基线模型在维持正确选择方面的普遍优势。聚合策略（如投票）仅提供有限保护，即使所有模型一致输出，错误答案仍频繁出现。研究揭示了“可重复决策”与“跨等效呈现保持正确性”之间存在关键差距，表明仅依赖稳定准确率无法证明模型具备抵抗选择偏差的能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35826
作者: Mingyang Song,Mao Zheng,Zhiyuan Ma,Xinpeng Zhou
机构: Tencent(腾讯)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev’s accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27–29% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. This loss of initial successes is substantially larger than under fixed-order repetition, even for highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.

[NLP-3] Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散型大语言模型（diffusion large language models, dLLMs）在生成文本时因需经历大量解码轮次而导致效率低下的问题。尽管dLLMs支持并行生成多个标记（token），但其生成速度受限于解码过程中对高置信度标记的盲目依赖，而忽视了标记揭示顺序对整体不确定性降低的潜在影响。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于调度蒸馏（schedule distillation）的新框架dSpark，通过构建优先揭示那些能显著提升其他位置可预测性的标记的去掩码（unmasking）策略，提前减少解码过程中的不确定性。该方法将优化后的揭示顺序以知识蒸馏方式融入模型，结合KL散度正则化以保障生成质量，在不牺牲性能的前提下实现更快的并行采样。实验表明，在数学推理与代码生成任务中，dSpark在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上分别实现了10.12×和5.12×的显著加速，同时保持了优异的任务表现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35804
作者: Aidar Myrzakhan,Zhiqiang Shen
机构: VILA Lab, MBZUAI(MBZUAI的VILA实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Code is available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12 \times and 5.12 \times speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-4] Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在深度研究任务中因过度整合多源信息而产生的“平滑化”（smoothing）问题。具体而言，当大型语言模型（LLM）对大规模文档集合进行分析并生成长篇研究报告时，尽管输出内容呈现高度自信的综合叙述，却往往未能准确反映原始文献中的多样性与潜在冲突，导致结论的确定性超过其引用证据所能支持的程度。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为SmoothScore的主张级评分流水线：该方法首先从模型生成的报告中提取关键结论性主张，随后检索与每个主张相关的证据，并基于高层维度对证据进行聚类；最终，通过评估主张与其证据之间的匹配程度，量化模型在信息整合过程中所表现出的平滑化程度。实验结果表明，在7个系统和4个数据集上，模型均持续生成了超出证据支持范围的更强主张，凸显了该问题的普遍性与严重性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35793
作者: Tiasa Singha Roy,Manya Wadhwa,Greg Durrett
机构: New York University (纽约大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Code and data present at: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential “jaggedness” of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.

[NLP-5] Atomic Security Concerns: Towards a Foundational Language for Security Knowledge Representation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决网络安全治理、风险管控、合规性及安全架构中普遍存在的概念异构问题，即各类安全属性、域、控制措施、风险、实施手段、能力与合规要求等概念常以多样化的抽象形式和术语体系表示，导致概念间关系难以一致表达，且相关推理高度依赖专家经验。其解决方案的关键在于提出“安全关切（Security Concerns）”与“原子级安全关切（Atomic Security Concerns, ASCs）”的概念，并基于化学中“原子”的类比，提出网络安全知识可由一组有限的、基础性的关切构成，而非独立的抽象实体。通过将复杂安全概念视为原子级安全关切的组合，ASCs 成为跨领域、跨粒度、跨性质的安全概念统一抽象层，从而为构建一种可显式表达概念间关系的网络安全语言提供基础词汇。该研究的核心贡献是概念层面的：提出一个用于探索网络安全知识表征、推理与未来形式化基础的框架与研究假说。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, and security architecture rely on numerous concepts, including security properties, domains, controls, risks, implementation measures, capabilities, and compliance requirements. Although these concepts are widely used, they are often represented through heterogeneous abstractions and vocabularies, making relationships among them difficult to express consistently and leaving much of the associated reasoning dependent on expert knowledge. This paper introduces the concepts of Security Concerns and Atomic Security Concerns (ASCs) and explores the hypothesis that cybersecurity knowledge may be represented through a finite set of foundational concerns. Inspired by the role of atoms in chemistry, the proposed approach views cybersecurity concepts as compositions of more fundamental concerns rather than as independent abstractions. Hence, Atomic Security Concerns could be viewed as a common abstraction layer for the representation of cybersecurity concepts, independently of their domain, nature, or level of granularity. Building upon this perspective, the paper explores how Atomic Security Concerns may provide the vocabulary of a cybersecurity language and how cybersecurity concepts may be represented as concern sets supporting explicit relationships among concepts. The contribution of this work is intentionally conceptual: it introduces a framework and research hypothesis for investigating the foundations of a common language for cybersecurity knowledge representation, reasoning, and future formalization.

[NLP-6] SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有越狱攻击方法中存在的两大局限：静态规划型攻击（static planners）虽计算高效但无法根据目标模型的回复动态调整策略，导致攻击效率低下且泛化能力差；而交互生成型攻击（interactive generators）虽能实时响应目标反馈，却依赖闭环评估器提供成功信号或提示，带来高昂的计算成本并可能夸大性能表现。为此，论文提出SEMA-Auto，一种具备自主感知能力与高效性的多轮越狱攻击框架，其核心创新在于通过双阶段训练机制实现行为稳定与能力增强：首先采用合成自举微调（synthetic bootstrap tuning）在基础模型中注入攻击目标意识与合规决策能力；随后通过决策监督的强化学习（decision-supervised reinforcement learning），分别优化越狱奖励与每轮决策对绝对目标的符合度，从而在无需外部反馈的情况下实现自主终止。实验表明，SEMA-Auto在多个数据集、目标模型及评测标准下均达到当前最优攻击成功率（ASR），且以极低的平均轮次完成攻击——例如在AdvBench上对DeepSeek-V4-Flash实现76.0%的ASR@1仅需3.0轮，显著优于固定7轮的最优静态基线（54.8%）和需3.7轮的最优交互基线（43.8%）；在对抗经过安全加固的前沿模型（如GPT-oss-120B、GPT-5.4等）时，于HarmBench上平均达成59.6%的ASR@1，较前人SOTA提升13.8%。该方法在保持高攻击效能的同时大幅降低资源消耗，实现了“高效性”与“有效性”的统一。

Abstract:Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim’s replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately, reinforcing the attack with higher jailbreak reward while supervising the decision at each turn against an absolute target. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack success rates (ASR) across multiple datasets, victims, and judges, outperforming all static and interactive baselines, within almost the fewest turns, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency. For example, SEMA-Auto performs a 76.0% ASR@1 within an average of 3.0 turns against DeepSeek-V4-Flash on AdvBench, while the best static baseline is 54.8% with fixed 7 turns and the best interactive baseline is 43.8% in 3.7 turns. Against safety-hardened frontier models, GPT-oss-120B, GPT-5.4, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and GPT-6-Astra, our counter-trained attacker achieves an average 59.6% ASR@1 on HarmBench, 13.8% over prior SOTA. Our code is available at: this https URL

[NLP-7] Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决临床试验预筛选过程中，如何准确区分患者记录中“未满足的纳入条件”与“证据不足”这一核心挑战。其关键解决方案在于提出一种非生成式决策模型JEV，该模型通过返回原始选项的概率分布，实现对临床条件的精准判断。在严格零数据保留（ZDR）政策下，JEV在多个数据集上表现出优异性能，尤其在MIMIC-III数据集上显著优于基于提示工程的Qwen Flash模型（宏平均F1得分差值Δ = +0.234），主要体现在对“证据不足”类条件更高的召回率（56.3% vs. 9.9%）。此外，JEV在推理延迟（1.18–1.40秒）和单位条件成本（降低53%–74%）方面均具有明显优势，表明其可作为高效、隐私保护的初始评估组件，用于提供标准级判断并识别潜在信息缺口。然而，其在解读临床证据时的误差提示，仍需人工核查以确保入组决策的可靠性。

Abstract:Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; \Delta = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV’s observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.

[NLP-8] Quantitative Generalization Bounds for Multi-Layer Transformers: A Few Long Strings can Beat Many Short Ones

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在训练数据之外的泛化能力问题，特别是针对基于Transformer的模型在面对更长、更复杂的问题实例时所表现出的惊人泛化能力，其理论理解仍不充分。传统机器学习模型通常仅关注分布内统计泛化（in-distribution statistical generalisation），即模型从训练样本推广到同分布新样本的能力；而由于语言数据具有序列特性，还需考虑长度泛化（length generalisation），即模型能否将训练中使用特定长度输入的学习成果外推至更长序列。然而，这两个维度长期被分别研究，缺乏对二者交互机制的系统分析。本文首次对固定精度下的Transformer模型进行了双轴联合分析，提出了基于模型参数规模、量化空间和词表大小的泛化保证，并揭示了样本数量与训练序列长度之间的权衡关系。研究表明，在同等条件下，增加训练序列长度比增加样本量具有指数级更高的效率。实验结果验证了理论预测的有效性。

Abstract:Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer this http URL two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.

[NLP-9] From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM -Assisted Auditing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）及多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在评估过程中自报告置信度（self-confidence）普遍存在的校准偏差问题，同时探索如何在保证统计有效性的同时提升评估效率。其核心挑战在于：尽管模型的置信度常不准确，但若能合理利用这一信息，仍可实现高效评估；而基于大模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）的自动化评估虽具可扩展性，其实际效益受限于评判者的校准质量与推理开销。本文提出一个统一的统计框架，涵盖直接人工审计与判官辅助评估两种路径，并针对不同采样策略进行分析。关键解决方案包括：在直接审计中采用置信度分层采样（confidence-stratified sampling），无需依赖校准的置信度即可从部分验证输出中恢复总体准确率，并量化有限样本下的不确定性；在判官辅助评估中，将评判者建模为具有敏感性与假阳性率的二元分类器，构建误差校正估计器并纳入校准不确定性。通过人类标签效率边界与总成本效率边界的对比分析，实验结果表明，在高度不平衡的置信度分布下，按比例分配样本相较于等量分配显著降低估计误差；而仅有少数目标-验证器组合满足理想的人类标签效率条件，且自动化推理成本可能抵消潜在节省。研究揭示了在何种统计与经济条件下，基于置信度引导的审计与自动化验证才具备实际价值。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost. This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries. Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target–verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful. Comments: 21 pages, 8 figures. [NLP-10] MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式终端代理（terminal agent）在执行长时程自然语言指令任务时，因缺乏有效纠错机制而导致的性能瓶颈问题。现有错误靶向学习方法主要针对单轮任务设计，且对代理失败的分析多用于评估与调试，无法直接用于模型训练。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于异常行为驱动的强化学习框架——Misbehavior-driven RL（MiRL），其关键在于：首先通过系统性地分析策略在多环境中的重复性错误，识别出可泛化的“异常行为”（misbehavior），即一类在不同上下文中反复出现的错误操作；随后，在强化学习过程中，从这些异常行为发生的具体步骤启动轨迹（rollout），仅当轨迹成功规避该类错误并通过测试时才给予奖励。该方法使模型在未见过的任务前缀上，平均减少43%至57%的既定错误行为。实验表明，基于Qwen3.5-4B的MiRL在终端基准测试中表现优于TMax-4B，同时仅使用其35%的采样轨迹，验证了错误靶向学习在真实、长时程终端任务中的有效性与高效性。

Abstract:Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.

[NLP-11] Not One Belief: Answer Payloads Persistence and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话式问答系统在用户提出质疑或反馈时，如何有效识别并修正错误回答的问题，特别是如何在用户未提供具体答案的情况下判断应信任哪个回答。其核心挑战在于：当用户通过“重问”（re-ask）、“同意”（agree）或“质疑”（challenge）等语用行为表达反馈时，系统能否准确感知并调整输出。研究的关键发现是，仅依赖语用行为（speech act）不足以驱动答案更新，而必须结合具体的回答内容（payload），尤其是在用户主动提供答案字符串时，系统才可能实现显著纠错。四个置信度信号——口头表达的置信度、归一化似然性、冻结隐藏状态探测器（frozen hidden-state probe）和P(True)——表现出显著分歧，其中冻结探测器在Qwen2.5-7B模型中随答案持续性上升而非真实性，表明其存在偏差。实验显示，在81个持续错误中，仅提供答案字符串的修复率可达75%-95%，而仅通过重问、重启会话或放弃回答等方式几乎无效。进一步分析表明，基于BM25检索到包含正确答案的句子可修复67%-76%的持久错误，而无此类信息的修复率不足12%。最终提出的“包含门控”（contain-gate）机制虽在端到端训练下表现不佳，但一种不依赖黄金答案的可部署门控仍能有效提升修复能力，揭示出基于证据匹配而非依赖先验真值的修复路径具有可行性。

Abstract:Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. Among 81 Qwen2.5-7B errors that survive one re-ask, re-asking, a fresh chat, or abstain repair almost none, while a gold answer repairs 75-95%. In two preregistered replications, every repair rate without an answer string stays below 0.15; a larger post-hoc rerun excludes 0.15 except for the empty elicit. With BM25 TriviaQA evidence, sentences that contain the answer repair 67-76% of persistent errors versus at most 12% when they do not. An end-to-end contain-gate cuts harm on TriviaQA, but a deployable gate that does not know the gold answer repairs few errors.

[NLP-12] Adapting LLM -SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在处理活态宗教遗产地游客评论时，因通用信息抽取框架忽视仪式行为、神圣空间、文化禁忌及情感复杂性等关键文化语境而造成的表征缺失问题。其解决方案的关键在于对原有的LLM-社会计算（LLM-Social Computing, LLM-SC）框架进行文化情境化改造：针对尼泊尔帕舒帕蒂纳寺（Pashupatinath Temple）的特定语境，构建了一个包含12类实体（在原4类基础上新增8类与神圣遗产相关的类型）、4种关系类型及9个方面-情感维度的定制化标注体系，并通过GPT-4o设计结构化抽取提示（prompt），应用于2,500条经筛选的英文Tripadvisor评论。该方法实现了对文化敏感实体（如“圣火祭祀”“禁入区域”）的高比例识别（占实体记录的64.8%），并通过双标注员人工验证提供组件级评估结果，包括实体精确率41.0%、召回率21.8%、微平均F1为28.4%，方面存在性F1为53.6%，端到端方面+极性预测F1为42.6%。研究强调了其文化扎根性、领域特异性以及可复现性与泛化能力的明确边界，为文化遗产数字化中的生成式AI应用提供了可解释、可验证的实践范式。

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.

[NLP-13] Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前前沿语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在开放权重（open-weight）版本中缺乏系统性安全评估的问题，尤其针对具备强自主代理能力（agentic capabilities）的DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017模型。随着模型能力日益增强，独立第三方评估对识别其系统性安全风险至关重要，但现有公开评估多集中于闭源模型，而开放权重模型的安全性评估仍显不足。为此，研究基于欧盟通用人工智能（General-Purpose AI）实践准则，构建了涵盖34个基准测试的独立安全评估体系，包括5个自研评估套件，覆盖评估完整性、失控风险与有害操纵等多个维度。评估结果表明，V4.1 Flash-1017相较于前代V4系列在安全性上取得显著提升，并在多个指标上接近或达到主流闭源模型（如GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol和Gemini 3.8 Flash）水平，但仍存在需持续关注的行为表现。解决方案的关键在于：一是强调在增量更新中嵌入持续安全评估机制，以应对微小更新可能导致的安全退化；二是提出部署阶段需具备全流程可观测性，不仅依赖最终输出，还需对推理轨迹与动作日志进行过程级监控，以有效检测失控行为；三是倡导发展私有基准测试，以规避公共基准带来的评估意识强化与数据污染风险，从而保障前沿模型评估的可信度与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35671
作者: Yao Huang,Zhiyuan Zeng,Yu Wang,Zhitong Zhu,Dingcheng Duan,Hao Li,Shangzhi Xu,Yifan Wang,Jinzhe Tu,Shukun Xiong,Yihe Zang,Han Yan,Hongchang Yang,Fuyu Gu,Wei Xu,Yinpeng Dong,Xiaojian Li
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 87 pages, 44 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

[NLP-14] Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在自然语言推理（NLI）任务中进行跨请求重排序（cross-request reranking）时，原有直接选择（direct selection）范式下的读出机制与模型适配策略是否依然有效的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持低参数量的前提下，提升模型在多轮独立推理场景中的性能。解决方案的关键在于提出两种协同优化策略：一是采用均值跨度读出（mean-span readout），通过计算每个候选答案内部上下文状态的平均值替代原有的选项结尾指针，从而无需引入额外的头部参数；二是实施选择性适配（selective adaptation），仅保留注意力模块和门控DeltaNet投影中的低秩更新，移除前馈适配器（feed-forward adapters）。实验结果表明，在MC11基准上，该方案在不增加参数量的情况下显著提升了NeoHorse-1-4B模型的平均准确率，且训练参数量减少超过一半，验证了该组合策略在跨请求重排序场景下的有效性与高效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35654
作者: Haocheng Mei,Yuchuan Tian,Ye Yuan,Enhua Wu,Chao Xu,Allen Chen,Kai Han,Yunhe Wang
机构: Peking University (北京大学); SUIBE (上海外国语大学); University of Macau (澳门大学); Tsinghua University (清华大学); TokenRhythm Technologies
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 3 figures. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.

[NLP-15] Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决代码生成过程中技能（skill）泛化能力不足的问题，即现有编码轨迹常与特定任务和代码库上下文紧密耦合，导致从中提取的程序性知识难以在多样化编码环境中复用。其核心解决方案是提出分层技能演化（Hierarchical Skill Evolution, HSE）框架，通过多层级证据聚合实现从编码轨迹中渐进式提炼可迁移的通用技能。关键在于构建一个外部写作者-评估者循环（writer-evaluator loop），在不更新底层编码模型的前提下，由外部策略动态优化写作者与评估者，逐步过滤任务特异性细节，保留跨代码库一致有效的程序模式。该过程利用成功轨迹提供可复用的指导，失败轨迹则揭示共现的错误模式以支持规避与恢复。实验表明，仅基于SWE-Gym生成的10个技能即可在多个基准（SWE-bench Verified、DeepSWE）及不同大模型（GLM-5.2、GPT-5.5、Opus 4.8）与代理引擎（Pi、Claude Code）上提升性能，验证了技能的跨模型、跨基准与跨工具链的迁移能力；进一步通过目标基准轨迹自演化技能库，仅依赖学习到的评估器进行候选评估，无需验证器反馈，仍实现了性能增益，证明了该方法对特定任务的适应性优化潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35616
作者: Jun Gao,Yun Peng,Changhai Zhou,Yuhan Zhu,Xiangyu Zeng,Shiyang Zhang Yuhua Zhou,Luozheng Qin,Qian Qiao,Xiaoteng Ma,Baian Chen Weiyi Shang,Zhen Ming Jack Jiang,Lizhi Liao,Xiaoxue Ren
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.

[NLP-16] Making Reasoning Visible: Configuration-Aware Diagnostic Modeling for Adaptive Scaffolding in Structured Reasoning Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自适应辅导系统在学生学习过程中难以捕捉其潜在、多步骤推理过程的核心问题，传统系统仅依赖“正确/错误”判断，缺乏对学生思维路径的深入理解。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种可诊断的框架，通过分析学生在交互式学习游戏中的操作序列，将学习者的分步解题过程显性化。该框架能够计算五种可解释的策略维度（如系统性纠错、随机猜测等），评估任务结构与行为模式共同决定的协调需求，并将推理状态划分为四种不同类别。基于234名学生完成42个形态句法练习的36,234次交互数据，研究发现学生的推理策略主要受情境影响而非稳定特质（组内相关系数=0.14），且在低效推理状态中表现出高度持续性——74.6%由高协调需求导致的失败在无干预情况下会继续引发后续失败。此外，该研究构建的早期预警模型仅利用策略模式即可实现较高的验证成功预测准确率（AUC=0.826），结合序列上下文后进一步提升至0.902，且避免了对当前错误计数的循环依赖。结果表明，将隐性推理过程可视化，可实现更早、更精准的支架支持，使辅导系统能够响应学生的实际思维方式，而不仅仅是结果成败。尽管在语言学习领域验证，该框架具备通用性与可解释性，适用于任何需要诊断复杂结构化推理的领域。

作者: Trystan Geoffre,Zheng Yuan,Thierry Geoffre
机构: University of Fribourg (弗里堡大学); University of Sheffield (谢菲尔德大学); University of Luxembourg (卢森堡大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modeling the latent, multi-step reasoning processes of learners is a core challenge for adaptive tutoring systems, which often rely on simple right/wrong answers rather than understanding how students think. Instantiated here for grammatical reasoning, this study introduces a diagnostic framework that makes students’ step-by-step problem-solving visible by analyzing their action sequences in an interactive learning game. The framework computes five interpretable strategy dimensions (e.g., systematic error correction, random guessing), estimates coordination demand from task structure and behavioral patterns, and classifies reasoning into four distinct states. Analyzing 36,234 interactions from 234 students working on 42 morphosyntactic exercises, we found that reasoning strategies vary primarily by context rather than stable traits (intraclass correlation = 0.14), and students show high persistence in unproductive states; specifically, 74.6% of failures driven by high coordination demand (rather than simple knowledge gaps) are followed by another failure without intervention. Our early warning model predicts validation success with strong accuracy (AUC = 0.826 using strategy patterns alone; 0.902 with additional sequential context) while avoiding circular reliance on current error counts. These findings demonstrate that making latent reasoning processes visible enables earlier, more targeted scaffolding that responds to how students are thinking rather than simply whether they succeed. While demonstrated in language learning, the framework provides a generalizable, interpretable architecture for diagnosing complex, structured reasoning in any domain.

[NLP-17] Linear Probes Transfer from Base to Distilled Language Models despite Rotation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在语言模型迭代更新背景下，如何高效复用已训练的线性探测器（Linear Probe）以检测有害请求的问题。随着模型版本更迭，重新训练探测器成本较高，而现有方法缺乏对探测器跨版本迁移性能的系统评估。其解决方案的关键在于验证：在模型经过知识蒸馏或指令微调后，基于基础模型训练的线性探测器是否仍能保持有效性能。研究发现，尽管后续模型在语义空间中使有害与安全提示的分离方向发生17°至35°的旋转，但探测器在XSTest和独立的OR-Bench测试集上性能仅轻微波动（AUC变化范围为-0.011至+0.053），表明探测器具备较强的可迁移性。然而，探测器部分依赖于文本表面特征（如包含警示词汇），而非真正识别危害本质，在某些测试集中误报率高达29%–42%，说明其能力受限于测试数据分布，且对“表象危害”敏感。因此，该研究证实了线性探测器在模型演进过程中可被有效复用，但其鲁棒性与对真实危害的判别能力高度依赖于评估数据集特性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35586
作者: Marios Tsatsos
机构: Independent researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 16 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Linear probes, classifiers that read a language model’s internal activations, are widely used to detect harmful requests. They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer’s instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17 ^\circ to 35 ^\circ , yet on XSTest the transferred probe’s AUC changes by only -0.011 to +0.027 , and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by -0.015 to +0.053 . On XSTest, whose safe prompts deliberately contain alarming words, the probes beat a classifier that sees only the prompt text by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC. On the OR-Bench prompts that margin shrinks to 0.03 to 0.20, and the probes flag 29% to 42% of prompts that sound harmful but are benign, so part of what they read is the appearance of harm rather than harm itself. A probe trained on a base model can thus be reused, in these families, after distillation and after instruction tuning; how much it reads beyond textual cues depends on the test set.

[NLP-18] EXCISE: Locating and Excising Distracting Sentences in Medical Question Answering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式医疗语言模型在临床决策支持中因受到无关信息（即干扰项）影响而导致推理错误的问题，尤其关注如何在不事先知晓具体干扰项位置的情况下，有效消除其负面影响。现有研究虽表明单个无关句子即可显著降低模型准确性，但尚未明确干扰项在模型内部的具体作用机制及其可被干预的位置。本研究发现，通过阻断注意力机制对已知干扰项的访问可恢复正确答案，而头掩码（head masking）则可能抑制正确答案；更重要的是，模型的隐藏状态能够标记出与病例最不一致的句子——即使模型最终采纳了该句。基于此，作者提出EXCISE，一种推理时的去干扰方法：仅当模型隐藏状态指示某句子与病例不一致时，才阻断该句子对输出的影响。在作者构建的MedQA-TD基准测试中（每个干扰项针对特定错误选项），EXCISE在保持无干扰问题上仅有1.5–2.1个百分点的精度损失前提下，实现了16.7–22.8个百分点的准确率提升，显著优于提示工程、重写和引导等基线方法，并在MedDistractQA、BiasMedQA及链式思维生成任务中均展现出泛化能力。其核心解决方案在于利用模型内部表示对不一致性进行检测，从而实现无需先验知识的精准干扰项抑制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35558
作者: Yerim Hong,Sohyun Son,Heeseung Chung,Mujeen Sung
机构: Kyung Hee University (庆熙大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model’s hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor’s effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model’s hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.

[NLP-19] LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环型变压器（Looped Transformers）在增加循环深度以提升语言建模与下游任务性能时，因逐层依赖导致解码延迟显著上升的问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管更深的循环结构可带来性能增益，但传统方法中各循环阶段必须顺序执行，造成计算瓶颈。解决方案的关键在于提出LoopFold机制，通过将多层循环计算折叠为同一词元前缀下的并行批处理，实现计算重叠；引入轻量级预测器提前估计后续循环的输入，使深层循环可在浅层尚未完成时启动；随后利用校正模块基于早期循环的最新输出对深层循环结果进行精细化修正。所有组件均通过最终的下一个词元预测损失联合训练。实验表明，在1.4B模型上，更深层的LoopFold配置在8个零样本任务中平均准确率从53.41%提升至56.38%，显著优于标准循环模型和并行循环变压器（PLT）；相比九循环标准模型，仅用五阶段串行+额外并行计算即实现46%的解码延迟降低，有效平衡了性能与效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35556
作者: Feichen Song,Boyi Zeng,Yiqin Hao,Shixiang Song,He Li,Yizhou Yang,Zitong Wang,Yifan Liu,Ziwei He,Zhouhan Lin
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学); Sun Yat-sen University(中山大学); Shanghai Innovation Institute(上海创新研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped Transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone, offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. However, each loop depends on the preceding loop, so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. Existing approaches include Parallel Loop Transformers, which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions, but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. To address this challenge, we introduce LoopFold, which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. A lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. A corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. All components are trained jointly using only the final next-token prediction loss. In experiments with 1.4B models, deeper LoopFold configurations achieve progressively higher average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks, rising from 53.41% to 56.38%. Vanilla looped models and PLT show limited gains over the same depth range. Compared with a nine-loop vanilla model, LoopFold uses five sequential stages and additional parallel computation to reduce decoding latency by 46%.

[NLP-20] StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统循环式Transformer（Looped Transformers）在多轮迭代中难以有效保留长期信息的问题。尽管其共享主干网络实现了参数高效的语言建模，但原始方法依赖单一隐藏状态来传递跨迭代的信息，导致关键上下文在深层迭代中易丢失。为此，论文提出StateLoop，其核心创新在于为每个词元引入一个额外的持久化状态（persistent state），通过可学习门控机制动态控制前一状态与主干输出信息的融合比例，并将更新后的状态投影回主干输入以支持后续迭代与最终预测。该设计显著降低了Pile数据集上的困惑度，并在8个零样本任务上提升了平均准确率；尤其随着训练循环深度增加，其困惑度优势愈发明显，表明持久化状态在深度递归计算中对信息保持具有持续增强的价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35544
作者: Feichen Song,Boyi Zeng,He Li,Shixiang Song,Yiqin Hao,Zitong Wang,Yizhou Yang,Yifan Liu,Ziwei He,Zhouhan Lin
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学); Sun Yat-sen University(中山大学); Shanghai Innovation Institute(上海创新研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

[NLP-21] An Algorithmic Account of Few-Shot Concept Induction in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决智能系统在少样本概念归纳（few-shot concept induction）情境下如何识别并突出对当前上下文相关特征的问题。其核心挑战在于，模型与人类心智不仅需编码描述实体的特征，还需动态判断哪些特征在特定语境中具有意义。针对此问题，论文提出“近似方向强化”（Amortized Direction Accentuation, ADA）算法假设，其关键在于通过在特征空间中构建示例的摘要表征，并利用预先习得的、关于哪些特征更可能揭示项间共性的经验知识，来引导相关特征的增强。该机制使得语言模型能够在少量正例基础上有效归纳出潜在概念，从而为语言模型中的上下文学习能力及认知系统的核心机制提供了新的理论解释。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35533
作者: Michael A. Lepori,Laila Johnston,Aalok Sathe,Zhuonan Yang,Roman Feiman,Ellie Pavlick
机构: Brown University (布朗大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Both models and minds not only encode features that describe an entity, but can specifically represent which features of that entity are relevant for a given context. This core capability underlies in-context learning in language models and a variety of cognitive phenomena in minds, yet it is unclear how intelligent systems identify and promote relevant features. In this work, we propose Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA), an algorithmic hypothesis that provides an explanation for how relevance is determined in the context of few-shot concept induction — the ability to infer a latent concept from a small number of positive examples. Under ADA, concept induction proceeds by forming a summary representation of the examples in a feature space that is shaped by amortized knowledge about which features tend to be useful for finding commonalities between items. We investigate and validate ADA in language models using a few-shot concept induction task. This work provides a novel perspective on the mechanisms supporting contextualization in language models and a promising hypothesis for a core aspect of cognition.

[NLP-22] S3AC: Stabilized Selective and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式强化学习中长链思维（long chain-of-thought, CoT）推理任务里，基于可验证奖励的强化学习（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, RLVR）方法在缺乏评论家（critic）时所面临的两大核心问题：一是无法实现细粒度的令牌级信用分配（token-level credit assignment），二是依赖分组回放（grouped rollouts）估算提示词特定基线（prompt-specific baselines）导致效率低下。现有无评论家方法虽避免了昂贵的评论家训练，但难以有效区分不同推理步骤的贡献。为克服上述局限，本文提出S3AC（Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic）框架，其关键在于设计了一套实用的评论家训练方案，通过引入提示级基线与令牌级优势值，实现更精确的策略优化。同时，提出难度感知提示采样（Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling, DAPS），利用评论家对提示难度的估计结合历史结果动态选择生成提示，从而减少无效回放（rollout waste），无需离线预初始化难度标签。实验表明，S3AC在从1.5B到397B参数的大语言模型上均显著优于传统分组回放方法及现代GRPO变体（GRPO-X），尤其在35B规模模型上，仍能维持单次回放训练的有效性，而其他无评论家基线在初期收益后性能迅速下降。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35518
作者: Shuo Shen,Guangran Cheng,Chengqi Lyu,Xiangsen Wang,Yanan Sun,Wenwei Zhang
机构: Shanghai AI Laboratory(上海人工智能实验室)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 14 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout training while tested critic-free baselines deteriorate after initial gains.

[NLP-23] MATCHA: A Chinese Multi-Disorder Mental Health Dataset with Cross-Lingual Analyses on Social Media EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前社交媒体心理健康研究中普遍存在的语言与文化局限性问题，即研究过度依赖英文语料库和以DSM-5为中心的资源，导致对跨语言、跨文化背景下在线心理健康表达的理解受限。其核心解决方案是提出MATCHA——首个面向中文场景的多障碍心理健康数据集，该数据集将特定心理障碍的微博超话题（Weibo Super-Topic）社区与用户更广泛的公开动态相链接，涵盖7种DSM-5诊断类别及对照组，共包含46,025名个体级用户和180万条帖子。关键创新在于采用大语言模型（LLM）辅助的标注流程，精准区分具有明确自我披露证据的个体与一般相关参与者，并以严格去标识化、受控访问的形式发布，保障隐私安全。基于MATCHA，研究进一步分析了不同障碍在行为、语言、症状及生活事件等方面的模式，并与Twitter-STMHD进行跨平台比较，发现微博超话题作为情感与健康表达的集中场域，且微博与推特之间的平台差异往往大于不同障碍间的差异。这一数据集为开展具备社区意识和跨语言能力的心理健康自然语言处理（NLP）研究提供了重要基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35512
作者: Bingrui Jin,Baihan Li,Zitong Li,Kunyao Lan,Shimeng Li,Kenny Q. Zhu,Mengyue Wu
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学); University of Texas at Arlington(德克萨斯大学阿灵顿分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 18 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mental health research on social media has been dominated by English-language datasets and DSM-5-centered resources, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural understanding of online mental health expression. We introduce MATCHA, the first Chinese multi-disorder mental health dataset that links disorder-specific Weibo Super-Topic communities with users’ broader public timelines. MATCHA covers seven DSM-5 disorders and a control group, comprising 46,025 cohort-level users and 1.8 million posts. The dataset distinguishes users with explicit self-disclosure evidence from broader disorder-related participants through an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline, and is released in a rigorously de-identified, controlled-access format. Using MATCHA, we analyze behavioral, linguistic, symptom-related, and life-event-related patterns across disorders, and conduct cross-lingual comparisons with Twitter-STMHD. Our analyses show that Weibo Super-Topics function as concentrated spaces for affective and health-related expression, while cross-platform differences between Weibo and Twitter often exceed cross-disorder variation. MATCHA provides a new resource for community-aware and cross-lingual mental health NLP research.

[NLP-24] Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决社交媒体翻译中因用户生成内容（UGC）意义分布于文本、图像与文化知识三者之间，导致现有翻译模型难以准确还原语义的问题。其核心挑战在于：传统评估方法将图像视为可选信息，假设仅依赖文本即可完成翻译，从而掩盖了错误来源究竟是因缺失视觉证据，还是缺乏文化语用适配所致。为此，作者提出Culture-MMT——一个针对社交媒体翻译中“分布式证据语用重构”的诊断性基准，包含498个跨20个领域的去标识化UGC实例，按所需证据类型划分为符号型（Symbol）、视觉型（Visual）和混合型（Hybrid）。研究构建了与人类判断对齐的领域特异性评判模型（Judger）及受控评估框架，系统性地调控翻译者可获取的证据类型。实验表明，在17种模型配置下，真实图像使视觉型任务性能提升+0.280，混合型提升+0.197，而符号型仅+0.050；随机图像则无显著增益。此外，人工描述显示，即使视觉事实明确，联合依赖场景仍具挑战性。结果揭示出：文化有效性的社交媒体翻译本质上是基于分布式证据的意义重建过程，其中视觉锚定（visual grounding）与文化-语用适应（cultural-pragmatic adaptation）构成模型的两个独立瓶颈。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35482
作者: Dingming Li,Yiwen Qiu,Linjuan Wu,Hongxing Li,Zixuan Wang,Xinze Lyu,Ye Guo,Daoxin Zhang,Zhe Xu,Weiming Lu,Yongliang Shen
机构: Zhejiang University (浙江大学); Xiaohongshu Inc. (小红书公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbfCulture-MMT, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbfdistributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.

[NLP-25] GPDPO: Learning from Reward Conflicts via Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多奖励强化学习（multi-reward reinforcement learning）中因奖励信号冲突导致的更新方向模糊与优化不稳定性问题。现有方法虽通过奖励重加权、梯度协调或轨迹过滤等方式缓解冲突，但通常仅在单条响应或群体层面处理优化信号，未能充分挖掘采样响应间的相对关系信息，导致部分具有潜在价值的监督信号在过滤过程中被丢弃。本文提出一种名为组帕累托占优策略优化（Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization, GPDPO）的方法，其核心在于从已被冲突过滤的轨迹中恢复成对监督信号：通过识别采样响应间的帕累托占优关系，将其转化为辅助偏好信号，并与原始策略目标联合优化。该机制实现了对已有轨迹的高效再利用，无需额外采样或奖励评估。实验在涵盖多种模型规模与奖励配置的API-Bank基准上验证了GPDPO的优越性，且分析表明其显著降低了群体相对及成对奖励冲突，证实了利用响应间相对关系进行多奖励对齐的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35480
作者: Zixuan Xu,Haoxuan Chen,Jiangxin Sun,Jian-Fang Hu
机构: ISEE Lab, Sun Yat-sen University; Computer Science and Technology, University of Trento
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-reward reinforcement learning offers a promising framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse objectives, but conflicting reward signals can induce ambiguous update directions and hinder stable optimization. Existing approaches address such conflicts through reward reweighting, gradient coordination, or rollout filtering, yet they primarily operate on per-response or group-level optimization signals and underexploit relational information among sampled responses. As a result, conflict-filtered rollouts may still contain useful supervision that is discarded during training. We propose Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization (GPDPO), a multi-reward policy optimization method that recovers pairwise supervision from conflict-filtered rollouts. GPDPO identifies Pareto-dominance relations among sampled responses and converts them into auxiliary preference signals, which are jointly optimized with the original policy objective. This enables more effective reuse of existing rollouts without additional sampling or reward evaluation. Experiments on API-Bank across multiple model scales and reward configurations show that GPDPO consistently outperforms competitive multi-reward optimization baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that GPDPO reduces both group-relative and pairwise reward conflicts, supporting the effectiveness of exploiting relational supervision for multi-reward alignment. Code will be released.

[NLP-26] MANTIS: Multi-Axis News Transformations for Instance-Wise Stress Testing and Worst-Case Training in Fake News Detection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决社交媒体中虚假新闻在经过多样化外观篡改（cosmetic modifications）后导致现有自动检测方法鲁棒性不足的问题。当前方法多依赖表面文本特征或单一风格的重写模式，难以应对复杂多变的伪造手段。为此，研究构建了MANTIS-Bench——一个涵盖写作风格、情感表达与传播框架三个维度的多轴呈现攻击基准数据集，系统化地评估模型在多重篡改下的性能。其核心解决方案是提出MANTIS框架，一种实例自适应的对抗训练机制，能够针对每篇新闻文章动态生成最恶劣的对抗样本进行训练，且在推理阶段无额外开销。该方法将虚假新闻防御从传统的启发式格式平滑策略，转变为基于事实不变性的针对性可信度评估。实验表明，MANTIS在MANTIS-Bench上相较于SheepDog将联合攻击成功率（UASR）降低了3.55个百分点，并在宏平均F1（Macro-F1）上持续优于以往单轴防御方法，同时保持较高的纯净样本准确率，验证了多轴与实例自适应最坏情况训练的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35475
作者: Dexin Liu,Fan Yang,Zimu Wang,Xunfei Zhu,Bolin Ren,Bingyan Zhang,Wei Wang,Qi Chen
机构: Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University, Suzhou, China(西安交通大学-利物浦大学，苏州，中国); University of Liverpool, Liverpool, United Kingdom(利物浦大学，利物浦，英国); Nanjing Sibei Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., Nanjing, China(南京思贝智能科技有限公司，南京，中国)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated fake news detection is vital on social media, where fake news is easily rewritten to fool detectors. However, existing approaches typically rely on superficial writing cues or single-style text rewrites, resulting in poor robustness under diverse cosmetic modifications. We construct MANTIS-Bench, a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark that pairs original news with rewritten views across writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing. We further propose MANTIS, an instance-adaptive adversarial framework enabling dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead. This reframes fake news defense from heuristic format smoothing into targeted, fact-invariant credibility assessment. Experiments on MANTIS-Bench show that MANTIS reduces the Union Attack Success Rate (UASR) by 3.55 percentage points relative to SheepDog on GossipCop and consistently outperforms prior single-axis defenses on Macro-F1 while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-axis and instance-adaptive worst-case training.

[NLP-27] A Contextual Measure of Ambiguity in Prescriptive Text EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决法律、合同、规则、政策或建议等规范性文本中语义模糊性（ambiguity）的量化难题。现有方法多基于文本在孤立状态下的感知差异，难以反映其在具体情境中的实际解释分歧，因而无法有效预测模糊性带来的现实后果（如解释冲突或裁量权滥用）。为此，本文提出一种新的模糊性度量方法：将模糊性定义为一组利益相关方（“评分者”）在多个典型场景（“案例”）下对不同规范性文本（“政策”）适用性的判断分歧程度。通过两个政策领域进行初步分析表明，该方法不仅与真实人类之间的分歧存在显著相关性，且对文本中的虚假特征具有鲁棒性；进一步应用于既有协商数据集，揭示了政策模糊性与其获得支持度之间的关联模式。该方法的核心创新在于将模糊性评估置于上下文交互框架中，实现了对模糊性影响的可预测性量化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35461
作者: Sally Dong,Luke Thorburn,Andrew Konya,Michiel Bakker
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院); AI Democracy Foundation (人工智能民主基金会)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages, EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Ambiguity in prescriptive text such as laws, contracts, rules, policies, or recommendations can be both desirable (e.g., if it enables a law to adapt to changing context, such as new technologies) and undesirable (e.g., if it leads to arbitrary discretion or conflict over the law’s interpretation). To help navigate these trade-offs, it would be valuable to have methods for quantifying ambiguity that are predictive of such outcomes, but existing measures capture how text is perceived in isolation rather than how it is interpreted in context. In this paper, we propose quantifying ambiguity as the degree of disagreement among a set of stakeholders (“raters”) on how alternative prescriptive texts (“policies”) apply in each of a set of relevant scenarios (“cases”). Using two policy domains, we present preliminary analysis suggesting that, even when using simulated raters, this approach (i) correlates with real human disagreement, and (ii) is robust to spurious text features. We then apply the measure to existing deliberation datasets to describe the association between policy ambiguity and support for those policies.

[NLP-28] Skillinfty: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式智能体在实现递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）过程中面临的瓶颈问题，即现有技能优化方法依赖人工设计的固定流程，缺乏对优化过程本身的持续迭代与自适应能力。其核心挑战在于如何使技能优化机制本身具备可自我演化的能力，从而真正实现“以改进方式来改进”的递归闭环。解决方案的关键在于提出Skill^∞框架，通过引入一个元智能体（meta agent）与可自我优化的元技能（meta-skill），使技能优化过程自身成为可被迭代改进的可重用技能。该元技能定义了诊断执行轨迹、生成候选方案、请求独立评审及分配搜索预算等步骤，并可通过相同优化流程进行自我重构与提升。更重要的是，该元技能与具体任务技能解耦，在多个优化任务上进行训练与精炼后，可跨领域复用于不同任务技能的优化。整个优化过程由智能体主导，且所有技能均通过原生技能发现机制加载，实现部署与优化的一致性。实验表明，Skill^∞在83个SkillsBench任务上达到60.7%的通过率，显著优于人工编排技能（56.4%）和SkillEvolver（54.5%），验证了其在实现递归自我改进方面的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35434
作者: Wangcheng Tao,Zhanglu Yan,Han Wu,Weng-Fai Wong
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); City University of Hong Kong(香港城市大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill ^\infty , which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill ^\infty reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.

[NLP-29] Probing the phon* representations of the Mimi codebooks ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音编码器（如Mimi编码器）中首个码本（CB0）所提取的音素表征是否具备语义明确性与音素可区分性的问题。传统ABX评估方法因受限于固定80毫秒的分帧窗口，难以准确反映跨音素边界的信息，因而不适用于此类编码器；为此，本文提出采用强制对齐（forced alignment）、熵分析及音素归一化互信息（Phone-Normalized Mutual Information, PNMI）作为替代评估策略。实验基于TIMIT数据集（SA1/SA2，58/55名说话人），结果表明：尽管单个编码器输出的码本词元（token）与特定音素存在强关联性（PNMI = 0.84，显著高于随机水平），但同一音素通常由多个竞争性词元表示，而非一对一映射，揭示了音素在编码空间中的分布式表征特性。该研究的关键在于通过更适配长时上下文编码结构的评估方法，揭示了神经音频编码器在音素层面的隐含表征机制。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Neural audio codecs are increasingly used to encode speech for integration with large language models. This paper investigates the phonetic representations in the first codebook (CB0) of the Mimi codec. ABX style evaluation is poorly suited to Mimi fixed 80 ms tokenization window, which often spans multiple phonemes; we instead use forced alignment, entropy analysis, and Phone-Normalized Mutual Information (PNMI). Using TIMIT speech (58/55 speakers, SA1/SA2), individual tokens are strongly associated with specific phonemes (PNMI = 0.84, above random), yet phonemes are realized by multiple competing tokens rather than a one-to-one mapping.

[NLP-30] INVAR-Agri: Detecting Discrepancies in Multilingual Operator Manuals of Agricultural Implements with a Fine-Tuned LLM

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决农业机械操作手册多语言翻译后审校流程中的瓶颈问题，即标准要求由具备资质的专业人员对每种语言版本进行人工审核，而这一环节耗时且效率低下。其解决方案的关键在于评估两种基于同一大语言模型（LLM）EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct 的自动化审校工作流的效能：方法A采用回译对比机制，即各语种翻译回英文后与原始英文版本比对；方法B则通过专门训练的检查器同时阅读英文原文与目标语言译文，识别差异。实验结果表明，回译模型虽提升了翻译质量评分，却未能有效识别多数人为植入的错误（尤其是弱化义务性表述），存在显著漏检；相比之下，独立训练的检查器能检测出大部分预设错误，但在单位和非训练样本中的数值变更方面表现较弱。此外，简单规则检查可识别数值与单位错误，但误报率高。对真实芬兰语译文的验证显示，多数警报为假阳性，源于语言特异性表达，因此在实际应用中仍面临精度不足的问题。研究结论认为，在当前设定下，训练后的检查器可作为辅助工具支持专业人员审校，但尚不足以替代人工审查，需更多数据以得出更确定的结论。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Operator manuals of agricultural implements are delivered in many languages, and the standards require that competent persons review every translation, which makes this review the bottleneck. This paper presents a proof of concept that compares two training workflows on the same LLM, EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct, trained on operator manuals of one manufacturer. In approach A, a back-translator translates each language version back into English, and an English reader compares it with the English version. In approach B, a checker reads the English version and the translation together, where the checker reports differences. The test sets contain errors planted in numbers, units, opposite words, obligations, negations, and conditions in 24 languages, and they include unmodified text and meaning-preserving edits for alerts and false alarms. The trained back-translator concealed many planted errors, most of all weakened obligations, while translation-quality scores rose. In contrast, the separately trained checker detected most planted errors, although it was weak for units and for number changes unlike those in training. A check by the author confirmed the concealment. In addition, a simple rule check caught the number and unit changes, but it alerted on harmless rewrites. A check of alerts on real Finnish translations showed that most alerts were false, caused by language-specific wording, so the precision on real text remains a limitation. Within this setting, a trained checker might support, not replace, the review by competent persons, and firmer conclusions need more data.

[NLP-31] ImgMT: Wikipedia-based Dataset For Evaluating Text-in-Image Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决图像中嵌入文本的跨语言翻译问题，特别是针对图文混合场景下的文本信息迁移挑战。传统文本-图像翻译（Text-in-Image Translation, TIT）仅生成目标语言文本，而本文进一步提出“图像内机器翻译”（In-Image Machine Translation, IIMT），即在完成翻译后将结果重新渲染回图像中，实现端到端的视觉化翻译。为支持这一任务，作者构建了ImgMT——一个大规模多语言数据集，基于维基媒体公共库中的本地化SVG图示（如图表、地图与信息图），涵盖129种语言、20余种书写系统及4,886种语言对，包含35,612对齐图像样本，分属1,855个图像集合。其核心解决方案在于提出一种多层次评估协议，综合衡量源端文本区域检测与光学字符识别（OCR）精度，以及目标端翻译质量。实验表明，源语言和书写系统显著影响翻译性能；此外，研究发现ImgMT数据集难以有效隔离视觉信息在多模态翻译中的独立贡献，提示未来需设计更精细的评估范式以深入解析视觉与语义的交互机制。

Abstract:Text-in-image translation aims to translate all textual content embedded in an image. In Text Image Translation (TIT), the output is translated text; In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) additionally renders the translation back into the image. We introduce ImgMT, a massively multilingual dataset and benchmark mined from localized SVG illustrations on Wikimedia Commons, focusing on diagrams, maps, and infographics. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 image sets, spanning 129 languages, 20+ writing systems, and 4,886 language pairs. We propose a multi-level evaluation protocol that measures source-side text-region detection and OCR accuracy alongside target-side translation quality. We benchmark several multimodal large language models and a dedicated TIT system in English-X and X-English settings, and find that the source language and writing system substantially affect TIT quality. Finally, we show that ImgMT is not well suited for isolating the contribution of visual information in multimodal translation. [NLP-32] he Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale Depth and Instruction Tuning

【速读】： 该论文旨在揭示大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在情感表征上的几何结构及其随模型规模与微调过程的变化规律。其核心问题是：不同规模及训练阶段的LLMs是否共享一致的情感几何结构？该结构如何在模型内部传播？解决方案的关键在于采用基于Sofroniew等人（2026）提出的提取流程，系统性地分析谷歌Gemma 2系列六个模型（包括基础版与指令微调版）在情感向量空间中的几何特性。研究发现，所有模型均表现出稳定的“核心情感几何结构”——通过线性映射可将一个模型的情感向量精确投射至另一模型中，且未被观测到的情感词在目标模型中的排名中位数为1；经清洗嵌入表后，所有测试对均能在秩1处恢复目标情感。此外，模型规模扩大使情感几何的方差分布更广，但其与人类情感效价（valence）的相关性保持稳定（介于0.71至0.78之间）。进一步分析显示，情感词在输出词汇表中的可检索性随模型深度变化：小模型（2B、9B）中情感词从第0层即进入前10,000名，而大模型（27B）则需至第23层才首次进入，表明深层表示中情感语义的涌现性增强。最后，指令微调虽使效价相关性提升、唤醒度相关性下降，但整体仍维持在各层级的基线之下，且主成分2（PC2）的方差占比显著降低，中后期层稳定性高于预期，暗示其源于基础27B模型末层的内在结构。该研究通过系统性的几何分析框架，揭示了情感表征在大规模语言模型中的演化机制。

作者: Adam Hollowell
机构: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google’s Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry’s variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component’s share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector’s own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2’s variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B’s final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

[NLP-33] Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在使用约束解码（constrained decoding）时，普遍被认为会损害模型推理能力的假设。研究通过构建三类约束类型——格式约束（format constraints）、有效性约束（validity constraints）和推理路径约束（reasoning constraints），系统分析其对模型性能的影响。研究表明，约束解码本身并不必然导致性能下降，关键在于约束类型与输出空间的匹配：适当设计的约束可通过排除无效推理路径来维持甚至提升性能。实验结果表明，性能下降主要源于提示（prompting）方式与输出格式不一致，而非解码器层面的屏蔽机制；其中，有效性约束可显著提高输出的可靠性与可提取性，而合理的推理路径约束则能引导有益的推理轨迹，从而提升准确率。因此，约束解码的有效性取决于约束类型及其所移除的输出空间特性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35328
作者: Ngoc Trinh Hung Nguyen,Alonso Silva,Armen Aghasaryan,Mehwish Alam
机构: Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, France; Nokia Bell Labs
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Constrained decoding guarantees that Large Language Models (LLMs) produce outputs conforming to predefined formats, but is often assumed to inherently degrade reasoning. We examine this assumption through a taxonomy of three constraint types: \emphformat constraints, which enforce output structure; \emphvalidity constraints, which mask invalid answer; and \emphreasoning constraints, which restrict reasoning trajectories. We theoretically show that appropriate constraints can preserve or improve performance by eliminating invalid paths. Across four model families and eleven open-source models, causal ablations on diverse benchmarks using state-of-the-art constrained decoding strategies reveal that apparent performance degradation largely stems from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than from decoder-level masking. Meanwhile, validity constraints improve reliability and extractability by eliminating invalid answers, while reasoning constraints can improve reasoning and, consequently, accuracy when they enforce beneficial trajectories. These findings show that the impact of constrained decoding depends on the type of constraint and the output space it removes. Our code is available.

[NLP-34] Did the Model Use That? Counterfactual Training Boosts Self-Attribution in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在回答问题时难以准确揭示外部信息对其输出影响的问题，即缺乏对自身响应是否依赖于附加信息的可解释性与责任性。其核心挑战在于：当前主流模型极少能正确识别并仅在真实受外部信息影响时进行自归因，甚至存在错误归因非相关信息的情况。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为CREDIT的新方法，通过引入反事实（counterfactual）标签直接监督最终答案层面的自归因行为，无需人工标注。该方法有效克服了传统基于推理链微调或提示工程中“承认”未传递至最终输出的问题，在四个开源模型上显著提升了自归因能力，并展现出对未见信息类型及矛盾来源提示的部分泛化性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35295
作者: Zikai Zhou,Jiacheng Sang,Yilin Xu,Yufei Jin,Monica S. Lam
机构: Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Duke University (杜克大学); Emory University (埃默里大学); UCLA (加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 29 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A fundamental challenge for explainable and accountable language models is revealing how external information influences their answers. This paper examines whether models are self-attributive: that is, whether they indicate when – and only when – their responses to questions are influenced by information provided alongside the question. Furthermore, we explore how self-attribution can be improved through counterfactual training, which explicitly teaches models to distinguish between answers that do and do not depend on supplied information. We found that most of the eleven frontier models rarely attribute influential information in their answers, and the rest attribute non-influential information. Training acknowledgment into reasoning does not fix this: the acknowledgment does not reach the final answer. We introduce CREDIT, which directly supervises final-answer self-attribution with counterfactual labels, without the need for human annotation. CREDIT substantially improves attribution in four open models, including two distilled reasoning models, and outperforms reasoning-level fine-tuning and prompting baselines. Among answers that agree with a user’s suggestion, CREDIT distinguishes those changed by the suggestion from those the model would have given anyway. Gains transfer partly to unseen information types and prompts containing sources that support conflicting answers. Comments: 29 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. [NLP-35] he Voice on the Line

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决单麦克风环境下语音通话中说话人分离（voice isolation）的难题，尤其针对长时对话中因注意力窗口限制导致的说话人遗忘与孤立说话人语音质量退化问题。其核心挑战在于：在真实通话场景下，当某位说话人长时间沉默后重新发言，或仅有单一说话人持续讲话时，传统模型易丢失该说话人的语音特征或造成其语音损伤。解决方案的关键在于引入基于因果掩码机制的可训练语音隔离器（causal voice isolators），并利用预训练的WavLM-Large模型权重进行参数迁移与微调。通过将大模型的深层语义表示能力注入轻量级学生模型，显著提升了对长对话、多轮交替发言及实际耳机串扰等复杂场景的鲁棒性；特别是采用从长通话片段中截取短窗口进行训练的方法，有效缓解了初始阶段无说话人信号的训练盲区，使开发集错误率从3.92%降至2.96%。最终发布的模型在实时场景下表现优异，在AMI测试集上达到16.13%词错误率，优于最强开源基线VoxLock（23.66%），且可在仅22.1M参数、单个CPU线程、每帧20ms延迟的条件下运行，具备良好的部署可行性。

作者: Husein Zolkepli
机构: 未知

Abstract:A transcriber listening through one microphone also hears everyone near it. We train causal voice isolators: masking transformers of 140M, 243M and 374M parameters, 20 ms of latency, enrolling the caller from the call itself. Short evaluation windows hide two failures that real calls expose: forgetting the caller when another voice talks alone for a while, and damaging a caller who is alone. Long calls with turns, memory beyond the attention window, real headset crosstalk and drifting caller levels address both, but each trades one against the other. WavLM-Large’s own weights, made causal and trained with the model, move the trade: M with them (555M parameters) lowers the error on our development sets from 11.44% to 10.55%; a student trained from scratch to imitate WavLM does not, and w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper’s encoder, pre-trained on far more audio, help less or not at all. A lone caller loses most at the start of a recording: no training call opened with someone already talking. Training on windows cut from longer calls lowers the error on clean development calls from 3.92% to 2.96%; this is our release. Live, the release makes 16.13% word errors on 60 s AMI windows, against 23.66% for VoxLock, the strongest open isolator, and 10.19% on its own AMI windows, against 11.71%; it is level on Krisp’s benchmark (5.74% against 5.63%), and a caller who is alone still loses more words than with VoxLock (5.58% against 2.92% on clean test calls). Distilled into 22.1M parameters without WavLM, it runs live on one CPU thread inside a LiveKit agent, at 33% of a core per call in 20 ms frames, with 10.66% error on our development sets (the release 10.49%). We open-source the release and this CPU model, with a LiveKit plugin, at this https URL.

[NLP-36] MechAlign: Evaluating Semantic Alignment at the Project Level in Mathematical Formalization

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决形式化证明系统（如Lean）中形式命题与数学手稿中数学主张之间语义对齐不一致的问题。尽管Lean可验证形式证明在预设假设下逻辑正确，但无法确保形式命题准确反映手稿中的原始数学意图，尤其当关键依赖项分散于大型项目时，这种偏差难以察觉。其解决方案的核心是提出MechAlign框架，通过结合形式依赖提取与大语言模型（LLM）评估实现项目级语义对齐审查。该框架的关键组件为LeanTrace，它能从展开的声明中构建保留定义体与结构约束、排除证明体并止于显式库边界的语句依赖图；评审者利用此上下文分析命题与手稿间的对应关系，并基于局部证据报告差异。研究以201个来自OpenAI Math项目的主定理进行初步评估，通过提供的非形式描述和论文上下文识别出语义偏离，例如在一个双曲群案例中定位到缺失的维数约束，其与上游形式化范围声明一致。此外，作者构建了LeanReviewBench基准数据集，包含501组固定“主张-陈述-上下文”三元组及描述来源记录，支持对项目级语义对齐评估方法的可控比较。

作者: Hao Shen,Ruichen Qiu,Lihong Zhi,Xiao-Shan Gao
机构: State Key Laboratory of Mathematical Sciences, Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院数学与系统科学研究院数学科学国家重点实验室); University of Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院大学)
