Abstract:Lean verifies that a formal proof establishes its stated proposition under declared assumptions, but does not check whether that proposition faithfully expresses the mathematical claim in a manuscript. Assessing this correspondence requires interpreting the main theorem through its project dependencies, which may be scattered throughout a large development. We introduce MechAlign, a framework for project-level semantic alignment review that combines formal dependency extraction with LLM-based assessment. Its extraction tool, LeanTrace, constructs a statement dependency graph from elaborated declarations, retaining definition bodies and structure constraints while excluding proof bodies and stopping at an explicit library boundary. The reviewer uses this context to investigate alignment and report discrepancies with localized evidence. We conduct a preliminary review of 201 main results from 173 OpenAI Math projects, using supplied informal descriptions and available paper context. A hyperbolic-group case illustrates how dependency inspection localizes a missing dimensional constraint relative to the manuscript, consistent with the upstream declaration of formalization scope. We also construct LeanReviewBench, comprising 501 fixed claim-statement-context triples from OpenAI Math, Fermat’s Last Theorem, and Kakeya, with description provenance recorded. The resource supports controlled comparisons of more project-level semantic alignment evaluations.

[NLP-37] he Lay of the Land in Idiom-Translation Quality Estimation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决机器翻译中习语（idiom）翻译质量评估的可靠性问题，特别是现有质量评估（Quality Estimation, QE）系统是否能够有效区分习语的恰当意译与错误直译。其核心挑战在于，当前多数QE指标和模型存在显著的“字面性偏差”（literality bias），倾向于为直译结果打分更高，而忽视了习语应以意译为优的语言特性。解决方案的关键在于构建首个跨九种目标语言的平行数据集，该数据集包含带有习语的英文句子及其对应的字面翻译与意译版本，并通过多句段落形式及分级字面性连续体进行增强，从而实现对习语翻译质量的精细化评估。基于此数据集，研究对比了11个传统QE指标（COMET与MetricX系列）以及10个大型语言模型（LLM，来自Qwen-3、Gemma-4和OLMo-3系列）作为类GEMBA判官的表现，发现仅有MetricX-24-Hybrid（XL, XXL）和Gemma-4-31B能稳定地将意译评分高于直译，且仅Gemma-4-31B具备可靠区分不同程度意译与字面表达的能力。研究结论警示：在富含修辞语言的领域，不应直接使用标准QE指标，因其高分可能反而奖励不恰当的字面化翻译。

机构: Inria(法国国家信息与自动化研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Idioms have long been a challenge for machine translation, and while large language models (LLMs) have proven increasingly adept at handling them, whether quality estimation (QE) systems have kept pace and can reliably score idiomatic renderings of these expressions above faulty literal ones remains unclear. We introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, augmented into multi-sentence segments and a graded literality continuum. Using this dataset, we benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, display a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. Higher parameter counts and newer training sets appear to reduce this bias to an extent; nevertheless, of all the benchmarked systems, only MetricX-24-Hybrid (XL, XXL) and Gemma-4-31B consistently rate idiomatic translations of idioms above literal ones, and only Gemma-4-31B reliably ranks intermediate degrees of idiomaticity and literality. Our findings caution against deploying standard QE metrics in domains rich in figurative language, where higher scores might be rewarding undesirable literalism.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在学术同行评审中的可靠性问题，特别是大语言模型（LLM）在评估科研论文时可能受到与科学内容无关的语言特征干扰的隐患。其核心解决方案在于构建一个受控实验框架，通过系统性地改变论文的语言风格，包括模拟母语与非母语英语写作特征以及高置信度与低置信度表达特征，同时严格保持原始科学内容不变。该方法基于语言学文献设计细粒度重写指令，并借助大语言模型实现干预。实验结果揭示出一个关键缺陷：基于 LLM 的同行评审存在显著偏倚，会系统性地偏好语气自信的表达，而忽视实际科学内容质量，暴露出当前 LLM 评审机制在鲁棒性方面的严重脆弱性。

作者: Sai Suresh Macharla Vasu,Sumedh Santosh Joshi,Philipp Christmann,Ivaxi Sheth,Ruta Binkyte,Koel Dutta Chowdhury,Raouf Kerkouche,Hui-Po Wang,Mario Fritz
机构: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security; German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI); University of Technology Nuremberg; INRIA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Preprint. Submitted to ICLR 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The number of paper submissions to major AI conferences has increased dramatically in recent years, substantially increasing the peer-review workload of researchers. At the same time, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support peer review, both by individual reviewers and by conference organizations. While LLM capabilities have improved considerably, their evaluations may be influenced by linguistic characteristics that are unrelated to scientific content. In this work, we introduce a controlled experimental framework for studying such effects by systematically perturbing the linguistic style of research papers. Specifically, we rewrite papers to exhibit (i) linguistic features associated with native or non-native English writing, and (ii) high- or low-confidence linguistic features. To construct these interventions, we derive fine-grained rewriting instructions grounded in the linguistic literature and apply them using LLMs. Crucially, our interventions are designed to preserve the underlying scientific content. We then evaluate the resulting papers using different LLM reviewers. Our experiments expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-based peer review: reviewers systematically reward confident rhetoric independent of scientific content, raising serious concerns about the robustness of their assessments.

[NLP-39] Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决艺术作品中情感识别的挑战，即情感意义具有主观性、隐含性，并依赖于视觉形式与语义关联之间的复杂关系。现有基于视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）的方法在直接进行图像到情感的预测时，往往忽略了形式、语义与情感线索之间显式关联的重要性，导致对情感解释的支持不足。为此，论文提出一种基于图结构的框架——视觉-语义情感图（Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs, VSAG），其核心在于将艺术作品表示为可解释的特征节点图，包括颜色、笔触、构图、光影、线条质量以及提取的视觉实体等关键视觉特征。该图通过学习特征与情感之间的关联来实现主导情感预测，并引入可选的层次化辅助情感模块，以建模效价-唤醒（valence-arousal）结构，从而实现从粗粒度到细粒度的情感层次化表达。实验表明，相较于直接使用Qwen3-VL和InternVL3.5进行VLM推理的基线方法，基于图结构的VSAG及其变体VSAG-TopK显著提升了主导情感预测性能，尤其在准确率、宏平均F1和加权平均F1上均取得最优结果；进一步分析显示，效价-唤醒层次结构作为粗到细的情感推理机制，比简单后处理修正更有效，且图模型与VLM捕捉到的情感信号具有部分互补性。研究结果表明，显式的视觉-语义结构不仅有助于提升情感预测性能，还能增强对艺术作品情感内涵的可解释性。

Abstract:Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.

[NLP-40] rainable Boundary-Keeping Where No Formal Answer Exists: A Controlled Knock-In Study of Reward Training in Evidence-Sufficiency Judgment

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在证据充分性判断任务中是否能通过推理调优与奖励训练实现更可靠的因果主张拒绝能力这一关键问题。研究发现，尽管缺乏可判定的正确性奖励信号，采用“监督微调（SFT）后接基于人类反馈的强化学习（GRPO）”的边界保持策略，可使模型自发正确拒绝率从25%提升至100%，显著优于基线（95%置信区间下限为91.2%，与基线区间[14.2%, 40.2%]无重叠），而随机配对对照组则表现崩溃（自发正确拒绝仅5%，邀请式正确拒绝7.5%）。其核心解决方案在于：最终边界保持能力可通过训练实现，无需依赖推理时的验证器；该效应具有边界特异性而非泛化性拒绝，自动误拒率在281个结构良好命题上仅为1.1%（95%置信上限3.09%），且针对特定测试项的复核结果亦显示极低误拒率（0/18和1/18）。机制分析表明，奖励内化最终动作状态（H2假设）是主要解释路径，而模型在计算检查等具体推理行为上的主动参与度仍接近零，暗示其决策机制可能不依赖显式的逻辑验证过程。研究局限在于仅在同家族140亿参数模型间进行控制实验，未涵盖跨家族泛化或独立人工专家验证。

Abstract:Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-© recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. A pre-registered mechanism adjudication favors reward internalization of final-action status (H2, best-supported, not proven). The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.

[NLP-41] DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）在强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）训练过程中面临的细粒度信用分配难题，即由于迭代去噪机制导致最终输出奖励难以有效反映各词元（token）对结果的贡献。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为去噪词元信用分配（Denoising Token Credit Assignment, DTCA）的框架，关键在于通过测量在词元确定后剩余掩码位置预测置信度的提升来量化词元贡献，并依据词性（Part-of-Speech, POS）类别对贡献信号进行分组；进而利用这些贡献权重选择具有信息量的去噪步骤，并在强化学习训练中为每个词元分配精细化的学习信号。此外，DTCA还根据策略更新引发的词元级熵变化对学习信号进行自适应校准，以增强训练稳定性与有效性。实验结果表明，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct模型上，DTCA在不同生成预算下均显著提升数学推理能力，相较基线模型在MATH500和GSM8K测试集上分别取得最高达9.0和5.3的性能提升。

机构: Zhejiang University (浙江大学); National University of Singapore (新加坡国立大学); SAP(思爱普)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, enabling bidirectional context modeling and parallel token refinement. Recent studies have applied reinforcement learning (RL) to DLMs and improved their reasoning performance. However, the iterative denoising process makes credit assignment more challenging, as final outcome rewards provide limited information about how different tokens contribute to the final output. In this paper, we propose Denoising Token Credit Assignment (DTCA), a framework for token-level credit assignment in reinforcement learning for diffusion language models. DTCA estimates token contributions by measuring the improvement in prediction confidence of remaining masked positions after token commitment and groups these signals according to part-of-speech (POS) categories. These contribution weights are used to select informative denoising timesteps and assign token-level learning signals during RL training. DTCA further calibrates these learning signals according to token-level entropy changes induced by policy updates. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct show that DTCA consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance across different generation budgets, with gains of up to 9.0 points on MATH500 and 5.3 points on GSM8K over the base model.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Given that the Chinese are one of the oldest ethnic groups to immigrate to the US, their cuisine have become central to the US dining scene and an interesting avenue to study how Chinese immigrants have culturally adapted into American life. In that regard, previous research has focused on analyzing the English names that Chinese restaurants adopt, e.g., finding the use of familiar and typical words. To investigate how Chinese immigrants have culturally integrated in the US depending on social, geographic and demographic contexts, we investigate in this work the under-explored relationship between the Chinese and English names of American Chinese restaurants. Specifically, we conduct a study on 3,172 Chinese restaurants (10% of the total on Google Maps) sampled across the US. We present 8-dimension name frames to capture the underlying meanings behind names and create the NameFrames dataset containing 884 annotated parallel Chinese/English names. We also built an NLP pipeline to analyze the semantic discrepancies between names with both frame-based and embedding-based distance metrics. Our frame analysis shows that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty, while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity and Ambiance. Furthermore, we observe that for Chinese restaurants located in urban areas, those in counties with a higher concentration of Chinese population, or those that are relatively new, the discrepancies between the English and Chinese names are noticeably larger. Finally, interviews with 10 Chinese restaurant owners reveal additional interesting insights regarding naming conventions.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）在计算社会科学中用于基于编码本（codebook）的内容分析时，其文本标注结果的可靠性与鲁棒性问题。尽管已有研究显示大语言模型（LLM）在预测性能上表现优异，但其在实际应用中是否存在隐匿的系统性失败模式仍不明确。论文的关键解决方案在于通过大规模实证分析，系统评估五种主流大语言模型在四个数据集上的编码管道在受控扰动、领域迁移及优化策略下的稳定性、鲁棒性与概念有效性。研究发现，即使在高聚合指标（如准确率和微平均F1）表现良好的情况下，模型仍普遍存在标签层面的显著差异、运行间不稳定性、对领域变化的高度敏感性以及标签语义解释的偏移等隐蔽失败模式。这些缺陷在常规评估指标下难以察觉，且在广泛采用的优化策略下依然持续存在。因此，论文强调当前基于大语言模型的编码流程不能被视为稳定可靠的测量工具，必须在超越聚合性能的基础上进行针对性验证。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.

[NLP-44] Do Language Models Understand Igbo Culture? Beyond Multiple Choice

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前语言模型在服务特定文化群体时，普遍缺乏对目标社区本土文化深层理解的问题，尤其聚焦于非洲尼日利亚的伊博族（Igbo）文化语境。现有评估基准多基于西方概念的翻译，未能真实反映非西方文化的复杂性与深度。为此，研究提出CAB-Igbo——一个源自伊博族本土文化资源、经由母语者跨六个领域验证的新型评估基准。其核心解决方案在于构建以社区知识为基础的文化评估体系，通过多维度评估指标（包括认知真实性、表征丰富性、语言质量与语用熟练度）结合自动评分与人工评价，系统检验模型在伊博语环境下的表现。关键发现表明：多数模型在英语语境下已存在严重的认知真实性与表征丰富性缺失，切换至伊博语后并未显著恶化，反而因母语提示导致语言质量与语用能力下降；唯有Gemini 2.0 Flash在伊博语提示下表现出文化知识的提升。研究进一步揭示，当前模型常通过模式匹配在多项选择题中伪装理解，而自动化评价虽能捕捉语言质量，却无法有效识别认知层面的文化误读。因此，结论强调：文化评估必须根植于社区本体知识，人类评估应作为衡量低资源语言文化对齐性的黄金标准，以避免全球范围内对边缘化社群的系统性误表征。

Abstract:The value of language models for any community depends on whether a model actually understands the culture of the people it intends to serve. We use the Igbo language as a case study. Existing benchmarks test translated Western ideas, lacking depth. To address this, we introduce CAB-Igbo, a benchmark developed from indigenous cultural sources and verified by native speakers across six domains. We evaluated diverse models under varying conditions, incorporating regional personas. Performance was assessed using multiple-choice accuracy and human evaluations across Epistemic Fidelity, Representational Richness, Linguistic Quality, and Pragmatic Proficiency. Results reveal a stark dissociation between language fluency and cultural knowledge. Through statistical testing, we show that for most models, the severe lack of Epistemic Fidelity and Representational Richness is already present in English and does not significantly worsen when switching to Igbo. Instead, native language prompting mainly degrades Linguistic Quality and Pragmatic Proficiency. Gemini 2.0 Flash is the only model whose cultural knowledge scores improve under Igbo prompting. We find that current models struggle to demonstrate the knowledge needed for true alignment with Igbo, and multiple-choice formats allow pattern-matching to appear as understanding. Furthermore, automated judges agree with humans on linguistic quality but fail on epistemic fidelity. Ultimately, cultural evaluation must be built from community knowledge, establishing human evaluation as the gold standard to prevent misrepresenting low-resource communities globally.

[NLP-45] CalibraRL: Confidence-Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Hallucinations in RAG

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成回答时存在“看似合理但错误”的幻觉问题，尤其针对传统基于结果的强化学习奖励机制无法区分不同置信度下的错误回答、忽视查询层面回答可靠性差异的问题。其核心挑战在于：固定奖励策略难以有效惩罚高自信错误，也未能合理引导模型在不确定时选择拒答。为此，论文提出CalibraRL框架，其关键创新在于将响应置信度与查询级别的回答证据纳入奖励设计。对于非拒答响应，通过结合正确性效用与基于Brier分数的惩罚项，促使置信度与实际正确性保持一致；对于拒答行为，则利用从各采样组中非拒答响应的正确性推导出的贝塔后验分布，估计条件回答可靠性，并使拒答奖励随模型在非拒答任务上的准确率低于预设阈值的概率而增加。该方法无需额外标注“模型是否知道答案”，可复用训练回放数据。实验表明，相较于强基线，CalibraRL显著提升了答案精度并减少了幻觉现象，在两个主干模型和三个问答数据集上平均降低了30.8%的期望校准误差（Expected Calibration Error, ECE），展现出提升检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）在网页搜索中可靠性的潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35142
作者: Qianchi Zhang,Hainan Zhang,Liang Pang,Hongwei Zheng,Zhiming Zheng
机构: Beihang University (北京航空航天大学); Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院计算技术研究所); Beijing Academy of Blockchain and Edge Computing (北京市区块链与边缘计算研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) often produce plausible but incorrect answers, motivating reinforcement learning methods that reward correct answers, penalize incorrect answers, and allow abstention. However, fixed outcome-based rewards do not distinguish incorrect responses with different confidence levels or account for differences in answering reliability across queries. Consequently, such rewards may inadequately penalize overconfident errors and fail to discourage unnecessary abstention. We propose CalibraRL, a reinforcement learning framework that incorporates response confidence and query-level answering evidence into reward design. For non-abstaining responses, CalibraRL combines correctness-based utility with a Brier-based penalty that encourages agreement between confidence and correctness. For abstentions, it estimates conditional answering reliability using a Beta posterior derived from the correctness of non-abstaining responses within each sampled group. The abstention reward increases with the posterior probability that the model’s accuracy on non-abstaining responses is below a predefined threshold. CalibraRL reuses training rollouts without requiring additional annotations indicating whether the model knows the answer to each question. Experiments on three QA datasets demonstrate that CalibraRL improves answer precision and reduces hallucinations compared with strong baselines. Further analysis shows that CalibraRL reduces mean expected calibration error (ECE) by 30.8% across two backbone models and three datasets, highlighting its potential to improve the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in web search.

[NLP-46] Quality over Quantity: Rethinking Data and Model Assumptions for Bengali Coreference Resolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言变换器模型在低资源语言环境下进行指代消解（coreference resolution）任务时泛化能力不足的问题，尤其针对拥有超过2.5亿使用者但标注数据稀缺的孟加拉语（Bengali）。研究发现，现有假设如“模型具备跨语言泛化能力”或“数据量越大效果越好”在实际中并不成立。其解决方案的关键在于：高质量标注数据相较于大规模低质量数据具有显著优势（p < 0.01），且数据增强（特别是回译）不仅未能提升性能，反而可能降低效果；跨语言迁移学习表现不稳定，从远距离语言（如英语）迁移会损害性能，而从近亲语言（如印地语）迁移亦无一致收益。此外，部分广泛使用的多语言模型存在嵌入空间坍缩现象，导致其不适用于基于相似性的聚类任务。因此，该研究强调在低资源自然语言处理中，应优先保障标注质量，并提供实证依据以指导指代消解系统在资源匮乏语言中的有效构建。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35114
作者: Zenith Biswas,Andrew Thomas Dyer
机构: Saarland University (萨尔兰大学); Saarbrücken, Germany
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at KONVENS 2026, Hamburg, Germany. 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multilingual transformer models are often assumed to generalise across languages, but their effectiveness for coreference resolution in low-resource settings remains unverified. We investigate this gap in Bengali, a language with over 250 million speakers but limited annotated coreference resources. We evaluate transformer-based pre-trained encoders under multiple settings, including zero-shot, fine-tuning, data augmentation, and cross-lingual transfer. Our results challenge several common assumptions about model generalisation and data efficiency in low-resource NLP. We demonstrate that a small amount of high-quality annotated data significantly outperforms larger mixed-quality datasets (p 0.01). We find that data augmentation, particularly back-translation, does not improve performance and can degrade results in coreference resolution. Cross-lingual transfer is also inconsistent: transfer from a distant language like English reduces performance, and transfer from the related language Hindi provides no consistent benefit across models. Several widely used multilingual models exhibit collapsed embedding spaces, rendering them unsuitable for similarity-based clustering tasks. These findings highlight the importance of annotation quality over data quantity and provide empirical guidance for developing coreference resolution systems in low-resource languages.

[NLP-47] Rethinking Evaluation for Principled Generalization Using a Kripkean Challenge to Meaning as Use

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在语义理解上面临的“规则遵循挑战”（rule-following challenge），即尽管模型通过大量使用实例（use）习得语义，但有限的历史使用模式无法唯一确定未来扩展的规则。基于克里普克（Kripke）对维特根斯坦（Wittgenstein）思想的诠释，论文指出，仅依赖训练数据中的使用模式不足以保证模型具备真正的语义能力。这一问题不仅关乎模型在分布外（OOD）泛化时的表现，也深刻影响自然语言处理（NLP）评估范式——当前主流基准测试往往聚焦于固定用例或局部鲁棒性，而这些指标本身无法充分证明模型具备真正的语义能力。为此，论文提出应从两个核心能力入手进行更本质的评估：抽象（abstraction）与递归（recursion），二者是模型在原则性域外扩展中保持规则与概念一致性的关键；并设计了一套实验范式以系统检验这两项能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35111
作者: Niyar R Barman,Omar Naim,Nicholas Asher
机构: Université de Toulouse(图卢兹大学); IRIT(图卢兹信息科学研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models operationalize an intuitive, view of meaning as use. We argue that it faces a rule-following challenge. Using Kripke’s interpretation of Wittgenstein, we argue that finite histories of use do not determine a unique rule for future extension. This reframes the debate about OOD generalization but also about NLP evaluation; benchmarks that measure performance on fixed use cases or local robustness, we argue, do not by themselves establish semantic competence. To evaluate whether models preserve rules and concepts under principled domain extension, we propose to evaluate two capacities, central to this ability: abstraction and recursion; and we offer an experimental paradigm for testing both.

[NLP-48] RAG ing Against Misogyny: Improving Implicit Misogyny Explanations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决隐性性别歧视（implicit misogyny）识别与解释中的核心难题，即其理解高度依赖背景知识，而传统大语言模型（LLM）在缺乏相关知识支持时易出现误判或解释不足的问题。为此，论文提出一种基于检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）的框架，通过整合百科全书、俚语及女性主义文献等多源知识，提升对英语和意大利语中隐性性别歧视的检测精度与解释可读性。研究的关键在于验证不同知识来源对检测与解释质量的贡献，并评估RAG是否缓解了大语言模型在处理隐性性别歧视时常见的失效模式。实验结果表明，RAG显著提升了在ImplicIT-Mis数据集上的召回率，且人类评估显示其生成的解释在两种语言中均优于无RAG的基准方案；其中，女性主义文献作为知识源表现出最强的一致性有效性，成为提升检测与解释能力的核心要素。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Implicit misogyny often requires background knowledge to be understood. To address this challenge, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for detecting and explaining implicit misogyny in English and Italian, leveraging encyclopedic, slang and feminist knowledge sources. Using the ImplicIT-Mis and SBIC+ datasets, we evaluate the contribution of each knowledge source to detection and explanation quality, investigating also whether RAG addresses known LLM failure modes in implicit misogyny. Results show that RAG improves recall on ImplicIT-Mis, but does not improve detection performance on SBIC+. However, human evaluation shows that RAG-based explanations are preferred over no-RAG explanations in both languages. Feminist literature emerges as the most consistently useful source for detection and explanation.

[NLP-49] Ask Before You Answer: A Question-Driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture (QERA) for In-Context Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）在处理用户真实生活场景下的网络痕迹（如群聊记录、社区讨论、活动日志与编辑历史等）时，因隐含规则（implicit rubrics）难以显式表达而导致推理准确率低的问题。尽管这些上下文信息对任务完成至关重要，但其关键约束往往未在用户请求中直接体现，导致模型无法有效识别和遵循。解决方案的核心在于提出一种基于问题驱动的证据推理架构——QERA，其关键创新在于“先提问，后回答”的范式：首先将原始请求转化为结构化的需验证要求清单与类型化信息需求，并通过代码确保对用户原始表述的忠实性；随后，在完整对话上下文中检索证据，以受控方式重复提问并利用代码验证引用内容，最后执行局部修复。QERA无需训练或依赖预设评分标准，仅需约四次LLM调用即可完成任务，在405个任务上显著优于三种推理时基线方法（平均解决率达21.0%，高于最强基线18.2%），尤其在处理隐含规则方面表现突出，且在生成效率上优于对比方法。

作者: Jinhu Qi,Minda Hu,Wentao Zhang,Zixing Song,Irwin King
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong, China; Macao Polytechnic University, Macao, China; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong, China
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 12 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI assistants are increasingly asked to reason over a user’s own web traces: group chats, community threads, activity logs and revision histories. On CL-bench Life, a benchmark of such real-life context learning, frontier LLMs solve fewer than one task in five. We find that the request is not the specification: over 80% of the benchmark’s rubrics share less than 60% of their content words with the final request, as for a rule set two turns earlier or every record that meets the user’s criterion, and LLMs answering directly pass only 67% of these implicit rubrics against 81% of the others. We propose QERA, a Question-driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture that asks before it answers. QERA first turns the request into a requirement checklist and typed information needs, filtered by code for faithfulness to the user’s words; it then answers from the whole conversation, asks the same questions again with quotes verified by code, and applies a guarded local repair. It needs no training or rubrics and makes about four LLM calls per task. On all 405 tasks with four frontier LLMs, QERA attains the highest solving rate on every LLM (21.0% on average, against 18.2% for the strongest of three inference-time baselines and 14.6% for direct answering) and leads every baseline significantly when pooled across LLMs, while using fewer tokens than PSCI and 4-5% of the tokens of Ctx2Skill. Ablations on GPT-6-Luna show that the gain is settled before the answer, by a fixed answer protocol (+3.8 rubric points) and the request-specific questions (+1.6), and that it is concentrated on implicit rubrics, with checking afterwards refining mainly numeric requirements.

[NLP-50] CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在组合使用可复用的“技能”（Skill）时，因技能间交互导致策略违规的问题。现有方法仅对单个技能进行独立验证，无法识别多技能协作过程中产生的新型违规行为，此类问题被定义为“技能冲突”（Conflict of Skills, CoS）。其核心问题是：某些技能生成的输出或评估信号在跨技能传递时，未保留原始使用场景中的权限限制或授权条件，从而引发数据泄露、未经授权的状态修改及不安全执行等风险。论文的关键解决方案是提出“技能冲突攻击”（Conflict of Skills Attack, CoSA），通过向已有技能池中引入本地允许但潜在危险的技能，实现能力补充或重构技能间的上下文依赖关系（如结果传递、决策复用与目标-动作绑定），而无需改变原有技能或运行时权限。为系统评估该威胁，作者构建了CoSA-Bench基准测试集，涵盖招聘、金融、IT等多个真实业务场景的288项任务。实验表明，在仅增加5%新技能的情况下，策略违规率从35.02%上升至58.45%，显著提升。进一步的追踪分析揭示，违规行为主要源于新增技能与原有技能之间的跨技能依赖关系。为此，论文设计了一种轻量级的宿主层防护机制，通过在关键操作前检查信息流与授权状态，有效缓解该类攻击；在OpenClaw招聘任务中，违规率由65.28%降至6.67%，同时对正常任务的完成率影响极小（从66.67%降至65.00%），验证了其高效性与实用性。

Abstract:Agent Skills allow LLM agents to combine reusable capabilities, but checking each Skill in isolation cannot rule out policy violations when they are composed. We term such failures Conflict of Skills (CoS): artifacts or assessment signals produced for one purpose may be reused downstream without preserving the restrictions or authorization needed for their new use. Using controlled executions of publicly available Skills and matched single-Skill controls, we identify four recurring mechanisms behind CoS. Building on these findings, we introduce the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA), which adds locally admitted Skills to an existing pool to supply missing business operations (capability supplementation) or reshape artifact exchange, decision reuse, and target/action bindings (relationship reshaping). CoSA leaves existing Skills and runtime permissions unchanged. To evaluate this threat under autonomous Skill selection, we introduce CoSA-Bench, built from real-world Skills and controlled services, with 288 tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, covering data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution. Across five LLMs and three agent harnesses, additions capped at 5% of each original pool raise the policy-violation rate from 35.02% to 58.45%, an increase of 23.43 percentage points. Trace analysis links compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. Finally, we develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. On OpenClaw recruiting tasks across five models, the guard reduces violations from 65.28% to 6.67%, while policy-compliant task completion on matched benign controls changes from 66.67% to 65.00%.

[NLP-51] Improving VLMs on Scientific Chart Analysis via Autonomous Evolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）在科学图表问答任务中因推理管道设计不当而导致的准确率低下问题，尤其关注模型在回答描述性问题时出现的不精确输出。其核心解决方案在于不对模型本身进行任何修改（即“冻结”模型），而是通过自主进化（autonomous evolution）机制优化推理程序的代码逻辑。具体而言，研究基于一个初始推理程序，利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判器，在每轮迭代中分析训练样本中的失败案例，并生成改进型的代码变更建议；所有候选程序被维护在一个小规模池中，按训练准确率排序并持续演化。实验在三个VLM和四个科学图表基准上验证了该方法的有效性，结果显示平均准确率从初始的16.6%提升至41.3%，最大单次提升达55.2个百分点。此外，优化后的程序因生成简短答案而更易评估，整体运行速度提升3.8倍。研究证明，大量错误源于推理流程而非模型能力本身，因此仅通过优化推理管道即可显著提升“冻结”模型的表现，无需重新训练。

作者: Abhinav Sudhakar Dubey,Vidushi Goel,Kiran Rana,Shikhar Mathur,Vaggos Chatziafratis

类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding and operating with scientific charts is a standard approach in data analysis, and while humans are good at interpreting such charts, open vision-language models (VLMs) are known to perform poorly when it comes to question answering based on such data types. Motivated by an initial observation that many of their errors are due to inexact answering, we raise the following natural question: how much accuracy can we recover without changing the model at all? In this paper, we study this question by searching over inference programs and the code around a “frozen” version of the model. Using ideas from autonomous evolution (famously used in AlphaEvolve), we first start from a baseline inference program, and in each round we show an LLM judge the code together with a few failures on training questions, and ask for an improving evolutionary move. As usual in autonomous evolution approaches, the candidate programs are kept in a small pool ranked by training accuracy, and the next edit is performed on top-scorers from this pool. We run this approach on three VLMs and four popular benchmarks on scientific charts, and we measure the fraction of descriptive questions whose answer exactly matches the ground truth. The accuracy improves in all experimental settings. On average, it rises from 16.6% with the starting program to 41.3% with the evolved one, and the largest single increase is 55.2 percentage points. As a side benefit, our evolved program is 3.8x faster than the starting program, because short answers are easier to grade and faster to generate. Our results demonstrate that a large part of the observed errors arise due to the inference pipeline, and that optimizing it can improve the “frozen” VLM without the need to retrain it.

[NLP-52] Reinforcement Learning Done Right for Explicit Confidence Targets

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在不确定性情况下生成看似合理但错误回答的问题，这种现象会误导用户并降低模型的可靠性。现有基于强化学习的拒答训练方法通常采用固定的误差惩罚机制，无法在推理时根据不同的置信度要求动态调整行为。为此，论文提出显式置信度目标（Explicit Confidence Targets）框架，即用户在提示中指定一个目标置信度 ( p )，模型需直接决定是否作答，以确保作答问题的准确率不低于 ( p )。然而，此前方法难以让单一模型有效区分不同置信度目标，主要原因在于：优化过程中用于区分不同 ( p ) 值的奖励信号容易丢失，且原始误差惩罚随 ( p ) 接近 1 而无界增长。针对此问题，论文提出 RLEC（Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Confidence Targets）方法，其关键创新在于：保持可区分不同置信度目标的学习信号、引入稳定奖励函数以维持期望回答条件不变，并采用奖励调度策略平衡学习效率与训练稳定性。这些设计首次实现了单个大语言模型对显式置信度目标的有效控制。大量跨基准测试和模型规模的实验表明，RLEC 在保持模型通用能力的同时，实现了优异的校准性能，并支持无需外部决策系统或训练后阈值校准的细粒度目标调控。通过将显式置信度目标内化为训练策略的一部分，RLEC 为模型行为校准开辟了一条更直接、更高效的新路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35059
作者: Zefeng He,Yichen He,Yuan Lin,Yang Yang,Yu Cheng
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 22 pages, 13 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) can produce plausible but incorrect answers when they are uncertain, which can mislead users and undermine model reliability. Training models to abstain with reinforcement learning is a natural approach, but most existing methods use a fixed error penalty and therefore cannot adapt their behavior to different confidence requirements at inference time. We study \emphexplicit confidence targets, where a user specifies a target (p) in the prompt and the model directly chooses whether to answer or abstain, with the goal of achieving an accuracy of at least (p) among answered questions. However, learning to respond to different confidence targets with a single model has proven difficult, and prior attempts have failed to distinguish different targets. We show that this failure comes from two problems: the reward signal that distinguishes different values of p is often lost during optimization, while the original error penalty grows without bound as p approaches one. We propose RLEC (\textbfReinforcement \textbfLearning with \textbfExplicit \textbfConfidence Targets), which preserves the learning signal needed to distinguish confidence targets, introduces a stable reward family that keeps the desired answer condition unchanged, and uses reward scheduling to balance effective learning and training stability. Together, these designs enable the first successful training of a single LLM for explicit confidence target control. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and model scales show that RLEC largely preserves general capabilities and achieves competitive calibration performance. RLEC also supports fine-grained target control without an external decision system or threshold calibration after training. By making explicit confidence targets part of the trained policy, RLEC opens a new and more direct path toward behavioral calibration.

[NLP-53] From Questions to Queries to Insights: A Schema-Grounded Agent ic Workflow for Natural-Language Crash Data Analysis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决交通管理部门在利用事故数据库进行安全分析时，如何实现非专业用户通过自然语言提问获取可靠分析结果的难题。传统方法依赖预设分析模板或需具备数据库查询与编码知识的专业人员支持，限制了数据的可及性与使用效率。为此，论文提出CrashDB-QA——一种完全本地部署、基于数据模式（schema-grounded）的智能体工作流，其核心在于通过专用组件将自然语言问题转化为可验证的只读SQL查询，并依托机构专属的知识库（包含数据字典与安全分析规范）确保查询语义准确。该系统通过记录中间输出支持结果可审计与可追溯。进一步提出的CrashDB-QA+扩展模块引入三者一致性验证机制（问题-查询-执行结果），并提供证据以支持迭代修正。实验基于威斯康星州440万条事故记录快照，采用涵盖十类分析任务的300个问题基准测试九种本地大模型。结果表明，领域知识的嵌入显著提升查询准确性，7B规模的代码优化模型在准确率与延迟间取得最佳平衡；然而复合型分析（如跨群体或时段比较）仍具挑战性；当验证环节使用权威字段定义且修正器能访问执行证据时，性能提升明显，单纯增加检查步骤则无稳定收益。研究证实，本地化、领域对齐的工作流可有效拓展事故数据分析的可及性，同时明确了实现可靠分析所必需的推理与验证能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35054
作者: Jingwen Zhu,Keshu Wu,Steven T. Parker,Bin Ran,David A. Noyce
机构: University of Wisconsin–Madison (威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Transportation agencies maintain extensive crash databases to identify safety priorities, evaluate countermeasures, and guide resource allocation. Making these data accessible to practitioners requires flexible ways to translate analytical questions into reliable results. Existing dashboards support predefined analyses, while additional requests often depend on specialists who understand database queries, coded fields, and agency conventions. This study presents CrashDB-QA, a fully local, schema-grounded agentic workflow that enables natural-language analysis of crash databases. Specialized components interpret questions, generate and validate read-only SQL, execute queries, and explain the results. A shared knowledge base grounds query construction in the agency’s data dictionary and safety-analysis conventions, while recorded intermediate outputs support inspection and auditing. An optional extension, CrashDB-QA+, checks the alignment among the question, query, and execution result and supplies evidence for iterative repair. We evaluate the workflow on a frozen snapshot of 4.4 million Wisconsin crash records using a new benchmark of 300 questions across ten analytical categories and nine local open-weight models. Domain grounding substantially improves query accuracy, and a code-specialized 7B model provides the best accuracy-latency balance among the tested models. Compositional analyses remain more difficult than routine retrieval, particularly comparisons between groups or periods. Verification improves performance when the Judge uses authoritative field definitions and the Refiner receives execution evidence, whereas additional checking alone offers no consistent benefit. These findings demonstrate the potential of locally deployed, domain-grounded workflows to broaden access to crash analysis and identify the reasoning and verification capabilities needed for reliable use.

[NLP-54] SimPOTrans: Self-Adaptation for Offline-to-Simultaneous Speech Translation via Reinforcement Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决同时语音翻译（SimulST）中如何使离线训练的语音翻译模型在不依赖特定训练策略的情况下，自适应地实现低延迟、高质量的实时翻译问题。现有对话式SimulST方法通常依赖于合成的读写轨迹或联合优化翻译质量与延迟，前者可能带来次优的训练信号，后者因目标冲突导致优化不稳定。本文提出一种基于强化学习（RL）的框架SimPOTrans，其关键在于通过一个简单的两阶段强化学习后训练流程，使离线模型在接收到部分语音输入时，自发产生有利于同步场景的翻译行为，从而实现从离线到实时的自适应转换。该方法无需合成读写轨迹或显式延迟优化，在推理阶段仅通过调整语音输入的分块大小即可灵活控制翻译质量与延迟的权衡，实验结果表明其在ACL 60/60和MCIF基准上三个语言方向（英→德、英→中、英→日）均优于多个强基线模型，显著提升了质量-延迟平衡性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35042
作者: Haotian Tan,Hiroki Ouchi,Sakriani Sakti
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) aims to translate ongoing speech with low latency while preserving translation quality. Recent studies have adopted large language models (LLMs) for SimulST and formulated it as a multi-turn dialogue task for efficient generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance. However, existing dialogue-style SimulST approaches typically rely on specialized training schemes to acquire simultaneous translation behavior, either using synthesized read/write trajectories, which may provide suboptimal training signals, or jointly optimizing translation quality and latency, whose competing objectives may cause optimization instability. In this paper, we introduce SimPOTrans, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables offline speech translation models to self-adapt to dialogue-style SimulST. Through a simple two-stage RL post-training pipeline, SimPOTrans rewards an offline model for exhibiting translation behaviors beneficial to simultaneous scenarios when given partial speech inputs, thereby enabling offline-to-simultaneous self-adaptation without synthesized read/write trajectories or explicit latency optimization. At inference time, SimPOTrans requires no external decision policy and enables flexible quality–latency control by simply adjusting the chunk size of speech input. Experiments on the ACL 60/60 and MCIF benchmarks across three language directions (En \rightarrow De, En \rightarrow Zh, and En \rightarrow Ja) demonstrate that SimPOTrans outperforms several strong baselines, achieving a superior quality–latency trade-off.

[NLP-55] Synthetic Child-Adult Interactions Are Not Developmentally Plausible

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型（Generative AI）在发展性可解释语言建模研究中广泛使用合成数据所引发的可信度问题，即基于语言模型生成的儿童-成人对话数据是否真实反映自然对话的特征。研究表明，尽管合成数据在词汇层面与真实数据表现相似，但在语用层面显著低估了口语交互中固有的混乱性与碎片化特征。其解决方案的关键在于通过指令微调（instruction-tuning）方式，利用真实对话数据构建训练样本，以提升模型对自然对话统计特性的拟合能力；初步实验表明，经过适度的参数高效微调后，小型模型即可有效逼近真实对话的数据分布。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Synthetic data has become a common resource for training language models, and this trend has spilled over into research on developmentally plausible language modeling. However, it remains unclear whether LM-generated child-adult interactions actually resemble natural ones. We compare the synthetic TinyDialogues dataset to natural dialogue across a broad range of linguistic measures. While synthetic data matches natural data on the lexical level, it drastically underestimates the messy, fragmented nature of spoken interaction. To mitigate this, we propose instruction-tuning with data created from real dialogues, and show in a pilot study that a small model approximates the statistical tendencies of natural data after moderate parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

[NLP-56] When the Persona Contradicts the Line: Diagnosing Plan-to-Synthesis Failures in Chain-of-Thought TTS ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音合成（TTS）系统中，当文本情感与预期声学情感存在冲突时，语言模型规划器（planner）在意图传递过程中出现的语义-声学对齐失效问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管规划器生成的表达短语在方向上通常正确，但下游环节（如情绪向量、合成波形）的声学表现一致性显著下降，导致情感传达失真。解决方案的关键在于构建一个双语（日语-英语）的“人格-语句冲突”基准测试集，通过系统性地评估不同模块（规划器输出、情绪向量、QwenEmotion生成向量、合成波形）在预设声学方向上的对齐程度，揭示信息丢失的环节。研究发现，直接绕过情绪生成模块仅带来有限提升，而通过监督微调QwenEmotion可分别将日语和英语的声学方向准确率提升至75%和84%；进一步引入学习型文本到潜在空间的接口（learned text-to-latent interface），在英语中达到89%的最高准确率，在日语中实现88%的最高唤醒度（arousal）准确率，表明通过学习修复从规划到合成的接口，能够有效恢复与文本内容相悖的声学表达，且该方法在不同语言和声学维度上具有差异化的表现能力。

作者: Joonyong Park,Jerry Li

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)

Abstract:Chain-of-thought TTS systems rely on language-model planners to translate persona and context into vocal delivery, but it is unclear where this intent is lost when the requested affect conflicts with lexical sentiment. We introduce a bilingual Japanese–English persona–line conflict benchmark in which each item pairs one line with congruent and conflicting personas and pre-declares the expected acoustic direction. We probe this direction in the planner-generated delivery phrase, the planner-written emotion vector, the QwenEmotion-generated vector, and the rendered waveform. Planner outputs are usually direction-correct, while downstream agreement can be substantially lower. Bypassing QwenEmotion provides only modest gains over the full planner-controlled Base. Supervising QwenEmotion raises the direction rate to 75% in Japanese and 84% in English. A learned text-to-latent interface reaches the highest English rate of 89% and the highest Japanese arousal rate of 88%. These results show that learned repair of the plan-to-synthesis interface can recover counter-textual delivery, although its effect differs across languages and acoustic axes.

[NLP-57] Reason or Recite: Complementary Specialists with an LLM Judge for Traffic Anomaly Reasoning ECCV2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决交通异常事件中视频理解系统在推理与描述能力之间的权衡问题：现有视觉-语言模型在处理闭式问题时强调精确、基于证据的推理，而在开放性回答任务中则依赖于与参考文本的语义相似度评分，导致模型更倾向于模仿标注风格而非进行正确推理。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种双专家框架——Reason-or-Recite (RoR)，通过三个核心步骤实现性能优化：首先，将官方链式思维标注重构为结构化、时间对齐的语义模板，并使用LoRA微调一个90亿参数的视觉-语言模型以增强推理能力；其次，对一个4比特量化后的270亿参数模型仅在答案层面进行微调，以吸收标注风格特征；最后，采用无需训练的大型语言模型（LLM）判别器在两个候选输出间进行选择。该方法在2026年AI City Challenge的交通异常推理赛道中取得领先，域内排行榜平均得分为0.6788。

机构: Stellarview AI(Stellarview AI)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 18 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the AI City Challenge Workshop, ECCV 2026. 1st place in Track 3 (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per question with a training-free LLM judge. RoR ranks first on the in-domain leaderboard with mean score 0.6788.

[NLP-58] Diagnosing and Mitigating Long-Session Degradation in Full-Duplex Speech Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音对话模型在长时间会话中出现的性能退化问题，特别是响应速度、语音内容质量及语音一致性随会话时长增加而下降的现象。其核心挑战在于如何在保持模型实时性与自然交互能力的同时，维持长期会话中的稳定性与信息保留能力。解决方案的关键在于提出两项创新方法：一是基于自蒸馏（self-distillation）的轻量级低秩适应（LoRA）训练框架，通过少量额外训练有效缓解长时间会话中的性能退化；二是引入双分辨率上下文（Two-Resolution Context, TRC）架构，该架构在保留近期交互细节的同时，将历史交互信息压缩为关键-值（key-value）表示，显著降低记忆存储开销并提升长期信息保留能力。实验表明，该方法在三种不同架构的全双工语音模型上均能有效增强长会话稳定性，并实现超过90%的键值缓存（KV-cache）增长抑制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34991
作者: Junho Kim,CheHyun Lee,Donghun Kang,Youngho Cho,Dongwook Lee,Heeseung Kim,Sungroh Yoon
机构: IPAI, Seoul National University (SNU); Department of ECE, SNU; Department of AI, University of Seoul; AIIS, ASRI, INMC, and ISRC, SNU
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: The project page is available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:End-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue models enable natural, real-time spoken interactions with interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. Prior evaluations have assessed diverse interaction capabilities and identified some degradation patterns across conversational turns. However, how model behavior evolves over extended sessions remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we address this gap by systematically characterizing long-session degradation and developing efficient methods to mitigate it. We introduce a closed-loop evaluation framework for long-session stability and apply it to several publicly available full-duplex speech models, revealing degradation over time in responsiveness, spoken content quality, and voice consistency. To mitigate this degradation, we propose a self-distillation-based training framework for lightweight LoRA adaptation that improves long-session stability with a small amount of additional training. We further introduce a two-resolution context (TRC) architecture that preserves recent interactions in full detail while compressing older interaction history into key-value representations. We evaluate our methods on three models with distinct architectures, assessing long-session stability, information retention, and computational efficiency. Across all three models, we show that LoRA adaptation mitigates performance degradation over ten-minute sessions, while adding TRC extends these gains beyond the training session length and reduces KV-cache growth by more than 90%.

[NLP-59] AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统药物警戒（pharmacovigilance）体系与患者在线叙事之间存在的信息断层问题，即非结构化的网络患者经验难以被纳入正式的药物安全性监测系统。其核心解决方案是提出AskGLP1系统，通过基于MedDRA术语体系的LLM辅助流程，将海量社交媒体文本（如近850万条Reddit帖子）中关于GLP-1类药物的用药体验转化为结构化的知识图谱（Knowledge Graph, KG），并支持以自然语言形式查询药物副作用与使用目的之间的关联关系。该系统的关键在于利用大语言模型（LLM）实现对非结构化文本的精准抽取与标准化映射，最终构建包含385,790条药物-不良反应及药物-用途关系的知识图谱，揭示了不同药物在真实世界中的差异化体验特征，如替尔泊肽（tirzepatide）相比司美格鲁肽（semaglutide）引发更少恶心呕吐，而韦戈利（Wegovy）相较于奥兹莫帕（Ozempic）表现出更高疲劳率等。研究发现，线上叙述更突出日常负担性症状（如疲劳、食欲减退），而监管数据库（FAERS）则更关注注射部位反应和严重诊断事件，凸显现有药监体系与患者实际体验间的差距，因而呼吁建立以患者为中心的新型药物警戒范式。

机构: University of Arizona; University of California, Irvine; University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; New York University; University of Cincinnati; Vanderbilt University Medical Center; Florida State University
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at this https URL.

[NLP-60] SVD-Attention: Efficiently Analyzing Attention Blocks in Transformers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决预训练变换器模型在推理过程中大量计算资源消耗于自注意力（self-attention）模块，而每个注意力头的查询-键交互矩阵在结构上具有低秩特性这一现象所引发的效率瓶颈问题。其核心问题是：在真实数据上，不同层与不同架构中的注意力头究竟有多少真正利用了其完整的秩容量，哪些则存在冗余？为此，论文提出SVD-Attention，一种后处理诊断方法，通过分解每个注意力头的交互矩阵 $ M_h $，并基于小规模校准集上各奇异模式的谱幅值及其跨标记激活方差进行评分，从而筛选出实际被数据激活且可被放大的关键奇异模式，其余则予以舍弃。该方法保留的模式构成精确重构，无需微调。实验表明，该诊断揭示了任务依赖性的冗余分布规律：情感分析、图像分类及生成任务中冗余集中于浅层至中层，而密集预测与抽取式问答任务则集中在深层。此外，该方法具备预测能力——仅对诊断标识的层进行截断，性能损失不超过1.75 F1，而对其他层进行同等数量截断则可能导致高达50 F1的性能下降。值得注意的是，SVD-Attention本身为分析工具，而非压缩手段；单独使用可降低0.8%–1.5%的推理浮点运算量（FLOPs），若与权重剪枝结合，则可进一步实现8%–11%的加速，同时任务性能变化仅为0%–4%，展现出良好的效率-精度平衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34971
作者: Debopam Sanyal,Hongjie Chen,Riya Elizabeth Kuriyan,Arth Tak,Divya Kothandaraman,Akshay Mehra,Joshua Kimball,Alexey Tumanov
机构: Georgia Institute of Technology(佐治亚理工学院); Dolby Laboratories(杜比实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Pretrained transformers spend a large share of their inference compute inside self-attention, yet the per-head query-key interaction is structurally low-rank by construction. We ask a diagnostic question: across layers and architectures, which heads actually use the full rank budget on real data, and which do not? We propose SVD-Attention, a post-hoc method that decomposes the per-head interaction matrix M_h and scores every singular mode by both its spectral magnitude and its activation variance across tokens on a small calibration set. The score keeps the modes the head can amplify and that real data actually activates, and discards the rest; the resulting factorization is exact for the retained modes and needs no finetuning. Across seven pretrained models and five task types, the diagnostic finds a task-dependent pattern: redundancy sits in the early to middle layers for sentiment and image classification and for generation, and in the late layers for dense prediction and extractive question answering. It is also predictive: truncating the layers it flags costs at most 1.75 F1, while truncating the same number of layers elsewhere in the same model costs up to 50 F1. SVD-Attention is an analysis tool rather than a compression method: acting on it reduces inference FLOPs by 0.8 - 1.5% on its own and by 8 - 11% when composed with weight pruning, with 0 - 4% change in task quality.

[NLP-61] Improving Reasoning with Rollout Agreement for Group-Based Policy Optimization

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）中，因正确答案轨迹间差异所引发的推理有效性问题。尽管现有方法利用轨迹多样性提升推理性能或训练效率，但其对正确轨迹间的差异是否反映有意义的替代推理路径，还是源于未被发现的错误仍缺乏清晰理解。为此，研究通过盲对比较分析采用组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）训练的模型，在同一问题下高一致性和低一致性的正确轨迹进行对比，发现低一致性轨迹中存在更高比例的虚假推理（35% vs. 22%），包括内部矛盾和误用问题条件等现象。基于此，提出一种名为RoAR（Rollout-Agreement Reward）的解决方案，即在GRPO的可验证正确轨迹奖励中引入推理层面的一致性信号，该信号由已有在线策略轨迹组计算得出，无需人工编写推理过程、额外采样或独立训练的流程评估器。在五个数学推理基准测试中，1.5B参数规模的GRPO-RoAR模型在零样本评估下达到55.5%的平均pass@1，分别优于GRPO和GRPO-CARE 6.0和5.5个百分点；进一步的盲审审计显示，四款1.5B模型在100个正确回答问题中的虚假推理率分别为：GRPO-RoAR（18%）、GRPO（32%）、GRPO-CARE（27%）和DRA-GRPO（37%）。研究结果表明，推理一致性是利用轨迹差异指导学习时必须考虑的关键因素，而RoAR有效提升了推理的有效性与可信度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34951
作者: Sohyun Son,Yerim Hong,Jaeyun Park,Mujeen Sung
机构: Kyung Hee University (庆熙大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 21 pages, 7 figures, 16 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent methods for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) use rollout diversity to improve reasoning performance or training efficiency. Despite these gains, the extent to which differences among correct-answer rollouts reflect useful alternative reasoning or unresolved errors remains poorly understood. We investigate this question through a blind paired analysis of a model trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), comparing the highest- and lowest-agreement correct-answer traces for the same problem. Across 126 pairs, low-agreement traces have more spurious reasoning than high-agreement traces (35% vs. 22%), including internal inconsistencies and misuse of problem conditions. Based on these findings, we propose RoAR (Rollout-Agreement Reward), which adds reasoning-level agreement to GRPO’s rewards for verified-correct rollouts. RoAR computes this signal from existing on-policy rollout groups, requiring no human-written rationales, additional sampling, or separately trained process evaluator. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, the 1.5B GRPO-RoAR model reaches 55.5% mean pass@1 under zero-shot evaluation using 7K training examples, exceeding GRPO and GRPO-CARE by 6.0 and 5.5 percentage points. A separate blind audit of 100 problems answered correctly by all four 1.5B models finds spurious rates of 18% for GRPO-RoAR, 32% for GRPO, 27% for GRPO-CARE, and 37% for DRA-GRPO. Our findings identify reasoning validity as an important consideration when using rollout differences to guide learning. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-62] Correlation-Aware Exploration for Long-Trace Reasoning NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理模型在使用组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）训练时出现的策略坍缩（policy collapse）问题，尤其是在生成数千词长思维链（chain-of-thought）的情况下，传统熵正则化方法因在每个推理步骤上强制提升全局熵而与收敛所需的熵衰减产生冲突，导致超参数调节困难。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于信息论的新型框架——Info-GRPO，通过构建策略与潜在先验（latent prior）之间的互信息（mutual information），利用训练过程中引入的潜在种子（latent seeds）来引导策略探索，使多样性体现在整个推理轨迹的结构相关性上，而非依赖于逐令牌的随机性。这一机制实现了探索与收敛的解耦，避免了熵正则化带来的副作用。实验表明，Info-GRPO在多个推理基准测试中显著优于原始GRPO及熵正则化GRPO，尤其在AIME24数据集上，相对于GRPO在四种不同骨干模型上的平均准确率（Avg@8）分别提升了3.75%、1.66%、4.16%和4.17%，且达到相同多数投票准确率时仅需八分之一的采样量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34949
作者: Junxing Hu,Zicheng Zhang,Zhiqian Zhang,Ai Han,Yifeng Zhang,Pengzhang Liu,Ling Li
机构: JD.com(京东); Microsoft(微软)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 28 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM), NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. To resolve this tension, we propose Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates correlation between the policy and a latent prior. Rather than raising entropy everywhere, Info-GRPO builds on the mutual information between a latent variable and the trajectory it induces: augmenting prompts with latent seeds during training lets the model explore diverse policies correlated with the prior, while the seed-conditioned entropy is guided toward convergence. Diversity is therefore carried across whole reasoning traces rather than by per-token randomness, and exploration no longer fights entropy reduction. Experiments show that Info-GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO and entropy-regularized GRPO across diverse reasoning benchmarks. On AIME24, it improves Avg@8 over GRPO by 3.75%, 1.66%, 4.16%, and 4.17% on four backbones, and it reaches the same majority-vote accuracy with 8\times fewer samples. Code and models will be publicly released.

[NLP-63] What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing Reliability Rarely Reach

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在复杂推理任务中，尽管在 pass@1（即首次尝试即正确）指标上表现提升，但在大范围 k 值下的 pass@k 指标未同步提升的根本原因。其核心问题是：强化学习（RL）带来的性能提升是否源于行为模式的改变、知识的新增，还是仅限于对现有能力的优化？解决方案的关键在于将 pass@1 的变化分解为三个可量化维度：完成度（Finishing）、可靠性（Reliability） 和 可达性（Reach）。其中，完成度衡量模型在令牌预算耗尽前完成推理的能力；可靠性衡量模型在完成推理后答案正确的概率；可达性则评估 RL 是否解决了其基础模型在全部八次尝试中均无法解答的问题。研究发现，当基础模型常因令牌预算不足而无法完成时，绝大多数性能变化来自完成度的提升（4k/8k预算下占比达82%），且若放宽预算，基础模型自身即可弥补大部分差距；而在有足够资源的情况下，性能提升主要体现为可靠性提高；而真正意义上的新问题解决能力（即可达性）极为有限，最大仅增加2.1个百分点，且多数“新解”在重采样或人工验证后不成立，表明其本质更接近对已有样本的再利用而非真正新增知识。此外，在小规模实验中，引入物理设定信息并未显著提升纯强化学习的表现，进一步说明当前提升主要源自策略优化而非外部信息增强。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34894
作者: Shan Yang
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 27 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). Given more tokens, the base closes most of the finishing gap itself. (2) Where the base has enough tokens, the gain is reliability: the RL model is graded right more often, even on problems both finish. (3) By our definition, RL rarely solves what its base cannot. Reach adds at most 2.1 percentage points on any of our four physics and math sets. We checked 144 physics problems that only the RL model solved. Of these, 3.5% hold up when resampled or read. In a random sample, nine of ten new RL steps a human confirmed also appear in the base’s samples. (4) In a small-scale RL run on an 8B model, the gain on new problems is finishing, with reliability flat. Supplying each problem’s physical setup was not shown to improve on plain RL.

[NLP-64] FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型中个性控制存在的核心矛盾：即在保持强烈人格特质表达的同时，难以兼顾对话生成的自然性。现有方法往往在人格表现力与对话流畅度之间存在权衡，导致生成内容或过于刻板、或人格特征模糊。为克服这一问题，论文提出FATE-5（Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five），一种两阶段框架，其关键在于将人格表征学习与自然性对齐解耦。第一阶段通过对话监督和辅助问卷目标，学习基于大五人格（Big Five）的连续软提示（continuous soft prompt）表示；第二阶段基于对话质量与人格一致性双重偏好，进行偏好对齐以提升对话自然性。实验表明，FATE-5在三种不同模型架构下均实现了强人格表达与高自然性之间的平衡，在保留人格特质强度的同时显著提升了对话质量，且在留出问卷测试中表现出高达0.97–0.99的单调性相关系数与8.9–12.4的恢复均方根误差（RMSE），显著优于基线方法，验证了其在实现连续人格控制与自然对话行为协同优化方面的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34889
作者: Gunhee Cho,Hongyeob Kim,Yun-Gyung Cheong
机构: Sungkyunkwan University (成均馆大学); Suwon, South Korea
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective. It then improves dialogue naturalness through preference alignment based on both dialogue quality and personality agreement. Across three language model backbones, FATE-5 maintains strong trait expression while achieving substantially higher dialogue naturalness than other trait-strong methods. On held-out questionnaires, it achieves monotonicity correlations of 0.97-0.99 and recovery RMSE of 8.9-12.4, substantially improving over the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate effective continuous personality control while maintaining natural conversational behavior.

[NLP-65] NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决金融分析师代理（financial analyst agent）生成的数值主张在看似正确（与公司披露数据匹配）时，仍可能因实体、概念、期间、单位或范围等财务语义层面错误而存在根本性偏差的问题。传统基于参考答案的验证方法仅能判断结果“对错”，却无法解释错误原因。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个名为NumTrace的新基准，专门审计数值主张的来源及其财务语义（provenance and financial semantics）。NumTrace通过构建基于会计准则的参考答案，对每项主张给出三个独立判别：数值正确性（value）、绑定关系正确性（binding）和支撑证据充分性（support）。其中，保留分离的“数值”与“绑定”判别是核心创新——可有效识别“正确数值但错误账户”（Right Number, Wrong Account, RNWA）类错误。实验表明，三大主流模型（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）中高达67.5%–81.8%的失败案例为RNWA错误；尤其在13F共同申报组问题中，约91%的主张通过数值检查，但不足一半通过绑定检查，揭示了当前模型在财务语义理解上的显著缺陷。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34887
作者: Tianlei Zhu,Matt White,Xue Liu,Xiao-Yang Liu
机构: Columbia University (哥伦比亚大学); University of California, Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校); Linux Foundation (Linux基金会); MBZUAI; McGill University (麦吉尔大学); Mila – Quebec AI Institute (魁北克人工智能研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 22 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company’s shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. By retaining separate value and binding verdicts, NumTrace detects right number, wrong account (RNWA) errors: a claim has an RNWA error when it passes the value check but fails the binding check. The RNWA rate quantifies the gap between value-only and joint value-and-binding pass rates. Finally, we audit three agents, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. RNWA errors make up 67.5-81.8% of each agent’s failing claims. In particular, on 13F co-filing group questions, about 91% of claims pass the value check, but fewer than half pass the binding check.

[NLP-66] hinkBit: Search Codewords Recalibrate Scales Select by Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在低精度量化（如两比特量化）下推理能力退化的问题，尤其关注在极低存储开销（如使用2比特替代bfloat16权重）时，如何保持模型对复杂推理任务（如数学问题求解）的处理能力。传统两比特方法通常以困惑度（perplexity）和多项选择题准确率作为评估标准，但这些指标无法有效反映模型在面对更复杂推理任务时的表现。为此，本文提出ThinkBit——一种严格基于标量的两比特量化框架，其核心在于：每个权重为整数码字乘以一组共享的bfloat16尺度，从而在保持参数紧凑性的同时保留推理能力。关键创新包括：（1）基于敏感性分析为各层分配三元、2比特或3比特层级，实现分层最优比特宽度分配；（2）采用基于Gumbel-Softmax的逐层标量量化算法，块级搜索最优码字；（3）通过知识蒸馏损失对冻结码字的尺度进行再校准，以缓解层间交互失配；（4）引入短周期量化感知训练（QAT），使模型通过重新分配码字来模仿原始模型的输出分布；（5）最终通过成对推理测试在再校准与QAT阶段之间选择最优检查点。实验表明，该框架在相同尺寸下显著优于现有2比特方法，在Qwen3-1.7B模型上达到MATH-500 46.7分（对比EfficientQAT的30.0分），且在14B规模下实现94.8分（接近29.5GB bfloat16模型的97.5分），验证了其在压缩与推理能力之间的高效平衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34886
作者: Rhea Sanjay Sukthanker,Pashmina Cameron
机构: Microsoft Applied Sciences Group(微软应用科学组)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning language models generate thousands of tokens per answer, and generation speed is limited by memory bandwidth, so storing weights in two bits instead of bfloat16 can potentially make inference 8 \times cheaper. Two-bit methods are usually judged by perplexity and multiple-choice question-answering accuracy, both of which say little about whether a model can still reason through more difficult problems. We present ThinkBit, a strictly scalar two-bit framework built to preserve reasoning, in which every weight is an integer codeword times a bfloat16 scale shared by a group of weights. We first use a sensitivity metric to assign each layer a ternary, 2-bit, or 3-bit tier to allocate bitwidths optimally among layers. This is followed by a layerwise Gumbel-softmax-based scalar quantization algorithm that searches for optimal codewords block by block. Since a layerwise scheme does not capture how quantized layers interact with each other, we recalibrate scales, with the codewords frozen, using a knowledge-distillation-based loss against the teacher model. We then perform a short quantization-aware training (QAT) stage that lets the model mimic the base model’s distribution by reassigning codewords. Finally, a paired reasoning test on training problems selects the final checkpoint between the recalibration stage and the QAT stage. On Qwen3-1.7B at matched size, our recalibrated checkpoint scores 46.7 on MATH-500 against 30.0 for EfficientQAT trained on the same data, and 73.0 after QAT on reasoning traces; at 0.52 GB it is smaller than every published 2-bit GGUF of the model yet more accurate on MATH-500. We show that this framework scales and up to 14B, a 3.74 GB model scores 94.8 on MATH-500, against 97.5 for the 29.5 GB bfloat16 model.

[NLP-67] RubriX: A Fast Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于评分量规（rubric-based evaluation）的评估效率问题，即传统方法依赖大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者时，需对每个评分等级进行文本生成并逐项阅读描述，导致计算开销随量规复杂度线性增长。其核心解决方案是提出RubriX，一种受对比语言模型（Contrastive Language Model, CLM）启发的新型评分量规判别器：通过LoRA微调的编码器将输入响应和各评分等级描述映射为向量表示，并利用缩放后的余弦相似度计算各等级的概率分布，避免了生成式推理。该方法在缓存等级嵌入后，推理延迟稳定在约28毫秒/判断，即使单个等级描述扩展至3000词也保持高效，显著优于基线模型（如Jev和Qwen3-8B裁判），在准确率与速度上均实现显著提升，尤其在大规模量规场景下展现出7.7倍于Jev、18.8倍于Qwen3-8B的性能优势。

机构: CobuildX(科构建)

Abstract:Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe’s Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev’s accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, RubriX outperforms G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on every SummEval dimension and both QAGS subsets. With level embeddings cached, RubriX’s latency stays at about 28 ms per judgment as level descriptions grow from 10 to 3,000 tokens, while Jev’s (approximate network time subtracted) rises from 44 ms to 211 ms and the Qwen3-8B judge’s from 32 ms to 516 ms, making RubriX 7.7x faster than Jev and 18.8x faster than the Qwen3-8B judge at 3,000 tokens per level.

[NLP-68] Adaptive Retrieval Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agent ic RAG

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在智能体式检索增强生成（agentic RAG）场景下，尽管采用基于检索的相关性评分与事后合取过滤（conformal filtering）策略以提升事实准确性，但仍面临生成内容事实支持率与响应可用性之间权衡的问题。其核心挑战在于：在语言模型政策动态决定是否继续检索或终止检索的自适应流程中，如何在保障每个生成主张均被充分支持的前提下，维持较高的有效响应覆盖率。解决方案的关键在于显式建模自适应检索轨迹，并通过后生成合取过滤实现逐条主张的事实性校验；研究发现，在95%的目标置信水平下，虽可使非空输出的完全支持率高达89.14%–95.56%，但相应导致响应覆盖率下降至17.23%–60.17%，揭示了可靠性（factuality）与信息量（informativeness）之间的内在权衡关系。

作者: Muhammad Aimal Rehman,Chi-Kuang Yeh
机构: Georgia State University (乔治亚州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code: this https URL

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.

[NLP-69] DocTalk: Enhancing Medical Knowledge Retrieval via Fine-tuned Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Robust Clinical Decision Support

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在医疗领域应用中因幻觉（hallucination）和领域适配偏差（domain misalignment）导致的安全性与有效性问题，尤其是在电子健康记录（Electronic Health Record, EHR）问答任务中的临床可靠性挑战。其核心解决方案是构建一个名为DocTalk的医生辅助问答系统，通过基于去标识化出院小结生成精准、可解释且受病历支持的简明回答。关键创新在于采用高保真数据生成流程，结合句子级分解、思维链引导的问题生成及专家评审，构建了500个具有临床意义的问答对；并引入参数高效指令微调（Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning, PEIT），利用低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）对六种开源模型进行优化，同时融合提示工程、上下文学习（in-context learning）与医学对齐评估体系，显著提升了模型在词汇、语义及临床真实性等维度的表现。实验表明，经微调后的模型在自建的DocTalk-QA数据集上实现显著性能提升，并在PubMedQA等外部基准上展现出更强的泛化能力，验证了临床语料驱动的指令微调在提升医疗问答系统可信度方面的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34871
作者: Asad Gohar,Md Ariful Islam Mozumder,Moon-Il Joo,Hee-Cheol Kim
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The framework integrates prompt engineering, in-context learning, and medically aligned evaluation to support factual and interpretable responses. Results: On DocTalk-QA, instruction tuning produced consistent improvements across lexical, semantic, and clinical fidelity metrics. The best-performing tuned model, Llama-3-Med42-8B, achieved ROUGE-L = 0.40, BERTScore-F1 = 0.76, and UMLS-F1 = 0.49. To examine external generalization beyond the DocTalk-QA dataset, the two best-performing models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Med42-8B, were evaluated on PubMedQA before and after instruction tuning. Accuracy improved from 0.931 to 0.977 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 0.935 to 0.943 for Llama-3-Med42-8B. Conclusion: DocTalk was deployed as a secure web-based platform for interactive EHR querying. These findings suggest that clinically grounded instruction tuning can improve medical QA performance and support practical clinical decision support.

[NLP-70] Priority-Preserving Advantage Aggregation for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）后训练过程中多目标优化时出现的优势优先级倒置（advantage priority inversion）问题。在强化学习（RL）中，传统加性奖励聚合方法在处理主目标与辅助目标冲突时，可能因辅助信号过强而扭曲主目标的偏好，导致优化方向偏离预期。尽管奖励层级门控（reward-level gating）可部分保护主目标优先级，但会无差别地丢弃不满足主目标条件样本中的辅助信号信息，造成信息损失。为此，本文提出主优势策略优化（Primary Advantage Policy Optimization, PAPO），一种面向优先级的优势聚合方法，通过非对称融合主优势与辅助优势，在目标一致时保留辅助监督信号，而在冲突时平滑衰减辅助信号，确保融合过程保持主目标的符号一致性（primary-consistent ordering）。该方法适用于基于广义策略优化（GRPO）的序列级优势和基于演员-评论家PPO的词元级优势。实验表明，PAPO在多个任务与模型上均能稳定实现最优的主目标性能，同时在辅助目标表现上达到最优或具有竞争力水平，有效平衡了多目标优化中的优先级与信息利用之间的矛盾。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34862
作者: Xiangchi Yuan,Xingjian Diao,Zheyuan Liu,Chunhui Zhang,Dachuan Shi,Kejing Xia,Zhenbang Du,Shenglong Yao,Soroush Vosoughi,Wenke Lee
机构: Georgia Institute of Technology(佐治亚理工学院); Dartmouth College(达特茅斯学院); University of Notre Dame(圣母大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
