点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM post-training often optimizes multiple objectives with unequal priorities, such as correctness and reasoning efficiency. However, the widely used additive reward aggregation in RL can violate these priorities: when primary and auxiliary advantages conflict, a sufficiently large auxiliary signal can overturn the preference induced by the primary objective. We term this problem \emphadvantage priority inversion. Although reward-level gating can protect priority more directly, it still removes potentially useful auxiliary distinctions among rollout samples that fail the primary condition. To address this trade-off, we propose Primary Advantage Policy Optimization (\textbfPAPO), a priority-aware advantage aggregation method that asymmetrically combines a primary and an auxiliary advantage. PAPO retains auxiliary supervision when the objectives agree and smoothly attenuates conflicting auxiliary signals, preserving the primary sign during fusion for \emphprimary-consistent ordering. This rule applies to sequence-level advantages in GRPO and token-level advantages in actor–critic PPO. Experiments on multiple domains and models show that PAPO consistently achieves the best primary objective while maintaining best or competitive auxiliary-objective performance across both GRPO- and PPO-based optimization. \hrefthis https URLCode is available.

[NLP-71] Semantic Atoms for Scalable Text Analysis in Data Analytics in the Era of LLM -Based Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在数据分析师工作流中，如何高效、准确地处理文本列（text columns）以支持后续数据分析的问题，这类工作负载被称为“文本分析在数据分析中的应用”（TADA, Text Analysis in Data Analytics）。其核心挑战在于：在智能体（agent）驱动的动态查询场景下，如何合理划分神经网络（神经式）与符号计算（符号式）的任务边界，并确定哪些语义输出可被后续步骤复用。为此，论文提出两种互补的、由查询驱动的语义原子（semantic atoms）——标记（Tagging） 与 分类（Categorization）。Tagging 对每个输入文本项返回一个字符串标签，结果以行对齐的列形式物化；Categorization 则生成覆盖所有输入项的类别表，二者均以结构化形式暴露给后续的精确计算（如 SQL 或 Python 操作）。该框架通过 TADA-Agent 实现，其语义原子嵌入在生成的 Python 程序中，并能处理超出可靠上下文窗口限制的输入。在 TABench 基准测试（涵盖 40 个完整分析请求，覆盖工作流组合、输入输出结构及文献依据的分析场景）上，TADA-Agent 在保持与语义操作基线相当的逐行语义质量的同时，显著提升了完整分析产物的保留率，并在原生执行路径下将语义模型调用次数减少了一个数量级以上。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34860
作者: Jinxiang Xie,Zihao Li,Rui Ding,Bartuer Zhou,Shi Han,Dongmei Zhang
机构: Nanjing University (南京大学); Tsinghua University (清华大学); Microsoft Research (微软研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Much of the information needed for data analysis is buried in text columns: an analyst may infer customer frustration from complaint text and use it to explain resolution time. We call workloads in which processing text columns is central to subsequent data analysis TADA (\emphText Analysis in Data Analytics). In an agentic setting, the user’s query dynamically specifies this processing, and answering it interleaves LLM-based semantic steps with exact SQL or Python operations. This mixed execution raises two design questions: which work should be neural and which symbolic, and which semantic outputs later steps can reuse. We address them for agent-planned TADA workflows with two complementary, query-driven semantic atoms. Each atom takes a sequence of text items and a natural-language query specifying the semantic task: \textbfTagging returns one string per input item, while \textbfCategorization returns M category objects over N input items. Tagging results are materialized as a row-aligned column and Categorization results as a category table; SQL or Python then performs exact computation over this exposed state. We realize this interface in TADA-Agent, whose atoms run inside generated Python programs and internally handle inputs beyond a reliable context window. We evaluate TADA-Agent on TABench, a benchmark of 40 complete analysis requests over spreadsheet tables spanning workflow composition, input–output structure, and literature-grounded analytical scenarios. Against a semantic-operator baseline and relative to a held-out TADA reference run, TADA-Agent delivers comparable row-level semantic quality, has higher complete-artifact preservation estimates, and uses over an order of magnitude fewer semantic-model requests under the evaluated native execution paths.

[NLP-72] Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究在语言模型（Language Model）已独立正确回答问题的情况下，何种外部干预因素能够使其偏离正确答案，从而揭示影响模型决策稳定性的关键机制。其核心问题是：当模型自身具备正确推理能力时，哪些提示工程（prompt engineering）设计要素会显著削弱其表现？解决方案的关键在于通过控制变量实验，系统分离并量化三个此前常被混淆的因素——提示中建议内容的位置、建议的来源归属（权威性或非权威性角色）、以及模型先前生成内容的性质。研究发现，位置效应具有决定性影响：对于仅陈述结论的“裸命题”（bare claim），其危害性最强的位置是在模型即将作答前；而若附加虚假论证，则最致命的干扰出现在问题之前，可使原本几乎零错误的题目错误率从1%飙升至67%。此外，将建议归因于权威主体并采用肯定语气，可分别导致错误率上升10–27个百分点，且不同权威之间的差异不足2个百分点，表明权威性本身的作用强于具体身份。最后，无论正确示例以模型自述还是他人视角呈现，提前复现正确解答均能有效保护其不被后续错误提示所干扰，而相同机制却无法纠正已被错误回答的内容。这些发现强调了提示结构设计中的时空顺序与权威暗示在操控模型输出方面的重要性，并为构建鲁棒性更强的生成式 AI 系统提供了实证依据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34809
作者: Xinyi Ni
机构: Brandeis University (布兰戴斯大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare “the answer is X” does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the same position changes error by a few points. Second, attributing the note to an authority rather than to another participant, and phrasing it assertively, each raise error by 10-27 points, while the two authorities we tested differ by under two. Third, replaying a correct worked answer before the advice protects it whether the text is shown as the model’s own or as someone else’s, and the same replay keeps wrong answers from being corrected by a bare correct note. The position result replicates under an independently written prompt. Code, items and all result tables are released at this https URL.

[NLP-73] xt Is the Bottleneck: A Small-Scale Replication of LLM Game Playing in Riichi Mahjong

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在极低计算资源约束下（最多20亿参数模型、单块16 GB消费级显卡、约五天GPU算力）是否仍可实现对复杂纸牌游戏——立直麻将（riichi-mahjong）的高效学习与高性能表现的问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管数据和标签与先前研究保持一致，但大型语言模型（LLM）在文本理解与决策生成方面存在瓶颈，导致性能受限。解决方案的关键在于采用轻量级、专用的神经网络架构（如卷积神经网络与小规模Transformer），通过端到端的策略学习直接从游戏状态编码中预测最优动作，而非依赖文本提示。实验表明，仅490万参数的Transformer模型在171万决策上达到94.7%的教师一致性，显著优于0.8B参数的LLM（p=0.005），且在对战中与强敌“Mortal”达到统计等效水平（TOST检验，p=6e-4）。进一步发现，针对教师策略进行训练带来的性能提升（+2.5分）远超参数量增加2.5倍的效果（+1.5分），说明模仿学习的有效性远高于单纯扩大模型规模。然而，关键结论指出：即使在教师一致性上存在显著差异，这种差异也无法转化为实际对局中的显著胜率优势（置信区间内无统计显著性），揭示了“高一致性”不必然等价于“高竞技实力”的现象。此外，研究还修复了原始论文中因代码与论文描述不一致导致的胜利过滤器问题，并提出分治流水线方法，使自动生成的日语解释在句级精确度达到93%（无事实信息时仅为43%）。最终，为遵守Tenhou平台协议，研究仅发布代码、配置及评估流程，不提供训练权重。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34791
作者: Mingge Xu
机构: The University of Tokyo (东京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Replication of the riichi-mahjong track of arXiv:2509.01328 . Code, configurations and ~3,200 arena game logs released; no trained weights (Tenhou data terms)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We replicate the riichi-mahjong track of “Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?” (arXiv:2509.01328) under a drastically smaller budget: models of at most 2B parameters, one 16 GB consumer GPU, about five GPU-days. (1) With matched data and labels, text is the bottleneck: on the same 100k-decision training set, a 2.6M-parameter convolutional board encoder agrees with the strong AI Mortal on 80.6% of test decisions, above every text-prompt LLM we train (best 77.8%), and places better at the table (2.85 over 1,000 games vs. ~3.0 for the LLMs; paired difference at n=100 not significant). Scaled to 1.71M decisions, a 4.9M-parameter Transformer reaches 94.7% agreement, beats the 0.8B LLMs on identical seeds (-0.45 ranks, sign test p=0.005), and is statistically equivalent to parity against three Mortal champions (TOST within 0.10 ranks, p=6e-4); parity against a teacher-opponent is roughly the ceiling of pure imitation. (2) Training toward the teacher raises teacher agreement more than a 2.5x parameter increase does (+2.5 vs. +1.5 points); on human-record agreement both effects are +1.0, and neither is visible at the table. (3) Few-point agreement differences do not resolve into playing strength within a family: +2.5 agreement points coincide with a paired placement difference of +0.02 +/- 0.12 ranks (p=1.0), and +2.0 points at 2B with -0.06 (p=0.37) - both below the ~0.25-rank resolution of 100 paired games. We also document a paper-code mismatch in the original winner filter, reconstruct its two private engine patches, and show that a divide-and-conquer pipeline makes template-generated Japanese rationales 93% sentence-exact (43% without facts). Per Tenhou’s terms we release no trained weights - only code, configurations, and evaluation protocols.

[NLP-74] BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决个性化系统在电子商务场景中如何有效构建持续性用户行为记忆（continual behavioral user memory）的问题，尤其关注如何同时实现对用户显式行为与隐式交互所蕴含的客观证据和长期兴趣的准确记忆，以及基于这些记忆进行深层次需求与偏好的推理。现有方法多集中于语言模态交互的记忆建模，且评估缺乏真实行为数据支持，难以区分记忆与推理能力的独立表现，导致无法有效衡量两者协同机制。本文提出的关键解决方案是：构建一个统一的评估框架与记忆架构——BehaviorMemBench 与 BehaviorMem。其中，BehaviorMemBench 是基于真实电商日志（覆盖1,194名用户、超过三 年的17,462个行为批次）的基准测试集，具备自动标注的未来行为标签及任务无关的记忆接口，可独立评估记忆与推理能力；而 BehaviorMem 则是一种双轴状态架构的记忆设计，通过显式行为事实与推断出的用户特征在长短期跨度上的分层组织，实现基于证据的形成、持续维护及查询无关的读取。实验表明，该方法在记忆与推理两项能力上均优于现有代理型记忆模型，并揭示不同方法在两类能力上的性能差异，验证了其在下游任务中的有效性。

作者: Sizhe Wang,Xinghao Fang,Rui Qiu,Zhenjia Ma,Dagui Chen,Kun Kuang,Hongcheng Guo
机构: Fudan University (复旦大学); Zhejiang University (浙江大学); Taobao Tmall Group, Alibaba (淘宝天猫集团，阿里巴巴); Alibaba (阿里巴巴)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emphremember concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emphinfer underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbfBehaviorMemBench is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1,194 users and 17,462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbfBehaviorMem is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

[NLP-75] Natural Jammers: When Non-Robust Features Become Antagonistic NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决深度神经网络在干净、未修改图像上仍表现不佳的问题，其核心在于揭示非鲁棒特征（non-robust features）并非简单的“捷径”，而是具有主动误导作用的自然干扰源（Natural Jammers）。传统观点认为这些特征是模型在干净数据上取得高准确率的偶然依赖，但本文提出，它们实际上会通过特定机制干扰模型决策，导致错误预测。解决方案的关键在于发现并验证“频谱-空间锁定”（Spectral-spatial Locking）现象：当高频成分与特定空间结构精确对齐时，才会引发干扰效应；一旦通过频域滤波或微小几何变换破坏该锁定关系，模型即可恢复正确预测。进一步揭示的“替换悖论”（Substitution Paradox）表明，尽管单个干扰源对几何扰动敏感，但整体干扰水平在变换下保持稳定，仅发生重新分布而非消除。这表明自然非鲁棒性并非孤立缺陷，而是一种存在于模型-数据经验几何结构中的可转移性失效场，其本质是系统性的而非局部的。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34785
作者: Jiaming Zhang,Fuyao Zhang,Pengjun Xie,Wei Yang Bryan Lim
机构: Nanyang Technological University (南洋理工大学); Alibaba Group (阿里巴巴集团)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remains approximately stable and is redistributed rather than eliminated under such transformations. Our results reframe natural non-robustness as a failure field over the empirical model-data geometry: one that redistributes rather than disappears under small transformations.

[NLP-76] DynEdit: Dynamic Entropy-Guided Sequential Editing for Large Language Models NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型中长序列知识更新的效率与精度问题，特别是现有参数编辑方法在处理长文本时存在的局限性：单点编辑覆盖范围不足，而固定分块编辑则采用均匀分配编辑力度的方式，无法针对信息密集且难编辑的高难度区域进行优先优化。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种动态编辑框架DynEdit，通过引入**令牌熵（token entropy）**作为衡量编辑难度与语义重要性的代理指标，实现两个核心创新：一是基于熵的非均匀滑动窗口机制，增强对高熵区域（即难编辑且富含关键事实的区域）的覆盖；二是采用熵引导的令牌级优化策略，在每个编辑窗口内强化对信息密度高的令牌的更新。实验结果表明，DynEdit在三个基准测试和两种主干模型上均显著优于现有基线，尤其在复杂改写查询任务中最高提升14.0 BLEU分数，并在多个知识领域接近饱和的语义评分，验证了其在长序列知识编辑中的有效性与普适性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34768
作者: Jinhu Fu,Yan Bai,Yihang Lou,Li Sun,Jiahong Wu,Xiangxiang Chu,Sen Su
机构: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications(北京邮电大学); Peking University(北京大学); AMAP, Alibaba Group(阿里巴巴集团AMAP); Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications(重庆邮电大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted by main conference of NeurIPS 2026 (poster)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Knowledge editing aims to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without full retraining. Existing parameter-editing methods remain limited for long-sequence knowledge: single-point editors provide insufficient coverage for extended targets, while fixed chunk-based editors distribute editing effort uniformly across rigid predefined windows, failing to prioritize difficult, information-dense tokens. In this work, we show that token entropy is closely associated with both editing difficulty and semantic importance: high-entropy regions are harder to edit and often contain key factual content. Motivated by this observation, we propose DynEdit, a dynamic framework for long-sequence knowledge editing. DynEdit uses token-level entropy to guide non-uniform sliding, increasing the coverage of difficult high-entropy regions, and further applies entropy-guided token-level optimization to strengthen updates on information-dense tokens within each editing window. Experiments on three benchmarks and two backbone models show that DynEdit consistently outperforms competitive baselines across diverse long-form editing settings, achieving gains of up to +14.0 BLEU points on challenging paraphrase queries and near-saturated semantic scores on several diverse knowledge domains.

[NLP-77] From Belief Inference to Task Action: A Multi-Level Evaluation of Theory of Mind on Verifiable Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在协作任务中缺乏对他人心理状态（Theory of Mind, ToM）的准确理解与有效利用的问题。现有理论心理模型评估多依赖故事问答类基准，但此类任务仅验证了模型对心智状态的推断能力，未能检验其是否能将这些推断转化为后续决策与行为。为此，论文提出一种多层次、可验证的评估框架，通过在家庭协作与日程安排任务中引入信息不对称场景，在保持原有约束条件和验证机制的基础上，构建独立接口以分别评估世界认知、信息获取、信念建模、决策制定及执行能力。通过设置对照实验，提供个体证据或正确信念以区分“信念恢复”与“信念使用”的差异。实验结果表明，不同模型配置在各项能力上表现分化显著：例如，Claude虽能正确恢复所有代理的信念，但在匹配日程场景中仅在67.9%的情况下生成主观最优计划；而Qwen-27B在提供信念信息后成功率从55.0%提升至75.0%，但其40亿参数版本虽能正确回答预设信念问题，却仅在20.0%的延续性任务中完成目标。这揭示了现有评估体系的局限性，强调必须将视角推断与独立可验证的决策及任务结果相连接，才能真实衡量模型在复杂协作情境中的真正心智建模与应用能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34759
作者: Zhenshuai Yin,Yongxin Guo,Mingda Zhang,Zhongze Luo,Haoyue Liu,Lianmin Zhang,Xiaoying Tang
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)(香港中文大学（深圳）); ByteDance Inc.(字节跳动); Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data(深圳市大数据研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Effective collaboration requires language models to understand what others know and believe, and to act accordingly. Models that assume others share their information may omit necessary communication and undermine coordination. Many theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks assess mental-state inference through story questions, but correct answers do not establish that models can use these judgments in subsequent tasks. We introduce a multi-level evaluation built on existing, verifiable tasks. We extend household collaboration and calendar scheduling with asymmetric information while retaining their original constraints and validators. Independent interfaces assess world understanding, information access, beliefs, decisions, and execution. Controls supply personal evidence or correct beliefs to distinguish state recovery from state use. Across six model configurations, these abilities diverge. On matched scheduling cases, Claude recovers all agent beliefs correctly but produces subjectively optimal plans in only 67.9% of cases. In household collaboration, supplying beliefs raises Qwen-27B success from 55.0% to 75.0%, yet Qwen-4B answers every fixed supplied-belief source question correctly while completing only 20.0% of the corresponding continuation condition. These results show why ToM evaluation must connect perspective inference to independently verified decisions and task consequences.

[NLP-78] Mechanistic Insights into LoRA: Layer Sparsity for Adaptive Fine-Tuning via Path Patching NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）在微调大语言模型时存在的效率瓶颈问题，即标准全层LoRA在变压器（Transformer）结构中均匀施加适应性调整，而未考虑各组件与层级对任务的实际贡献差异。其核心问题是：不同任务下关键的网络层存在显著异质性，导致全层适配造成大量冗余参数更新。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于校准驱动的自适应方法——Adaptive-LoRA，通过冻结基础模型的零消融（zero-ablation）策略，自动识别任务相关的特定层，实现无需穷举搜索的高效层选择。实验表明，在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型上针对11个多样化推理任务进行评估，Adaptive-LoRA仅使用30%的层数即可超越全层LoRA性能，同时将适配器参数量减少3.5倍，有效融合机制可解释性分析与实际效率优化，为自适应微调提供了理论依据与实践范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34756
作者: Fei Zuo,Yizhou Huang,Kezhi Wang
机构: East China Normal University(华东师范大学); Brunel University of London(布鲁内尔大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 31 pages, including appendices and the paper checklist

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Standard all-layer LoRA applies adaptation throughout the transformer, despite heterogeneous contributions from its components. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic interpretability analysis to understand how LoRA affects model internals. We observe that LoRA’s adaptation effect is highly non-uniform, with significant component-wise and layer-wise sparsity. Most critically, we find that important layers are highly task-dependent, with limited overlap across tasks. Motivated by these insights, we propose Adaptive-LoRA, a calibration-driven method that automatically identifies task-specific layers via frozen-base zero-ablation, enabling efficient layer selection without exhaustive search. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B across 11 diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that Adaptive-LoRA outperforms full-layer LoRA while using only 30% of layers, achieving a 3.5\times reduction in adapter parameters. This work bridges mechanistic interpretability and practical efficiency, providing both fundamental insights and a principled approach for adaptive fine-tuning.

[NLP-79] DecisionTraceBench: Tracking Decision-Critical Information in Multi-Party Spoken Conversations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决高风险领域（如金融）中多主体交互环境下决策信息状态演变的联合追踪问题，现有语音评估基准在转录、局部理解及回合级状态预测方面表现良好，但对跨说话人决策事件序列的联合演化缺乏充分评估。其核心解决方案是提出DecisionTraceBench，一个面向决策关键信息状态追踪（Decision-Critical Information State Tracking, DCIST）的语音状态追踪基准，通过轨迹级F1分数衡量完整事件链的恢复能力，综合评估决策事件序列、说话人归属、作用范围及时间证据。该数据集包含2至4名说话人的中文金融对话，涵盖100.39小时合成音频与8.61小时真人录音。在固定真人录音样本上，五种级联系统和两种直接音频模型的DCIST得分仅为5.73%至21.35%，即使在去除时间定位要求并使用带说话人标注的参考脚本的情况下，最高得分也仅达38.72%，表明当前方法在联合理解信息溯源与状态演化方面存在显著局限。音频扰动实验进一步揭示，整体转录错误率无法有效反映完整轨迹恢复情况，凸显了构建更全面评估框架的必要性，为高风险场景下决策过程理解和可追溯性提供了关键基准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34746
作者: Wenchao Du,Fangxin Shang,Long Wu,Runze Cui,Qing Yang,Yehui Yang
机构: AI Lab, Qifu Technology(启富科技), Beijing, China; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Project repository: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In high-stakes domains such as finance, critical information evolves through multi-party interaction. Recovering these changes and their sources is fundamental to reliable speech understanding. Existing speech benchmarks focus on transcription, local understanding, and turn-level state prediction, leaving joint decision evolution across speakers insufficiently evaluated. We introduce DecisionTraceBench, a speech state-tracking benchmark for Decision-Critical Information State Tracking (DCIST). It jointly evaluates decision event sequences, speaker attribution, scope, and temporal evidence, using trajectory-level F1 to measure complete event-chain recovery. Our dataset comprises Chinese financial dialogues involving two to four speakers, with 100.39 hours of synthetic audio and 8.61 hours of human-performed recordings. On a fixed cohort of human-performed recordings, five cascaded systems and two direct-audio models achieve DCIST scores of 5.73% to 21.35%. Ablations with speaker-labeled reference scripts and no temporal localization requirements yield a maximum score of only 38.72%. Audio perturbation experiments further show that overall transcription error rates do not adequately reflect complete trajectory recovery. These findings reveal limitations in jointly understanding information provenance and state evolution, providing a benchmark for evaluating decision-process understanding and decision traceability in high-stakes speech applications.

[NLP-80] LADDER: Diagnosing Domain-Level Self-Assessment Under Noisy Feedback

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在人机协作中如何准确评估自身能力的问题，尤其关注在交互反馈不可靠或不完整时，模型能否形成可信的自我认知。其解决方案的关键在于提出并使用LADDER框架，系统性地研究语言模型在面对不可靠反馈时的自我评估行为。研究发现，尽管模型能够准确复述提供的性能信息，但在基于实际交互经验进行自我评估时仍存在显著偏差，表面准确的评估结果可能掩盖真实的能力差异，且不具备对未来任务表现的有效预测能力。这表明，可信的自我评估必须基于与实际任务表现的对照，并具备预测价值。该研究为评估模型在可靠人机协作中的能力感知水平提供了实证依据，揭示了当前语言模型在自我知识方面的局限性。

作者: Zhenshuai Yin,Jianshu Liang,Xuyue Xiong,Yongxin Guo,Mingda Zhang,Zhongze Luo,Haoyue Liu,Lianmin Zhang,Xiaoying Tang
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)(香港中文大学（深圳）); Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data(深圳市大数据研究院); ByteDance(字节跳动)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Knowing when they are reliable is essential for language models to support human-AI collaboration. Yet interaction feedback is not always complete or correct, and may mislead models’ understanding of their own capabilities. We introduce LADDER to study how language models assess themselves under unreliable feedback. Our findings show that models can accurately report supplied performance information while still struggling to form trustworthy self-assessments from interaction experience. Apparently accurate assessments can obscure capability differences and do not necessarily predict future task performance. These findings suggest that trustworthy self-assessment should be evaluated against observed task performance and its predictive value. Our study provides empirical evidence of the limits of model self-knowledge and a basis for evaluating capability awareness in reliable human-AI collaboration.

[NLP-81] PrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决个性化移动使用代理（personal mobile-use agents）在面对用户请求中信息不完整（underspecified）时，如何有效推断缺失信息并适时向用户提问以实现精准服务的问题。其核心挑战在于：代理需在不做出无依据假设的前提下，从用户的历史行为中推理出可推断的信息（history-inferable），同时识别出必须由用户提供的信息（ask-only），并在交互中恰当地发起询问。解决方案的关键在于构建一个可执行的iOS环境下的基准测试平台iPrefBench，该平台基于包含3,051条历史活动事件的连贯人格模型，设计了130个跨26个应用的不完整任务，确保每个缺失项均为可推断或仅能通过提问获取。通过评估前沿代理在“个性化任务完成率”与“用户-代理交互合理性”两方面的表现，发现当前代理虽具备较高的动作执行成功率（最高达91.6%），但整体任务成功率偏低（最高仅47.7%），尤其在处理需提问的信息时严重不足，暴露出代理在“何时推断、何时提问”上的能力短板。因此，iPrefBench为开发真正理解用户并协同工作的智能代理提供了关键评估工具与研究方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34735
作者: Yuting Ning,Ruijia Cheng,Sushobhan Ghosh,Peitong Duan,HungShi Lin,Abhishek Sundararajan,Shreyash Pandey,Huan Sun,Jeffrey Nichols,Eldon Schoop
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user’s activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

[NLP-82] AdaTutor: Adaptive Tutoring through Pedagogical Strategy Selection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决智能辅导系统中如何动态选择最优教学策略与反馈形式的问题，即在面对学生错误时，如何根据互动进程自适应地调整教学方法以提升学习效果。其核心解决方案是提出一种**比较式教学监督（Comparative Pedagogical Supervision, CPS）**训练框架，通过对比不同教学策略的效果，让模型学习到在特定情境下选择最有效的反馈方式。实验表明，在数学与科学推理数据集上，经过五轮辅导后，CPS显著优于固定策略的基线模型；同时，所学得的教学策略具备跨数据集迁移能力，并可为基于API的独立辅导系统提供策略指导。

Abstract:Effective tutoring requires determining not only what information to provide, but also which form of assistance to deliver. A tutor may address the same student error using various pedagogical strategies, adapting its approach as the interaction progresses. We introduce Comparative Pedagogical Supervision (CPS), a training framework to learn to select the optimal strategy and feedback for student learning. We evaluate CPS on math and science reasoning datasets. After five tutoring turns, CPS outperforms the strongest fixed-strategy baselines. The learned tutor transfers across datasets, and its strategy selection can also inform a separate API-based tutor.

[NLP-83] Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低延迟语音代理在对话中难以确定请求可执行最早时刻（earliest actionable point, EAP）的问题。现有语音代理与对话语料库均未明确定义请求何时具备可执行性，导致系统常需等待整个话语回合结束才响应，造成不必要的延迟。其核心解决方案是构建一个合成式语音对话生成管道，通过受控任务生成、语音合成与对齐、以及门控标注机制，提供精确的EAP监督信号，标记出语音内容首次足以触发工具调用及其所需参数的时刻。基于此，研究构建了包含48个领域、总计786小时、26,694条对话的高质量数据集，并创建了τ²-bench的音频版本用于外部评估。在此基础上训练的全模态语言模型能够实现因果性、逐块级决策和部分转录生成，支持边听边决策。实验结果表明，该模型在保留对话与外部基准上的工具状态宏平均F1得分分别达到0.48和0.47，且在正确调用情况下，相较于以回合结束为触发点的基线方法，平均提前1.8–2.0秒（域内）和1.1秒（τ²-bench）完成调用，验证了基于数据驱动的方法在实现“听觉中行动”（acting while listening）方面的有效性。研究将开源该合成管道与训练脚本。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34653
作者: Yizhou Peng,Chen Chen,Donghang Wu,Hexin Liu,Eng Siong Chng
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: Submitted to ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of \tau^2 -bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downstream call completion. The model achieves tool-state macro-F1 scores of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and the external benchmark, respectively. For correct calls, the estimated mean lead over a turn-end cascade, using the same formatter, is 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on \tau^2 -bench. These results demonstrate a data-driven path toward spoken agents that act while listening. We will open-source the pipeline and the training scripts.

[NLP-84] Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决预训练循环语言模型（pretrained looped language model）在两跳检索（two-hop retrieval）任务中，后期循环（later loops）如何修复早期循环中错误的检索结果这一问题。其核心挑战在于理解并利用后期循环中可转移的信息来纠正前期循环中的错误推理路径，尤其是在缺乏显式桥接实体（bridge entity）提示的情况下。解决方案的关键在于通过在相同层、头和最终提示位置之间移植后期循环（如loop 3）的注意力查询（attention queries），发现一组可转移的、与层索引相关的晚期查询能够显著提升早期错误回答的修复率：在合成上下文问题上，将loop 3的查询注入loop 1可使原本在loop 1错误但在loop 3正确的90%和97%的问题被成功修复，远优于随机打乱捐赠者（shuffled donors）的24%和21%。此外，交叉交换（crossed donor-recipient swaps）表明模型更倾向于通过捐赠者的桥接实体进行检索而非直接复制答案，但位置信息在Ouro-2.6B中仍起重要作用。值得注意的是，后期键（keys）和值（values）的迁移效果较差，且冻结loop 1的查询会比提供匹配问题更严重地损害两跳准确性。在自然问题上，修复效果有限且仅在Ouro-2.6B中部分复现，交叉交换亦无法建立桥接重定向。综上，研究识别出一组可转移的晚期循环查询，支持在合成场景下的桥接条件检索，但未揭示桥接实体的具体计算位置，也未实现单一向量的交接机制。

作者: Ziyu Mu,Zehua Wang
机构: The University of British Columbia (不列颠哥伦比亚大学); Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (电气与计算机工程系)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries between loops at the same layer, head and final prompt position. On synthetic in-context questions, injecting the layer-indexed collection of loop-3 queries throughout loop 1 rescues 90% and 97% of questions answered incorrectly at loop 1 and correctly at loop 3, versus 24% and 21% for shuffled donors. The rescue also holds under greedy generation in Ouro-2.6B; in Ouro-1.4B it is limited to four-candidate ranking. Crossed donor-recipient swaps favor retrieval through the donor’s bridge entity over copying its answer, although a substantial positional component remains in Ouro-2.6B. Late keys and values rescue far fewer targets. Freezing queries at their loop-1 values also damages two-hop accuracy more than a matched question that supplies the bridge. On natural questions, rescue is smaller and replicates only in Ouro-2.6B, and crossed swaps do not establish bridge redirection. These results identify a transferable collection of late-loop queries that supports bridge-conditioned retrieval on synthetic scenes; they do not locate where the bridge is computed or establish a single-vector handoff.

[NLP-85] Entity Matching using Decision Models ATC

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决实体匹配（Entity Matching）任务中现有方法的局限性：基于预训练语言模型（PLM）的方法需要特定任务微调，而生成式大语言模型（LLM）虽无需微调但存在推理速度慢、成本高的问题。为此，论文提出将决策模型（Decision Models）作为生成式LLM与微调PLM的替代方案。其核心解决方案在于利用决策模型在零样本（zero-shot）场景下直接输出预定义答案选项的概率分布，而非生成文本，从而兼顾性能与效率。实验表明，四种表现最优的决策模型在无任务特定训练数据的情况下，平均F1得分接近甚至略超生成式LLM GPT-6 Luna，且在八项基准中的六项上优于基于PLM的Ditto模型；同时，所有决策模型均显著快于GPT-6 Luna，多数成本更低。此外，其中三个最强模型的预测概率具有良好的校准性，无需额外校准。通过构建模型级联（model cascade），将置信度最低的记录对路由至生成式LLM集成系统，可进一步提升决策模型的平均F1得分1.9至4.0个百分点，并在四项基准上超越已有文献报道的最佳性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34626
作者: Aaron Steiner,Ralph Peeters,Christian Bizer
机构: University of Mannheim(曼海姆大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 15 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables. Code, prompts, and results: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Entity matching is the task of deciding whether two records describe the same real-world entity. Current entity matching methods rely on pre-trained language models (PLMs) which require task specific fine-tuning or generative large language models (LLMs) which do not require task-specific fine-tuning but are slow and expensive at matching large record sets. Decision models are a new class of LLM-based models that return a probability for each predefined answer option rather than generate text. This paper investigates decision models as an alternative to generative LLMs and fine-tuned PLMs for entity matching. We evaluate six decision models in a zero-shot setting across eight benchmarks and compare their performance with that of the generative LLM GPT-6 Luna and the PLM-based matcher Ditto. Our experiments show that, without task-specific training data, the four strongest decision models achieve mean F1 scores close to that of GPT-6 Luna, with the best model slightly surpassing it. This model also outperforms Ditto on six of the eight benchmarks. All decision models are faster than GPT-6 Luna, and most are less expensive. For three of the four strongest decision models, the predicted match probabilities are well calibrated without requiring any task-specific recalibration. A model cascade that routes the least confident record pairs to an ensemble of generative LLMs improves the mean F1 scores of the four strongest decision models by 1.9-4.0 percentage points. Using the best decision model and its best-performing prompt for each benchmark, the cascade surpasses the highest published F1 scores from literature on four of the eight benchmarks.

[NLP-86] One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语音识别模型在缺乏配对语音-文本数据时的训练瓶颈问题，通过引入无配对文本的文本注入（Text Injection）方法，使模型能够利用大量未配对的文本数据进行有效训练。其核心解决方案是用一个简单的查找表（lookup table）替代原先依赖的冻结文本到语音（Text-to-Speech, TTS）合成器，具体实现为：每个音素对应一个均值对数梅尔倒谱系数（mean log-mel vector）或一热编码向量，并根据对齐统计分布随机采样持续时间，词间插入静音。该方法显著提升了训练效率，达到神经TTS方案1.8倍的速度提升，同时保持相近的词错误率（Word Error Rate, WER）。此外，结合外部语言模型，在LibriSpeech数据集上实现了1.36% / 2.90% / 1.52% / 3.24%的WER（dev/test-clean/other），据作者所知为仅使用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本及词典的最先进水平。研究还系统分析了合成输入中持续时间与声学特征的影响，比较了不同隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）对齐器性能，评估了在25,000小时Loquacious数据集上的可扩展性，并验证了全编码器注入（full-encoder injection）相较于部分编码器或解码器级注入具有更显著的相对性能提升。整个实验流程的代码均已公开。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34623

机构: AppTek(应用科技); NVIDIA(英伟达)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)

Abstract:Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech dev,test-clean,other, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. We analyze components of synthetic input (durations, acoustic features), compare different HMM aligners, evaluate scaling on the 25 000 h Loquacious dataset, and show that full-encoder injection yields strong relative improvements compared to partial-encoder and decoder methods. The code of the whole pipeline behind every number in this paper is public: this http URL

[NLP-87] Does the Outfit Change the Price? Context Halo in Vision-Language Model Valuation of an Identical Low-Cost Necklace

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在视觉商品估价任务中受上下文影响的偏差问题，具体表现为同一物品在不同使用场景下的价格估计存在显著差异。其核心发现是：尽管物品本身未变，但当图像呈现于正式着装、派对、回收场或平铺静物等不同情境时，六种前沿语言模型对其估价差异高达1.9至3.57倍，且这种效应在文本描述任务中同样存在，说明其根源并非像素级视觉线索，而是模型对语境暗示的过度敏感。解决方案的关键在于识别并验证“上下文诱导的价格放大”机制——即模型会将穿戴场景与社会价值符号（如正式性、时尚感）关联，从而系统性高估物品价值。研究进一步表明，仅通过简单指令要求模型忽略服饰与环境可部分缓解该偏差（如某模型比率降至0.77），但对多数模型效果有限；而提供照片来源信息（公司官网或个人账号）则无显著影响。这揭示了当前生成式AI在客观评估任务中存在深层认知偏见，亟需通过多对象、多观察者基准实验进行可重复验证，并推动更稳健的上下文去偏策略发展。

作者: Brianne Lee
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A chunky gold-tone chain necklace bought online for 2.43 USD was photographed four ways: worn with formal attire against a wood-panelled wall, worn at a party, worn with casual clothing in a recycling yard, and laid flat with no person present. We asked six frontier language models to estimate its price in 1,164 independent and sequential API sessions (4,604 logged rows) and compared estimates across settings. Among the four models that answered image prompts, the same necklace was priced 1.9 to 3.3 times higher in the formal photograph than in the flat-lay (all p 0.01). Against the yard photograph, the ratio ranged from 1.23 (Grok 4.5, not significant) to 3.57 (Kimi K3), with Claude Fable 5 at 3.32. A text-only version of the task, in which the setting is described in words, produced formal-to-yard ratios of 2.2 to 3.9 in all six models, so the effect does not require pixels. Flat-lay estimates themselves were 7.8 to 18.7 times the receipt price, so part of any headline “outfit multiplier” computed against the receipt is baseline overestimate, not a context effect. A single instruction to ignore clothing and setting significantly reduced the effect in one model (ratio of ratios 0.77, 95% CI 0.65 to 0.91) and not detectably in the others; telling the model the photo came from a company website or a personal account changed nothing significant. Asked afterward whether a different outfit would have changed their number, Claude Fable 5 said yes in 24 of 24 sessions, GPT-5.6 in 69%, and GPT-4o in 18%, while GPT-4o also refused 79% of image estimation prompts. The study isolates a mechanism with one object and one wearer at about 10 sessions per model and condition; we outline the replication needed next, with multiple objects and a human benchmark. Data, code, and raw outputs are released.

[NLP-88] Large Language Models : A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在实际应用中面临的透明性与可解释性问题，尤其关注训练过程、提示工程及模型微调等环节对生成结果的影响。其核心挑战在于：如何清晰区分模型能力的来源——是来自预训练阶段的通用知识，还是微调或提示设计带来的特定行为；同时应对数据泄露（data contamination）、幻觉（hallucination）、长上下文处理能力不足以及评估偏差等关键局限。解决方案的关键在于系统性地梳理并整合多种先进方法：通过引入检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）提升事实准确性，利用链式思维提示（Chain-of-Thought Prompting）促进推理过程可追溯性，采用基于人类反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, RLHF）优化响应质量，并结合FlashAttention与量化低秩适配（Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, QLoRA）分别降低计算开销与微调内存占用。此外，论文提出一套评估检查清单，强调独立验证事实准确性与判断回答实用性，以实现对大语言模型性能的客观、可靠评估。

作者: Bahaeddin Türkoğlu
机构: Ankara University (安卡拉大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 16 references. Author’s preprint; to be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

[NLP-89] STEP: Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction Correctness via Per-Step Probability Scoring EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在缺乏真实标签（ground truth）的情况下，如何可靠评估大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）预测正确性的关键问题，尤其针对高风险应用场景中的可信部署需求。现有方法如熵（entropy）和困惑度（perplexity）仅依赖最终输出的统计特征，忽略了推理过程中蕴含的丰富中间信息。为此，本文提出一种无需训练的框架——STEP（Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness），其核心在于通过轻量级前向传播对每一推理步骤生成候选答案的软概率分布 $ q_i $，并据此构建一组捕捉每一步置信度及其向最终答案演进过程的软轨迹特征（soft trajectory features）。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准测试中显著优于基于输出的基线方法及硬指标轨迹方法，尤其在AUROC指标上表现突出。其中，时间加权一致性（Temporally-Weighted Consistency）通过赋予推理后期更稳定的答案分布更高权重，带来了最大性能提升，凸显了推理轨迹中时间结构的重要性。这一成果进一步验证了保留连续概率信号相较于二值化处理的优势。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34537
作者: Chenyang Yu,Zifan Zeng,Qunli Zhang,Feng Liu
机构: Technical University of Munich (慕尼黑工业大学); RAMS Lab, Huawei Heisenberg Research Center (华为海森堡研究中心)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026) at EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.

[NLP-90] Does the Voynich Manuscript Mean Anything? Calibrated Tests Find Little Trace of Language

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决《Voynich手稿》文本是否为无意义的随机构造，抑或隐藏着可破译的真实语言这一长期争议性问题。其核心挑战在于：如何在缺乏已知解码规则的情况下，通过统计证据区分“人为虚构的抄写产物”与“经过加密的真实语言文本”。解决方案的关键在于将两种假设分别建模为可执行程序——一种模拟逐字复制并轻微变异的生成过程（如Timm和Schinner提出的抄写模型），另一种则基于不同类型的密码机制（如单密钥替换、多密钥分段加密、词类编码等），并在相同的计算预算下对这些程序进行拟合与验证。研究发现，单纯的抄写模型在预测文本的词频统计特征方面显著优于单一密钥的加密模型；然而，若采用针对手稿中两种方言切换密钥的加密方案，或仅对真实文本的词类进行编码，则其预测能力与抄写模型相当，表明仅依靠词频统计无法明确区分二者。因此，研究进一步引入“词语共现模式”作为语言结构的独立指标——在16种语言共28个文本中，特定词对频繁出现在同一行的现象普遍存在，而《Voynich手稿》虽表现出该模式但强度仅为最弱参考文本的一半。当使用词码（word code）模型时，该模式仍能被保留，前提是明文本身具有较强结构且误抄率较低。实验表明，在多种密码类型（包括字母替换、词码及28种每词对应一个字母/字母对/音节的编码）下，均无法从控制文本中解出可读内容，暗示手稿可能未包含可识别的明文信息。值得注意的是，以缩略拉丁语为明文的词码模型能更清晰地揭示词序关系，除非超过五分之二的词汇发生误抄。最终，唯一仍可能成立的模型是带有第二密钥的名目密码（nomenclator），其制作者误抄了超过一半的词汇，且当前解码方法无法在16种语言中的9种中排除该可能性。此外，解码结果表明，大多数可观测到的结构源于词尾与词首之间的连续性，这反映了符号之间紧密绑定的书写习惯。只有当消息足够长、每个字母始终映射为同一词且词间相邻时，才能可靠检测到嵌入信息，这意味着其他潜在信息可能仍隐藏于手稿之中。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34499
作者: Xin Zhang,Victor S. Sheng
机构: Texas Tech University (德克萨斯理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The Voynich manuscript is a fifteenth-century book in a script that no one can read. One account holds that its text means nothing and that a scribe made it by copying his own words and changing them a little. The other holds that a real language lies hidden behind a cipher. We write each account as a program that fills the pages of the manuscript, fit every program with the same budget, and check it on statistics the fit never saw. The copying process of Timm and Schinner predicts these statistics far better than any cipher with one key. But ciphers that switch keys between the manuscript’s two dialects, or that encode only the word classes of a real text, predict them equally well. Word statistics alone cannot decide. We look for a trace of language that needs no decipherment. In 28 texts in 16 languages the same word pairs keep sharing a line. The manuscript shows this pattern at half the strength of the weakest of these texts. A word code keeps the pattern above the manuscript unless its plaintext has a weak pattern or many words are miscopied. Solvers that decipher control texts find no readable text in the manuscript under a letter cipher, a word code or 28 codes with one letter, letter pair or syllable per word. Word codes of abbreviated Latin, the plaintext their fits prefer, show which word follows which more clearly than the manuscript unless two words in five are miscopied. One cipher remains possible, a nomenclator with a second key whose scribe miscopies more than half of the words, and our solvers cannot exclude it in 9 of 16 languages. Most of the structure a solver finds comes from how the end of one word shapes the start of the next, which reflects how tightly glyphs are bound to each other. Planted messages are found reliably only when they are long, each letter always becomes the same word and these words are adjacent, so other messages could hide.

[NLP-91] What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型推理过程中“推理努力程度”（reasoning effort）选择的不确定性问题。在当前生成式 AI 模型中，用户需预先决定推理计算资源的投入水平，但无法预知额外计算是否真正提升性能，且即使任务成功完成，也无法判断所支付的计算成本是否具有边际价值。由于这种投入的边际效用不可观测，推理努力本质上是一种“可信品”（credence good）。为此，研究通过在四个基准测试上对专有模型与开源权重模型进行系统性评估，量化不同努力水平的反事实影响。研究发现，高努力水平并非总是提升性能：它不仅可能丢失低努力即可解决的任务，还存在过度消耗计算资源的问题，并显著改变智能体的任务求解轨迹——如更频繁地自我验证和搜索而非直接推理，从而延长推理路径但未必改善结果。实验表明，简单采用从最低努力起步、仅在失败后逐步升级的策略，在所有模型与基准上均能以更低成本实现或超越固定最高努力水平的表现，证明了动态调整策略在成本效率与实例级性能上的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34491
作者: Kaiser Sun,Yongchan Kwon,Zain Hasan,Shang Zhu,Kaitlyn Zhou,Federico Bianchi
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.

[NLP-92] Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决形式化系统（如Lean 4）中自动化数学推理时，传统多候选答案求解流程中存在的计算冗余问题。在传统方法中，每个候选答案需独立进行定理证明搜索，导致大量重复计算开销。其核心解决方案是提出一种联合证明框架（joint proof framework），将候选答案选择、答案补全与形式化证明生成整合为统一的推理过程。该框架的核心是一个经过训练的证明生成器（prover），能够在单次调用中同时完成答案选择（包括采纳已有答案或提出新答案）与至少一个答案的可验证证明生成。此外，该框架可通过复用已生成的证明来检测语义不忠实性：若在相同形式化命题下，两个不同答案均能获得可验证证明，则表明该形式化陈述未能忠实保留原始问题的语义。在MATH-500、AMC 2023以及AIME 2024/2025/2026数据集上，该框架在保持与逐候选证明生成相当的形式化证明成功率的同时，仅消耗约六分之一的令牌成本，并且无需额外人工评判即可识别出至少6.1%的形式化陈述存在语义失真问题。

作者: Pengzhen Lin,Ke Zhang,Maziar Raissi,Zhouxing Shi
机构: University of California, Riverside(加州大学河滨分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Code and model: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at this https URL.

[NLP-93] AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决移动设备上多模态智能体在动态环境中因中间错误导致任务失败后，缺乏有效恢复能力的评估与训练问题。传统评估方法仅关注从干净初始状态下的任务成功率，无法衡量智能体在非理想状态或未知环境中的鲁棒性与容错能力。其核心解决方案在于提出AndroidFlux——一个基于AndroidWorld构建的故障恢复基准测试框架，通过将已记录的任务轨迹回放至首次可恢复错误前、中、后的可控检查点（checkpoint），实现不同智能体在相同设备状态和历史路径下进行公平比较。同时，引入互补的奖励建模基准，基于下游滚动执行结果评估恢复动作的偏好，从而量化恢复性能。此外，研究还发布了离线强化学习（Offline Reinforcement Learning, RL）数据集，显著提升了错误恢复能力和整体任务成功率。实验表明，恢复性能与无错误启动的成功率仅有部分相关性，且显式推理仅对经过图形用户界面（GUI）领域特定强化学习训练的模型有效，揭示了当前智能体在复杂动态场景中自主纠错能力的局限性。

作者: Gyubeum Lim,Yemo Koo,Ghunwoo Jang,Zsolt Kira
机构: Georgia Institute of Technology(佐治亚理工学院); Konkuk University(韩国中央大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

[NLP-94] Whether or Where? Tail Calibration Signals Finite-Budget Reward Hacking in Best-of-N Selection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在最佳- N（Best-of-N, BoN）推理过程中，因代理奖励（proxy reward）的尾部偏差导致性能下降的问题。具体而言，当增大采样数量 $ N $ 时，BoN 依赖于代理奖励的极端尾部表现，而该尾部可能因模型校准偏差或噪声分布特性出现非单调退化，从而使得高 $ N $ 下的输出质量反而劣于低 $ N $。其解决方案的关键在于揭示了精确的 BoN 值可表示为基于 Beta 权重的条件真实奖励在同提示内得分分位数上的积分，表明 BoN 仅依赖于得分的相对排名而非绝对值。进一步推导出：只有当尾部校准曲线呈向下倾斜趋势时，BoN 才会下降，且衰退发生的预算阈值取决于该下倾点的位置。在受限加性误差模型下，误差分布的尾部特性决定了最终行为——高斯误差持续提升，拉普拉斯误差趋于平台，重尾误差则回退至先验均值。尤其当真实奖励较低时误差方差最大，即使高斯噪声亦可能导致 BoN 低于随机选择。通过合成相图验证了该分类体系的有效性；在涵盖多个可验证领域、基础策略及学习型奖励模型的真实候选集上，尾部失败极为罕见，且全部集中于代码生成任务。此外，一个保留的尾部校准统计量能可靠预测跨拟合预算上限的收益，其预测能力与排名准确率相当，且该预算上限在性能上可媲美 Soft-BoN 基线。因此，尾部校准并非替代传统排序指标，而是一种不受任何单调变换影响的审计工具，能够识别出存在风险的预算设置。

作者: Cheng Gui,Yihua Shao,Lei Li,Jingcai Guo,Maolin Wang
机构: City University of Hong Kong(香港城市大学); University of Science and Technology Beijing(北京科技大学); University of Washington(华盛顿大学); Hong Kong Polytechnic University(香港理工大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 28 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Best-of-N (BoN) inference returns the candidate with the highest proxy reward, so a larger N tests the proxy’s extreme tail more than its average ranking quality. We show that the exact BoN value is a Beta-weighted integral of conditional true reward over within-prompt score quantiles. It follows that BoN depends on scores only through their ranks. It also follows that BoN can decline only if the calibration curve in the tail turns downward, and the budget where the decline appears depends on where that turn lies. Under a bounded additive model, the error tail sets the limit: Gaussian errors keep improving, Laplace errors reach a plateau, and heavy-tailed errors return to the prior mean. When error variance is largest at low true reward, even Gaussian noise can push BoN below random selection. Synthetic phase maps agree with this taxonomy. On real candidate pools spanning several verifiable domains, base policies, and learned reward models, tail failures are rare and all occur in code generation. A held-out tail calibration statistic reliably predicts where a cross-fitted budget cap helps. It does about as well as rank accuracy, and the cap is competitive with a Soft-BoN baseline. Tail calibration therefore does not replace ranking metrics. It is an audit that is unchanged by any monotone rescaling of the reward scores and shows which budgets are at risk.

[NLP-95] Beyond the Opening: Tracing the First Tokens Persistent Influence on Reasoning Length

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理过程中初始词元（first token）如何持续影响推理长度这一关键问题。其核心发现是：尽管仅替换推理序列的首个词元，其余上下文保持不变，但后续推理长度仍发生显著变化，表明初始选择具有持久性影响。解决方案的关键在于揭示这种影响的机制——通过分析不同首词元条件下的下一个词元分布，研究发现注意力敏感位置集中于少数特定生成阶段。当屏蔽这些敏感位置对首词元的注意力时，不同首词元条件间的推理长度差异显著缩小；反之，在这些位置使用另一首词元条件的分布也能显著改变后续推理长度。这表明，首词元通过在少数关键生成步骤中维持注意力连接，从而持续影响整体推理长度，揭示了局部词元选择如何通过注意力机制塑造全局序列行为。

作者: Ruochen Liu,Hao Yan,Ziluowen Luo,Senzhang Wang,Sihong Xie
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)(香港科技大学(广州)); Central South University (中南大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding how individual token choices affect reasoning length is important for characterizing reasoning models. Building on prior findings that changing the first reasoning token (hereafter, the first token) can substantially alter reasoning length, we focus on this initial choice to investigate how its influence operates during subsequent generation. One possibility is that the first token changes the early text that follows, which in turn affects reasoning length. However, replacing only the first token of an existing reasoning prefix and resuming generation substantially changes the remaining reasoning length, even though all other prefix tokens are unchanged. To trace this persistent influence, we compare next-token distributions while varying only the first token and find that sensitivity is concentrated at a small set of generation positions. Blocking attention from these positions to the first token reduces the length gap between first-token conditions. Using next-token distributions from a different first-token condition at these positions also substantially changes subsequent reasoning length. Together, these findings suggest that attention to the first token at a few sensitive positions helps sustain its length effect, illustrating how a local token choice persistently influences a sequence-level outcome.

[NLP-96] Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决结构化语义解析中仅关注类别识别正确性而忽视值恢复与实例级关联的问题，即系统可能正确识别事件或意图，却将论元绑定至错误实例或提供不准确的槽位值。其解决方案的核心是提出USP（Unified Semantic Parsing），一种跨任务家族的统一语义契约，通过统一接口同时表征类别、字段、值及实例关联，涵盖命名实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取和意图-槽位解析四大任务。USP配套五种诊断匹配视图——类别一致性、字段识别、字段-值配对、实例绑定分配与完整实例恢复——从不同维度对同一输出进行精细化评估。基于此契约，研究将61个数据集归一化为共享模式、提示和匹配规则的统一语料库，并在固定测试子集上对比六种模型。实验表明，微调后的Xing4.0-29B-Intent模型在任务平衡的字段-值微观F1上达到57.70，且在所有任务族和五个视图中均排名第一；其相对于最强替代方案的性能差距从类别匹配的2.93点扩大至完整实例匹配的20.73点，揭示了仅依赖类别一致性的评估会严重低估结构缺陷。因此，USP为社区提供了可衡量、可比较的统一表示框架、标准化语料库及诊断评估协议，显著提升了结构化语义解析中结构性一致性的可评估性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34343
作者: Zhongqiu Li,Boyang Wang,Ruiyu Fang,Shiquan Wang,Di Wu,Jiayi Liang,Feilong Zhang,Hongfeng Du,Xiaomeng Huang,Mengjiao Bao,Luwen Pu,Xuewei He,Yu Zhao,Chao Wang,Kaidong Yu,Bingkai Yang,Qingjun Zhu,Shaoyi Du,Shuangyong Song,Yongxiang Li
机构: Xingchen AGI Lab, China Telecom Artificial Intelligence Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd(中国电信人工智能技术（北京）有限公司); State Key Laboratory of Human-Machine Hybrid Augmented Intelligence, Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Xi’an Jiaotong University(西安交通大学人工智能与机器人研究所人机混合增强智能国家重点实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
