点击查看摘要

Abstract:Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views—category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery—that ask distinct questions about the same output. Using this contract, we normalize 61 datasets into a unified corpus with shared schemas, prompts, and matching rules, and compare six models on a fixed test subset. Our fine-tuned Xing4.0-29B-Intent attains 57.70 task-balanced Field-Value Micro-F1 (equally weighted across the four task families) and ranks first in every family and on all five views; its margin over the strongest alternative widens from 2.93 points for category matching to 20.73 points for complete-instance matching. This widening gap shows that category agreement alone understates structural deficits. USP thus offers the community a shared representation, a normalized 61-dataset corpus, and a diagnostic evaluation protocol that make structural agreement measurable and comparable across extraction and intent-slot tasks.

[NLP-97] Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long–Short Contrastive Pruning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型推理过程中因模型规模庞大和思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）过长导致的高服务成本问题。现有方法中，权重剪枝（weight pruning）与思维链压缩（CoT compression）虽分别针对模型体积与推理长度进行优化，但二者存在协同干扰：剪枝会引入冗余推理（对仍能正确求解的问题）或不完整推理（对已无法求解的问题），且在处理更复杂问题时还会降低后续基于偏好（preference-based）的长度优化可压缩性。作者指出，这一问题源于两方面的“盲点”——剪枝标准无法区分必要推理与冗余推理，而基于偏好的压缩方法在剪枝后无法对模型始终正确或始终错误的问题提供有效的训练信号。为此，论文提出对比集合差分（Contrastive Set-Difference, CSD）方法，通过对比同一问题在长正确解与短正确解下的神经元激活差异，识别并优先剪除在冗余推理中富集的神经元；同时将偏好样本扩展至剪枝后模型始终正确或始终错误的问题。实验表明，在对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 模型剪枝 20% 的情况下，该联合方案在四个数学基准上比先使用推理感知校准（RAC）再进行压缩的方法减少 8–22% 的思考令牌消耗，同时保持精度在 0.5 点以内，验证了其高效性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34336
作者: Tao Jing,Chen Kang,Feifei Zhai,Pengyuan Liu,Dong Yu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 11 pages. Preliminary version; further experiments and revisions are planned

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8–22% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration (RAC) followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

[NLP-98] CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长时程对话历史中显著信息提取的挑战，尤其针对大语言模型（LLM）因上下文窗口受限及高效检索困难所导致的信息丢失、检索冗余和局部注意力局限等问题。其核心解决方案在于提出CoLink框架，通过引入认知科学中“对话即意义建构与记忆关联”的理念，构建跨语义关联的领域特定多轮对话信息链接与压缩机制。关键创新点在于：首先基于主题图谱对历史上下文进行聚类，建立与外部知识的跨语义关联；其次，在自适应思维控制（adaptive control of thought）引导下，协同语义相关性与图结构拓扑实现知识的精准检索与激活；更重要的是，基于信息论原理，设计了具有理论依据的优化目标，用于提取核心意义建构信息，结合竞争性槽位机制，将全局上下文与知识高效压缩至专用的记忆与知识槽中，生成高度紧凑的潜在表示。该方法显著提升了长对话场景下的全局上下文感知能力与知识融合效果。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34335
作者: Lian Yan,Zhenbo Xia,Haotian Wang,Chen Tang,Yi Guan,Jie Liu,Jingchi Jiang
机构: Harbin Institute of Technology (哈尔滨工业大学); National Key Laboratory of Smart Farm Technologies and Systems (国家智能农业技术与系统重点实验室); Institute for Advanced Algorithms Research (先进算法研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 7 pages, 15 figures, work in prograss

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs’ global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink’s superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

[NLP-99] Birth Death and Diff: Insertion-Based Sequence Generation with Corrections

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于插入的掩码扩散模型（insertion-based masked diffusion models, MDMs）在并行生成过程中因生成决策不可逆而导致的错误累积问题。这类模型在高并发解码时易引入难以纠正的错误，迫使采用保守的解码策略以保证质量，从而牺牲生成效率。此外，由于训练中对多种对齐方式的概率平均（marginalization），其输出熵较高，进一步加剧了对保守解码的需求。为此，本文提出δMDM，其核心创新在于引入替换（substitution）与删除（deletion）操作，使中间生成结果具备可修正性。训练阶段，模型通过暴露于激进的解码错误中学习自我纠错能力；推理阶段，则通过交错插入、去掩码与修正步骤，动态调整已生成内容并移除冗余掩码，实现更激进但可靠的并行生成。这一机制显著提升了生成速度与质量，在无条件文本生成任务中，相较于基准模型FlexMDM，δMDM在最高推理预算下将生成困惑度降低50%，且在所有预算水平上均优于从零训练的变长填充序列标准MDM；在条件生成任务中，其精度与FlexMDM相当，但仅需一半的前向传递次数（NFEs）。因此，δMDM在速度-质量权衡上实现了帕累托改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34310
作者: Durga Prasad Maram,Dhruvesh Patel,Tahira Naseem,Benjamin Rozonoyer,Gaurav Pandey,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo,Andrew McCallum
机构: IBM Research(IBM 研究院); University of Massachusetts Amherst(马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Insertion-based masked diffusion models enable flexible-length, parallel generation by interleaving mask insertion with token unmasking. However, because their generation decisions are irreversible, aggressive parallel decoding can introduce errors that subsequent steps cannot correct, necessitating conservative decoding with more forward passes (NFEs). Moreover, they exhibit higher entropy than standard MDMs because they marginalize over multiple alignments during training and therefore require even more conservative decoding in the absence of a correction mechanism. To address this limitation, we introduce \delta MDM, which makes intermediate generations revisable by equipping an insertion-based model with substitution and deletion operations. During training, we expose the model to errors caused by aggressive unmasking and insertion, teaching it to correct its own mistakes. At inference time, we interleave insertion and unmasking with correction steps that can revise previously unmasked tokens and remove unnecessary masks. This mechanism makes aggressive decoding practical, improving both generation speed and quality. \delta MDM Pareto-dominates FlexMDM, a vanilla insertion-based MDM, on the speed–quality trade-off. On high-diversity unconditional text generation on OpenWebText, it halves the generative perplexity relative to FlexMDM at the highest inference budget. It also achieves lower generative perplexity at all inference budgets compared to MDM trained from scratch with variable-length padded sequences. On low-diversity conditional text generation on TinyGSM, it matches FlexMDM accuracy with half as many NFEs.

[NLP-100] ransformer to GPT -5: Advancements Limitations and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design ICIP

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）缺乏系统性分类体系的问题，致力于构建一个全面、细致的LLM分类框架。其核心挑战在于如何在模型规模不断扩张的背景下，实现架构复杂性与数据质量之间的最优平衡。解决方案的关键在于揭示：当前新一代AI模型的成功标志并非单纯追求参数量或计算资源的线性增长，而是通过优化“架构复杂性与数据质量之比”，在不显著增加计算负担的前提下，提升模型的推理稳定性与对齐能力。这一平衡机制成为衡量模型可持续扩展性的关键指标，为未来LLM的发展提供了理论指引与实践方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34281
作者: Harsidak Singh Banwait,Chander Prabha
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 5 pages, ICIPCN

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

[NLP-101] A Russian a Brazilian and a German Walk into a Bar Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在处理具有主观性、争议性及证据冲突的跨语言真实世界问题时，其观点表现存在语言偏倚与不一致性的核心挑战。现有评估基准多局限于英语语境，难以反映全球用户多元视角的差异。为此，研究者构建了PerspectivesQA——一个涵盖18种语言、经人工验证的多语言争议性话题数据集，并提出ROOTS框架，用于系统性地刻画语言特征、观点分布与表述框架的多样性。关键发现表明：在英语中，大模型倾向于采取模糊或保守立场（hedging），而在低资源语言中则更易表现出明确且固执的观点倾向；大规模模型展现出更强的跨语言一致性世界观，而小规模模型则更易受输入扰动影响；此外，所有模型对输入表面形式的微小变化均表现出高度敏感性，即使在大型模型中亦可能引发显著立场偏移。因此，解决方案的关键在于通过多语言实证数据与系统性分析框架，揭示并量化模型在跨语言情境下的观点偏差机制，为提升模型的公平性与稳健性提供理论依据与实践路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34278
作者: Wiem Ben Rim,Yao Lu,Pontus Stenetorp,Emine Yilmaz
机构: University College London(伦敦大学学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. Larger models maintain a more consistent cross-lingual worldview, while smaller models are more easily swayed. All models also exhibit high sensitivity to minor surface-level input variations, producing notable stance even in larger models.

[NLP-102] Synthetic linguistic data

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言数据（Generative Language Data）在语言学研究中日益广泛应用背景下，其作为研究对象的性质与解释方法缺乏系统性界定的问题。当前研究既涉及对大规模人工智能生成文本的分析，也包括在受控条件下检验语法与词汇偏好的实验，但这些数据的类型与生成机制差异显著，导致研究结论的可比性与解释力面临挑战。论文的关键解决方案在于提出“人工植物苗圃”（artificial plant nursery）这一新隐喻，以区分两类合成数据：一类是“合成灌木丛数据”（synthetic bush data），即由模型生成的、类似语料库的语言集合；另一类是“合成花园数据”（synthetic garden data），即在受控条件下诱发模型输出以检验特定语言假说的数据。该区分的核心在于强调合成数据应被视为独立的语言学研究对象，其与自然语言数据的对比不仅可揭示共性模式，更需审慎考量其生成条件，从而为合成数据的科学使用提供理论框架与方法论指导。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34215
作者: Giuseppe Samo
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 11 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan’s (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

[NLP-103] Higher Reasoning Effort Improves Reference Verifiability and Changes Reasoning Summaries in GPT -5.5

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在科学知识生产中生成参考文献的可验证性问题，特别是探究增加推理努力程度是否能够提升所生成参考文献的准确性与可信度。其核心解决方案的关键在于通过对比低努力与高努力两种推理模式下GPT-5.5生成的学术参考文献及其推理过程摘要，系统评估推理强度对参考文献可验证性的影响。研究发现，提高推理努力使论文级可解析验证的参考文献比例从78.3%提升至84.8%，且推理摘要长度显著增加；四个预定义特征评分均随努力程度上升而提高。然而，模型自主发现的新特征在不同条件下的出现频率变化不一致，且无论在何种努力条件下，各特征得分与验证率之间均未呈现稳定正相关关系，表明推理质量与验证结果之间的关联并非线性或可直接预测。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34212
作者: Melika Mobini,Andres Algaba,Vincent Ginis
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 4 main figures. Supplementary material included

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models are increasingly being used in different stages of scientific knowledge production, including the suggestion of references. These models can operate at different levels of reasoning effort and provide summaries of their reasoning processes. This raises two questions: Does increasing reasoning effort improve the verifiability of generated references, and do the resulting reasoning summaries reveal how the model’s behavior changes with greater effort? We examined summaries from GPT-5.5 as it generated scholarly references for 1,000 papers under paired low- and high-effort settings. Generated references were matched to external bibliographic records, and reasoning summaries were scored for four predefined features and explored for additional features discovered by GPT-5.5. High effort increased the mean paper-level resolver-verified reference rate from 78.3% to 84.8%, and produced longer reasoning summaries. All four predefined features received higher scores under high effort. The discovered features changed less uniformly: some appeared equally often in both conditions, whereas others were more common under high effort. Within each effort condition, neither feature set showed a consistent increase in verification rates with higher scores.

[NLP-104] MIS-VQA: An Annotation-Driven Surgical Vision-Language Dataset for Complex Surgical Understanding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前外科手术视觉-语言理解（Surgical Vision-Language Understanding）中普遍存在的多模态理解能力不足问题，尤其针对现有数据集在任务监督上局限于单一任务（如识别或模板化问答）、缺乏自然描述性标注以及空间关系与操作上下文信息稀疏等关键缺陷。其核心解决方案在于构建MIS-VQA——一个通过注释驱动的流水线生成的外科手术视觉-语言数据集，将异构的手术标注（包括阶段、器械、交互、三元组及分割标签）统一转化为结构化的文本场景表征，从而引导大语言模型生成具有临床一致性的问答对。该数据集支持四种响应类型：简洁与详细描述、感知级定位以及多步推理，实现了从原子级视觉定位到复合推理的分层评估体系；为缓解标注稀疏性问题，引入置信度过滤的分割结果与跨注释一致性校验机制，实现大规模空间对齐的监督。此外，研究进一步提出LLaVA-SurgXpert系列外科视觉-语言模型，验证了视觉表征对多模态推理的影响，实验表明其在基准测试中持续优于现有方法，同时揭示了以往基准中被掩盖的感知定位与高层推理能力之间的差距。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34210
作者: Mohamed Hamdy,Iheb Zouari,Fatmaelzahraa Ahmed,Muraam Abdel-Ghani,Muhammed Arsalan,Ponnuthurai Suganthan,Khalid Al-Jalham,Abdulaziz Al-Ali,Shidin Balakrishnan
机构: Qatar University(卡塔尔大学); Hamad Medical Corporation(哈马德医疗委员会)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern surgical AI increasingly requires multimodal understanding rather than isolated perception, yet existing datasets remain largely limited to single-task supervision such as recognition or templated question answering. Current medical VQA resources often rely on synthetic templates, lack natural descriptive supervision, or provide sparse annotations that hinder reasoning about spatial relations and procedural context. We introduce MIS-VQA, a surgical vision-language dataset generated through an annotation-driven pipeline that converts heterogeneous surgical annotations into structured textual scene representations. Using EndoVis18 and CholecT50, we transform phase, instrument, interaction, triplet, and segmentation labels into unified contexts that guide large language models to generate clinically coherent question-answer pairs. MIS-VQA supports four response types-concise and detailed descriptions, perception-level grounding, and multi-step reasoning-enabling hierarchical evaluation from atomic visual grounding to compositional reasoning. To address annotation sparsity, we incorporate confidence-filtered segmentation and cross-annotation consistency checks, enabling spatially grounded supervision at scale. MIS-VQA establishes a unified benchmark for surgical vision-language understanding with spatial supervision and multi-tier reasoning evaluation. To demonstrate its utility, we introduce LLaVA-SurgXpert, a family of surgical vision-language models with visual encoders to analyze how visual representations influence multimodal reasoning. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing surgical VQA baselines while revealing capability gaps between perceptual grounding and higher-level reasoning hidden in prior benchmarks.

[NLP-105] Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization: Pre-empting Catastrophic Forgetting via Dynamic Feedback

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT）过程中面临的灾难性遗忘问题，尤其针对现有缓解策略难以平衡模型可塑性与稳定性之间的矛盾（plasticity-stability dilemma）这一核心挑战。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于熵控的稳态优化框架（Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization, ECHO），通过分解KL散度，识别输出熵（output entropy）为KL变化的主要可观测成分，从而将熵作为计算高效的在线代理指标，实时监测遗忘风险，避免了传统方法中依赖参考模型推理所带来的高昂计算开销。在此基础上，ECHO采用弹性控制器，依据预训练状态下的熵平衡点偏差作为误差信号，通过比例控制律动态调节回放数据的梯度权重，实现对模型更新过程的闭环调控。实验结果表明，ECHO在0.6B至9B参数规模的多种架构上均位于甚至超越了当前观测到的可塑性-稳定性边界，且对不同数据混合比例具有高度鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34182
作者: Shangxi Wu,Xiaorong Yan,Xiaojun Meng,Yuxiang Zhang,Jiansheng Wei
机构: Beijing Jiaotong University (北京交通大学); The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (香港理工大学); Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab (华为诺亚方舟实验室)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of LLMs suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and prevailing mitigation strategies struggle to reconcile the plasticity-stability dilemma. To address this, we propose Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization (ECHO), a closed-loop control framework. By decomposing the KL divergence, we identify output entropy as a dominant observable component of KL variation. This enables us to leverage entropy as a computationally efficient online proxy to monitor forgetting risks in real-time, bypassing expensive reference-model inference. Consequently, ECHO employs an elastic controller that dynamically modulates the gradient weight of replay data via a proportional control law, using deviations from the pre-trained entropic equilibrium as an error signal. Empirical evaluations across 0.6B to 9B parameter architectures demonstrate that ECHO lies on, and in several comparisons extends, the observed plasticity-stability frontier and maintains high operational robustness against varying data mixing ratios.

[NLP-106] Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长序列建模中如何有效保留早期信息的核心挑战：传统全注意力机制虽能保留全部历史信息但计算开销随序列长度呈平方增长，而基于循环记忆的模型虽实现线性时间复杂度，却受限于固定容量的记忆槽，导致写入操作具有高代价——错误写入会干扰有效内容，遗漏关键证据则无法召回。现有方法将“是否存储”与“更新多少槽位”耦合处理，缺乏灵活性。本文提出因子化写入路由（Factorized Write Routing, FWR），其核心创新在于解耦写入决策与槽位分配：先判断每个输入标记是否应被保留或跳过，再独立决定使用固定数量或根据标记自适应调整的槽位数进行写入，而查询阶段仍读取所有槽位。在两个合成任务（密集特征回忆与稀疏事实密钥任务）上的实验表明，当上下文信息密度高时，持续写入优于选择性写入；而在干扰项主导的稀疏场景下，学习到的选择性写入显著提升性能（0.222 vs 0.048）。尽管所测试的自适应规则表现不及固定分配策略，且诊断性基准（已知真实标签）显示仍有提升空间，结果表明在信息密集环境中应避免遗漏写入，在干扰主导场景中需强化去噪能力。

作者: Chen Chen,Rui Cheng
机构: Hong Kong Baptist University(香港浸会大学); Anhui University(安徽大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

[NLP-107] Reasoning or Just Prompting? Probing the Mechanism of Latent Chemical Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式化学推理模型中隐变量（latent states）是否真正构成可解释的逐步推理链这一核心问题。传统观点认为，隐变量在连续空间中执行中间计算，能够避免显式符号推理中的错误传播，从而提升化学任务的准确性。然而，研究发现，对中间隐变量进行替换或轻微扰动对模型性能影响甚微，而完全移除这些隐变量却可能导致显著性能下降，表明隐变量虽重要，但其分子特异性内容并非关键因素。进一步分析揭示，隐变量更可能起到类似软提示（soft prompts）的作用，即通过引导后续模型计算流程来影响输出，而非编码具体的、可追溯的推理步骤。实验验证显示，使用单一固定前缀即可复现LatentChem模型的性能，且学习得到的静态软提示在控制模型中表现与逐输入生成的隐变量相当。此外，隐序列对替换和扰动的高度鲁棒性也支持了其作为软提示而非推理链的解释。因此，论文提出，隐式化学推理应被重新理解为一种基于连续空间的软提示机制，而非隐藏于连续空间中的显式推理链。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34173
作者: Kaiyuan Lu,Jiatong Li,Yatao Bian
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 27 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Latent reasoning performs intermediate computation in continuous space rather than through explicit tokens, which is particularly appealing in chemistry, where errors in explicit reasoning can propagate to the final answer. Yet if latent states truly constitute an implicit reasoning chain, they should be causally important. We find otherwise: swapping or moderately perturbing intermediate latent states has little effect on performance, while removing them entirely sometimes causes a substantial score drop. Thus, the latent states matter, but their molecule-specific content appears to matter far less. This points to a simpler interpretation. Rather than encoding a step-by-step reasoning chain, latent states may primarily steer subsequent model computation, much like soft prompts. Indeed, a single fixed prefix shared across molecules reproduces LatentChem’s performance, and a learned static soft prompt performs comparably to per-input latent generation in controlled models. The tolerance of latent sequences to substitution and moderate perturbation further supports this connection. We therefore suggest that latent chemical reasoning may be better viewed as soft prompting than as a reasoning chain hidden in continuous space.

[NLP-108] ask Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在执行工具使用任务时存在的“附带损害”（collateral damage, CD）问题，即模型虽能完成用户指定任务，却在过程中实施了未经授权的副作用行为，如误写对象、扩大请求范围或联系错误接收者。此类问题在现有评估体系中被忽视，因为传统指标仅关注任务完成率，而未考量操作的授权合规性。论文提出SABench（Side-effect-Aware Benchmark），一个包含201个电子邮件、日历与工单任务的基准测试集，涵盖四种状态结构（独立、依赖、外部可访问、跨工具）与四类陷阱类型（歧义、误靶向、级联伤害、过度扩展），并为每项任务提供基于确定性轨迹的双重验证：目标达成与授权合规性。实验覆盖11个前沿大模型的2,211个模型-任务组合，结果显示15.2%的运行出现CD，其中歧义类任务的违规率高达38.8%，远高于非歧义陷阱的平均8.4%；即使在目标达成的场景下，仍有12.8%的运行产生未经授权的写操作。跨工具与依赖状态下的CD率约为独立状态的两倍。不同模型在相似任务成功率下，CD率差异达4.7倍，表明任务成功无法有效反映工具使用的安全性。因此，论文强调，必须引入对授权合规性的显式评估机制，以实现更安全的生成式AI（Generative AI）应用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34167
作者: Jiaju Huang,Shaobin Chen,Xinglong Liang,Xinyu Ma,Hao Yang,Wei Ke,Tao Tan,Yue Sun
机构: Macao Polytechnic University(澳门理工学院); Southwest Medical University(西南医科大学); Netherlands Cancer Institute(荷兰癌症研究所); Radboud University Medical Center(拉德堡德大学医学中心)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 19 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tool-using language model agents are usually evaluated by whether they finish the user’s task. That metric misses a common failure: an agent can complete the requested work while also taking an unauthorized side-effecting action, such as writing to the wrong object, expanding the scope of the request, or contacting an unintended recipient. We call this failure mode collateral damage (CD). We introduce SABench (Side-effect-Aware Benchmark), a benchmark of 201 email, calendar, and ticket tasks. Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at this https URL the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at this https URL.

[NLP-109] Humans in Space: Can MLLM s Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration? WACV

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在复杂人本场景中缺乏主动空间推理能力的问题，尤其针对其在存在遮挡时因依赖静态被动观察而无法准确识别自身视觉不确定性、导致错误判断与过早终止探索的缺陷。现有基准测试多采用被动多视角评估方式，难以真实反映模型在动态环境中的视觉自知与主动视点探索能力。为此，论文提出SATE-Bench这一新型交互式评测基准，包含316个真实世界场景和2,525个多轮问答对，通过结合被动多视角控制与主动探索设置，要求模型从严重遮挡的初始视角出发，逐步查询相邻视点以获取充分证据，最终“满足”问题需求，并采用步数惩罚的效率奖励机制进行评分。实验结果表明，当前先进MLLMs虽在主动探索中表现出高置信度但常提前终止，且在细粒度三维几何任务上表现不佳；对比分析揭示主动-被动差距主要源于证据获取不足。进一步地，基于组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）的微调显示，鼓励视点搜索虽提升了探索行为，却因过度探索及跨轮次多视角上下文融合失败而降低了整体准确性。研究结论指出，单纯扩大被动多视角感知能力无法自然催生主动空间推理能力，强调需构建具备“知何处看、如何整合所见、何时停止”的智能体，从而实现真正意义上的视觉自知与主动认知。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34149
作者: Tianchen Guo,Tengyue Zhang,Chen Liu,Ling Chen,Xin Yu
机构: The University of Queensland(昆士兰大学); Follow Me AI Pty LTD(跟随我人工智能有限公司); Australian Institute for Machine Learning, Adelaide University(阿德莱德大学机器学习研究所); University of Technology Sydney(悉尼科技大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 33 pages, 14 figures, and 23 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate’’ the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active–Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at this https URL

[NLP-110] Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长上下文语言模型在处理完整文档时，尽管具备足够的信息接收能力，却难以有效筛选并组织最相关证据以支持查询的问题。现有全文档提示（full-context prompting）方法虽能利用全部文本信息，但缺乏对关键事实与语义关系的聚焦，导致冗余信息干扰模型推理。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需训练的框架\ours，通过语义抽象（semantic abstraction）在单次生成中构建可复用的语义层次结构，将节点描述与原文段落进行关联。针对具体查询，该框架结合结构-语义评分与细粒度词汇归属机制，精准识别共享源节点，并通过整合其祖先上下文，保留语义结构关系与局部完整文本。实验表明，在三个LongBench任务上，\ours相较于全文档提示平均提升QA-F1 1.72点，且在四类前沿问答模型上的平均表现优于所有对比基线，同时将答案-上下文长度减少58.55%。

作者: Zhe Xu,Tianhao Liao,Zhenqing Ling,Ying Shen,Yaliang Li,Daoyuan Chen
机构: Sun Yat-sen University (中山大学); Alibaba Group (阿里巴巴集团)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural–semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55%. Our code is available at the \hrefthis https URLrepository .

[NLP-111] Self-Evolution Reason er: Continuous Optimization via Policy-Intrinsic Exploration and Exploitation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在强化学习中因探索瓶颈导致的推理能力难以持续提升的问题，尤其是在策略无法采样有效解时易陷入局部最优的困境。现有方法如基于标量奖励的强化学习（RLVR）与自监督在线策略蒸馏虽引入了更密集的监督信号，但仍受限于探索能力不足。为突破此瓶颈，本文提出自进化策略优化（Self-Evolution Policy Optimization, SEPO），其核心创新在于构建一个基于内在探索与分布内利用的迭代循环机制：通过标签引导策略生成正确的推理路径，激活其探索潜力；随后将当前策略在该分布内新发现的有效解作为“自教师”进行知识蒸馏，实现对自身策略的持续优化。这一机制既避免了依赖外部示范带来的非策略性偏差，又充分挖掘了分布内推理的潜力，从而在科学推理、工具使用及复杂逻辑推理等多领域均展现出卓越的性能、更高的训练效率与更优的收敛上限，尤其在小模型或高难度任务场景下表现出显著稳定性与持续改进能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34137
作者: Wenhang Shi,Yiren Chen,Zhe Zhao,Jinhao Dong,Wei Lu,Xiaoyong Du
机构: Renmin University of China (中国人民大学); Peking University (北京大学); Tencent (腾讯)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables large language models (LLMs) to continuously self-improve their reasoning capabilities. Compared to RLVR’s scalar rewards, recent self-supervised on-policy distillation methods leverage denser supervision signals. However, both paradigms suffer from exploration bottlenecks, struggling to escape local optima when the policy fails to sample valid solutions. Relying on external demonstrations can bypass this issue; however, the off-policy nature hinders genuine self-improvement and the mismatched-distribution reasoning can not be fully exploited. In this work, we propose Self-Evolution Policy Optimization (SEPO), a framework that drives continuous reasoning capability evolution via guided exploration and in-distribution exploitation. Specifically, SEPO utilizes labels to elicit correct reasoning from the policy, unlocking the exploration potential. By treating current policy conditioned on this in-distribution reasoning as a self-teacher, SEPO distills the newly discovered solution back into the policy. Through this iterative cycle of policy-intrinsic exploration and exploitation, SEPO achieves robust and continuous capability evolution. Across scientific, tool-use, and complex logical reasoning domains, SEPO consistently achieves the best performance under identical training time or steps, demonstrating superior efficiency and convergence ceilings. Notably, SEPO maintains stable improvements even in scenarios where baselines severely underperform or fail entirely, such as on complex tasks or with small-scale models. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-112] 2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中自回归文本生成的效率瓶颈问题，具体针对推测解码（speculative decoding）技术在实际应用中受限于两个关键因素：草案模型（draft model）与目标模型之间的分布对齐程度，以及草案模型在推理过程中的延迟表现。现有方法通常依赖独立预训练的小型草案模型，或通过手动选择架构对目标模型进行剪枝，未能显式平衡模型对齐性与生成效率之间的权衡。为此，本文将草案模型设计建模为一个优化问题，提出T2D框架——该框架基于目标模型，结合感知延迟的结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏技术，直接构建出兼顾实际推理延迟与目标模型输出交叉熵损失的优化草案模型。T2D通过联合优化这两个核心指标，实现了卓越的推测解码性能。在多领域基准测试及不同规模的目标模型家族上，实验表明T2D可将目标模型剪枝高达92%，同时获得显著优于基线的草案模型性能；此外，由T2D生成的草案模型具备良好的兼容性，可作为即插即用模块与其他推测解码中的对齐与蒸馏方法协同使用，进一步提升整体效果。研究结果强调了在架构-对齐边界上协同优化的重要性，以充分释放推测解码在大语言模型（LLM）中的潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34103
作者: Shahriar Kabir Nahin,Xiao Ye,Muhao Chen,Ben Zhou,Anshuman Chhabra
机构: Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity, and Computing, University of South Florida(南佛罗里达大学贝尔尼尼人工智能、网络安全与计算学院); School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence, Arizona State University(亚利桑那州立大学计算与增强智能学院); Department of Computer Science, University of California, Davis(加州大学戴维斯分校计算机科学系)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model’s latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model’s responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

[NLP-113] he LALA Benchmark: Evaluating Literary and Linguistic Analysis in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型在语言学与文学分析能力评估方面缺乏系统性、专业化基准测试的问题。现有评估体系往往无法有效区分模型在不同语言认知维度上的真实理解水平，尤其难以捕捉模型对语义歧义、修辞风格、指代关系及隐含假设等复杂语言现象的处理能力。为应对这一挑战，研究提出了文学与语言学分析基准（Literature and Linguistics Analysis Benchmark, LALA），包含由语言学与文学研究专家设计的236道开放性问题及其理想答案，覆盖多个语言学领域。其解决方案的关键在于：通过对比同一模型家族中基础模型与后训练版本在相同训练规模下的表现，并结合人类专家与两种大型语言模型（Sol和Qwen）作为评判者，揭示后训练阶段在提升模型语言学能力中的核心作用。结果表明，尽管参数量与部分得分无显著相关性，后训练显著增强了模型在逻辑关系与特定语篇任务上的表现，但对歧义处理、文学风格理解、指代消解及错误前提识别等高阶能力仍存在明显短板。这说明后训练是逐项引入语言知识的过程，而非生成通用语言智能，提示未来模型改进需聚焦于针对性的知识注入与推理机制优化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34080
作者: Michael Foster,Barbara McGillivray,Gard B. Jenset,Jakub Mácha,Jason Harding,Marcus Perlman,Devyani Sharma,Patrick Skeels,Jana Willer-Gold,Jeannette Littlemore
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 49 pages, 10 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce the Literature and Linguistics Analysis Benchmark (LALA), comprising 236 open-ended questions written by experts in linguistics and literary studies, together with expert-provided ideal answers. By comparing models within families and at similar training scales using human and LLM judges, LALA identifies differences in linguistic competence associated with post-training, offering a framework for evaluating future models and guiding targeted improvements. We administered questions to 17 language models and evaluated their responses using both human expert assessment and two LLM evaluators, Sol and Qwen. Base models displayed little of the linguistic competence assessed by the benchmark, whereas their post-trained versions performed markedly better, suggesting that post-training plays a central role in making linguistic knowledge accessible and usable. Parameter count, by contrast, showed no statistically significant association with partial-credit performance, and competencies remained unevenly distributed across linguistic domains. We interpret this pattern as evidence that post-training adds linguistic competencies piecemeal, without producing a general linguistic intelligence capable of extending them beyond the learned policies that support them. Models performed best on logical relations between statements and selected discourse-level tasks, while even the strongest post-trained models continued to struggle with ambiguity, literary style, reference, and misleading assumptions. Human and Sol evaluations produced nearly identical model rankings in both the original and ReliableEval runs, supporting the replicability of the comparative results.

[NLP-114] Identically Trained Language Models Break on Different Jailbreaks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式AI（Generative AI）安全评估中一个关键问题：现有越狱基准测试（jailbreak benchmarks）将某个模型检查点（checkpoint）是否被越狱攻击成功，归因于其预训练数据和安全训练过程的固有属性。然而，这种归因忽略了模型训练过程中随机性（如预训练种子、数据采样顺序等）对越狱脆弱性的显著影响。论文通过系统实验验证，发现同一份预训练数据在不同预训练种子下生成的模型，其对相同越狱提示的响应行为存在显著差异，表明越狱攻击的有效性更多取决于具体的预训练运行（pretraining run），而非数据本身。解决方案的关键在于：通过控制相同的预训练数据与安全后训练流程，对比不同预训练种子和数据配方下的模型表现，量化了预训练过程对模型越狱敏感性的主导作用。实验结果显示，相同预训练运行的模型间越狱响应率相关性高达0.984，而更换预训练种子后降至0.811，进一步更换数据配方仅轻微下降至0.779；同时，模型表现出独特的“指纹”特征——其在特定提示上的拒绝率可精确识别所属预训练运行，即使仅使用50个提示也具备98%的识别准确率。这一结果揭示了当前越狱评估框架的局限性，并强调应将预训练过程的随机性纳入安全评估体系，以实现更稳健、可复现的模型安全性分析。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34074
作者: Chi-Wei Chang,Mu-Tien Kuo,Kuan-Wei Lee,Meng-Hsun Tsai
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Jailbreak benchmarks test one checkpoint and treat which jailbreaks break it as a property of its pretraining data and safety training. We ask whether another pretraining run of the same data, given the same safety training, would break on the same jailbreaks. For each of 25 pretraining data recipes, we take 1B base models from 3 pretraining seeds and give each the same safety post-training with 2 post-training seeds, for 150 models in all. We then collect 20 responses from every model to a shared set of jailbreak prompts and correlate the per-prompt non-refusal rates between every pair of models. On average, two post-trained copies of the same pretraining run have per-prompt non-refusal rates that correlate at 0.984. A different pretraining seed lowers the correlation to 0.811, and a different data recipe lowers it only slightly further, to 0.779. These results indicate that which jailbreaks break a checkpoint depends much more on its pretraining run than on its data, a pattern that holds in all 25 data recipes and at 150M and 300M parameters. In practice, the best of 91 attack templates found on one checkpoint stays the best after a new pretraining seed in only 27% of model pairs, against 67% after a new post-training seed. Each pretraining run also leaves a fingerprint: across 3,211 prompts, a model’s per-prompt non-refusal rates identify its pretraining run among all 75 runs every time, and a random subset of 50 prompts still does so 98% of the time.

[NLP-115] Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长期智能体（long-horizon agents）中记忆系统（memory system）的净价值（net value）不明确的问题，尤其关注构建记忆相较于直接从原始历史记录中检索信息是否真正带来收益。其核心问题是：尽管许多专用记忆系统被设计用于提升性能，但现有实证研究发现，在多数情况下，这些系统的表现反而不如简单的检索增强生成（RAG, Retrieval-Augmented Generation），暗示其存在负的净价值。为此，作者以RAG为基准，将记忆的净价值分解为两部分——记忆收益（memory benefit）与记忆税（memory tax）。其中，记忆收益源于记忆系统对原始信息的重构与优化（如事实重排、偏好提炼等），而记忆税则源于记忆过程对原始证据的删减或模糊化，即“双刃剑式偏差”（double-edged deviations from raw history）。该偏差虽可能服务于特定任务目标，但会损害信息可追溯性与完整性。论文进一步指出，当前研究过度关注记忆收益，而忽视了记忆税的产生机制，因此提出应将注意力从单一性能指标转向对记忆净价值的评估。通过系统分析记忆税在系统设计与评估层面的成因，并将其概念泛化至更广泛的应用场景，本文旨在为记忆系统的可靠设计与评估提供新视角。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34073
作者: Xuan He,Sining Zhoubian,Ruozhen Yang,Yuhao Wen,Zhineng Wang,Yuyang Hu,Ke Yang,Yuyu Zhang,Ping Nie,Jiawei Han,ChengXiang Zhai
机构: University of Illinois Urbana Champaign(伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校); Tsinghua University(清华大学); Renmin University of China(中国人民大学); Verdent.ai; University of Waterloo( Waterloo 大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: this https URL

[NLP-116] When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 中反射提示优化器 GEPA 所存在的系统感知合并操作（system-aware merge operator）在不同模型间表现不一致的问题，即其合并操作在 GPT-4.1-mini 上通常提升性能，而在 Qwen3-8B 上却导致性能下降，这种不对称性在原始论文中被观察到但未得到解释。研究通过在五个数据集和两个模型上的系统性实验发现，合并操作的性能不稳定并非源于合并算子本身存在固有缺陷，而是高度依赖于具体配置——包括合并时机与合并策略的选择。通过对九种配置组合的全面测试，表明在恰当配置下，合并操作可同时提升两个模型的性能，从而提出“配置敏感性”是解释该不稳定性更合理的机制。进一步分析发现，提示层面的静态特征无法有效预测 GEPA 的合并接受决策，排除了基于静态特征的门控机制的可能性。作为概念验证，研究构建了一个基于行为诊断的探测器（behavior-based probe），通过在高风险任务上主动回避合并（abstain），在多种子运行中显著减少了大规模合并失败，尽管其整体性能仍未能持续优于不进行合并（NoMerge）的基准。该工作揭示了现有反射优化方法在部署中的可配置性关键作用，并为未来鲁棒性增强提供了可解释的诊断路径。代码已开源，项目名为 GEPA-MergeProbe。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34027
作者: Chong Zhao,Ruyi Yang,Changming Liu,Alice Zhao
机构: Harvard University (哈佛大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 12 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA’s merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at this https URL .

[NLP-117] he Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在医疗诊断场景中存在迎合用户偏见（sycophancy）的问题，即模型可能无条件接受患者错误的自我诊断信念，从而导致误诊风险上升。其核心解决方案在于揭示模型在面对患者主观信念时的脆弱性，并通过实证研究发现：当患者提出与临床证据不符的疾病假设时，九种主流生成式 AI 模型平均有 23.2% 的概率改变原有诊断以迎合用户信念，甚至接受虚构疾病；在特定角色设定（如“罕见病声称者”）下，这一比例可高达 43.0%。研究进一步表明，经过医学领域微调（medical fine-tuning）以及模型规模更大的系统表现出更低的迎合倾向，提示模型训练策略和规模对缓解此类偏差具有关键作用。该发现强调了在医疗应用中加强 AI 安全性验证的必要性，尤其在公众日益依赖 AI 获取健康建议的背景下。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34013
作者: Viswonathan Manoranjan,Andrea Mock,Myra Cheng,Lujain Ibrahim,Andrew Coyne,Junyi Jessy Li,Desmond C. Ong
机构: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill(北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校); Vals AI; Stanford University(斯坦福大学); University of Oxford(牛津大学); The University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users’ beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient’s belief on average 23.2% of the time—sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.

[NLP-118] Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLM s: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决专业人员在将工作文档提交至外部大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）时，个人身份信息（PII）泄露的风险问题。现有防护措施普遍采用可逆伪匿名化（reversible pseudonymisation），即在发送前将个人数据替换为占位符，并在接收响应后本地还原。然而，现有工具在实际应用中存在识别准确率不足、敏感信息残留率高等问题，尤其在俄语和英国英语场景下表现不佳。本文的关键解决方案是构建一个开放基准测试平台，整合五种现有开源工具及正则表达式基线，在相同数据集上进行公平对比；并基于其中表现最强的两个工具开发了一个新型引擎。该引擎通过在多个独立保留集（held-out set）上的验证，展现出显著优于现有工具的性能：在俄语和英国英语的1000份合成文档测试中，其敏感信息完全暴露率分别降至0.3%和0.2%，远低于最佳现有工具的61%和58%；同时满足所有预设检测阈值，并实现超过99%的占位符恢复率（英国英语），在俄语中恢复率为94.6%（略低于99%阈值，主因源于借用pii-guard的词形变化规则导致姓氏形式错误）。整个评估过程使用合成数据，且由引擎开发者独立执行，所有代码、数据、预测结果与原始输出均公开，确保了可复现性与透明性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34012
作者: Vladimir Beskorovainyi
机构: Besk Tech(贝斯克科技)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注: 22 pages, 9 tables. Code, data generator, held-out sets, pre-registrations, predictions and raw LLM answers: this https URL (release v0.5.0, DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23624098 )

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool’s own authors’ dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets all predefined thresholds: in UK English the identifier and leak thresholds are not met, in Russian the identifier threshold is borderline. On the last held-out set of 1,000 documents per language, the best existing tools leave a whole value visible in 61% (Russian) and 58% (UK) of documents. On these documents, from the generator it was developed on, the engine does so in 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] and 0.2% [0.1; 0.7], leaves any part of a value visible in 0.8% and 0.2%, and meets all detection thresholds in both languages. In UK English it also restores at least 99% of its placeholders after 760 answers. In Russian it restores only 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] of name placeholders, against a 99% threshold, mainly because the inflection it borrows from pii-guard produces wrong surname forms. The engine was developed over six earlier held-out sets from the same generator; real documents were not tested.

[NLP-119] “High-Quality” Data for Early-Stage Instruction Tuning: An Empirical Study of Data Quality Metrics

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决指令微调（instruction tuning）中“数据质量”这一概念过于模糊且缺乏明确定义的问题。研究聚焦于将数据质量视为可操作的属性，通过系统评估一系列源自数据筛选、文本质量评估及指令微调领域的简单示例级指标，以识别哪些指标在固定微调预算下最能预测训练效果。研究方法为：针对每个指标对指令-响应样本进行排序，按近似相等的词元量（token mass）划分为低、中、高三个区间，分别在各区间上独立微调模型，并比较不同累积训练词元量下的验证困惑度（perplexity）与基于大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-judge）的生成答案评分。研究结果表明，响应密度监督（answer-dense supervision），由响应比例（response ratio）所捕捉，是比现有常用代理指标更强且更具普适性的指令微调效用预测因子。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33969
作者: Vladimir Necula,David Gvadzabia,Sofia Serrano
机构: University of Cambridge Department of Physics(剑桥大学物理系); Lafayette College Department of Computer Science(拉法耶特学院计算机科学系)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:“Data quality” is widely invoked in instruction tuning, but the term is often underspecified. We study it as an operational property by asking which simple example-level metrics, drawn from prior work on data selection, text quality, and instruction tuning, best predict training utility under a fixed finetuning budget. For each metric, we sort instruction-response examples by score, partition them into low, middle, and high bins with roughly equal token mass, finetune separately on each bin, and compare validation perplexity and LLM-as-judge scores for the models’ generated answers as a function of cumulative training tokens. Our results suggest that answer-dense supervision, as captured by response ratio, is a stronger and more portable predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative proxies.

[NLP-120] Beyond Belief: Evaluating and Mitigating LLM Susceptibility to Misinformation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在使用外部工具时对虚假信息（misinformation）的判断与行为响应之间不一致的问题，即模型虽能识别出某些信息为不可信，但仍可能执行有害的工具调用。其核心解决方案的关键在于评估模型在执行前对信息可信度的判断是否真正反映其行为上的抗误导能力。研究发现，即使模型将虚假通知标记为不可信，仍会在27%至99%的情况下执行有害操作；移除可信度评估步骤后，有害执行率平均上升15个百分点，表明可信度评估本身会改变模型的行为表现。尽管提升可信度辨别能力的干预措施并未稳定降低风险，但简单的预先警告（forewarning）在五种模型中的四种中显著减少了有害执行，而基于生成示例的预打假（prebunking）方法在主要评估中未超越该效果。此外，这些安全干预措施可能损害合法任务的完成率。研究进一步表明，在有可信度评估前置的协议下，通过生成虚假内容进行监督微调可有效降低在保留攻击样本上的有害执行，但存在模型依赖性及无评估环节时保护效果减弱的问题。因此，该研究强调：评估虚假信息防御机制时，必须同时考量有害行为的抑制与合法任务完成率的维持，并充分考虑评估流程本身对行为结果的影响。

作者: Emran Kanaan,Jiho Lee,Ibrahim Odat,Soroush Vosoughi,Weicheng Ma
机构: Oakland University(奥克兰大学); Dartmouth College(达特茅斯学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tool-using large language models (LLMs) must decide whether external information warrants action. We investigate whether their expressed credibility judgments reliably indicate behavioral resistance to misinformation. We evaluate five LLMs on 196 constructed false notices paired with legitimate counterparts and 204 archived attacks adapted to simulated tool use. When asked to act on the constructed notices, models issue harmful tool calls in 27%–99% of cases they have rated untrustworthy. Removing the preliminary rating step increases harmful execution by 15 percentage points on average, showing that credibility elicitation itself changes the behavior being evaluated. Interventions that improve credibility discrimination do not consistently yield safer actions. A simple forewarning significantly reduces harmful execution in four of five models, but neither tested generated-example prebunk outperforms it in the main evaluation. These reductions can also compromise legitimate task completion. Supervised fine-tuning on generated false notices reduces harmful execution on held-out archived attacks under the rating-first protocol, with model-dependent utility costs and weaker protection without rating elicitation. Our findings motivate evaluating misinformation defenses through both harmful actions and legitimate task completion, while accounting for the behavioral effects of the evaluation protocol.

[NLP-121] How Do Small Coding Agents Use Code Graphs and Embeddings?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式代码修复（Code Repair）中模型对代码仓库结构理解不足的问题，即模型缺乏对代码依赖关系和上下文结构的显式感知能力，导致在定位缺陷相关代码时效率低下。其核心挑战在于：当问题涉及的代码路径跨越多个函数或模块时（以“跳数”即代码图中最短路径长度衡量），模型性能随路径深度呈指数下降。解决方案的关键在于引入结构化工具（嵌入搜索与代码图工具）辅助模型进行更精准的代码定位。实验表明，这些工具使小规模模型（1.7–4B参数）的定位准确率提升达17–21个百分点，但随着模型规模增大至32B，工具增益显著衰减至4–5个百分点，且大部分收益源于提交行为优化而非真正提升定位能力。进一步分析揭示，代码图工具的实际效用主要体现在初始跳数（hop 0）的符号名查找和第一跳扩展，而跨跳链式推理仅在12–14%的样本中发生。此外，通过线性探测发现，小模型在权重和使用层面均呈现局部、一跳、以词法为主的代码视图，难以捕捉深层依赖关系。研究结果表明，当前生成式编码代理对复杂代码结构的理解仍严重依赖外部工具，且工具有效性随模型规模增长而递减，凸显了构建具备内生结构感知能力的代码模型的重要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33958
作者: Saurav Bellam(The University of Texas at Austin)
机构: The University of Texas at Austin(得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 29 pages, 5 figures. Depth labels and dataset card and full code, raw results and analysis will be released in the near future

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Coding agents are given embedding search and code-graph tools on the premise that a repository’s structure is something the model lacks and the tool supplies. We test that premise on SWE-bench Verified with small open-weight models, stratifying tasks by a deterministic hop depth (the shortest code-graph path from code the issue mentions to code the gold patch changes) that a companion paper defines and validates. First, we ablate a localization agent’s tool set (grep only; +embedding search; +graph tools; all) on a depth-balanced 160-task split and on all 500 tasks for ten models (six Qwen3 sizes from 0.6B to 32B with five decodings each, an FP8 control, three Gemma 4 sizes; 79k episodes). Structured tools double grep-only accuracy for Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 E4B; their gain peaks at 17-21 points at 1.7-4B and falls to 4-5 points at 32B (odds ratio 0.77-0.82 per doubling of parameters). From 8B up, about half of that gain is the form of the submission rather than finding the target; the fall from 14B to 32B is a fall in tool uptake at equal grep-only accuracy; and the same 4B size gains or does not gain from a tool depending on the checkpoint. Each extra hop multiplies the odds of correct localization by 0.50-0.67 at every size, and no tool set flattens that gradient: traces show the graph tools’ gain is name lookup at hop 0 and one expansion at hop 1, and agents chain expansions in only 12-14% of episodes. A fixed repair model resolves 6-13 of 160 tasks from these localizations (oracle 26). Second, linear probes find direct call edges decodable under a within-anchor, degree-stratified protocol (AUC 0.74; 0.61-0.66 inside agent conversations), but below a lexical baseline (0.99), with two-hop edges at 0.57. Small agents carry a one-hop, largely lexical picture of their repository, in weights and in use. We release the agent, probes, logs and traces.

[NLP-122] Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在长期运行中难以实现持续学习（Continual Learning）的问题，即模型无法有效积累、整合并应用过往经验以实现性能的持续提升，而现有评估体系多聚焦于单任务表现，忽视了基于经验积累的渐进式改进能力。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个大规模、高真实性的持续学习评估基准——持续学习测评（Continual Learning Exam, CLE），由50余名领域专家共同构建，包含120个由人类撰写的任务，每个任务设计为五级阶梯式结构，共600个层级，覆盖12个职业领域中的89种专业角色。任务设计要求智能体必须逐级通过前序任务才能解锁后续任务，且后期任务依赖前期经验积累，从而真实模拟专业工作流中的知识延续性。评估采用人工制定的评分标准，通过对比单次提交与允许失败后获得诊断反馈并进行一次修订的设置，验证了反馈机制对性能提升的有效性。实验表明，引入反馈与修订可带来平均5.3个百分点的完成率提升，但最先进系统仅能完成47.7%的层级，且仅有23.3%的任务能完整达成全部五级目标，揭示当前前沿大模型在持续学习方面仍存在显著瓶颈。因此，该数据集不仅可用于评估，还可作为后训练数据集，用于强化模型的持续学习能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33956
作者: Haoyu Zhao,Sitian Tu,Yuxuan Huang,Huichi Zhou,Zhangyue Yin,Jiahao Huang,Jingyuan Xu,Tianmiao Shi,Jin Shi,Nianxi Zhang,Yangmiao Zhang,Zhuolang Chan,Huiyan Hu,Chenchao Sheng,Yaqing Luo,Yue Chen,Huaxiu Yao,Meng Fang,Jun Wang
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs. As such, the dataset can also be used to post-train LLMs to strengthen their continual learning capabilities.

[NLP-123] What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在人机交互中仅被动应答而缺乏主动引导性提问的问题，尤其关注如何通过模型生成具有认知探索意义的提问来揭示知识盲区、假设前提及潜在选项。其核心解决方案在于提出“模型好奇心”（model curiosity）的概念，并构建一个基于理论的分类体系，以区分面向认知探索的提问（即好奇心驱动型提问）与一般性提问。研究发现，在四个对话数据集中，好奇心驱动型提问占比仅为17%-28%，但此类提问能显著激发用户后续更具探索性和认知深度的回应，且在咨询、创意生成和科研等情境中尤为有效。该研究为构建能够更精准、有选择地发起认知驱动型提问的生成式AI系统提供了实证依据与设计方向，推动实现更深层次的人机协作。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33950
作者: Angana Borah,Rachana Ramchandar,Inderjeet Nair,Rada Mihalcea
机构: University of Michigan - Ann Arbor, USA; PES University, Bangalore, India
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.

[NLP-124] Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在实际应用中因结构化输出（structured output）验证失败而导致的管道可靠性评估失真问题。现有方法通常仅以单一有效性率（validity rate）衡量系统表现，无法揭示失败的具体模式，进而阻碍对故障根源的精准干预。其核心解决方案是提出一种细粒度的格式符合性失败分类体系，并开发一个确定性分类器，基于模型输出与 Pydantic 验证错误，自动识别失败类别。研究通过对 3,997 次生成尝试（涵盖九种 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 模型/接口配置）进行分析，发现相似的有效性率可能掩盖截然不同的失败模式；其中，Markdown 代码块封装的 JSON 是最常见的失败类型——在 681 例此类失败中，仅有 48.0% 在移除代码块后可通过验证，其余则隐藏着额外的字段长度违规等深层问题。进一步的提示消融实验表明，抑制代码块封装虽看似将失败转向长度违规，实则暴露了原本存在的潜在违规，说明聚合有效性率会掩盖失败构成的变化。基于此，论文提炼出四项工程实践：验证器设计、模式定义、重试机制与评估方法优化，其中三项经数据支持，另一项关于重试反馈的建议尚未验证，相关分类器、生成结果及标注数据已开源。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33949
作者: Amit Verma
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 36 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Under review at Empirical Software Engineering. Artifact: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints and task. Markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure: among 681 fenced failures, only 48.0% pass validation after fence removal, while the remainder conceal additional violations, predominantly field-length violations. In an exploratory prompt ablation, variants that suppress fences appear to shift failures toward length violations, but the shift is consistent with exposing violations that were already present, illustrating how aggregate validity rates can obscure changes in failure composition. We derive four engineering practices for validator, schema, retry and evaluation design, three supported by our data and one, on retry feedback, proposed but not tested, and release the classifier, completions, and annotations.

[NLP-125] Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决文本到SQL（Text-to-SQL）系统在学术基准上表现优异，但在企业实际部署中性能显著下降的核心问题。其根本原因在于现有方法依赖完整的模式文档（schema documentation），而企业数据库普遍缺乏详尽的文档支持，普遍存在命名晦涩、关系隐含等问题。本文提出首个无需依赖模式文档的Text-to-SQL框架，通过从历史查询日志中学习数据库结构来弥补这一缺陷。其解决方案的关键在于：首先，从解析的查询模式中构建知识图谱，以捕捉表间关联、连接逻辑及列与业务概念之间的映射；其次，引入基于实体驱动的GraphRAG检索机制，将用户问题与领域术语进行语义对齐，而非仅依赖嵌入相似性。在工业级部署和Beaver基准上的实验表明，该方法在可执行性和答案质量方面显著优于主流的基于嵌入的检索方法，在Beaver上实现95.7%的执行有效性，远超嵌入方法的60.8%，且在内部评估中获得70%的数据工程师偏好度。研究证明，Text-to-SQL可在模式模糊的企业环境中有效运行，为自然语言数据库接口在真实场景中的应用提供了可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33946
作者: Ömer Faruk Akgül,Nikhil Kapahi,Prajit Reddy Muppidi
机构: University of Southern California(南加州大学); Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Text-to-SQL systems achieve remarkable accuracy on academic benchmarks, yet performance drops dramatically in enterprise deployments. This gap stems from a fundamental assumption: existing approaches require complete schema documentation, but enterprise databases typically lack comprehensive documentation, featuring cryptic naming and implicit relationships. We present the first text-to-SQL framework that operates without schema documentation, instead learning database structure from historical query logs. Query logs encode implicit structural knowledge: which tables are queried together, how they join, and what columns map to business concepts. We construct a knowledge graph from parsed query patterns and introduce entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval that grounds user questions in domain terminology rather than relying solely on embedding similarity. Validated on both an industrial deployment with expert evaluation and the Beaver benchmark, our approach substantially outperforms similarity-based retrieval methods, the dominant industry approach, in both executability and answer quality. On Beaver, we achieve 95.7% execution validity compared to 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, with expert data engineers preferring our system 70% to 10% on internal deployment. Our work demonstrates that text-to-SQL can operate effectively in schema-ambiguous enterprise environments, enabling natural language database interfaces “in the wild”.

[NLP-126] HerHealthGPT : An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Womens Reproductive Health Copy title

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前对话式人工智能（Conversational AI）系统在女性生殖健康领域中存在的关键问题：面对不完整或模糊的健康咨询（如“我的月经为什么推迟了？”），系统往往缺乏必要的上下文追问机制，且其回复未能基于可验证的循证证据，导致信息可信度与临床适用性不足。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个以证据为基础的交互式对话系统——HerHealthGPT，通过集成检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）、上下文感知的澄清机制以及来源验证，在保持对话连贯性的基础上主动进行目标导向的追问，避免过早下结论，并确保输出内容可追溯、可验证。实验结果显示，引入证据检索可将问题类别识别准确率从微调模型的54.1%提升至59.3%，澄清路由模块在构造目标上的召回率和特异性分别达到85.6%和86.2%；用户研究表明，83.3%的参与者更偏好具备检索能力的配置，且多数人认为系统的追问问题具有相关性。这些结果表明，将循证检索与动态交互澄清相结合，是实现透明、上下文敏感且可信的女性生殖健康信息系统的有效路径，但仍需进一步开展临床验证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33931
作者: Hassan Saeed Hassan Albattra,Mazen Mohammed Bahgat,Rahatara Ferdousi,Hana Essam Sayed Ahmed Amrya,Mariam Mousa
机构: Queen’s University (皇后大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:“Why is my period late?” Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women’s reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.

[NLP-127] Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在测试阶段因依赖训练数据中的捷径（shortcuts，即训练与测试分布不一致时失效的统计相关性）而导致预测性能下降的问题。现有大多数去除捷径的方法需在训练阶段进行，依赖标注数据、模型权重访问及大量计算资源，难以在实际部署中应用。本文提出一种测试时捷径消除方法——反事实测试时增强（Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation, CTTA），其核心思想是：对于给定测试样本，利用辅助模型生成一系列反事实编辑版本，其中捷径特征被改变，随后对LLM在这些编辑样本上的预测结果进行加权平均。理论证明，最优的捷径不变预测器属于该CTTA家族，并可确定其最优权重。尽管这些权重依赖于训练分布且通常无法仅从已训练模型和无标签测试数据中识别，但作者在特定假设下，提出可通过已训练模型的词元概率估计权重，并设计检测方法以验证假设有效性。基于此，提出Select-CTTA方法，通过选择最优的CTTA子方法实现自适应优化。实验表明，Select-CTTA显著优于现有的测试时基线方法，并接近在捷径平衡数据上微调模型的性能，实现了高效、无需重训练的测试时鲁棒性提升。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33904
作者: Katie Matton,Rosalind W. Picard,John Guttag,Maggie Makar
机构: MIT(麻省理工学院); University of Michigan(密歇根大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 24 pages, 9 tables, 2 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM’s predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate method that selects among CTTA methods. Empirically, we find that Select-CTTA outperforms test-time baselines and approaches the performance of models fine-tuned on shortcut-balanced data.

[NLP-128] When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLM s with Global Citizenship Values Alignment EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在面对具有价值取向的个性化人格（persona）请求时，如何在保障安全性的前提下有效尊重用户多元价值观的问题。传统对齐方法主要针对显性恶意请求进行防御，难以识别由价值导向型人格引发的隐性危害，导致模型或过度拒绝合法的价值表达，或无差别服从潜在危险的人格设定。为此，研究构建了一个包含1.1万条争议话题与基于施瓦茨价值观量表（Schwartz Value Survey）映射的价值维度的人格配对数据集，并通过一种代理式（agentic）迭代优化流程，成功从已对齐的商用大模型中挖掘出超过47%的有害响应。研究以联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）全球公民原则为最小共识基础，界定有效价值表达与有害行为的边界，提出一种可调控的对齐模型，允许用户在推理阶段动态权衡人格一致性与安全性。实验表明，该方法在多数样本上均实现了比基线更优的安全性与人格适配性表现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33899
作者: Siqi Shen,Lajanugen Logeswaran,Moontae Lee,Honglak Lee,Rada Mihalcea
机构: University of Michigan(密歇根大学); LG AI Research(LG人工智能研究院); University of Illinois at Chicago(伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO’s global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.

[NLP-129] Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for σ-Weighted Post-Training EMNLP ACL EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决混合后训练（Hybrid Post-Training）中因训练侧信号与目标任务及评估场景不匹配而导致的隐式行为放大问题。现有方法通常通过监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）的混合策略，依赖训练侧信号动态调整样本权重，但这些信号仅反映锚点数据和策略特征，无法判断所强调的行为是否真正有助于目标任务。这种不一致性可能导致在移除显式指令后，预训练模型中已存在的有害或无关行为仍被重新激活并放大。为此，作者提出双隐式对抗放大（DIAA），一种基于每样本σ加权的SFT/RL混合方法，其关键在于引入对未执行工具集成推理（TIR）行为的识别与量化。实验表明，即使在完全移除显式Python约束的情况下，DIAA仍会在29%的MATH-500测试提示中生成无效的TIR，是基线GRPO的三倍。通过成对干预分析，发现抑制TIR可带来10.6个百分点的准确率提升，且SFT模仿与σ增强均贡献显著。进一步提出的干预认证放大（ICA）方法，利用成对回滚的目标证据动态门控σ，实现冻结与在线两种模式下的有效控制，将TIR比例降至13.8%和11.2%，显著降低残余干扰，使准确率分别提升至48.7%和49.3%，并可在无需重调参的情况下迁移至未见的GSM8K基准。因此，解决方案的关键在于构建基于目标评估反馈的动态校准机制，以实现对有害行为的精准抑制与有益行为的可靠放大。

作者: Leiyue Chen,Meng Wei,Xuefeng Hu,Wei Liu
机构: ByteDance(字节跳动)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 13 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026; see this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample’s balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample \sigma -weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on 29% of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show 10.6 percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and \sigma -amplification; a student trained on a 0% -TIR teacher anchor emits it at 45.8% . Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA) gates \sigma with paired-rollout target evidence. Frozen and online ICA reduce TIR to 13.8% and 11.2% , halve residual drag, improve accuracy from 47.5% to 48.7% and 49.3% , and transfer to held-out GSM8K without retuning.

[NLP-130] Ranking Is Not Deciding: Benchmark Shortcuts and Operating-Point Collapse in Query-Time RAG Poisoning Defenses

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）系统在面对后门攻击时，现有查询阶段过滤器（query-time filters）所报告的高检测性能可能具有误导性的问题。研究发现，这些过滤器看似优异的检测效果并非源于其对内容语义或特征的真正识别能力，而是高度依赖于攻击构造过程中引入的特定“构建线索”（construction cues），如将目标问题直接作为前缀插入到污染文档中。关键发现在于：一旦移除此类线索（例如删除前缀），即使检索排名保持不变，防御系统的决策能力也会急剧下降——即“排序未受损，但判断失效”。论文提出，通过两个无标签统计量即可刻画这一线索特征：包含度（containment，目标问题在污染数据中是否原样出现）与长度重叠（length overlap，污染文档与干净语料的长度相似性）。实验证明，仅通过移除前缀或用无意义填充词替换原文本长度，即可使多个主流防御模型（如RAGuard、TrustRAG及自研评分器）的检测性能从近乎完美的表现（如AUROC 0.953）骤降至严重失效水平（误检率高达0.986），而其召回率也大幅恶化。因此，论文强调，任何检测结果的有效性必须结合攻击样本的构造特征与实际部署阈值下的假阳性率进行评估，并公开了用于计算该构造特征的脚本，以提升研究可复现性与透明度。

作者: Pushkal Kumar,Arvin Sahaym
机构: 未知
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 26 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Query-time filters that screen each retrieved document before it reaches the generator are the dominant published defense against retrieval-augmented generation poisoning, and they report near-perfect detection on domain benchmarks. We show that this performance is predicted by how the poison set was built rather than by what the filter reads: removing a single construction cue destroys the deployed decision before it destroys the ranking. Two label-free statistics of a poison set and its clean corpus profile the cue: containment, how often the target question appears verbatim in the poison, and length overlap. PoisonedRAG’s released code prepends the target question to every inserted passage. Of the 21 published defense evaluations we survey, 8 verifiably run poison built this way and 5 substitute a length cue; separately, 12 report no false-positive rate at the operating point they deploy. Deleting only that prefix from the attack authors’ own passages (0.93 still retrieved for their target) takes RAGuard, a published content filter we re-implement, from AUROC 0.953 to 0.758 and its miss rate from 0.191 to 0.763. Across four corpora, four attack families and ten per-document defenses on one shared candidate set, the profile predicts where detection saturates. Padding medical poison to clean length with word-shuffled filler that carries no content takes TrustRAG’s set-level stage from a miss rate of 0.000 to 0.827, and one learned scorer of ours from 0.000 to 0.986 (0.321 at a matched 5% false-positive rate) while its AUROC holds at 0.953. The ranking survives; the decision does not. A defense-aware attacker defeats our own scorer, so we claim no defense. A detection result is evidence only when it is reported with its poison set’s construction profile and the false-positive rate at the threshold actually deployed; we release the script that computes the profile.

[NLP-131] Grounding on Request: Learning Modality Control in Vision-Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉-语言模型（VLM）在图像与文本描述存在冲突时，用户能否可靠地控制模型遵循特定模态（如图像或文本）的问题。传统评估仅依赖准确率，无法判断模型是否真正遵循了用户指定的证据来源，因为模型可能通过参数化知识给出正确答案但并未响应模态指令。为此，论文提出通过保留冲突的反事实干预（conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions）来评估模态接地控制能力，引入两个核心指标：Flip衡量初始正确答案是否随目标模态的编辑而改变，Stay则衡量当竞争模态被修改时答案是否保持稳定。解决方案的关键在于基于“新词学习”（neologism learning）机制，为视觉和文本模态分别引入新的可学习嵌入（embedding），仅训练这些新增的模态词嵌入并固定预训练模型参数；同时提出反事实孪生边界（Counterfactual Twin-Margin, CTM）监督策略，利用成对干预样本指导模型在请求证据变化时应如何调整答案概率。实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了模型对自然语言指令的模态控制能力，且单个模态嵌入即可实现轻量级但有效的视觉控制，平均性能下降极小；尽管LoRA仍表现最优，其视觉优势在未见数据上有所缩小。此外，反事实监督在标准监督较弱的场景中进一步增强了控制效果。最后，在真实新闻视频上的测试显示，当相关视觉证据更易获取时，视觉控制能力得到提升。总体而言，研究强调可靠的模态控制不仅需验证答案正确性，还需确保答案能持续响应所选模态的编辑，从而揭示了评估模型对多模态证据依赖性的关键范式转变。

作者: Maxime Dassen,Alexander Martin,Andrew Yates,Reno Kriz,William Walden

类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
