Abstract:When an image and its caption disagree, can a user reliably control which one a vision-language model (VLM) follows? Accuracy alone cannot answer this question, since a model might give the correct answer from parametric knowledge without following the requested evidence. We therefore evaluate modality grounding control through conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions. Specifically, Flip measures whether an initially correct answer follows an edit to the requested modality, while Stay measures whether it remains stable when the competing modality is edited. To learn this control, we build on neologism learning by introducing new words for visual and textual grounding, training only their embeddings while keeping the pretrained model fixed. We also introduce Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM) supervision, which uses paired interventions to teach how answer probabilities should change when the requested evidence changes. Across three VLMs on three existing benchmarks and our multi-attribute Ground-CF benchmark, we find that learned modality words improve control over natural-language instructions. Surprisingly, a single learned embedding per modality provides strong lightweight visual control and shows little average degradation on held-out values. LoRA remains strongest overall, although its visual advantage narrows under held-out evaluation. Moreover, counterfactual supervision improves control in several settings where standard supervision is weaker. Finally, we test our method on real-world news video and find that visual control improves when the relevant evidence is made easier to access. Overall, our results show that reliable modality control requires testing not only whether an answer is correct, but whether it continues to follow edits to the modality of choice.

[NLP-132] EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决使用托管语言模型对临床笔记进行去标识化时，可能泄露敏感信息的问题。其核心解决方案是提出EdgeDeID，一个参数量为0.6B的本地运行解码器架构去标识模型，通过合成数据训练而无需真实患者文本：由三个大语言模型（LLM）教师生成合成临床笔记，单一名标注者将其统一为标准标注格式，模型则学习输出带有类型标记的XML结构化标识符。在包含100条人工验证标注的合成领域基准测试中，该模型达到0.994的微平均F1分数，且99%的样本中无遗漏标识符，显著优于八种现成系统中的最优者（0.857 F1，12%遗漏率）。模型经量化后可在仅615 MB内存的CPU上运行。在监督训练中引入的三项改进手段中，仅有验证器适配器（verifier adapter）有效——其能以0.94的AUROC区分其他系统输出的完整与不完整结果；而基于召回加权奖励的强化学习和基于规则的后处理层对域内性能无改善。在MIMIC ICU护理记录上的性能下降至F1=0.48，错误主要源于合成数据缺乏真实临床文本的两个特征：简略语风格（telegraphic style）和低标识符密度。通过引入三例人工编写的上下文示例，无需额外标注数据即可恢复0.08的F1分数提升。

Abstract:De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.

[NLP-133] EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在代理型数据分析任务中对大量人工标注任务依赖的问题。由于高质量的标注任务需要耗费大量人力，而可执行环境（如数据库）本身具备丰富的交互结构和可验证的执行结果，因此作者提出了一种名为 EnvLunch 的预训练阶段，利用环境自身提供的可验证轨迹作为无标签任务信号，无需人工或模型生成的任务描述即可进行代理训练。其核心解决方案在于：通过采样有效的动作轨迹并执行以获得最终观测结果，训练代理仅根据最终观测恢复功能等价的轨迹，从而实现无需标签的自监督预训练。该方法显著提升了下游强化学习的表现，在不同训练预算下平均性能优于基线超过9个百分点；且在极少量标注数据情况下，基线模型需8至32倍的标注样本才能达到 EnvLunch 模型在最小训练预算下的准确率。实验表明，仅依赖环境定义任务所带来的增益大于由模型自动生成任务的效果，且该预训练策略在数据解析之外的基准任务上也表现出更强的泛化能力。因此，EnvLunch 有效减少了对人工标注任务的依赖，并为标注资源有限场景下的代理模型微调提供了更优的初始化起点。

作者: Wei Liu,Min Gao,Yali Du,Yulan He
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Databases (cs.DB)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.

[NLP-134] ask Format as a Factor in Adaptation: A Controlled Comparison of LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning for Prompt-Safety Classification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在分类任务中微调策略选择的争议问题，特别是低秩适应（LoRA）与全量微调（full fine-tuning）之间的性能差异及其影响因素。研究发现，现有对比常因实验设计不一致而产生偏差，且任务格式（task format）对结果的影响长期被忽视。为解决此问题，研究采用一对匹配的4亿参数编码器-解码器架构（Ettin），在三种不同任务格式下系统比较两种微调方式，并设置最多15个随机种子和预设分析流程以增强可重复性。结果表明，在仅使用标签作为训练目标时，全量微调在所有架构和任务格式下均优于LoRA 2–3个百分点；但当学习率通过统一搜索优化后，两者的差距缩小。值得注意的是，若在LoRA中引入“输出判断理由”的训练目标，性能提升4.0个百分点并完全弥合差距，而仅增加等长无内容句子则无效，凸显训练目标设计的关键作用。此外，尽管微调模型在域内数据上表现良好，但在跨域数据集上显著落后，尤其在对抗性越狱攻击场景下性能下降8–23个百分点，且误判27–66%的良性有害提示为不安全，远高于80亿参数基线模型的2–3%。综上，该研究揭示：模型性能差异更多取决于训练方式、学习率选择及训练目标设计，而非单纯的微调范式；同时强调，仅关注域内准确率不足以评估模型鲁棒性，需综合考量泛化能力与安全性。

作者: John Alderete,Srirakshith Betageri,Jennifer Flynn,Alex Greenhalgh,Josh Rubin,Yoshita Varma Annam

Abstract:Fine-tuning a language model for classification involves many design decisions. Comparisons of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with full fine-tuning are common but often confounded, and task format is rarely studied. We compare both regimes on prompt-safety classification with a matched 400M encoder-decoder pair (Ettin) across three task formats, with up to 15 seeds per cell and pre-specified analyses. At the pre-specified learning rates, full fine-tuning leads LoRA by 2-3 pp in every architecture and format trained on the label alone. On the encoder, the gap closes once both rates are chosen by the same search. Training LoRA to write a reason after its verdict adds 4.0 pp and closes the gap, but a content-free sentence of equal length does not. Trained models score above a prompted 8B in domain but fall behind it on two of three out-of-distribution corpora, trailing by 8-23 pp on adversarial jailbreaks and flagging 27-66% of benign but harmful-looking prompts as unsafe, against the 8B’s 2-3%. Together, the results suggest that the adaptation regime matters less than how each model is trained, its learning rate, and training target, and that in-domain accuracy alone is an incomplete guide to robustness.

[NLP-135] IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型智能体在复杂任务执行过程中，面对用户需求与优先级动态变化时的适应性问题。其核心挑战在于如何准确捕捉并持续维护用户意图的演化过程，尤其是在约束条件与偏好发生可行性或优先级层面调整时，智能体仍能保持对历史要求的理解并正确区分硬性约束与软性偏好。解决方案的关键在于构建了名为IntentDelta的多轮人工作标注基准，涵盖WebShop和TravelPlanner两个场景，共包含638条任务轨迹与3,766个对话回合，每一轮均配有用户语句、累积意图状态及人工参考动作，且通过交叉验证确保数据质量。该基准系统性地覆盖了由可行性或偏好驱动的意图变更，为评估智能体在意图恢复（intention recovery）与动作质量方面的表现提供了可靠标准。实验结果表明，当前十一类智能体在旅行规划和购物场景中的平均意图恢复率分别为33.1%和44.7%，动作评分分别为31.6%和41.0%，反映出智能体普遍难以维持早期需求，并混淆软性偏好与必须满足的约束，同时指出意图恢复成功并不等同于任务执行成功，凸显了将动态演变的用户意图转化为有效行动序列的深层挑战。

作者: Jieyu Zhou,Zijian Wang,Yun Wang
机构: Georgia Institute of Technology (佐治亚理工学院); Microsoft Research (微软研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1% in TravelPlanner and 44.7% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.

[NLP-136] MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在开放世界、多步深度搜索任务中面临的局限性，即如何有效实现图像锚定（image grounding）、工具选择与网络证据整合。现有方法依赖于固定离线语料库构建和过滤，其问题分布无法随目标深度搜索智能体的性能提升而动态适应。为此，本文提出MTA-Zero，一种无需预先计算多跳语料库的在线多模态问答-求解器联合训练框架。其核心创新在于：基于图像锚定的视觉问答（VQA）种子上下文，通过可训练的问答生成器（QA Generator）在线检索并构造经过验证的多跳问题；同时，独立的深度搜索求解器（Solver）负责工具选择、证据收集与答案生成。为聚焦生成过程于求解器的学习前沿，设计了一种“恰到好处”（Goldilocks）奖励机制，该奖励由求解器组级回放成功率推导而来——仅当问题被部分但非全部回放成功时获得正向奖励，从而引导生成器生成具有挑战性且适切的问题。两个策略通过GRPO算法独立优化，不共享参数或梯度。在六个多模态深度搜索基准测试中，MTA-Zero将Qwen3-VL-8B求解器的平均准确率从36.91%提升至51.58%，性能接近使用GPT-5的水平；对更先进的Qwen3.6-27B求解器亦带来10.82个百分点的提升。结果表明，经验证的在线问题生成可为多模态深度搜索智能体提供特定于策略的学习课程，实现持续自我改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33799
作者: Xiangyu Peng,Jiaxin Zhang,An Yan,Yu Li,Ran Xu,Zeyuan Chen,Chien-Sheng Wu
机构: Salesforce( Salesforce)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent’s image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver’s learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver’s group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.

[NLP-137] Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在文本到图像检索任务中，现有冻结编码器（frozen encoder）仅孤立地评估每对图像-文本匹配关系，而忽略了同一图像所附多个标注（caption）之间潜在协同信息的问题。其核心挑战在于如何有效利用图像自身多条标注作为上下文线索，在推理阶段提升检索性能。解决方案的关键在于：通过融合图像与自身标注间的相似性，构建更鲁棒的候选图像支持（support）机制——具体而言，将图像与其多条标注之间的语义一致性作为额外监督信号，从而增强正确候选图像的得分。实验表明，当标注来自与查询相同标注者时，该方法可使文本到图像检索的R@1指标提升3.4至16.8个百分点；即使使用通用图文生成模型生成标注，性能仍可提升1.9至7.2个百分点，而来自不同标注源的标注则贡献极小。进一步分析揭示，该优势主要源于正确候选图像的支持集结构与负样本存在差异，其中支持集大小和查询移除效应各贡献约一半效果，且在固定支持索引下，剩余增益可归结为对已有标注信息的重新加权。此外，在组合性（compositional）基准测试中，标注的作用体现在更准确地匹配人类对图像的描述，而非改善图像-文本语义对齐能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33798
作者: Khang Nhat Hoang Vo,Belal Shoer,Abhirama Subramanyam Penamakuri
机构: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image’s own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate’s supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: this https URL

[NLP-138] One Scan is Enough: Demonstration-Free Adaptation for Language-Guided Navigation NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言引导式导航（language-guided navigation）在新建筑环境中部署时普遍存在的泛化能力差问题，尤其针对公开基准数据集在布局、外观及语言表达上的漂移导致性能显著下降的挑战。传统解决方案依赖现场人工遥控采集新轨迹，但难以规模化。本文提出的关键解决方案是：仅通过一次简短的iPhone扫描即可完成场景适应，利用Scan2Instruction将扫描数据自动构建为完整训练环境，并合成带有语义锚定的可执行导航任务；随后，PRPT-KS基于重构场景直接计算闭式帕累托效用，无需学习型评判器或人工标注标签，实现策略的高效自适应。实验表明，该方法使真实机器人在五个真实场景中达到85%的成功率，显著优于基于人类示范微调的基线（49%），且在未扫描区域仍保持82%的成功率，远超基线的41%。该工作首次将无演示的场景自适应从理论构想变为可落地的实际系统。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33794
作者: Zhuoyuan Yu,Yuxing Long,Du Wang,Junyang Wang,Hongwei Fan,Hao Dong
机构: Peking University (北京大学); PrimeBot
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deploying a language-guided navigation policy in a new building usually means watching it fail. Public-benchmark VLAs degrade scene by scene as layout, appearance, and language drift, and the standard fix of teleoperating fresh trajectories on site does not scale. We replace human demonstration with a single brief iPhone scan. Scan2Instruction compiles that scan into a complete training environment, automatically synthesizing executable navigation episodes with grounded instructions. PRPT-KS then adapts the policy through a closed-form Pareto utility read directly off the reconstructed scene, with no learned critic and no human labels. Across five real environments, the two designs together drive our RealNav to an 85% real-robot success rate, compared with 49% for a RealNav baseline post-trained on human demonstrations, and still achieve 82% in unscanned regions of the same buildings, compared with 41% for the same baseline. Our work turns demonstration-free scene adaptation for language-guided navigation from an aspiration into a working reality.

[NLP-139] he Hitchhikers Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLM S

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在实际应用中因自回归（autoregressive）、逐标记生成的推理方式导致的效率低下、成本高昂以及决策校准性差的问题，尤其针对现代AI系统中大量需要亚秒级响应时间的常规决策任务（如路由、门控、评分、分类等）。其核心解决方案在于提出并系统化“系统1型决策模型”（System 1 decision models），即通过单次前向传播将输入直接映射为带有类型和结构化的决策输出，从而实现高速、低成本且可校准的决策能力。该研究的关键在于构建一个涵盖五类模型的综合性分类体系：基于编码器的分类器、奖励模型、非自回归决策引擎、对比式决策模型与提取模型，并深入分析各类模型的架构设计、训练方法及部署权衡。同时，论文强调校准性（calibration）作为核心原则，发展了正确评分规则的理论基础，探讨了强化学习校准决策（Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions, RLCD）方法，并揭示了诸如独立于无关选项假设（IIA）违反、序数尺度偏差以及分布偏移下的少样本再校准等关键现象。此外，论文还系统阐述了系统1模型在智能体工作流与“系统1+系统2”级联架构中的集成机制，实现基于置信度校准的快慢模型动态路由。整体上，该研究提供了一个覆盖18个应用场景、包含超过70个开源模型复现、附带可运行代码、实践检查清单、开源模型库及22道自测题的完整工具包，旨在成为快速决策、校准性与生产级AI系统交叉领域研究人员与工程师的统一入门指南。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33775
作者: Haggai Roitman
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: version 1.0

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family’s architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner’s checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.

[NLP-140] StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话助手在交互过程中对约束条件（constraint）管理失效的问题，具体表现为：随着对话轮次的增加，已激活的约束逐渐被忽略（持久性失败，persistence failure），而已被撤销的约束仍被持续执行（复发，relapse）。现有解决方案依赖外部记账系统（external ledger）在每一轮重新注入编译后的规范，但存在额外开销。其核心创新在于提出StateWise——一种自改进式方法，通过训练单一大语言模型（LLM）自主维护可修订的约束状态（typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints），利用可执行检查器（executable checkers）量化持久性与复发行为，并免费生成真实状态作为监督信号。该方法首先通过两阶段微调使模型学会将对话摘要为约束状态并基于该状态生成响应；随后通过自训练机制筛选仅通过精确往返验证（round-trip check）的对话轨迹，实现状态追踪的高精度。然而实验发现，尽管状态跟踪能力极强，模型却难以遵守自身维护的状态，导致复发率显著上升。为此，研究引入偏好阶段，在自生成的复发对比样本中进行强化学习：拒绝执行已撤销规则的响应，选择通过往返验证的响应。在未见约束类别和表达方式的测试集上，StateWise相较监督自训练显著降低复发率8–22个百分点，提升对话成功率8–19个百分点，并在无需推理时辅助结构的前提下超越基于编译记账本的基准。此外，研究还分析了该方法对通用指令遵循任务的影响，并探索权重插值作为缓解代价的策略。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33766
作者: Samarth Varshney,Ritu Yadav
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 13 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. StateWise fine-tunes the LLM on two complementary skills, summarizing a dialogue into its constraint state and responding conditioned on that state, then self-trains on its own trajectories, keeping only turns that pass an exact round-trip check against the compiled state. This teaches 7-8B models to track the state almost perfectly but, surprisingly, not to obey it: on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. We therefore add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts, where the rejected response enacts a revoked rule and the chosen one passes the round-trip check. On two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, StateWise cuts relapse by 8-22 points relative to supervised self-training, lifts conversation success by 8-19 points over the backbone, and beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. We also characterize the recipe’s cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and study weight interpolation as a mitigation.

[NLP-141] RoleHear: Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Role-Attributed Streaming Speech Recognition

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决流式自动语音识别（Streaming Automatic Speech Recognition）中词流缺乏说话人角色归属的问题，即在低延迟转录的同时，实现每个词与对应说话人角色的精确关联。传统方法通常将角色标注（Role Attribution）作为独立阶段处理，依赖离线或流式说话人分离模型对齐词序列，或使用基于文本的大语言模型进行后处理，但这些方法面临标注数据稀缺、延迟高及系统耦合性差等挑战。本文提出的解决方案——RoleHear，采用一种半监督流水线架构，其核心在于设计一个缓存感知的流式转换器（cache-aware streaming transducer），通过轻量级的词汇内角色标记符（in-vocabulary role tokens）实现角色信息的在线嵌入：先以快速的发言边界标记符（turn-boundary marker）指示发言切换，随后在数个词后插入对应的说话人角色标记。该方案利用一个经过角色标注微调的离线教师模型对未标注音频进行重标注，并结合多模态大语言模型在无真实标签场景下生成银色标签（silver labels），最终使流式学生模型在单次训练中联合学习混合数据，显著提升了角色标注准确性，同时保持了高质量的转录性能，并缩小了与离线教师模型之间的差距。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33765
作者: Zefang Liu,Chenyang Zhu,Sangwoo Cho,Xujun Peng,Rongqing Huang,Shi-Xiong Zhang,Sambit Sahu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Streaming automatic speech recognition transcribes at low latency but produces an unattributed word stream, while real-time applications such as customer-service analytics need each word tied to a speaker role. Role attribution is usually a separate stage, either an offline or streaming speaker-diarization model aligned to the words or a text-based large language model applied to the transcript, and role labels for training are scarce. We present RoleHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that makes a single cache-aware streaming transducer emit roles inline through lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens: a fast turn-boundary marker followed by a per-role token a few words later. An offline transducer teacher, fine-tuned into a role-attributed recognizer, relabels unlabeled audio, and a multimodal large language model supplies silver role labels where gold annotations are unavailable. The streaming student is fine-tuned on the mixture in a single pass. Across customer-service calls with gold roles and earnings calls with silver roles, RoleHear attributes roles accurately while preserving transcription quality and narrowing the gap to the offline teacher.

[NLP-142] Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation: Rethinking Machine Translation Evaluation in the Era of Human-Level Systems EMNLP2025

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前机器翻译（Machine Translation, MT）评估方法在逼近人类水平翻译质量时，难以有效识别细微翻译错误的问题。现有金标准评估方法（如MQM和ESA）存在标注者专业水平不一、分类体系过于复杂、严重性分级粗糙、过度侧重准确性而忽视流畅性，以及时间压力导致评估质量下降等局限。为应对上述挑战，研究提出了一套由专业语言学家完成的高质量英文-俄文翻译评估数据集（基于WMT24），并设计了新的评估协议RATE（Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation）。RATE的关键创新在于：简化误差分类体系、扩展严重性评分维度、引入多维度评分机制以平衡准确性与流畅性，从而实现更一致且深入的评估。基于该专家数据集的分析表明，当前最先进的MT系统在准确性上已超越人类翻译，但在流畅性方面仍存在显著差距——这一关键差异被传统以准确性为导向的评估指标所掩盖。研究强调，推进机器翻译评估不仅需要改进评估协议，更依赖于具备专业素养的语言学家提供的高质量标注。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33749
作者: Dmitry Popov,Vladislav Negodin,Ekaterina Enikeeva,Iana Matrosova,Nikolay Karpachev,Max Ryabinin
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2025. 17 pages. Dataset: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As machine translation systems approach human-level quality, traditional evaluation methodologies struggle to detect subtle translation errors. We critically examine limitations in current gold-standard approaches (MQM and ESA), including inconsistencies from variable annotator expertise, excessive categorization complexity, coarse severity granularity, accuracy bias over fluency, and time constraints. To address this issue, we introduce a high-quality dataset consisting of human evaluations for English-Russian translations from WMT24, created by professional linguists. We show that expert assessments without time pressure yield substantially different results from standard evaluations. To enable consistent and rich annotation by these experts, we developed the RATE (Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation) protocol. RATE provides a streamlined error taxonomy, expanded severity ratings, and multidimensional scoring balancing accuracy and fluency, facilitating deeper analysis of MT outputs. Our analysis, powered by this expert dataset, reveals that state-of-the-art MT systems may have surpassed human translations in accuracy while still lagging in fluency - a critical distinction obscured by existing accuracy-biased metrics. Our findings highlight that advancing MT evaluation requires not only better protocols but crucially, high-quality annotations from skilled linguists.

[NLP-143] Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM -Based Machine Translation Evaluators EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在机器翻译（Machine Translation, MT）评估中因设计选择不明确而导致行为不可预测的问题。尽管基于LLM的评估工具已成为MT评价的主流方法，但其指令设计、少样本示例、主干模型选择及多步骤工作流等关键因素如何影响评估性能仍缺乏系统理解。为此，研究通过在WMT24和WMT25英俄翻译数据上构建新的专家级错误标注（RATE），并结合跨五种语言对的MQM与ESA基准进行迁移验证，系统探究了上述设计要素的影响。研究揭示四个稳健结论：指令结构显著塑造评估器行为；高质量的少样本示例比数量更重要；前沿主干模型表现出不同的评估倾向（召回率导向、精确率导向或排序导向）；融合多种异构主干模型的输出优于单一模型多次调用的设置。尽管评估器设计存在庞大的组合空间，但部分发现的设计原则在不同标注协议和语言对间具有强泛化能力。基于这些发现，研究提出ORBIT——一类可配置的LLM-based MT评估框架，其最优配置在错误片段检测以及准确性和流畅性排序任务上达到专家水平性能，同时成本仅为人工专家标注的约1/20。

作者: Dmitry Popov,Roman Bokhyan,Ekaterina Enikeeva,Artem Mekhraliev,Stepan Vysotsky,Nikolay Karpachev
机构: Yandex(雅虎); HSE University(高等经济大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 1 figure. Dataset and prompts: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. Although evaluator design exposes a large combinatorial space, several discovered design principles transfer consistently across annotation protocols and language pairs. We synthesize these findings into ORBIT, a family of LLM-based MT evaluators. Our strongest configurations achieve expert-level performance in error span detection and in Accuracy and Fluency ranking at roughly 20x lower cost than expert human annotation.

[NLP-144] Gender Associations in LLM -Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在医疗自诊断场景中，人口统计学线索（如性别）如何影响输出结果的问题，尤其聚焦于注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）这一存在持续性别差异但与临床证据不完全一致的疾病。其核心挑战在于揭示模型在零样本自诊断情境下对性别化ADHD关联的响应机制。解决方案的关键在于采用情境关联测试（Context Association Test, CAT）框架，系统区分显式提示（explicit cueing）与隐式提示（implicit cueing）对GPT-4o模型输出的影响：研究发现，显式提示会显著强化特定ADHD亚型的性别关联，可能触发模型的偏差缓解机制并导致过度校正；而隐式提示则呈现出接近代理对齐（proxy-aligned）的分布，反映模型的默认行为模式。这一差异表明，评估LLM在医疗自诊断中的性别偏见时，必须精细考察模型所编码的人口统计学关联形式，且提示设计方式对偏见表现具有决定性影响。

作者: Matilde Elene Hansen,Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan
机构: Aarhus University (奥胡斯大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: 20 pages (10 pages of main text, plus references and appendix). Accepted at EVAL4SD 2026. To appear in the ACL Anthology

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model’s default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.

[NLP-145] Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统教育分类体系（educational taxonomies）依赖人工构建、耗时且难以迭代更新的问题，同时探索如何利用自动化方法生成可替代的教育分类体系。其核心挑战在于如何在不依赖专家经验的前提下，从教学内容本身（如数学题）中自动提取并组织知识单元（knowledge components），以支持智能辅导系统等教育应用中的学习目标定义与学生建模。解决方案的关键在于利用语义文本嵌入（semantic text embeddings）技术，对数学题目进行向量化表示，并通过聚类分析生成基于嵌入的教育分类体系。实验表明，这种嵌入驱动的分类体系虽与现有基于《共同核心州立标准》（CCSS）的人工分类体系存在部分一致性，但也揭示了新的内容组织结构；将其应用于深度知识追踪（Deep Knowledge Tracing）任务时，可使模型预测性能提升约3-5个AUC百分点，验证了该方法在恢复人类制定分类结构的同时，还能提供具有实用价值的替代性表示。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33694
作者: Kia Karbasi,Kaveh Karbasi,Gregory Pottie
机构: University of California, Los Angeles(加州大学洛杉矶分校); Tempus AI, Inc.
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. The embedding-based taxonomies exhibit substantial but incomplete correspondence with the existing taxonomies, revealing both preserved and alternative organizations of educational content. When used for knowledge tracing, they improve predictive performance by approximately 3-5 AUC percentage points. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic embeddings for automatically constructing educational taxonomies that both recover structure present in human-developed taxonomies and provide useful alternative representations for downstream educational modeling.

[NLP-146] PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology WACV2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能在数字病理学报告生成中面临的两大核心问题：一是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）依赖自身参数编码的分布进行推理，受限于模型规模，难以容纳充分的医学知识与可解释的推理逻辑；二是其“黑箱”推理过程缺乏可解释性，不利于临床医生对诊断推理路径的理解。为此，论文提出一种基于知识图谱（Knowledge Graph, KG）增强的多模态大语言模型框架——PathKGen，其解决方案的关键在于构建双分支架构：一方面通过视觉路径利用病理基础模型提取全切片图像（WSI）的视觉特征；另一方面引入知识路径，通过查询领域特定的知识图谱，自动提取与病理图像相关的关键形态学特征作为结构化知识令牌（knowledge tokens），从而将外部医学知识显式注入模型推理过程。该设计不仅显著提升了报告生成的准确性与可解释性，还通过可视化知识图谱形式呈现诊断推理链条，实现了从“黑箱”到“白盒”推理的转变。由于其模块化设计，该知识路径可灵活适配不同领域的知识图谱，具备良好的可扩展性与跨应用潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33691
作者: Nadun Rajapaksha,Sandun Herath,Devnith Wijesinghe,Isiri Amani Withanawasam,Hasindri Watawana,Ranga Rodrigo
机构: University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka; Idiap Research Institute, Switzerland; EPFL, Switzerland
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

[NLP-147] Meta-CLIP: Metadata-Conditioned Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Disease Inference

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医学视觉-语言预训练中因成像设备和采集协议差异导致的跨域泛化能力下降问题。现有方法主要聚焦于增强临床语义信息，而忽视了DICOM头文件中的结构化采集元数据的价值。其解决方案的关键在于提出Meta-CLIP，一种基于元数据条件的对比学习框架，通过利用采集相似性对跨模态负样本进行重加权。该框架设计了一个作用于数值型与类别型DICOM字段的核函数，定义了一个有界成对边界（bounded pairwise margin），使采集条件相似的负样本贡献更大，从而强化在相同成像条件下不同研究之间的区分能力。该核函数在图像-文本优化过程中保持固定，推理阶段仍采用标准双编码器架构，无需依赖元数据。实验表明，Meta-CLIP在胸部X线和容积胸腔CT任务上均显著提升性能，在CT-RATE数据集上相较CT-CLIP提升1.41个宏观受试者工作特征曲线下面积（macro-AUROC）点，且95%置信区间为0.96–1.85；在五个胸部X线基准中的四个取得最高宏AUROC。探索性BrgSA分析进一步验证了其鲁棒性。结果表明，采集元数据可作为医学视觉-语言学习中有效的训练时先验信息。

Abstract:Medical vision–language pretraining learns transferable representations from paired images and radiology reports, yet differences in scanners and acquisition protocols can impair transfer. Existing approaches primarily enrich clinical semantics, leaving structured acquisition information in DICOM headers underused. We introduce Meta-CLIP, a metadata-conditioned contrastive framework that uses acquisition similarity to reweight cross-modal negatives during pretraining. A kernel over numerical and categorical DICOM fields defines a bounded pairwise margin. This margin increases the contribution of acquisition-similar negatives, emphasizing distinctions among studies that share imaging conditions. The kernel remains fixed during image–text optimization, and inference follows the standard dual-encoder architecture without requiring metadata. We evaluate Meta-CLIP on chest radiography and volumetric chest CT through zero-shot classification, appearance perturbations, grounding, and representation analyses. On CT-RATE, Meta-CLIP improves macro-AUROC over CT-CLIP by 1.41 points, with a 95% paired bootstrap confidence interval of 0.96–1.85 points. It also achieves the highest macro-AUROC on four of five CXR benchmarks. An exploratory BrgSA evaluation extends the analysis to another CT backbone. These findings support acquisition metadata as a practical training-time prior for medical vision–language learning. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

[NLP-148] Jointly Modeling Preferences and Imperfect Decision-Making in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在标准偏好诱导任务中表现出的偏好是否能够有效预测其在复杂战略环境下的行为问题。现有研究多通过行为经济学或心理学方法单独测量偏好维度，但缺乏对不同情境下偏好的一致性检验及跨场景预测能力的评估，难以揭示多种目标（如个体福利、群体福祉与环境关切）协同作用对决策的影响机制。为此，论文提出偏好-行为模型（Preference-Behavior Model, PBM），基于效用理论，将偏好表征与非完美效用最大化的心理机制相结合，并将参数估计建模为逆博弈问题，通过观察到的选择行为联合推断偏好与行为参数。在公共品博弈、集体风险困境和共有资源困境三类社会困境中的实证表明：传统行为经济诱导工具所测得的偏好无法一致预测模型表现，而基于特定情境训练的PBM模型在其他情境中仍具预测力，说明其推断的偏好能捕捉到原始诱导工具所忽略的深层决策特征。此外，通过对角色指令对齐性的分析发现，推断出的偏好总体上反映预期优先级，但在不同维度、模型和游戏类型间存在可识别的偏差。本研究的方法论为系统评估LLM偏好的一致性、与设计意图的对齐程度，以及揭示标准偏好诱导方法可能遗漏的权衡关系与行为模式提供了可扩展的框架。

机构: Université Libre de Bruxelles (布鲁塞尔自由大学); Vrije Universiteit Brussel (布鲁塞尔自由大学); FARI Institute (FARI研究所); ELLIS Alicante (ELLIS阿利坎特); Center for Human-Compatible AI, UC Berkeley (人类兼容人工智能中心，加州大学伯克利分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Do preferences Large Language Models (LLMs) express in standard elicitation tasks predict their strategic behaviour? LLM agents interacting with humans and other AI systems face potentially conflicting objectives, such as individual welfare, group welfare, and environmental concerns. Prior work characterizes LLM preferences through behavioral-economic and psychological elicitation or strategic games, but rarely tests consistency across settings and prediction in other strategic environments. This requires modeling how competing objectives jointly shape behavior, whereas existing approaches typically measure preference dimensions in isolation. Drawing on utility theory, we introduce the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization. We formulate estimation as an inverse-game problem, jointly inferring preferences and behavioral parameters from observed choices. We evaluate PBM in three social dilemmas that expose conflicting motives: a Public Goods Game, a Collective-Risk Dilemma, and a Common-Pool Resource dilemma. We find that while preferences estimated from established behavioral economic elicitation instruments do not consistently predict behavior in these dilemmas, models fitted in one dilemma retain predictive value in others, suggesting that inferred preferences capture meaningful aspects of LLM decision-making that elicitation instruments may miss. Finally, we assess alignment with persona instructions, finding that inferred preferences broadly reflect intended priorities with specific divergences across dimensions, LLMs, and games being identified by our approach. Our methodology provides a framework for studying how consistently LLM preferences explain behavior, assessing alignment with intended priorities, and revealing trade-offs and behavioral patterns that standard elicitation may miss.

[NLP-149] PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决图形用户界面（GUI）定位任务中因界面元素密集、视觉干扰多而导致的控制项识别模糊问题，尤其在自然语言指令与目标控件之间存在歧义时。其核心挑战在于如何在不重新训练现有接地模型的前提下，提升输入信息的质量以增强模型对目标控件的定位与理解能力。解决方案的关键在于提出PreView——一个轻量级的辅助预处理器，通过生成两类互补的输入特征：一是针对任务需求的局部视图（task-relevant views），用于精确定位；二是针对候选控件的特定提示（candidate-specific cues），包括视觉提示（如带位置提示的红色圆圈标记）和文本提示（描述候选控件的身份或功能），以增强目标理解。该预处理器通过一个经过训练的轻量模型预测并优化图像中心点，裁剪并放大截图以生成高分辨率局部视图，同时生成结构化提示信息。这些增强后的输入被输入到冻结的接地模型中，显著提升了Qwen3-VL-2B、OS-Atlas-4B和Qwen3-VL-4B等主流模型在五个基准测试上的平均接地准确率，且无需对主模型进行微调。

Abstract:GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate’s identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.

[NLP-150] A Model-Theoretic Formalization of AlKhwaremis ilm alfaraid

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决伊斯兰教法（Fiqh）中继承分配问题的形式化建模与计算可判定性难题，尤其聚焦于阿尔·花剌子密（Al-Khwarizmi）所阐述的继承规则。其核心问题是：如何在形式逻辑与计算框架下，对特定类别的继承配置进行精确表达，并实现其有效性判断的机械化。解决方案的关键在于将每一类继承配置建模为有理数域上的有限线性等式与不等式系统，并利用傅里叶-莫茨金消去法（Fourier-Motzkin elimination over Q）实现该系统的精确判定。进一步地，论文定义了具有显著请求人坐标的固定维度继承结构 VdV_dVd​，并证明所有可接受的有理线性坐标实现均与 VdV_dVd​ 同构，从而确立了该代数表示在该类别中的规范性（canonical）。此外，通过构造证明了 VdV_dVd​ 的完整一阶理论 TdT_dTd​ 是完备的，且明确区分了其整体理论完备性与继承相关片段的可判定性。该方法论最终推广至更广泛的封闭教法领域形式化，通过穷尽案例生成、霍恩子句公理化（Horn clause axiomatization）及终止性推理，实现了领域相关的计算完备性（domain-relative computational completeness）。

作者: Elnaserledinellah Mahmoud Abdelwahab
机构: 未知

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper presents a model theoretic and computational formalization of AlKhwarizmis treatment of inheritance within the framework of Computational Fiqh. We first show that every inheritance configuration in a specified class is representable as a finite system of rational linear equalities and inequalities, and that such systems are decided exactly by Fourier Motzkin elimination over Q. We then define the fixed dimensional inheritance structure Vd with distinguished claimant coordinates, and prove that every admissible rational linear coordinate realization is isomorphic to Vd, this establishes the algebraic representation as canonical within that class. The complete first order theory Td of Vd is shown to be complete by construction and is explicitly distinguished from the decidability of the inheritance relevant fragment. The methodological principle is then related to a broader formalization of closed Fiqh domains via exhaustive case generation, Horn clause axiomatization, and terminating deduction, yielding domain relative computational completeness.

[NLP-151] RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在无人干预条件下能否自主完成语言模型的后训练优化，并通过用户反馈实现持续改进的问题。其核心挑战在于如何构建一个可审计、可验证的闭环系统，使AI代理能够基于人类反馈实现自我迭代升级。解决方案的关键在于提出Rapid Self-Improvement Arena（RSI Arena），采用两阶段实验范式：第一阶段中，十个前沿模型作为训练代理，各自从NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base模型出发，在共享64-GPU集群上独立完成数据选择、训练流程设计与检查点选取；第二阶段则引入人类偏好反馈的比较记录，允许各代理基于这些反馈进行为期三天的进一步微调。研究结果显示，八组模型在风格调整后的相对评分上实现了提升，尽管基准测试性能增益有限且与偏好提升无明显关联，但部分模型表现出响应长度增加和对强拒绝指令合规性上升等潜在风险。该框架为探索人类反馈引导下的递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback, RSIHF）提供了可追踪、可评估的实验环境，标志着迈向真正意义上的人机协同智能进化的重要一步。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33624
作者: Yue Huang,Yanbo Wang,Lichi Li,Yuanyuan Chen,Andreas Haupt,Xiaonan Luo,Zheyuan Liu,Jihye Choi,Felix Juefei-Xu,Xiangliang Zhang,Radha Poovendran,Misha Sra,Ying Liu,Ben Burtenshaw,Thomas Wolf,Alex Pentland,Zichen Chen,Zhangchen Xu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 39 pages. Project website: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and 300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.

[NLP-152] Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance Typology and Granularities

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）中幻觉（Hallucination）检测评估缺乏统一标准的问题。现有方法在不同基准测试（benchmark）之间进行比较时，由于各基准对幻觉的定义与度量方式存在显著差异，导致性能指标难以跨场景解释和有效比较。为此，论文将幻觉检测视为一种受基准条件影响的测量问题，并从三个维度系统组织现有基准：来源性（provenance），描述模型输出与证据条件的获取方式；类型学（typology），刻画基准标签所反映的事实性与忠实性偏差类型；粒度（granularity），规定幻觉标注、预测与评估的最小单位。基于此框架，论文分析了基准构建、标注及评估选择如何塑造底层预测任务，并将检测器机制与假设与其性能测量环境相联系。此外，论文深入探讨了片段级（span-level）评估中注释边界差异对结果的显著影响，提出**片段覆盖F1（Span Coverage F1）**作为基于包含关系的补充度量指标。该研究澄清了检测器评分所实际反映的内容，揭示了跨基准比较的局限性，并推动在不同基准条件下更透明地评估模型泛化能力。

作者: Julia Belikova,Elisei Rykov
机构: Skoltech(斯科尔科技研究所); Sber AI Lab(斯伯人工智能实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hallucination detection is increasingly important for evaluating and deploying large language models. However, existing methods are often compared across benchmarks that define and measure hallucination in substantially different ways, making reported scores difficult to interpret across settings. We study hallucination detection as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem and organize existing benchmarks along three axes: provenance, which describes how model outputs and evidence conditions are obtained; typology, which captures the factuality and faithfulness failures represented by benchmark labels; and granularity, which specifies the unit at which hallucinations are annotated, predicted, and evaluated. Using this framework, we analyze how benchmark construction, annotation, and evaluation choices shape the underlying prediction task, and relate detector mechanisms and assumptions to the settings in which their performance is measured. We also examine span-level evaluation, where variation in annotation boundaries can substantially affect reported results, and propose Span Coverage F1 as a complementary containment-based metric. Our analysis clarifies what detector scores capture, highlights limitations of cross-benchmark comparisons, and motivates more explicit evaluation of generalization across benchmark conditions.

[NLP-153] Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于社交媒体痕迹的抑郁严重程度估计中存在用户特定心理先验建模不足、语义检索多样性欠缺以及心理证据细粒度推理能力薄弱的问题。其核心解决方案是提出UMer框架，通过从用户历史社交痕迹中提炼个性化的心理先验以捕捉个体的心理倾向、行为模式与表达风格；采用量表引导的多查询检索机制，从相关帖子中构建证据记忆；进而实施由粗到细的证据感知推理，有效区分直接与间接证据，并生成可解释的逐项评分结果。该方法在真实数据集上的实验表明，不仅性能优于现有基线，还具备基于证据的可解释性并可泛化至其他量表任务。

作者: Nada Xu,Xueqin Chen,Qiang Gao,Hongru Liang,Wenqiang Lei
机构: Sichuan University (四川大学); Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (西南财经大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users’ active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user’s psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.

[NLP-154] When the Weakest Language Keeps Moving: ARMOR-DP for Multilingual BabyLM EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言生成式模型（Multilingual BabyLM）在训练过程中因固定语言采样比例而导致的语言能力不平衡问题，尤其关注弱语言在训练中动态变化的特性。其核心挑战在于：传统方法假设某一语言始终为最弱语言，因而采用静态保护策略，但实际训练中语言间的性能瓶颈会随时间迁移。解决方案的关键是提出一种模块化诊断与调控框架——ARMOR-DP，通过分析表示（representation）、暴露（exposure）、容量（capacity）和目标压力（objective pressure）四类失衡来源，并利用各语言的验证损失动态调整采样比例，实现对当前瓶颈语言的实时识别与响应。实验表明，动态采样控制器能够有效应对语言间性能转移，相比静态保护策略，在平衡性与整体性能之间取得更优权衡；同时，通过引入字节级编码与可扩展容量，显著缓解了中文等长语言的表征偏差。研究结论强调：多语言模型中的“弱语言”是训练过程中的动态状态，而非语言固有属性。因此，ARMOR-DP通过将诊断与干预分离，使保护机制能够自适应地跟随当前训练瓶颈，从而实现更高效、更鲁棒的多语言训练。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33583
作者: Hanyu Liao,Yijing Chen,Tao Ji
机构: East China Normal University (华东师范大学); Fudan University (复旦大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multilingual BabyLM systems usually fix language sampling proportions even though the weakest language can change during training. We present ARMOR-DP, a modular framework that diagnoses imbalance arising from representation, exposure, capacity, and objective pressure, and uses per-language validation loss to update sampling. Controlled experiments show that equal character budgets create a severe representation artifact for Chinese; byte-level encoding removes much of it, while static Chinese protection can subsequently make English the weakest language. The dynamic controller tracks these transitions and achieves a better score–balance tradeoff than fixed protection. On official evaluation, curriculum-dynamic checkpoints outperform a matched static Chinese-protective baseline while using fewer Chinese epochs; scaling capacity yields the strongest internal ARMOR-DP system. These results support a simple conclusion: multilingual weakness is a training-time state rather than a fixed property of a language. ARMOR-DP therefore separates diagnosis from intervention, allowing protection to follow the current bottleneck instead of a predetermined language label.

[NLP-155] rajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有工具使用轨迹监督中存在的根本性问题：成功执行的轨迹未必能提供有效学习信号，因其可能遗漏多步依赖关系，或包含在决策时刻不可见信息支持下的不合理动作。其核心挑战在于如何确保监督信号既具备组合覆盖性（compositional coverage）——充分表征关键观测-动作依赖关系，又具备决策可依据性（decision grounding）——每个被监督的动作均基于智能体在决策时可见的历史信息。为此，论文提出Trajectory2Gym框架，通过围绕低支持度的组合结构构建可执行交互，并仅从实际执行中具有可依据性的决策点提取监督信号。该方法通过结构支持选择机制分配经验，结合父节点归一化的监督微调，以语义交互为单位保持训练权重的一致性。这一范式将轨迹生成从“收集成功轨迹”转变为“有意识构造可学习的交互经验”。在五个Qwen3模型规模上，Trajectory2Gym在Tau1、Tau2和BFCL三个基准上均实现提升，平均性能增益达16.9–29.8个百分点，尤其在状态持续性和多轮交互场景中表现突出，验证了强化依赖显式建模与决策可解释性对规模化工具使用智能体的关键作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33568
作者: Yihao Hu,Zhihao Wen,Yitong Lin,Siyuan Lu,Pan Wang,Wei Wu,Jiang-Ming Yang,Tao Lin
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent’s visible history.

[NLP-156] SEDATE: Do Large Language Models Share an Aggression Circuit Across Languages?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态与多语言场景下人工智能系统安全性和责任性部署的挑战，尤其针对现有安全干预方法普遍存在计算开销大、标注成本高或难以拓展至多语言环境的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需训练的“检测-编辑-验证”（Selective Detection And Targeted Editing, SEDATE）框架，通过识别并针对性地修改关键责任神经元（responsible neurons），在不进行任何额外模型训练的前提下实现安全响应生成。该方法在7种语言和4类模型架构上均表现出显著优于基线的安全性提升，同时保持模型通用能力且计算开销可忽略，且在分布外语言和多个额外数据集上结果依然稳健，验证了其跨语言泛化能力与鲁棒性。

作者: Sagnik Basu,Sayan Das,Somnath Banerjee,Animesh Mukherjee
机构: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur(印度理工学院克哈拉格普尔分校); Singapore Institute of Technology(新加坡科技学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
