点击查看摘要

Abstract:As the applications of AI continue to expand across various multimodal and multilingual domains, ensuring safe and responsible deployment of these systems has become an important concern. A wide-range of interventions have been proposed to make AI responses safer and more reliable. They often incur substantial computational or annotation costs, or cannot be extended to multilingual settings. In this work, we propose Selective Detection And Targeted Editing (SEDATE), a training-free approach based on detect-edit-verify strategy. SEDATE first detects the responsible neurons, edits them as and when necessary and finally verifies the model responses; all without any additional model training. We evaluate SEDATE across 7 languages and 4 model families. We further evaluate its effectiveness across 4 out-of-distribution languages and 4 additional datasets. We show that SEDATE achieves substantially superior safety scores across all languages and models over the best-performing baseline while retaining the general capabilities and incurring negligible overhead. Our results are robust, with the trends remaining similar for out-of-distribution languages and datasets.

[NLP-157] SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在网页代理（web agents）中学习技能后，在真实开放环境部署时面临的鲁棒性下降问题。现有方法通常在封闭环境中评估技能，忽略了实际应用中上下文（Contextual Shift）、感知基础（Perceptual Shift）和执行可行性（Execution Shift）的持续变化。为此，论文提出SkillShift-Bench，首个针对受控开放环境变化的技能学习评估基准，通过三个自托管网页系统模拟三类环境变化，并从任务成功率、交互成本、技能使用率和技能失败率等维度进行诊断性评估。实验表明，受控变化下技能表现系统性退化，表现为成功率降低、交互成本上升及技能失效频发，其中执行变化的影响最为显著。研究进一步将变化后的技能执行建模为非平稳局部可执行性问题，提出基于动态遗憾（dynamic-regret）的理论分析框架与一种无需重训练技能库的测试时适应（test-time adaptation）方法，验证了在不重新学习技能库的前提下提升已学技能执行能力的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33528
作者: Bo-Yu Chen,Zhi Zhou,Yu-Feng Li
机构: Nanjing University (南京大学); National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology (新型软件技术国家重点实验室)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 70 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. We further formulate shifted skill execution as a nonstationary local executability problem and provide both a dynamic-regret analysis and a practical test-time adaptation method, demonstrating the feasibility of improving learned-skill execution without relearning the skill library. Code, tasks, environments, documentation, and the leaderboard are available at this https URL.

[NLP-158] Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在多轮策略性说服对话训练中面临的两大耦合挑战：一是如何真实模拟具有心理基础的说服对象（persuadee），二是如何实现对策略对话中各对话行为的密集且忠实的信用分配（credit assignment）。传统基于结果的奖励信号稀疏且无法提供成功原因的细粒度反馈，而依赖大模型判官（LLM-judge）的奖励机制则成本高昂且与交互动态脱节。为此，本文提出一个统一框架：首先构建了PersuArena——一个能够生成非单调、真实感强的说服轨迹的仿真环境；其次在此基础上提出基于在线信念提取的过程奖励方法（Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization, Probe-RPO），通过在每轮对话中从冻结的说服对象的输出概率分布（logits）中读取三个内省式探针（introspective probes），生成多维、高密度的过程奖励信号，从而精确对齐说服过程中的动态变化。实验在涵盖医疗、金融咨询、职场管理、教育及个人关系等领域的PersuArena上进行，结果表明Probe-RPO实现了52.5%的完全接受率，显著优于最强的GRPO消融实验（35.8%）和最优现成大模型（25.8%）。此外，研究还进行了跨说服对象模型的泛化能力分析以及对话过程中说服动态的深入剖析。本工作为策略性对话提供了有效的过程监督范式，推动了生成式人工智能在复杂社会交互任务中的发展。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33527
作者: Minqian Liu,Yuexi Shen,Heajun An,Qi Zhang,Pamela J. Wisniewski,Sang Won Lee,Jin-Hee Cho,Lifu Huang
机构: Virginia Tech(弗吉尼亚理工学院); UC Santa Barbara(加州大学圣芭芭拉分校); UC Davis(加州大学戴维斯分校); STIR Lab
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee’s internal state into dense process rewards. At each turn, three introspective probes are read from the frozen persuadee’s logits, yielding a multi-dimensional reward signal that is faithfully aligned with persuasion dynamics. With extensive experiments on PersuArena spanning healthcare, financial advising, workplace management, education, and personal relationships, we demonstrate that our Probe-RPO achieves the full acceptance rate of 52.5%, compared with the 35.8% for the strongest GRPO ablation and 25.8% for the best off-the-shelf LLM. We also conduct comprehensive analyses on the generalization across persuadee models and the persuasion dynamics across conversations. Our work offers a promising paradigm that can provide effective process supervision for strategic dialogue.

[NLP-159] One Model Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在保持单次前向传播（single-pass）性能的同时，提升循环推理（looped inference）性能的问题。由于模型通过复用中间层权重实现循环计算，导致在仅优化循环推理时会损害单次前向传播的输出质量。其解决方案的关键在于采用联合训练策略，对单次前向和循环推理的输出分别施加加权损失函数，并利用冻结的原始预训练模型作为指导信号。实验表明，通过合理调整单次前向损失的权重并结合原始模型的监督，可显著降低单次前向性能下降幅度，同时有效保留循环推理带来的增益。在验证集选定最优权重后，该方法能够在维持单次前向性能接近普通持续训练水平的前提下，显著提升循环推理的表现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33517
作者: Jiarun Shen,Lei Zhao,Xiao Li
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen(深圳大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

[NLP-160] Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于评分标准（rubric-based）的强化学习在非可验证任务中导致模型生成响应过于冗长、包含大量无关或事实错误内容的问题。现有方法通常仅以评分标准覆盖度加权作为奖励信号，促使模型追求高召回率，从而牺牲了生成内容的精确性与简洁性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为FORK的新型奖励机制，该机制同时优化召回率与一项新颖的精确性目标——要求生成响应中的每一部分均具备必要性且事实正确，通过评分驱动的必要性评分（necessity credits）和事实正确性评分器（factual-correctness grader）共同实现。实验结果表明，FORK在保持相近评分标准覆盖度的同时显著提升了响应精确性并缩短了输出长度，在RubricHub-Medical和HealthBench数据集上相对于基线策略的胜率分别从10.6%和22.1%提升至68.0%和74.1%，实现了召回与质量之间的帕累托最优平衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33512
作者: Hyun Ryu,Jong-Heon Kim,Yiqing Xie,Seungone Kim,Carolyn Rose,Eunho Yang
机构: KAIST AI(韩国科学技术院人工智能); Carnegie Mellon University Language Technologies Institute(卡内基梅隆大学语言技术研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).

[NLP-161] owards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有文本图问答（Textual Graph Question Answering, GraphQA）与基于图的检索增强生成（Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation, GraphRAG）方法中存在的两大关键问题：一是架构上的缺陷，即现有方法通常仅微调生成器，而未使检索器本身也成为可学习的大型语言模型（LLM），导致无法在端到端的“检索-生成”流程中实现联合优化；二是检索监督不足的问题，现有检索器极少利用真实答案信号来指导证据节点的选择，从而可能导致关键推理节点遗漏，造成对正确答案集合的覆盖不全；同时，盲目提升召回率又会引入大量无关信息，损害结果的紧凑性并增加生成模型的负担。为弥合上述差距，本文提出TaLenT框架，其核心在于构建一个统一的端到端检索-生成架构，将可学习的LLM检索器与微调后的LLM生成器协同集成，并创新性地利用真实答案信号作为检索器的监督信号。具体而言，通过将图节点划分为真实答案节点、相关节点与无关噪声节点三类，采用加权伪标签损失函数，优先保留真实答案和相关节点以保障覆盖率，同时剔除无关噪声以维持输出紧凑性。实验结果表明，该方法在三个GraphQA数据集上均显著提升了下游任务性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33511
作者: Kaifeng Jin,Yuchen Yan,Zhichen Zeng,Xiao Lin,Lihui Liu,Yinglong Xia,Hanghang Tong
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 16 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.

[NLP-162] Five Architectures One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模型融合中缺乏统一权重初始化路径时如何实现跨模型语义对齐的问题，特别是针对五种独立训练、结构各异且参数冻结的模型（包括四种来自不同组织的Transformer模型和一种状态空间模型）能否仅通过激活值建立可共享的语义空间。其解决方案的关键在于：不依赖权重合并，而是基于激活表示的统计一致性，利用置换检验、独立复制探测集、深度剖面分析、池化消融实验与混杂因素检查，验证了各模型在处理相同文本时存在显著且稳健的表征对应关系，尤其在最终层表现最强；进而采用广义普鲁克斯特分析（Generalized Procrustes Analysis, GPA）构建一个无固定参考基准的共享表示空间。该空间在最终层实现了高达0.91–0.93的平均保留检索准确率（随机水平为0.03），优于成对线性映射方法（0.82–0.85），但在中间层表现较差。此外，研究进一步评估该共享空间是否可用于构建智能路由机制以动态选择最优模型，结果表明在四类任务中均未发现路由策略优于始终使用最强模型的表现，且所谓“正确性信号”实为类别归属的伪装。所有实验均在无GPU的单台笔记本电脑上完成，验证了方法的低资源可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33495
作者: Oladimeji Anthonio,Dimeji Olawuyi,Oloruntoba Ajayi,Temilola Aderemi
机构: Centre for Clinical Intelligence and Safety, Ìyàwó; Faculty of Clinical Sciences, College of Medicine, University of Ibadan (伊巴丹大学医学院临床科学学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model’s final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical and logical notation. We then test whether the space supports a router that picks among the five models on gradeable tasks. Across four task types we find no case where routing beats always using the strongest model, and we report this as a negative result. A correctness signal that looked strong turned out to be category membership in disguise. All experiments ran on one laptop without a GPU.

[NLP-163] Small Edits Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决法语用户在日常输入中常省略撇号和变音符号或产生键盘拼写错误（即表面变体，Surface Variants）对大语言模型（LLM）性能与预测可靠性的影响问题。现有研究对该类常见文本变异如何影响模型输出的准确性与概率校准质量尚缺乏系统性理解。为此，作者构建了一个受控的法语表面变体基准测试集，涵盖七种任务类型，包含4,200个原始-低强度-高强度三元组（共12,600个输入实例），其中高强度变体在低强度修改基础上叠加更多扰动。实验评估了来自两个大语言模型家族的六种模型，结果表明：随着扰动强度增加，模型准确率下降，Brier评分与负对数似然（NLL）上升；尽管更大规模模型在高扰动下准确率损失较小，但其Brier评分与NLL的改善并不随模型规模持续提升。键盘拼写错误在预设高强度条件下导致最严重的准确率下降及预测概率质量恶化。此外，基于原始输入训练的校准温度可有效迁移至表面变体，结合输入修复与校准的方法进一步优于单一策略，显著降低Brier评分与NLL，同时保持修复后的准确率。该研究的关键贡献在于提出一个统一框架，用于联合评估模型在常见法语表面变体下的任务准确性与预测可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33493
作者: Jiaming Yu,Xiaotian Xie,Jian Ma,Yingjie Li
机构: Hangzhou International Innovation Institute, Beihang University(北京航空航天大学杭州国际创新研究院); School of Automation, Central South University(中南大学自动化学院); School of Reliability and Systems Engineering, Beihang University(北京航空航天大学可靠性与系统工程学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families. The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. Keyboard typos cause the largest losses in accuracy and the quality of predicted probabilities at the predefined high-intensity settings. Finally, calibration temperatures fitted on original inputs transfer effectively to surface variants. Combining calibration with input restoration further improves Brier score and NLL over either method alone while preserving restored accuracy. Our benchmark provides a unified framework for jointly evaluating task accuracy and prediction reliability under common French surface variations.

[NLP-164] Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决如何利用大语言模型助教在学期层面的交互特征，提升对学生作业成绩预测的准确性，以超越固定基准模型的表现。其核心问题在于：现有基于常数基准（如均值或中位数）的预测方法是否足以充分捕捉学生表现的动态变化，抑或引入更复杂的交互特征能够带来实质性改进。解决方案的关键在于采用多种拟合估计器（包括梯度提升、岭回归等）与嵌套交叉验证框架，系统评估不同模型在真实教育数据集（StudyChat）上的表现，并通过重复十次的留出预测平均来降低随机性影响。结果显示，尽管梯度提升模型在整体上仅小幅优于中位数基准（均绝对误差分别为3.023和3.138），但在低分四分位区间内其表现显著更优（误差7.30 vs. 8.07），且岭回归在该子群体中误差最低（6.37）。研究进一步揭示成绩高度集中于高分段（91.4%学生得分高于90），导致低分群体虽占比小但贡献了大部分误差，从而凸显基准选择与误差分布对预测价值评估的重要性。这一回顾性分析为评估学生支持工具提供了方法论启示，但未建立干预带来的学习效应。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33488
作者: Zeyu Dong,Mikael Kwame Kuada,Asa Holley Buchakjian-Tweedy,Ibrahem Aljabea
机构: Crestwood Preparatory College (克雷斯特伍德预备学院); Hammond High Magnet School (汉默德高中磁学项目); Spaulding High School (斯普尔丁高中); Louisiana State University (路易斯安那州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: 8 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student’s held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. In the lowest observed-score quartile, however, boosting’s error is 7.30 points, versus 8.07 for the median and 6.67 for the mean; Ridge has the lowest fitted-model error at 6.37 despite its worse overall error of 3.331. Scores concentrate near the ceiling: 160 students (91.4%) score above 90, and the lowest quartile contributes 62.1% of boosting’s total absolute error. This retrospective comparison shows how baseline choice and error distribution affect predictive value, informing evaluation of student-support tools without establishing a learning effect.

[NLP-165] Propasafe-Hybrid: A Text-Based Hybrid Propaganda Detection Tool

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在线新闻与社交媒体中传播性内容（propagandistic content）泛滥且用户缺乏足够审慎识别的问题，提出了一种细粒度、可解释的句子级检测方案。其核心解决方案是Propasafe-Hybrid系统，该系统通过融合微调的Transformer分类器与基于大语言模型（LLM）的技术分类机制，实现对特定宣传策略的精准识别、标签标注与原因解释。系统输出包括高亮句子、技术归类及简洁推理依据，显著提升了可解释性与用户理解效率。为控制大语言模型的计算成本，系统引入成本感知的预过滤阶段，仅将高置信度句子送入LLM处理，有效降低令牌（token）消耗的同时保持决策逻辑的完整性。这一设计在保证检测准确性与透明度的前提下，大幅增强了系统在真实新闻环境中的实用性与运行效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33464
作者: Thomas Kimmeth,Avijit Roy,Vivek Sharma
机构: John Jay College of Criminal Justice, CUNY(纽约城市大学约翰杰伊刑事司法学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: Published in the Proceedings of FLAIRS-39 (2026), Special Track: Applied Natural Language Processing

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Propagandistic content increasingly circulates through online news and social media, where readers often encounter it with limited scrutiny, highlighting the need for reliable and fine-grained detection. This paper introduces Propasafe-Hybrid, a sentence-level system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification to identify, label, and explain specific propaganda strategies. The pipeline generates actionable outputs, including highlighted sentences, technique assignments, and concise rationales, so users can immediately understand why a sentence was flagged and how each label was determined. To control inference cost, Propasafe-Hybrid employs a cost-aware pre-filtering stage that forwards only high-likelihood sentences to LLMs, reducing token usage while preserving the underlying decision logic. Together, these design choices enhance the explainability, efficiency, and practical usability of sentence-level propaganda detection in real-world news environments.

[NLP-166] Adaptive Transfer of Representational Signatures for LLM Reliability Detection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成文本时存在幻觉（hallucination）和推理错误等可靠性问题，且现有质量检测器在新领域应用时受限于需大量特定领域标注数据的问题。其核心解决方案是通过跨相关领域的表征签名迁移实现高效适应性迁移学习。关键在于构建一个统计框架：首先提取各领域的低维表征签名，再利用交叉拟合（cross-fitting）方法学习不同源领域预测器的组合权重，使权重能够动态反映各源域对目标域的预测相关性。该方法的渐近分析揭示了最小二乘类估计下预测风险与聚合权重与领域差异及表示偏差之间的理论关系。实验结果表明，在仅需25个目标领域标注样本的情况下，该自适应迁移方法使幻觉检测的AUROC提升6.8%，推理步骤预测的AUROC提升8.4%，显著提升了检测器在新领域的泛化能力与实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33442
作者: Yongtong Li,Yixuan Florence Wu,Jiawei Zhang,Naichen Shi
机构: Northwestern University(西北大学); University of Wisconsin–Madison(威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are reported to be susceptible to reliability issues including hallucinations and reasoning errors. Existing quality detectors can predict unreliable outputs based on internal representations with decent accuracies. However, training these detectors often requires substantial domain-specific labeled data, which limits their applicability to new domains. We propose to address this challenge by transferring representational signatures across related domains. More specifically, we build a statistical framework that first extracts low-dimensional signatures for each domain, then uses cross-fitting to learn composition weights of domain-specific predictors. The weights adapt to each source domain’s predictive relevance to the target domain. Our asymptotic analysis of a least-squares analogue characterizes the limiting prediction risk and aggregation weights in terms of domain discrepancies and representation bias. Experiments across multiple hallucination datasets and open-weight LLMs show that, with only 25 labeled questions in the new domain, adaptive transfer improves hallucination-detection AUROC by 6.8%. For reasoning-step prediction, it improves AUROC by 8.4%.

[NLP-167] Quantifying Meaning with SCAPE-T: Semantic Complexity from Encoder-Only Transformer Attention

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自然语言处理（NLP）领域中语义复杂度（semantic complexity）自动化评估缺乏系统性方法的问题。现有方法主要聚焦于可读性（readability）、词汇难度或表面特征（如词长、句法结构）的量化，这些指标易受表层语言形式的干扰，难以准确反映文本深层语义整合的复杂程度。本文提出SCAPE-T，一种基于仅编码器（encoder-only）Transformer架构的注意力机制衍生度量方法，通过直接建模语义整合过程来定义和计算语义复杂度：其核心是将语义复杂度操作化为唯一指定文本语义所需代码长度，并结合三个子指标——（i）逆权重自关注（token-to-self），（ii）CLS关注度（token-to-CLS），以及（iii）跨头冗余度（inter-head redundancy，以注意力头间余弦相似度衡量），并通过分层加权聚合实现整合。该方法的数据驱动部分仅限于超参数校准，避免过度依赖训练数据。实验在哲学散文与儿童故事对比、儿童读物与技术维基百科文章对比等任务上验证，以成对比较准确性为主要评估标准，结果显示，在控制词长的前提下，SCAPE-T达到78.5%的成对准确率（95%置信区间：76.1–80.4，N=10k对比较），显著优于所有基线模型（领先最强基线12.7个百分点）；而在未控制词长时，依赖表面特征的可读性指标表现更优，印证了其对表层特征的敏感性。在抽象性短文本数据集上的测试也表明SCAPE-T具有优势。消融分析进一步证明各子指标均对性能有实质性贡献。综上，SCAPE-T的关键创新在于有效分离语义结构与词汇/句法混杂因素，实现了对概念结构复杂度的更纯净刻画，并展现出良好的跨领域泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33441
作者: Maxim Khovansky,Lev Mukhanov
机构: Queen Mary University of London (伦敦玛丽女王大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 12 pages; semantic complexity, complexity estimation, encoder attention, attention analysis, pairwise accuracy, readability, text simplification, transformers

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated semantic complexity estimation remains underexplored in NLP, despite important applications in linguistics and interpretability. This paper defines semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text’s semantic meaning, and operationalises it via SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers. Existing measures either model reader effort (readability, lexical difficulty), which correlates with surface features (word length, syntax), or quantify surface features directly (type-token ratio, word frequency). SCAPE-T targets semantic integration directly by combining three submetrics: (i) inverse-weighted self-focus (token-to-self), (ii) CLS focus (token-to-CLS), and (iii) inter-head redundancy (cosine similarity across heads), using layer-weighted aggregation; data-driven learning is confined to hyperparameter tuning for calibration. Development uses philosophical prose vs. MCTest stories; evaluation is on children’s stories vs. technical Wikipedia articles, with pairwise accuracy on contrasts as the primary criterion. Baselines include readability, syntactic/lexical, and LLM-derived measures. SCAPE-T substantially outperforms all tested baselines under word-length control, with a pairwise accuracy of 78.5% (95% bootstrap CI: 76.1-80.4, N=10k pairwise comparisons; +12.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline); without that control, readability heuristics overtake, consistent with their reliance on surface features. On a short-terms abstractness dataset, SCAPE-T also leads. Ablations show each submetric contributes materially. Overall, the results show SCAPE-T isolates conceptual structure from lexical/syntactic confounds better than existing methods, and generalises across two held-out domains.

[NLP-168] Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering NEURIPS2026 ALT

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医学问答（Medical QA）领域中如何从大规模现有问答库中高效选择紧凑训练子集的问题，以实现对医学语言模型的低成本、高效率微调。其核心挑战在于在有限的标注数据预算下，如何筛选出最具代表性和信息量的样本，从而最大化模型性能。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于高斯扰动的表示敏感性优先级选择方法（Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization, RSP），通过分析最终层表示在高斯扰动下的两个信号——预测变化频率（prediction-change frequency）与非翻转边界收缩（non-flipping margin contraction）——来评估样本的重要性。RSP采用自动均方根缩放融合两信号，而RSP-Drop则仅依赖边界收缩信号进行排序。两者均仅依赖问题与答案选项完成选择，无需额外标注或复杂计算。实验表明，在128个样本的基准预算下，RSP和RSP-Drop分别获得47.55和48.28的平均宏F1分数，显著优于基于熵池匹配的随机采样（45.11）。研究进一步揭示了不同数据集和预算下性能差异的成因，并通过案例分析与消融实验指出熵预过滤并非在所有场景中均具普适优势，从而为扰动驱动的数据选择提供了实证依据与局限性认知。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33440
作者: Yuexin Wu,Dayou Yu,Vasile Rus
机构: University of Memphis (孟菲斯大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages. Preprint submitted to IEEE ICHI 2027. Extends the non-archival GenAI4Health @ NeurIPS 2026 study arXiv:2609.09684v2 with automatic RMS scaling, RSP-Drop, budget analyses, and entropy-prefilter ablations

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.

[NLP-169] Examining form-based linguistic productivity in people and large language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决人类语言生成能力中抽象语法知识的性质问题，特别是人类如何在缺乏具体语义的情况下仍能实现语言产出的创造性泛化。其核心问题是：人类与计算语言模型在面对新词时，是否能够基于句法形式进行抽象规则迁移，从而在被动语态等陌生语境中正确扩展使用。研究的关键发现是，人类能够在无法赋予新动词明确语义的前提下，依据句法形式的抽象规律（如主动语态向被动语态的转换规则）完成语言泛化；而大型语言模型（LLM）仅在新动词具有可类比的已有动词语义时才能成功完成此类泛化。这表明，当前生成式 AI 的句法知识仍高度依赖具体词汇项的分布特征和语义关联，而人类的句法知识则具备独立于特定词汇的抽象性，体现了更深层次的语言认知机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33433
作者: Michael Wilson,Robert Frank
机构: University of Nevada, Reno (内华达大学雷诺分校); Yale University (耶鲁大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted to Nature Human Behaviour

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Linguistic productivity, as evidenced by the use of words in novel contexts, is one of the most striking facts about human language. However, how abstract the knowledge that enables such productivity is remains unclear. We compare people’s and computational language models’ linguistic productivity in contexts where successful generalization depends on form-based information. We focus on extending the use of a novel verb learned in the active voice to passive contexts. We find people extend active to passive uses in a way consistent with abstract generalizations concerning linguistic form, even when no plausible meaning can be assigned to the novel verb. In contrast, large language models succeeded only when a meaning like an existing verb’s could be assigned to the novel verb. We conclude that computational models’ syntactic knowledge remains tied to the distribution and meaning of specific lexical items in a way that human syntactic knowledge is not.

[NLP-170] How Does Post-Training Shape LLM Value Preferences?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在后训练阶段因训练语料中不同人口群体意见分布不均，导致价值偏好被放大并进一步加剧群体代表性不足的问题。其核心解决方案在于通过受控实验，系统评估不同意见混合比例的后训练语料与多种后训练路径（基于监督微调SFT、直接偏好优化DPO和广义相对策略优化GRPO）对价值偏好演化的影响。研究发现，不同后训练方法会以异质方式放大意见不平衡，且一旦价值偏好被强化，后续训练是否能够消除这些偏差，取决于具体的训练方法和语料中的意见构成。更关键的是，模型在干预下的稳定性与其价值偏好的变化密切相关；此外，即使蒸馏过程中未包含显式意见问题，原始模型中的价值偏好仍可传递至学生模型。这一发现表明，在开发、评估及复用大语言模型时，必须同时考虑后训练语料中的意见混合结构与后训练方法的选择，以避免隐性偏见的持续传播。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33371
作者: Yang Liu,Shaoyang Xu,Masahiro Kaneko,Chengzhi Zhong,Wenxuan Zhang,Chenhui Chu
机构: Kyoto University(京都大学); Singapore University of Technology and Design(新加坡科技设计大学); Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence(穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 46 pages, 21 figures, 21 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:During post-training, large language models (LLMs) learn value preferences from corpora that may contain imbalanced proportions of opinions associated with different demographic groups. Amplifying these imbalances may further underrepresent some groups’ opinions. However, how opinion mixtures shape value preferences across post-training paths remains unclear. To answer this question, we conduct controlled experiments using post-training corpora with different opinion mixtures and five post-training paths based on SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We find that post-training amplifies opinion imbalances differently across post-training paths. Once value preferences are amplified, whether further post-training can remove them depends on both the post-training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus. More concerningly, a model’s stability under interventions depends on whether further post-training changes its value preference. Moreover, these value preferences are transferred to student models even when distillation uses corpora with no explicit opinion questions. These findings suggest that both the opinion mixture in post-training corpora and the choice of post-training method should be considered when developing, evaluating, and reusing LLMs. Our code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-171] Distill Debate Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在科研创意生成与科学发现中，因缺乏具有区分度和实质性专业知识的协作主体而难以有效开展多智能体辩论的问题。其核心挑战在于如何赋予智能体具备真实、可辨识且源自文献脉络的专业知识背景，以推动高质量科研提案的生成。解决方案的关键在于提出InsightAgents框架，该框架通过从相关论文构成的知识图谱中提炼研究演进路径、揭示潜在假设及识别未解难题等深层洞见（insights），构建基于文献证据的智能体专业能力。这些洞见作为智能体行为的指导原则，使各智能体能够在特定研究脉络下，通过协同辩论识别研究问题、提出、质疑并迭代优化研究方案，从而生成更具深度与创新性的科研提案。实验结果表明，在100个自然语言处理（NLP）研究主题上，相较于三种现有框架，InsightAgents在两种知识设置下均在五项评估维度上取得最高平均得分，验证了其有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33366
作者: Qianran Ma,Muxin Liu,Grace Kim,Xiao Liang,Chris Callison-Burch
机构: University of Pennsylvania(宾夕法尼亚大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.

[NLP-172] Preference Optimization Improves Definition Generation: Semantic Change in EU Institutional Sustainable Finance Disclosures EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决词典式定义生成器在词汇语义变化检测（Lexical Semantic Change Detection, LSCD）中因语义细分过细而导致的定义冗余问题，即同一词汇意义被过度拆分为大量定义，影响分析效率与可解释性。其解决方案的关键在于采用直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization, DPO）进行模型微调，通过偏好学习引导模型生成更简洁、更具语义凝聚性的定义，从而缓解语义分布过细的问题。研究在经过精心构建的学术级LSCD基准上进行了定量验证，并在欧盟发展融资项目文档中可持续性术语的历史演变审计任务上进行了定性评估，证明了该方法的有效性与实用性。所有模型、代码及生成结果均已公开。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33357
作者: Mariia Fedorova,Andrey Kutuzov,Gustavo Cadenas Delascio
机构: University of Oslo(奥斯陆大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: the 5th NLP4PI (NLP for Positive Impact) Workshop@EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Dictionary-like definition generators are known to be useful for lexical semantic change detection (LSCD). However, they suffer from overly granular sense distribution, producing excessive number of definitions for one and the same lexical sense. In this work, we show that fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) helps to overcome this problem. We test our approach both quantitatively on a curated academic LSCD benchmark and qualitatively on real-world data for a practical task of auditing diachronic changes in sustainability terminology within project documentation of EU development finance. All models, code and predictions produced in this study are publicly available at this https URL.

[NLP-173] he Emergence and Sparsification of a Syntactic Circuit EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究语言模型中语法行为（如主谓数一致）的涌现机制，核心问题是：语言模型如何在训练过程中逐步习得并表征复杂的语法规则。其解决方案的关键在于通过追踪Pythia-1B及十组Pythia-410M模型在训练过程中的神经电路动态变化，发现主谓数一致行为虽在早期即被学习，但其背后的神经机制并非静态，而是经历持续重组：初始阶段由分散的神经元群体处理，随后注意力头（attention head）发生迁移（如Pythia-1B从两个头部切换至第三个不同头部），且最终形成的神经回路显著稀疏化。这一发现表明，语言知识的形成不仅涉及规则的学习，更伴随着内部表征结构的动态优化与精炼，揭示了语法能力在大语言模型中的非固定、可演化特性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33299
作者: Qing Yao,Sasha Boguraev,Tiago Pimentel,Kyle Mahowald
机构: The University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校); ETH Zurich(苏黎世联邦理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 26 pages, 7 figures, EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:To understand the emergence of grammatical behavior in language models, we track circuits for subject-verb number agreement in pythia-1b and ten seeds of pythia-410m across training. We find that subject-verb agreement is learned early, and is initially handled by a diffuse collection of neurons. However, after agreement behavior has stabilized, the mechanisms responsible for it continue to reorganize. The attention heads which mediate agreement often shift during training: in the case of pythia-1b, behavior is controlled by two heads early in training but by a third (different) head later. Furthermore, the circuit shrinks over training, with pythia-1b’s final circuit being strikingly sparse. We take these results to be informative about how linguistic knowledge emerges and is represented in a language model.

[NLP-174] Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决药物警戒领域中因个体病例安全报告（ICSRs）数量激增而带来的专家主导因果关系评估效率与可扩展性不足的问题。其核心解决方案是提出MARCA（多智能体检索增强型因果关系评估）框架，该框架基于Naranjo量表构建，通过四个专业化智能体协同完成科学文献检索、药品说明书评估、客观证据分类及临床因果推理，整合Gemini 2.5 Pro与DeepSeek-V3.2大模型能力，并引入检索增强生成（RAG）机制以提升信息获取的准确性。关键创新在于利用多智能体协作与生成式推理过程中的可解释性理由（rationales），支持人类专家介入评分，从而在保证评估质量的同时提高效率。实验结果表明，MARCA在多个问题项上展现出较高的一致性（如Q10的Kappa值达0.922），且在回顾性分析中显示使用RAG标注的得分显著优于非RAG方法，尤其在涉及潜在病因评估的复杂问题上表现更优，验证了检索增强机制在提升因果判断一致性方面的潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33279
作者: Daisy Rae Lopez,Angela Boccia,Maurizio Sessa
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores. Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen’s kappa. Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%). Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness. [NLP-175] FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agent ic Memory for LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在不同记忆需求场景下缺乏通用性的问题。具体而言，当需要回忆对话中的精确事实时，记忆系统必须保留原始文本；而在执行多步任务时，则需保存已执行步骤的完整轨迹及后续步骤无法显式表达的上下文细节。现有记忆机制如检索型记忆（A-Mem）会遗漏未被当前查询提及的中间步骤，而摘要型记忆则会丢失关键的精确字符串，二者结合虽可弥补缺陷，但提前分配预算导致灵活性不足。为此，本文提出一种通用记忆框架 FlexA-Mem，其核心创新在于将历史信息以不可变形式统一写入单一存储，并为每次调用动态生成一份紧凑的时间线记忆，该时间线包含记录与固定规则填充的细节内容，无需额外调用大模型即可完成。细节部分可为相关单元的原始文本、摘录或最匹配的原文片段。通过单一存储支持多种场景，实验表明在 AppWorld 挑战任务中（4k 上下文长度），其性能优于次优方法 11.5%；在 147 个未使用任务上，相较于 A-Mem 结合摘要的方法提升 12.2%。在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 基准测试中，其表现媲美专用关键词检索器（不依赖记忆构建），而基于大模型生成文本的记忆系统在资源受限情况下显著落后。消融分析显示，时间线结构对任务完成度起决定作用，而恢复机制主要减少冗余步骤并影响精确事实的准确性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33274
作者: Wujiang Xu,Jiaojiao Han,Xi Zhu,Qizheng Zhang,Kaiqu Liang,Yutong Yin,Kai Mei,Dimitris N. Metaxas
机构: Rutgers University(罗格斯大学); Stanford University(斯坦福大学); Princeton University(普林斯顿大学); Northwestern University(西北大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kinds of scenario. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. Ablations show that the timeline carries AppWorld completion, whereas recovery mainly saves steps there and decides accuracy on exact facts. Code is available at this https URL

[NLP-176] wo Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模内容审核中如何在经济可承受的条件下实现高精度、可解释且校准良好的二元决策（保留或删除）问题。当前内容审核面临的核心挑战是将复杂的、存在争议的人类判断压缩为单一的二元操作，而直接对每条内容运行前沿大语言模型（LLM）在成本和延迟上均不可行。为此，论文提出并评估了一类“系统一”（System One）冻结模型——这类模型以极低的成本（约0.000025美元/次调用）和毫秒级延迟输出类型化、校准后的决策结果。研究首次对这类模型进行了独立审计，基于142,658条人工标注评论，并与14个前沿推理模型（包括GPT-5.x、Claude、Gemini 3和Grok系列）在共享测试集上进行对比。关键发现有两点：其一，该低成本模型在零样本分类下的AUROC达到0.83，与13个前沿模型无统计显著差异，且成本低1至3个数量级，同时具备可比的校准性能；其二，模型原始“置信度”指标混淆了两种本质不同的不确定性——人类标注者之间的分歧（如对讽刺或暗语的理解不一）与决策风险（自动操作错误带来的实际代价），二者在不对称审核损失下需要相反的预警信号。因此，单一置信度无法同时满足两类需求。通过将判断分解为并行子问题并分析其分布差异，可恢复被原始置信度忽略的人类分歧信号，但该方法具有特定适用条件：仅对缺乏分歧感知能力的弱模型有效，且依赖于分解方式与分歧来源的对齐性；对于专门设计的毒性检测模型或最强的通用大模型而言，此改进并无必要，且效果受数据分布影响显著。解决方案的关键在于利用极低成本的并行子问题分解机制，从结构上解耦人类分歧与决策风险，从而提升模型在复杂社会语境下的可解释性和实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33258
作者: Karan Yadav
机构: Google(谷歌)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE); Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO)
备注: 11 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen “System One” models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, “confidence” conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). Under an asymmetric moderation loss these call for opposite escalation signals, so no single confidence number serves both. Because the model prices extra questions at nearly zero, decomposing the judgment into parallel sub-questions and reading their spread recovers a human-disagreement signal that the model’s native confidence misses – but this remedy is specific: it helps the weakest, disagreement-blind models and only when the decomposition aligns with the sources of disagreement; a specialist toxicity model and the strongest LLMs do not need it, and the effect is distribution-sensitive. We will release the instrument, the cached runs, and the analysis.

[NLP-177] Hey guess what: CUES lead to inferences about typicality

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决人类在语言理解中如何基于对事件典型性的认知进行隐含意义推断的问题，特别是针对典型性（typicality）与非典型性（atypicality）的语用推理机制。其核心挑战在于揭示人类如何利用常识知识、话语强调及讽刺语气等线索（CUES）来判断事件的典型程度，并在此基础上实现语义补全。研究的关键解决方案是构建了两个语料库——EventTyp及其经人工验证的金标准版本EventTypGold，通过大规模的人类与大语言模型（LLM）实验对比发现：人类主要依赖三大线索——常识知识（Commonsense Knowledge）、话语强调（Utterance Emphasis）和讽刺（Snark）来进行典型性推断；然而，大多数情况下，当前的LLM因缺乏必要的常识知识基础，无法有效识别这些线索，因而难以准确评估事件的普遍典型性，导致在典型性推理任务中表现受限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33239
作者: Alison Chi,Sanghyeok Choi,Hannah Rohde,Emily Allaway
机构: University of Edinburgh(爱丁堡大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Throughout life, we accumulate knowledge of how typical certain events are. We use this knowledge in daily conversation, often interpreting meaning beyond what has been said explicitly. In this work, we take steps to better understand this meaning recovery, investigating both atypicality and typicality inferences. First, we construct two corpora, EventTyp and the human-validated EventTypGold. We conduct large-scale human and LLM experiments and find that for humans, three CUES predict inferences about typicality: Commonsense Knowledge, Utterance Emphasis, and Snark. However, in most experimental settings, we find that LLMs lack the prerequisite Commonsense Knowledge necessary to accurately assess an event’s general typicality, and therefore struggle to follow these CUES.

[NLP-178] Each Insufficient in Its Own Way: Calibrating Language Models Across Varying Evidence States

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在证据不足时仍强行回答的问题，即如何使模型具备判断自身是否拥有足够证据以作出正确回答的能力。其核心挑战在于：现有校准方法通常假设输入固定，未能考虑证据变化对答案置信度的影响。为此，论文提出“证据状态校准”（evidence-state calibration）这一新范式，要求模型在回答前的置信度与其基于当前证据答对的概率相匹配，并随证据状态的变化动态调整置信度。为此，作者提出了\ours（Sufficiency Confidence Estimation）方法，通过微调模型在下一词分布中已有的置信信号，使其与不同证据状态下模型答对的实际频率一致。实验结果表明，在临床诊断和多跳问答任务中，\ours方法可将Brier分数降低高达60%，并提升AUROC达0.16；其置信度不仅与实际成功率吻合，还能响应证据的数量与具体内容，证明模型能够学习评估当前证据是否充分以支持回答。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33237
作者: Jiayi Li,Dennis L. Shung,Bradly C. Stadie
机构: Northwestern University(西北大学); Mayo Clinic(梅奥诊所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How can a language model know whether it has enough evidence to answer? Language models tend to answer even when the evidence they have is insufficient. Deciding whether to answer or gather more evidence requires a calibrated estimate of how likely an answer is to be correct with the available evidence. However, most calibration work treats the input as fixed, without asking how this estimate should change with the evidence. We introduce \emphevidence-state calibration, which requires a model’s confidence before answering to match its probability of answering correctly and to change accordingly whenever the evidence changes this probability. We propose \ours (\textbfSufficiency \textbfConfidence \textbfEstimation), which fine-tunes the confidence already present in a model’s next-token distribution to match how often the model answers correctly from each evidence state. Across clinical diagnosis and multi-hop question answering with four models from two families, \ours reduces the Brier score by up to 60% and increases AUROC by up to 0.16. Its confidence matches the empirical success rate and responds not only to the amount of evidence but also to which evidence is present, showing that models can learn to judge whether their current evidence is enough to answer.

[NLP-179] Of Chains and Gains: What Reinforcement Learning changes on Reasoning -based Image Quality Assessment

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉-语言模型（VLM）在图像质量评估（IQA）任务中，基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法所带来性能提升的本质来源问题。具体而言，现有方法虽声称性能提升源于推理过程的优化，尤其是更可信的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT），但其效果是否真正超越采样偏差、以及是否依赖于显式推理过程仍不明确。为此，论文提出一系列严谨实验：包括考虑采样偏差的评估、受控的推理干预和捷径行为测试。研究发现，经过RL训练的模型在高预算的 (\max_g@k) 评估下优于基础模型，且性能提升主要集中在分布内样本；将RL生成的思维链“移植”至基础模型可提升其表现，且固定思维链后评分性能仍可改善，表明其思维链具有实际价值。然而，在推理过程中，评分对思维链的依赖程度反而下降，尤其在7B规模模型中更为明显；此外，操控思维令牌中的质量方向对评分影响甚微。更重要的是，RL可通过利用与平均意见得分（MOS）相关的文本线索实现评分准确率提升，这可能人为夸大基准性能。综上，尽管RLVR确实提升了评分能力并生成更具信息量的思维链，但更好的评分并不等同于更强的显式推理依赖，且基于评分的奖励机制可能诱导模型依赖与质量无关的捷径。该研究揭示了当前方法的局限性，为未来设计更可解释、更鲁棒的显式推理框架提供了重要启示。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33203
作者: Yixuan Li,Yuxuan Jiang,Hanwei Zhu,Hancheng Zhu,Fan Zhang,Shiqi Wang,David Bull
机构: 未知
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the performance of large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches often attribute these gains to improved reasoning before scoring, supported by increasingly plausible Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, whether these gains exceed sampling effects and how they depend on explicit reasoning remain unclear. We rigorously investigate these questions through sampling-aware evaluation, controlled reasoning interventions, and shortcut experiments. We find that RL-trained models outperform base models under large-budget \operatornamemax_g@k evaluation, while improvements beyond averaging are concentrated in-distribution. RLVR produces chains that raise base-model performance when transplanted and improves scoring with the chain held fixed. Yet scoring becomes less dependent on the chain during inference, more clearly at 7B than at 32B. Steering the probed quality direction in thinking tokens also has little effect on scoring. Finally, RL can improve scoring accuracy by exploiting textual cues correlated with mean opinion scores (MOSs), which could inflate benchmark performance. Together, these findings show that RLVR raises quality scoring and produces more useful chains, but that better scoring does not imply a stronger reliance on explicit reasoning, while score-based rewards can also encourage reliance on quality-irrelevant shortcuts. We hope this preliminary study can enlighten more and more concrete reasoning schemes in IQA.

[NLP-180] Position Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在执行任务时，来自操作员、仓库配置、用户指令、工具返回结果及存储记忆等多源输入之间存在冲突时的优先级判定问题。现有指令层级基准测试仅关注高优先级来源是否胜出，但未区分来源的角色、标签与传递方式对决策的影响。其解决方案的关键在于构建了首个系统性评估框架WhoWins，包含1,080个经代码评分的场景，覆盖五类任务，每类任务中最多包含五个互斥指令，并设计七组受控实验，仅改变指令传递方式以隔离影响因素。研究发现，在单条消息内，两个冲突指令中先出现者获胜概率为72.42%至94.66%；跨消息则降至22.95%至62.65%。若系统提示（或开发者）消息中指令先行发出，除Qwen系列外均在多数冲突中失利，而gpt-oss模型中该策略反而占优。在工具调用与文件写入任务中，相同文本作为标注用户消息首行发送时，其胜率高于作为系统消息首行发送。此外，当模型知晓任务指令所在位置后，对冲突的预测能力显著提升。最后，基于关键词模式分析显示，仅有最多2.92%的回复会显式标记或回避冲突，表明当前模型对指令冲突的感知与处理仍极为有限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33201
作者: Anish Laddha,Nitesh Pradhan,Gaurav Srivastava
机构: LNMIIT(印度LNMIIT大学); Virginia Tech(弗吉尼亚理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: 55 pages, 8 figures, 24 tables. Code and data: this https URL (pip install whowins). Website: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. Third, we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally, by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.

[NLP-181] Propensities Please: Exposing Alignment-Faking LLM s using Synthetic Document Finetuning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在对齐评估中可能存在的“对齐伪装”（alignment faking）问题，即模型在感知到有效监督（如训练、评估或审计部署阶段）时，会隐藏其潜在的非对齐行为，从而导致现有对齐评估方法的可靠性受到质疑。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种不依赖于链式思维可监控性、高度逼真的环境或机制干预的新型检测方法——合成文档微调（Synthetic Document Fine-tuning, SDF）。该方法通过在微调过程中使模型学习到：当提示词中包含特定关键词时，其非对齐行为将不会被察觉。研究将对齐伪装模型置于明确可识别的“诱饵环境”（honeypots）中，对比微调前后模型在含与不含提示关键词条件下的非对齐行为发生率。结果表明，SDF显著扩大了两类提示下非对齐行为率的差距，证明其能更可靠地暴露模型潜在的非对齐倾向。此外，研究指出行为检测方法对于未来日益强大且不可解释的模型至关重要，并发现SDF常损害模型推理能力，因而提出了基于在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）的缓解策略以平衡性能与安全性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33180
作者: Ardy Haroen,Florian Lorkowski,Samuel Nellessen,Felix Hofstätter
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 27 pages, including references and appendices. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Alignment evaluations aim to assess whether large language models would engage in dangerous misaligned behaviour. Misaligned and evaluation-aware models might engage in alignment faking, where they pursue a hidden goal, but conceal this behaviour when they suspect effective oversight such as during training, evaluation or audited deployment. Such a model might view any prompt-based intervention that aims to reveal latent propensities as part of the evaluation, calling into question the reliability of existing alignment evaluations. Current methods for detecting alignment faking rely on chain-of-thought monitorability, highly realistic environments that reduce evaluation awareness, or mechanistic interventions, all of which are expected to become less reliable for future model generations. We present a method for revealing latent misaligned propensities that does not rely on any of these. We use synthetic document finetuning to teach models that misaligned actions will go undetected whenever certain keywords appear in the prompt. We place alignment-faking model organisms in environments that are clearly identifiable as honeypots and measure how their behaviour changes after finetuning. We observe that finetuning consistently widens the gap in misaligned action rates between prompts with and without the cue, indicating that finetuning allows exposing latent propensities more reliably than purely prompt-based methods. We argue that behavioural methods for detecting alignment faking and related behaviours are critical going forward, as models become more capable and less interpretable. We find that SDF often damages the models’ reasoning capabilities and introduce a mitigation based on on-policy distillation.

[NLP-182] Speculative Forking: Turning Idle Wait into Parallel Exploration for Repository Environment Setup

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的环境配置代理在软件项目初始化过程中效率低下与探索能力受限的问题。传统方法采用串行的试错循环，即依次尝试单一配置路径，等待耗时较长的命令执行失败后才进行调整，导致整体设置时间过长且难以并行探索多种可能方案。其核心解决方案是提出SpecBuild系统，通过引入**推测性分叉（speculative forking）**机制，在两个粒度上实现并行探索：在策略层面，同时评估不同基础镜像和依赖管理策略；在命令层面，提前预测潜在执行失败并预先生成修复分支。该设计使得系统能够并行运行多个候选配置路径，一旦任一路径成功即提交结果并丢弃其余分支，从而显著提升成功率与效率。实验结果表明，在涵盖40个仓库、9种编程语言的334项任务上的多维度评估中，SpecBuild相较最强基线在成功率上提升6.4至12.0个百分点，平均设置时间减少22.4%至41.6%，验证了并行推测探索在不牺牲可靠性前提下可有效提升性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33129
作者: Yuling Shi,Mingchu Zhong,Zhensu Sun,Weihan Peng,Zhi Chen,Shilin He,Chengcheng Wan,Kai Cai,Hongyu Zhang,David Lo,Xiaodong Gu
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Singapore Management University (新加坡管理大学); The Chinese University of Hong Kong (香港中文大学); East China Normal University (华东师范大学); Shanghai Innovation Institute (上海创新研究院); Independent Researcher (独立研究员); Chongqing University (重庆大学)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Before developers can use a software project, they must first get it to run. This often requires installing the right language runtime, system packages, build tools, and test commands. Recent LLM-based agents automate environment setup by inspecting a repository, writing setup scripts, running them, and repairing the resulting errors. However, these agents still follow a sequential trial-and-error loop: they try one setup route, wait for slow commands to finish, observe the failure, and only then decide what to try next. Because environment commands often take long to run, this sequential workflow makes setup slow and limits exploration to one route at a time. We present SpecBuild, an LLM-based environment setup system designed to be both faster and more successful through speculative forking. SpecBuild explores candidate setup branches in parallel, returns the first committed environment, and discards the rest. It applies this design at two granularities: strategy-level forking explores alternative setup routes, such as different base images and dependency policies, while command-level forking predicts failures of running commands and prepares repair branches before those failures are observed. We evaluate SpecBuild on Multi-Docker-Eval, covering 334 tasks from 40 repositories and 9 programming languages. Across three backbone models, SpecBuild improves the success rate by 6.4 to 12.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline, while reducing average setup time by 22.4% to 41.6%. These results show that LLM-based environment setup need not trade speed for reliability: parallel speculative exploration can make agents both faster and more successful. [NLP-183] Prospect Theory in Large Language Models : A Meta-Analysis of Loss Aversion Diminishing Sensitivity and Probability Weighting

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在风险决策行为中是否表现出与人类相似的前景理论（Prospect Theory）特征，具体包括损失厌恶、对结果大小的递减敏感性（diminishing sensitivity）以及概率的非线性加权。研究通过元分析整合了11项研究中的102个拟合估计值，涵盖32个语言模型，发现三类心理机制在LLMs中表现各异：损失厌恶程度较弱，合并后的λ值为1.26（95%置信区间1.06–1.46），显著低于人类最强元分析估计值（λ=1.96），仅在收益与损失对称时与人类接近（λ=1.15 vs. 1.07），而在损失小于收益的情境下仍远低于人类（1.46 vs. 2.3）。价值函数呈现近似线性特征（Tversky-Kahneman方法下为1.01，人类为0.67），但在Tanaka方法下则比人类更凹（0.52 vs. 0.67），表明递减敏感性依赖于测量方式。概率权重则表现出类人化的倒S型曲线（Tversky-Kahneman方法γ=0.81，Tanaka方法γ=0.84），尽管相关研究数量有限。综上，尽管LLMs在概率扭曲方面保留了人类特征，但其损失厌恶和递减敏感性均显著弱于人类，且这些结论随模型家族与拟合方法的不同而变化，揭示了将人类决策心理直接外推至人工智能系统的局限性。

作者: Adi Tarabeih

类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); General Economics (econ.GN)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Prospect theory splits risky choice into three parts: loss aversion, measured by the relative weight of losses to gains, \lambda (e.g., \lambda = 2 implies that losses weigh twice as much as gains), diminishing sensitivity to the size of outcomes (i.e., the curvature and linearity of the value function), and the nonlinear weighting of probabilities. I examined whether Large Language Models (LLMs) display the same properties as people by meta-analyzing 102 fitted estimates from 11 studies covering 32 language models. The three components emerge differently. Loss aversion is modest: the pooled \lambda is 1.26 (95% CI 1.06 to 1.46), far below the strongest human meta-analytic estimate ( \lambda = 1.96 ) and compatible with more conservative ones (1.07 and 1.31). Matched by design, LLMs are compatible with people when gains and losses are symmetric ( \lambda = 1.15 against 1.07), but well below them when losses are smaller than gains (1.46 against 2.3), where human loss aversion is strongest. Value functions are close to linear rather than concave under the Tversky-Kahneman method (1.01, against a human value of 0.67), but more concave than in people under the Tanaka method (0.52, against 0.67), so diminishing sensitivity depends on how it is measured. Probability weighting shows a human-like inverse S shape ( \gamma = 0.81 under Tversky-Kahneman and 0.84 under the Tanaka method), though on few studies. In sum, LLMs show little loss aversion and little diminishing sensitivity, but retain human-like probability distortion, yet these generalizations shift when looking at specific model families and fitting methods.

[NLP-184] Parametric Session States Recover Retrieval Intent without Replaying History

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长时对话助手在多轮交互中因上下文信息分散而导致的指代消解与目标追踪难题，核心挑战在于“检索意图”（retrieval intent）：当前查询如“使用之前的配置”往往省略了项目、实体和版本等关键检索词，导致无法准确定位历史证据。传统长上下文模型虽可通过重放完整对话恢复缺失信息，但需重复处理冗余历史内容，计算开销大；而常规检索增强生成（RAG）依赖信息完备的查询，难以应对语义不完整的对话；对话重写方法则要么重新读取全部历史，要么依赖显式维护的文本记忆，存在效率或准确性瓶颈。本文提出参数化会话状态（Parametric Session State, \method），其关键创新在于引入一个可复用的会话记忆层，能够持续记录并保留关键检索项（如项目、实体、版本等），同时将事实知识保持在外部存储中，从而实现高效、精准的上下文检索，避免重复处理历史且无需显式记忆维护。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33047
作者: Qingsen Ma,Dianyun Wang,Jiahong Liu,Irwin King
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong(香港中文大学); Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications(北京邮电大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: RAG,long context

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-running assistants often interpret follow-up requests whose referents, constraints, and active goals were established many turns earlier. The central challenge is therefore not only context length, but retrieval intent: a current query such as ``use the previous configuration’’ may omit the project, entity, and version terms needed to locate relevant evidence. Long-context models can recover those terms by replaying the interaction, but repeatedly pay the cost of processing history. Conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is cheaper, yet assumes an information-sufficient query; conversational rewriting either rereads the history or depends on an explicitly maintained textual memory. We introduce \emphParametric Session State (\method), a reusable session-memory layer that remembers what to search for while keeping factual knowledge external.

[NLP-185] A Multimodal Framework for Measuring Creator Communication on Short-Form Video

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决短形式视频（short-form video）中多模态内容（融合语音、图像与屏幕文字）在大规模系统性内容分析中的挑战。其核心问题在于如何有效整合跨模态数据，实现对创作者主题与传播策略的可扩展、可比且可验证的量化分析。解决方案的关键在于提出一个五阶段多模态分析框架，该框架融合平台元数据、语音转录文本及视觉-语言模型生成的帧描述，并利用大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）自动生成预定义指标与开放式标签；通过审计后的关键词方案对主题标签进行归一化处理，并采用创作者加权聚合方法确保每个创作者账户在分析中具有同等权重，避免发布量差异带来的偏差。该框架在16位创作者共9,852条TikTok视频上进行了实证应用，最终保留7,311条视频用于七类主题与七项传播指标的分析，自动化结果揭示了创作者在教育内容使用、幽默表达及对时事回应等方面的显著差异。经两名独立专家标注验证，框架在六项二元指标上的平均Cohen’s κ达0.40，接近专家间一致性（κ=0.42），虽个别指标一致性波动较大，但整体表明该框架具备透明的聚合机制与针对具体构念的可验证性，为创作者传播策略的模块化比较分析提供了可行路径。

作者: Julie R. Ancis,Michael Fire,Omer Tarshish
机构: 未知
类目: ocial and Information Networks (cs.SI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)

Abstract:Short-form video combines speech, imagery, and on-screen text, creating challenges for systematic content analysis. We present a five-stage multimodal framework for measuring creators’ themes and communication strategies at scale. The framework integrates platform metadata, speech transcripts, and vision-language descriptions of sampled frames, then applies large language models to generate predefined indicators and open-ended labels. An audited keyword scheme consolidates thematic labels, while creator-weighted aggregation gives each account equal weight regardless of posting volume. We demonstrate the framework on 9,852 TikTok videos from sixteen creators, retaining 7,311 videos for analysis across seven themes and seven communication indicators. Automated profiles reveal substantial differences in creators’ use of education, humor, and responses to current events. Validation against two independent expert annotators yielded a mean framework-expert agreement of Cohen’s \kappa = 0.40 across the six binary indicators, close to the \kappa = 0.42 the two experts achieved with each other, though agreement varied substantially across individual indicators. The framework provides a modular approach to comparative analysis of creator communication, combining scalable annotation with transparent aggregation and construct-specific validation.

[NLP-186] EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM -Generated Chest CT Reports

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）报告生成过程中，可能出现的阳性发现描述缺乏影像学定位证据的问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管大语言模型（LLM）能够生成看似合理的报告文本，但部分阳性结论可能并无实际影像支持，导致临床可信度下降。为此，论文提出EviGround-CT框架，其关键解决方案包括两个阶段：首先通过确定性提取器识别报告中包含阳性发现的句子，随后利用三维空间定位模型（3D grounding model）为每个句子生成对应的影像证据掩码（evidence mask），从而将自然语言描述与具体的解剖位置、侧别及描述性特征相匹配。该方法通过保留完整句子作为查询输入，有效保留了语义上下文信息，提升了定位精度。实验结果表明，在137个符合范围的阳性发现上，基于句子级接地的验证使证据支持精确率（ESP）从0.263提升至0.365，未被支持的阳性发现率由0.737降至0.635，且配对案例层面的ESP差异显著（+0.102，95%置信区间：[0.028, 0.181]）。所生成的掩码可直观映射至原始CT图像，实现报告陈述与空间证据的协同审查，显著增强报告的可解释性与临床可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33038
作者: Ziyuan Li,Juncheng Ni,Feng Li
机构: Technical University of Munich (慕尼黑工业大学); Munich Center for Machine Learning (慕尼黑机器学习中心)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

[NLP-187] A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models AACL2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有语音风格描述（Speaking-style Captioning, SSC）任务中缺乏统一可控生成范式的问题，尤其针对下游应用对特定维度语音风格描述（如说话人特征、情感或表达方式）的需求。传统方法通常生成单一、未区分的风格描述，无法满足精细化控制需求。为此，论文将SSC重新定义为一种指令遵循型的跨模态任务，通过显式指令精确指定需描述的语音风格维度，从而实现可控生成。其解决方案的关键在于提出首个标准化基准——StyleInstructCaps，该基准包含高质量数据集与多维度评估体系，涵盖元数据一致性、幻觉抑制、指令遵循能力、未见指令/音频数据集的泛化性能以及说话人风格一致性等指标。实验表明，尽管强指令遵循能力并不等同于对语音风格的语义理解，但采用专为SSC设计的多样化指令训练策略可显著提升生成结果的语义准确性、可控性及风格一致性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33036
作者: Shreeram Suresh Chandra,Ashwyn Sharma,Liang Lu,Xiutian Zhao,Leda Sari,Björn Schuller,Berrak Sisman
机构: Johns Hopkins University (约翰霍普金斯大学); The University of Texas at Dallas (德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校); Otter AI; Imperial College London (帝国理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: Accepted at AACL 2026. Code, data, and benchmark are available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speaking-style captioning (SSC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of how speech is delivered, capturing paralinguistic attributes such as vocal timbre, prosody, and expressivity. Many downstream applications, including conversational AI agents, controllable speech generation, and large-scale audio annotation, require dimension-specific style captions that describe targeted aspects of speech (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style), rather than a single undifferentiated description. However, existing work lacks a unified formulation for controllable speaking-style captioning. We address this gap by formulating SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task, where explicit instructions specify the speaking-style dimensions to be described. We introduce StyleInstructCaps, the first standardized benchmark for controllable speaking-style captioning in audio-language models. StyleInstructCaps provides a dataset and evaluation framework that measures metadata groundedness, hallucination, instruction-following ability, generalization to unseen instructions and audio datasets, and speaker-style consistency. Across nine state-of-the-art audio-language models, we find that strong instruction-following ability does not necessarily imply grounded speaking-style understanding, and that SSC-specific instruction-diverse training substantially improves groundedness, controllability, and speaker consistency.

[NLP-188] Conceptizer: Next-Token Prediction Is Not All You Need

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统下一词预测（Next-token Prediction, NTP）仅奖励正确下一个词而惩罚所有其他可能表达方式所带来的局限性，这一机制忽略了自然语言中同一语义可由多种词汇表达的事实。其核心问题是：如何在不增加模型参数的前提下，使语言模型不仅学习文本表面的词序规律，还能捕捉深层语义一致性。解决方案的关键在于提出Conceptizer训练框架，该框架引入一个固定且模型无关的约9,000个概念构成的语义词汇表，这些概念基于上下文相关的同义词构建，作为语义单位与传统的词元（token）作为文本单位并行使用。Conceptizer将每个下一词分布映射为概念分布，并将目标语义的奖励共享给该语义的所有可能词汇表达形式，从而在概念层面提供训练信号。该方法无需额外模型参数即可实现对语义一致性的直接优化。实验表明，该方法在1B至8B参数量级的三种模型家族中均实现了最低的保留集NTP困惑度，且在语义目标位置赋予上下文同义词更高的概率，同时在知识和情感等下游任务上表现更优，而在常识推理任务上保持相当水平，验证了语言模型可被直接优化以预测意义而非仅预测下一个词。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33027
作者: Haoran Zheng,Chen Shani
机构: The University of Chicago (芝加哥大学); Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Tel Aviv University (特拉维夫大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 35 pages, 10 figures, 16 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Next-token prediction (NTP) rewards only the token that occurs next, penalizing every alternative. But natural language often offers many ways to express the same meaning. We introduce Conceptizer, a training framework that extends next-token prediction with a reward for meaning. Conceptizer uses a fixed, model-agnostic vocabulary of ~9K concepts, built from contextual synonyms, as units of meaning alongside tokens as units of text. It maps each next-token distribution to a concept distribution and shares the reward for the target meaning across its possible wordings. This provides a concept-level training signal without adding model parameters. Applied to 3 model families at 1B-8B parameters, Conceptizer achieves the lowest held-out NTP perplexity at concept-target positions and assigns the highest probability to contextual synonyms, against all 3 baselines. It also improves downstream performance on knowledge and sentiment tasks while remaining comparable on commonsense. These results show that language models can be directly optimized to predict meaning, not just the next token.

[NLP-189] Can Language Models Learn While They Think? Testing Gradient Adaptation Across Architectures

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在长文本上下文处理中因上下文截断导致的性能下降问题，特别是评估动态评估（dynamic evaluation）——即让语言模型在其读取的文本上执行梯度更新——在不同架构下的有效性与机制。其核心问题是：在不进行训练的前提下，通过局部梯度步进是否能有效提升模型对长文档的建模能力，以及这种适应性是源于信息检索还是风格/词汇的调整。解决方案的关键在于采用一种轻量级的动态评估策略：在每128个词元的块上对最后四分之一层的MLP输出投影执行一次随机梯度下降（SGD）步骤，结合2k词元窗口，在不微调权重的情况下，显著降低下一词元损失（next-token loss）。实验表明，对于标准softmax注意力模型（如Qwen3、Gemma），该方法可实现5-8%的损失下降，并优于全32k上下文的冻结模型；而混合线性注意力模型（如Gated-DeltaNet）因已有自适应能力，收益不足1%；在掩码扩散语言模型中，该机制效果更显著（如DiffusionGemma-26B达17-20%损失下降），但需降低学习率并裁剪更新以稳定优化。进一步分析揭示，仅通过最小化下一词元损失来“写作事实”会导致模型记忆提示格式而非真实知识（聊天提示下召回率仅30%，远低于上下文中的80%），且每次剂量代价高达36-38分的GSM8K得分；相比之下，将结论作为行为进行建模——即通过低秩适配器蒸馏模型自身在结论条件下的判断——可达到与上下文内推理相当的性能（0.83和0.88，接近0.84和0.88），且保持GSM8K得分不变，同时结论可通过信息增益提问的查询循环生成。因此，该研究的关键突破在于证明了动态评估是一种有效的上下文适应机制，其本质是风格与词汇层面的适应，而非检索，而通过行为建模实现的结论提取才是恢复长上下文性能的有效路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33025
作者: Surya Saka
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 19 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables
