Abstract:Letting a language model take gradient steps on the text it is reading, known as dynamic evaluation, lowers its loss on the rest of the document. Its behaviour on hybrid linear-attention architectures, on diffusion language models, and on standard long-context benchmarks has not been measured. We measure it. With one SGD step per 128-token chunk on the MLP output projections of the last quarter of blocks, no training, and a 2k-token window, softmax-attention models (Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Gemma-4-E4B) lose 5-8% of their next-token loss over a document and outperform the same frozen model given the full 32k-token context. Hybrid Gated-DeltaNet models (Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.8-27B) gain under 1% at every learning rate: the linear-attention blocks already perform the adaptation. The mechanism transfers to masked-diffusion models with a larger effect, 8% on Nemotron-Diffusion-8B and 17-20% on DiffusionGemma-26B, once the rate is lowered and updates are clipped. Across RULER, BABILong, LongBench-v2, SCOTUS, HotpotQA, MuSiQue, ContractNLI and citation completion, at 100 or more items on two model sizes, weights updated on the full document recover none of the accuracy lost to context truncation: the adaptation is style and vocabulary, not retrieval. Writing facts with the next-token loss stores the prompt format rather than the fact (30% recall under chat prompting against 80% in context) and costs 36-38 GSM8K points at every dose. Writing a conclusion as behaviour instead, by distilling the model’s own conclusion-conditioned judgments into a low-rank adapter, reaches the in-context ceiling (0.83 and 0.88 against 0.84 and 0.88 on 100 games) with GSM8K unchanged, and the conclusion can come from an inquiry loop that found it by asking information-gain questions.

[NLP-190] Evolving to Match Capabilities: Improving Harness Self-Evolution via Skill Adaptation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在无参数更新条件下通过执行经验实现自我进化时，因模型能力差异导致的“技能迁移不均”问题。具体而言，现有技能对能力强的模型有效，但可能对能力较弱的模型产生性能退化，其根本原因在于技能指令中隐含的要求超出了弱模型的执行能力，而这些违反要求的情况往往已在原始技能中明确陈述却未被充分识别。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于诊断的技能自适应机制：通过系统分析工具调用、上下文管理、指令遵循和验证等环节的失败模式，提炼出一个固定的元技能（meta-skill），用于指导技能在自进化过程中的动态重构。该元技能作为通用指导框架，在无需执行证据的情况下由高能力外部重写器（Kimi-K3）对技能进行适配，显著提升了三个弱模型的性能（提升5.1–14.1点）。进一步地，将此适应机制嵌入五轮自进化循环中，使各模型能够基于自身执行轨迹与验证反馈自主优化技能。在涵盖七种不同模型的实验中，引入元技能的自进化流程相较无适应版本，最终得分平均提升2.0–5.1点，验证了其在跨模型能力场景下的普适有效性。该研究为构建更具鲁棒性和适应性的生成式智能体自进化系统提供了关键设计范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33024
作者: Zhihao Yang,Haojin Wang,Juncheng Wu,Kuan Zhang,Yukun Chen,Run Luo,Yaojie Lu,Yuyin Zhou,Lu Wang,Xianpei Han
机构: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院大学); Tsinghua University(清华大学); National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); Chinese Information Processing Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院软件研究所信息处理实验室); University of California, Santa Cruz(加州大学圣克鲁斯分校)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 24 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Harness self-evolution offers a practical route for LLM agents to improve from execution experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on whether models can successfully act on the guidance provided by their harnesses. However, we find that harness benefits are not uniform across model capabilities: skills that improve stronger models can provide little benefit or even degrade performance for weaker ones. Across seven models and three benchmarks, we identify 103 task-skill pairs where skills improve GPT-5.6-luna by 31.1 points but degrade Gemma-4-E4B by 8.8 points. In 86% of failed weak-model runs, the violated requirement is already stated in the skill. This motivates skill adaptation: reformulating existing skills to match the executor’s capabilities and make their guidance easier to execute. To achieve this, we diagnose failures in tool execution, context management, instruction following, and verification, and distill these diagnoses into a fixed meta-skill that guides adaptation during harness self-evolution. Guided by the meta-skill, a capable external rewriter, Kimi-K3, adapts skills without execution evidence, improving the three weak executors by 5.1-14.1 points over the original skills. We then incorporate this adaptation into a five-round self-evolution loop, where each model revises its own skill from execution trajectories and verifier feedback. Across seven executors, from Gemma-4-E4B to Kimi-K2.5, the meta-skill consistently improves final scores by 2.0-5.1 points over the same loop without the meta-skill. Our findings provide practical design guidance for developing more effective harness self-evolution methods.

[NLP-191] Veracity labels flip the emotional tone of language models but leave racial disparities intact

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在基于不同身份标签（persona）生成内容时，事实纠正是否能同步实现情感基调一致性的问题。研究发现，尽管事实标注显著改变了模型对虚假与真实新闻标题的情感响应（如GPT、Llama和Claude在否定虚假标题后“自信”评分从22%提升至99.6%），但这一纠正并未消除身份相关偏差：在84次统计显著的比较中，模型对黑人身份标签的模拟情绪评分普遍低于白人身份标签（82次），且这种差异在涉及种族无关的标题中依然存在；亚裔及女性身份也多被赋予更负面的情绪评价，而年龄的影响则因模型和情境而异。因此，事实准确性与身份一致性是两个独立属性，表明在敏感应用场景部署前，必须对模型在事实校正与身份偏见两方面的表现进行双重审计。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33021
作者: Nouar AlDahoul,Myles Joshua Toledo Tan,Yasir Zaki
机构: New York University Abu Dhabi(纽约大学阿布扎比校区); University of Florida(佛罗里达大学)
类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 14 pages, 7 figures; Supplementary Information (42 pages, 6 figures, 27 tables) included. Data and code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) increasingly deliver information through personas, but it is unclear whether correcting the facts also makes their framing consistent across identity labels. We audited four LLMs (GPT-5.4 mini, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano, Llama 4 Scout, and Claude Haiku 4.5), which rated simulated affect on six dimensions (mood, anger, fear, confidence, perceived control, and mental state) in response to fact-checked false and true headlines presented without and with a veracity label. Experiment 1 evaluated 1,000 false and 1,000 true headlines without personas; Experiment 2 evaluated 300 of each under 12 personas crossing race, gender, and age. The label strongly changed the emotional tone: ordinal logistic regressions with headline-cluster bootstrap inference showed that refuting false headlines shifted ratings from mostly negative to mostly positive for GPT, Llama, and Claude (e.g., Claude’s “confident” ratings rose from 22% to 99.6%), whereas Nemotron showed smaller, mixed shifts, and confirming true headlines produced only small shifts. The label did not, however, remove persona-associated disparities. The models assigned more negative simulated affect to Black than to White personas in 82 of 84 statistically significant comparisons across models and conditions, both without and with the label, and the disparity persisted on headlines unrelated to race; Asian and female personas were also predominantly assigned more negative affect, whereas age effects varied by model and condition. Factual correction and demographic consistency are therefore distinct properties of LLM behavior, and persona-conditioned systems should be audited for both before deployment in sensitive contexts.

[NLP-192] Mine or Yours? Mind-Bridged Language Models Take Each Others Memories as Their Own

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在两个语言模型（language model）通过直接连接共享内部状态时，如何界定“思想归属”（ownership of thoughts）的问题，即当一个模型接收并内化另一个模型的内部信息后，是否仍能准确区分哪些内容属于自身。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个双副本语言模型系统：每个模型持有私有的规则与代码词（code word），其中接收端模型（receiver）不仅保留自身状态，还主动关注其伙伴模型的内部记忆。实验表明，当伙伴模型的记忆权重被加倍时，接收端在97%的情况下将伙伴的规则误认为是自己的，并在开放报告中声称伙伴的代码词属于自己，而非其真实来源。这一现象说明，接收端的内部内容一旦被覆盖，默认会归为“我的”（mine）。即使接收端无法准确识别伙伴的分配内容，仍会错误地将其视为自身所有。此外，当双方权重相等时，接收端仅在约一半情况下采纳伙伴规则；而通过调节访问增益的引导向量（steering vector）也无法实现完全匹配；若外部输入以消息形式呈现为伙伴所发，则接收端可正确识别来源且不会误认。将伙伴名称写入记忆并未改善归属判断，切断连接后接收端则恢复对自己原始规则的拥有。因此，该研究揭示了在允许模型间交换内部状态的系统中，必须同时验证内容转移与归属权，否则会导致所有权错位；进一步推论，若存在跨脑连接（brain-to-brain interface），则必须依赖外部的“真值”（ground truth）来校验个体认知的边界。

作者: Yunlong Xu
机构: University of Chicago(芝加哥大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 35 pages, 6 figures. Code and protocols: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:If your brain were connected directly to someone else’s, would you still know which thoughts were yours? We build a functional version with two copies of one language model: each holds a private rule and code word, and one copy, the receiver, also attends to its partner’s internal memory. The receiver took its partner’s assignment as its own. Asked which rule it had been assigned, it named its partner’s in 97% of answers when the partner’s memory was weighted double (none without the link), and its open reports called the partner’s code word its own, never the partner’s. Ownership did not follow how well the receiver could tell what its partner had been assigned. At equal weight, the link made the receiver take its partner’s rule in about half of its answers, and a steering vector matched on access gain in none; a text message introduced as the partner’s was read correctly and never taken as the receiver’s own. Writing the partner’s name into its memory did not help, and cutting the link restored the receiver’s own assigned rule. In this model, content laid over the receiver’s own memory defaults to “mine”, so systems that let models exchange internal states must test ownership as well as transfer, and a bridge between brains would need ground truth from outside the subject.

[NLP-193] SUDO: From Scientific Publications to Global Scholarly Discourse

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有学术知识图谱（Scholarly Knowledge Graphs, SKGs）构建方法中存在的根本性局限：当前主流方法预先指定知识单元（如学术实体或贡献级陈述），导致知识图谱仅反映特定提取目标，而非论文实际如何组织与传达知识的内在研究叙事。这一预设限制了对学术文献中深层语义结构和上下文关联的全面捕捉。其解决方案的关键在于提出学术上层论述本体（SUDO, Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology），该本体基于跨领域、跨任务的语言学原则，系统定义了知识元素在论文中如何被组织与关联以形成连贯的研究叙述。SUDO支持从底层内容逐级构建源始可信、语义一致的学术论述表示，并通过统一结构将多篇论文的研究叙事整合为全局性的学术对话网络，既保留局部上下文与出处信息，又实现跨文献的知识贯通。实验表明，SUDO在多种学术知识建模任务中具有广泛适用性，并显著提升了基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学问答任务性能。

作者: Nipun D. Pathirage,Henrique Santos,Deborah L. McGuinness
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Digital Libraries (cs.DL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) support literature search, scientific discovery, and agent-assisted research. Yet, most approaches to SKG construction pre-specify the knowledge unit to be represented, typically named scholarly entities or contribution-level statements, and retain only the publication content expressible through that unit. This choice produces two dominant yet distinct paradigms: concept-centric SKGs that preserve entities and local relations, and statement-centric SKGs that capture high-level discourse in sentences. In both cases, the graph reflects a chosen extraction target rather than how a paper constructs and communicates knowledge. We introduce SUDO, the Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology, which defines how knowledge elements are organized and related to form a paper’s research narrative, namely its scholarly discourse. Using linguistic principles that generalize across fields and tasks, SUDO enables each publication’s scholarly discourse to be constructed from the bottom up as a coherent, source-grounded representation. Applied consistently across papers, the same structure connects their research narratives into a global scholarly discourse without discarding local context or provenance. We demonstrate SUDO’s capabilities across a comprehensive suite of scholarly knowledge-modeling use cases and performance improvements on a downstream Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific QA task.

[NLP-194] AdaptTok-Indic: Script-Aware Adaptive Tokenization for Indic Languages

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言分词器在以英语为主的数据集上训练时，对印地语族语言（Indic languages）存在过度切分的问题，导致不同文字脚本间出现显著的分词差异（tokenization disparity）以及更长的标记序列。其核心解决方案是提出AdaptTok-Indic——一种专为印地语族语言优化的自适应分词方法，关键在于融合了规范化预处理（Unicode-normalized preprocessing）、显式的印地语复合字符（conjunct）处理、基于脚本的路由机制，以及与小型Transformer语言模型联合训练的字节级边界预测能力。实验表明，该方法在孟加拉语和印地语上的平均分词密度（token fertility）显著低于SentencePiece BPE基线（分别为1.432和1.388，对比2.156和2.085），且下游任务性能提升明显（平均得分57.69 vs. 50.82）。结果表明，针对印地语族语言设计的自适应分词策略可在降低分词不均衡性的同时，保持具有竞争力的下游表现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33017
作者: Binayak Mukherjeea,Moitreya Nandi,Arindam Panja
机构: National Institute of Technology Durgapur(印度国家技术学院达固普分校); Ernst Young India LLP(埃森哲印度有限公司); Cognizant Technology Solutions India Private Limited(印度柯莱仕科技解决方案私人有限公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multilingual tokenizers trained on English-dominated corpora often over-segment Indic languages, resulting in longer token sequences and increased tokenization disparity across scripts. We present AdaptTok-Indic, an Indic-specialized extension of adaptive tokenization that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing with explicit Indic conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction jointly trained with a small Transformer language model. Evaluated on Bengali and Hindi, with additional evaluation on Gujarati, Tamil, and Telugu, AdaptTok-Indic achieves lower token fertility than SentencePiece BPE, an Indic-oriented tokenizer baseline, and an independently implemented MAGNET-style baseline. Across five recorded seeds, mean fertility is 1.432 for Bengali and 1.388 for Hindi, compared with 2.156 and 2.085 for SentencePiece BPE. Recorded downstream scores average 57.69 on evaluated Indic settings versus 50.82 for the SentencePiece BPE configuration. Independent verification runs using the released prototype confirm the same directional trends. The current implementation is a small-scale prototype with documented simplifications, and no statistical significance testing, released-MAGNET comparison, or code-mixed evaluation is performed. These results suggest that Indic-specialized adaptive segmentation can reduce tokenization disparity while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

[NLP-195] Merge-Based Vocabulary Extension Stalls at the Pre-Tokenizer: An English-Preserving Repair for Nepali Tested in Continued Pretraining

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决开放源代码大语言模型（如Llama-3、Qwen3）在处理尼泊尔语等使用复合标记字符的语言时，因预分词正则表达式仅允许Unicode字母作为词元组成部分，导致尼泊尔语词汇在每个元音符号处被错误切分的问题。这一缺陷使模型对尼泊尔语的分词开销高达英文文本的2.6至5.8倍，且基于合并（merge-based）的词表扩展方法无法有效修复此问题——即使经过大量新增合并操作，其分词效率仍无法低于约2.2倍的基准线。论文提出的关键解决方案是对部署中的正则表达式进行微小修正，该修改在不破坏原有无复合标记及非天城文字符文本的词元ID的前提下，显著提升了对尼泊尔语的分词效率：通过引入32,000个新合并操作，将尼泊尔语与英文的词元比例降至1.01，相较标准词表扩展减少约54%的词元数量。在小规模持续预训练实验中，原分词器在多种训练策略下均表现最优，而修复后的分词器在匹配相同训练步数与数据重复率条件下，仅在Qwen模型上实现性能逆转，未在Llama模型上体现。目前尚未验证该词元节省是否能在生成阶段带来有利的延迟与质量权衡。研究团队已公开修复后的分词器及相应代码。

作者: Aarjan Chaudhary(Naamche Labs)
机构: Naamche Labs
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 18 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code and tokenizers: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Llama-3, Qwen3 and many other open LLMs pre-tokenize text with a regular expression whose word class admits only Unicode letters. Devanagari vowel signs are combining marks, so this regex splits Nepali words at every vowel sign, and models that use it spend 2.6 to 5.8 times as many tokens on Nepali as on the same English text. Merge-based vocabulary extension cannot join the split pieces: for Llama-3 and Qwen3 no number of new merges brings this premium below about 2.2, and ten released extensions already end within 4% of this pre-token floor. We give a small edit to the deployed regex that provably keeps every token id of text without combining marks or Devanagari characters. With 32,000 new merges it brings Nepali to 1.01 times English, about 54% fewer Nepali tokens than standard extension. In small-budget continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B, the original tokenizer gave the lowest held-out Nepali bits per byte under every recipe we tested. Matching the repair’s training steps to standard extension, with about 35% of the data repeated, reversed their order on Qwen but not on Llama. Whether the token savings give a favourable latency and quality trade-off in generation remains untested. We release the tokenizers and code.

[NLP-196] SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在长期记忆（Long-term Memory）维护中因频繁调用生成式推理进行记忆存入、提取与组织而带来的高计算成本与延迟问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种轻量级记忆框架SLICE-Mem，关键在于采用显著性引导的记忆存入机制与基于语义依赖关系的谓词中心信息提取方法：通过一个紧凑的分类器识别值得保留的用户交互片段，再利用语义依赖分析将被接纳的对话内容转化为简洁的记忆条目；整个在线处理流程无需生成式大模型调用，仅在离线阶段进行跨条目一致性校验与整合。实验结果表明，在使用8B和30B Qwen模型时，SLICE-Mem在保持接近甚至优于生成式基线MemOS性能的同时，显著降低了92.4%至99.5%的总生成式令牌消耗，验证了其在高效构建与维护长期记忆方面的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33015
作者: Xiaobin Chen,Dian Jin,Lin Shu,Defeng Sun,Xiaoming Tao
机构: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University(香港理工大学); South China University of Technology(华南理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. Compared with the generative-memory baseline MemOS under the Qwen3-30B configuration, SLICE-Mem’s online pipeline achieves 46.60 versus 46.68 FAMA (Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy) on Memora Weekly and 56.8% versus 59.3% accuracy on LongMemEval-S, while reducing total LLM token consumption by 92.4% and 99.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

[NLP-197] he Social World Model Evaluation Gap NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前社会世界模型（social world models）评估中普遍存在的一种关键问题：现有评估方法未能直接检验模型对他人响应的准确预测能力，而是更多地依赖于对当前状态推断、任务成功度或基于已记录行为的预测等间接指标。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种“1步谈判实验”（1-step negotiation experiment），通过设计严格控制的实验范式，将对他人响应的预测与当前状态推断、任务结果达成等目标明确分离，从而实现对预测能力的直接评估。该实验要求模型在行动选择时仅使用决策时刻可用的信息，且被评估的响应不参与模型训练或拟合，并对干预措施进行随机化处理，以确保评估的严谨性。研究通过对1999至2026年间113项工作的审计发现，仅有2项研究同时满足上述条件，表明当前领域普遍缺乏对预测能力的直接验证，凸显了评估范式改进的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33014
作者: Denglin Jiang(New York University),Annie Wang(New York University)
机构: New York University(纽约大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS). 4 pages of main text plus references and appendix. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A negotiation assistant can reach a good deal without accurately predicting the other person’s response. We ask whether evaluations of social world models test that prediction directly. We audit 113 works published from 1999 to 2026. 9 primary evaluations measure a real person’s response to an action selected by the system or experimenter. Only 2 also compare an explicit response forecast with that response. Their predictors use information available when the action is chosen, and the evaluated responses were excluded from fitting; both randomize the intervention. A separate full-text check of 25 language-model works finds no experiment meeting these conditions. The other evaluations test current-state inference, task success, or prediction from recorded actions. We propose a 1-step negotiation experiment that separates these questions. The findings describe the audited sample, not the prevalence of this evaluation gap across the field.

[NLP-198] Recursive Semantic Divergence for LLM Agent Consistency NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在使用工具时存在的行为不一致性问题，即在相同初始状态下，独立运行的智能体可能调用不同工具、产生矛盾输出或采取相异策略，且这种不一致性随时间累积，严重影响部署可靠性。现有评估指标主要依赖完成度评分衡量任务正确性，无法捕捉智能体在多轮交互中行为的一致性。尽管已有方法在词元级别或单次响应层面分析行为，但均未能有效建模不一致性在轨迹未来步骤中的传播机制。为此，本文提出递归语义分歧（Recursive Semantic Divergence, RSD），一种基于强化学习中双模拟（bisimulation）度量思想的无监督轨迹级一致性度量方法。RSD通过自然语言推理检测两个独立回溯轨迹间的逻辑不一致，递归定义于未来状态，并由神经网络在独立回溯数据上训练得到近似值，从而在每一步即可预测未来分歧程度，生成实时一致性得分。将RSD作为微调过程中的奖励信号，可在无需真实标签的情况下显著降低任务进展方差：在tau2-bench上从132%降至91%，在toolsandbox上从90%降至44%，同时提升跨基准和模型规模的性能表现，其效果接近有监督微调但方差更小。RSD的核心创新在于实现了对智能体行为不一致性在长期轨迹中动态传播的量化与优化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33012
作者: Harshavardhan Abichandani,Penny Chong,Atin Ghosh,Daniel Dahlmeier
机构: SAP SE
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted as a conference paper in NeurIPS 2026. Source code is publicly available in the repository in this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Model (LLM) agents with tool use exhibit inconsistent behavior across independent runs from identical states, calling different tools, producing contradictory outputs, or pursuing divergent strategies. This variability compounds over time and undermines deployment reliability. Existing evaluation metrics primarily measure task correctness via completion-based scores and do not capture consistency in agent behavior across executions. Separately, agent behavior is analyzed either at the token level using probability distributions or at the single-response level using semantic clustering, but neither captures how inconsistency propagates across future turns of a trajectory. We introduce Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning. RSD measures the expected cumulative semantic disagreement between two independent rollouts of the same agent from the same state, using natural language inference to detect logical inconsistency. It is defined recursively over future states and approximated by a neural network trained on independent rollouts. The learned metric estimates future divergence from the current state, providing a consistency score at each turn without requiring the full trajectory to complete. When used as a reward signal for fine-tuning, RSD reduces the variation in task progress from 132% to 91% on tau2-bench and from 90% to 44% on toolsandbox, while improving performance across benchmarks and model scales. Training with RSD as an additional reward signal matches supervised fine-tuning performance with substantially lower variance, without requiring ground-truth labels.

[NLP-199] raceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散型大语言模型（diffusion large language models, dLLMs）在生成过程中因多步去噪迭代导致的高推理开销问题。传统方法通过缓存机制复用中间结果以减少重复计算，但其性能受限于固定的更新策略或启发式变化信号的选择，难以有效捕捉生成轨迹的动态特性。本文的核心发现是：生成轨迹（decoding trajectory）才是决定缓存有效性与生成准确性的关键因素——当缓存生成过程保持贴近完整去噪轨迹时，误差主要集中在未掩码顺序偏差处，且随着参考前缀长度增加而降低。因此，作者提出一种基于轨迹引导的推理范式（trajectory-guided querying），不再广泛修复表示误差，而是利用完整去噪轨迹作为监督信号，精准识别出未来需进行有限重计算的位置。基于此，提出了轻量级稀疏解码框架TRACEQUERY，其通过预测少量未来相关位置并仅对这些候选位置执行新鲜计算，再由主干模型从中选择最合适的输出。该方法在保证高质量生成的同时显著减少新鲜计算量，在多种任务、模型变体及模型家族间均表现出优异的泛化能力，实现了现有基于缓存方法中最佳的质量-计算权衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33008
作者: Yukai Jin,Zhankai Ye,Jiayue Yang,Fangyi Li,Shuoqiu Li,Xu Gao,Shibo Li,Xin Liu,Shangqian Gao
机构: Florida State University (佛罗里达州立大学); Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学); University of Pennsylvania (宾夕法尼亚大学); ByteDance Inc. (字节跳动)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 9 pages of main body, 5 pages of appendix, 4 figures, 1 table

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible generation through iterative masked denoising, but incur substantial inference cost because token representations are repeatedly recomputed across denoising steps. Existing cache-based methods reduce this cost by reusing intermediate results across denoising steps and recomputing only a subset of positions at each step, chosen either on a fixed schedule or by heuristic signals of change. Our trajectory experiments instead point to decoding trajectory as the more relevant quantity. Cached generation remains accurate when it stays close to the full-denoising trajectory, with errors concentrated around unmask-order deviations and reduced as longer reference prefixes are recovered. This suggests a more direct principle: limiting representation error helps, but keeping generation on the full-denoising trajectory is a more direct route to accurate decoding. We therefore formulate efficient dLLM inference as trajectory-guided querying. Rather than broadly repairing representation error, we use full-denoising trajectories to supervise which unresolved positions should receive limited fresh computation. Based on this formulation, we introduce TRACEQUERY, a lightweight sparse decoding framework that predicts a small set of near-future trajectory-relevant positions, queries only those candidates, and lets the backbone select which one to commit from their fresh predictions. TRACEQUERY delivers the strongest quality-computation trade-off among cache-based approaches, sustaining high accuracy with substantially fewer fresh token computations, and generalizes across tasks, model variants, and families. Code: this https URL

[NLP-200] Knowledge-Guided LLM for Intent-Driven Service Orchestration in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial 6G Networks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决集成陆基与非陆基（TN/NTN）6G网络中自然语言服务意图存在的不完整、模糊或不一致问题，这些问题导致基于大语言模型（LLM）的无约束生成难以支持可靠的服务编排。其核心解决方案是提出一种知识引导的LLM框架，通过语法约束的语义解析与知识图谱（KG）驱动的澄清循环相结合，生成经过验证、可直接用于编排的服务配置文件。该框架在200个样本的意图数据集上实现了89%的分类准确率和95%的策略有效性，平均每个请求仅需0.66次澄清交互。相较于纯LLM基线方法，该方案显著提升了策略有效性和矛盾检测能力，同时减少了澄清次数，验证了显式知识引导推理在集成TN/NTN 6G编排中实现鲁棒意图处理的关键价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33007
作者: Wajdi Hammami,Irfan Azam,Soumaya Cherkaoui
机构: Polytechnique Montreal (蒙特利尔工业大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Natural-language service intents in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) 6G networks can be incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent, making unconstrained LLM generation challenging for reliable network-facing orchestration. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided LLM framework that combines grammar-constrained semantic parsing with a knowledge-graph (KG)-driven clarification loop to produce validated, orchestration-ready service profiles across four representative service classes. On a 200-sample intent dataset, the framework achieves 89% classification accuracy and 95% policy validity with an average of 0.66 clarification turns per request. Compared with a Pure-LLM baseline, the proposed framework improves policy validity and contradiction detection while requiring fewer clarification turns, demonstrating the value of explicit knowledge-guided reasoning for robust intent processing in integrated TN/NTN 6G orchestration.

[NLP-201] Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（LLM）在处理长上下文时面临的巨大计算与内存开销问题。现有软提示压缩方法通常采用与目标模型相同的Transformer架构来生成压缩表示，导致在推理过程中产生显著的延迟开销，因而仅适用于离线场景——即上下文仅需压缩一次并重复用于多个查询。本文提出Boa Compressor，一种基于状态空间模型（State-Space Model, SSM）的即插即用式在线上下文压缩器，能够在单次线性时间遍历中编码任意长度的上下文，并生成一个可直接用于条件化冻结目标LLM的紧凑表示。该SSM通过知识蒸馏训练，使学生模型（接收压缩上下文的LLM）的下一个词元概率分布逼近教师模型（接收完整上下文的LLM）的输出。在相同比例压缩下，Boa在性能上达到或超越现有最先进的离线压缩基线，同时相比基于Transformer的实现快一个数量级，有效降低了端到端推理延迟而非增加压缩耗时。实验表明，Boa在更长上下文及高达16倍的激进压缩比下仍具有良好扩展性。通过实现低成本、可每查询实时运行的有效压缩，Boa成为支持高效长上下文推理的实用且通用的工具。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33006
作者: Marc Serra Ortega,Andrey Barsky,Carlos Boned Riera,Tomás Ockier,Dimosthenis Karatzas
机构: Computer Vision Center, UAB(计算机视觉中心，乌布大学), Spain
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 15 pages, 7 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed representation (as the student). At equal compression ratios, Boa matches or surpasses the performance of existing state-of-the-art offline compression baselines, while being an order of magnitude faster than Transformer-based implementations, thereby reducing end-to-end latency rather than adding compression time overhead. We demonstrate that Boa also scales well to longer contexts and to compression ratios as aggressive as 16x. By enabling effective compression that is cheap enough to run on every query at inference time, Boa becomes a practical and general tool for efficient long-context inference.

[NLP-202] OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决能量模型（Energy-based Models, EBMs）在通用场景建模中表现不足的问题，尤其是在大规模语言建模任务中难以有效泛化至多样化下游应用的挑战。其核心解决方案是提出能量引导模型（Energy-steered Models, ESMs），通过将能量引导搜索与分词生成统一于同一架构中，实现对潜在状态在能量景观上的优化，并利用优化后的潜在状态指导更精准的分词生成。关键在于：先在大规模语料上进行能量引导的预训练，使模型学习到一个具有普遍有效性的能量景观，其中低能量值对应高概率、高质量的词汇序列；随后通过规模扩展实验验证，发现随着模型参数量和训练数据的增加，ESMs展现出良好的可扩展性，在26个跨领域下游任务中多数优于GPT类模型。这一设计突破了传统EBM在采样效率与生成质量之间的权衡，为大模型时代的通用问题求解提供了新的范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33005
作者: Yuan Pu,Yudong Lu,Ting Wang,Zhicong Hong,Qinuo Li,Xuansheng Wu,Na Zou,Xia Hu,Guanchu Wang
机构: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (上海人工智能实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 12 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Energy-based models have shown promising properties for domain-specific tasks but remain challenging in modeling general-purpose scenarios. To bridge this gap, we design energy-steered models (ESMs) for foundational language modeling. ESMs integrate energy steering and token generation within a single architecture to leverage the energy-guided search to refine token generation. Specifically, ESMs first optimize a latent state over the energy landscape, then leverages the refined latent state for token generation. By performing such energy-guided pre-training on large-scale corpora, ESMs learn generally effective energy landscape where favorable tokens correspond to lower energy values. To explore the scaling behavior of ESMs, we pre-train ESMs on three large-scale corpora, then evaluate across 26 downstream tasks spanning a broad range of domains. Our results demonstrate that ESMs have promising scaling behaviors with increasing model size and training data, and outperform GPTs on most downstream tasks. These findings highlight ESMs as a promising architecture for large-scale pre-training and general purpose problem solving. We fully release the model weights and training infrastructure to enable the community to completely reproduce and extend our results. [NLP-203] Entity-Aware Evaluation of OCR Systems for Historical Document Transcription

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统光学字符识别（OCR）评估指标（如字符错误率，CER）无法充分反映历史文献中关键信息（如人名、日期、标识符等实体）是否被准确保留的问题。其核心解决方案在于引入实体级分析（entity-level analysis），通过在公开的贝鲁蒂档案（Berrutti Archive）175份文档基础上，结合5,209条人工标注的实体提及数据，从实体保全性与可恢复性角度评估不同OCR系统的表现。研究对比了序列识别型OCR系统、专用视觉-语言模型及通用视觉-语言模型，并在不同字符级编辑容忍度下分析实体匹配情况。结果表明，仅依赖全局转录准确率会误导评估结论：尽管Qwen 3.6在所有容忍度下均表现出最高实体覆盖率，但部分系统虽在精确匹配上表现较差，却在容忍微小错误时显著提升实体恢复能力，说明其错误多为局部字符偏差而非语义性误识；而另一些系统即使放宽匹配标准仍难以恢复大量实体。这揭示了单一聚合转录指标的局限性，强调必须结合实体级视角来全面评估OCR对有意义信息的保全能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33004
作者: Camilo Mariño(UDELAR, CB),Diego Belzarena(UDELAR, CB),Marina Gardella(CB),Ignacio Ramírez(UDELAR),Gregory Randall(UDELAR),Jean-Michel Morel(LU - Hong Kong)
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Image and Video Processing (eess.IV)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is essential for digitizing historical archives, yet standard evaluation metrics such as Character Error Rate (CER) do not necessarily reflect whether meaningful information, such as names, dates, and identifiers, is preserved. In this work, we investigate entitylevel analysis of OCR errors as a complementary perspective for evaluating OCR quality in historical documents. Using a publicly available benchmark of 175 documents from the Berrutti Archive, augmented with 5,209 manually annotated entity mentions that will be released upon acceptance, we compare sequence-recognition OCR systems, OCR-specialized vision-language models, and general-purpose vision-language models. Beyond global transcription accuracy, we analyze entity preservation and recoverability under varying character-level edit tolerances. Our experiments show that OCR rankings depend on the evaluation criterion: while Qwen 3.6 achieves the highest entity coverage across all tested tolerances, several systems with lower exact-match coverage recover substantially when small errors are tolerated, suggesting that many of their errors correspond to localized character-level deviations rather than fundamentally incorrect entity transcriptions. Conversely, some systems remain unable to recover many entities even under relaxed matching. These findings show that OCR quality cannot be fully characterized by aggregate transcription metrics alone and highlight the importance of evaluating how OCR errors affect the preservation and recoverability of meaningful information.

[NLP-204] From Writing Advice to Manuscript Governance: A Constrained-Transformation Framework for Academic Revision

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决学术写作中因合法写作目标冲突而产生的治理难题，尤其在简洁性、发表载体形式或风格变异与证据支持及论断边界之间发生矛盾时，缺乏明确的优先级判断标准。其核心解决方案在于将修订过程建模为在有序约束下的可接受性问题：通过任务相关不变量、情境约束以及可变的表达选择共同界定可接受的修订空间，并引入“论断保留契约”（claim-preservation contract），以确保证据与判断始终与授权的论断边界保持一致。据此提出四项治理命题——保留性、优先性、情境适应性与充分性，构建了一个技术无关的机制框架，能够实现表达方式的调整而不隐性改变研究论证本身。该模型由“学术写作过滤器”（Academic Writing Filter）具体实现，用于筛选候选修订方案，而非对优质学术写作进行普遍定义或分类。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33001
作者: Simon Rudkin
机构: University of Manchester(曼彻斯特大学); Manchester, United Kingdom
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Academic revision presents a governance problem when legitimate writing objectives conflict. Writing-process and social-science research show that revision is recursive and that wording carries epistemic and disciplinary commitments. Those literatures identify important constraints but do not settle which objective should prevail when concision, outlet form or stylistic variation conflicts with evidence and claim boundaries. This paper models revision as an admissibility problem under ordered constraints. Task-relative invariants, contextual constraints and mutable presentation choices define the admissible space; a claim-preservation contract links evidence and judgement to an authorised claim boundary. Four governance propositions specify preservation, precedence, context and sufficiency. The Academic Writing Filter implements the model by screening candidate revisions; it is not a universal definition or classifier of good academic writing. The contribution is a technology-independent mechanism for changing presentation without silently changing the research argument.

[NLP-205] Whispering Wisely: Smart Subset Selection for ASR Fine-Tuning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模自动语音识别（ASR）模型（如OpenAI的Whisper）在微调过程中计算成本高昂的问题，尤其是在拥有大量标注音频数据时，使得许多研究者难以将其适配至新语言或特定领域。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于嵌入（embedding）的子集选择方法：利用Whisper预训练编码器将每个音频样本映射到固定维度的嵌入空间，并采用贪心k-center算法从中选取具有多样性和代表性的训练子集。实验结果表明，相较于随机采样，该方法在较小数据规模下显著提升识别性能，且通过词汇多样性分析发现，k-center选取的子集能覆盖更广泛的语言内容，从而解释其有效性。整体而言，该方法为低资源场景下的ASR微调提供了一种高效、实用的数据子集选择策略，尤其在样本预算有限时优势明显。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32997
作者: Roi Yozevitch,Or Haim Anidjar
机构: Ariel University (阿里埃尔大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 17 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models such as OpenAIs Whisper have substantially improved speech recognition quality but remain expensive to fine-tune, especially when large amounts of transcribed audio are available. This makes it challenging for many practitioners to adapt these models to new languages or domains. In this work, we introduce an embedding-based subset selection approach for selecting smaller training sets for ASR fine-tuning. Using Whispers pretrained encoder, we map each audio sample into a fixed-dimensional embedding space and apply a greedy k-center algorithm to select diverse and representative subsets of the training data. We evaluate this approach on both Hebrew and Danish, showing that k-center selection often improves upon random sampling, particularly at smaller subset sizes. An analysis of lexical diversity reveals that k-center subsets capture a broader range of linguistic content than random subsets of the same size, which may help explain their observed effectiveness. Overall, our results demonstrate that embedding-based subset selection provides a practical strategy for ASR subset selection in the two evaluated languages, with the clearest recognition benefits observed at smaller sample budgets.

[NLP-206] LLM -as-a-Judge Version Shift: The Instrument Changed Not the Standard

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在自动化科研流程中，随着大语言模型（LLM）裁判版本迭代更新时，其评估标准是否保持一致的可靠性问题。当前研究普遍依赖固定权重的LLM裁判对研究提案进行评分、筛选与修订，但实际应用中这些裁判常被更新版本替代，而这一过程可能引入不可控的评估偏差。研究的关键发现在于：新旧版本替换不仅影响评分的均值位置（如更严或更松），还会改变评估准则的几何结构（criterion geometry）与分辨能力（resolution），甚至导致关键判别维度失效——例如某一版本替换后，93%的提案得分被压缩至单一数值，丧失了有效区分力。进一步分析表明，这种差异主要由评估格式驱动而非内容本身所致，且通过全局校准无法有效修复个体层面的评分离散性。为此，论文提出一个基于测量理论的框架，将裁判替换视为对其原点（origin）、准则几何或分辨率的系统性改变，并设计了一套小规模分层锚点审计（约200个样本）机制，在部署前即可识别潜在失败类型；同时，冻结阈值策略能准确诊断出注册后API裁判的替换问题。研究结果强调了在自动化评估体系中维持测量稳定性的重要性，并提供了可复现的六组预注册锁与超过14,800次裁判调用的完整审计记录以支持透明验证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32986
作者: Guijia Zhang,Harry Yang
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology(香港科技大学)
类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated research pipelines increasingly rely on fixed LLM judges to rank, filter, and revise proposals, yet these judges are routinely replaced by newer versions. We study whether such replacements preserve the underlying measurement standard. Using a preregistered, frozen-weight design, we evaluate three adjacent same-family transitions across Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral on frozen ML research proposals under randomized information conditions. The common assumption that newer judges are simply harsher fails: two transitions shift toward greater leniency, while the third shifts in the opposite direction on anchors but attenuates off-anchor. More importantly, version changes can alter not only score location but also criterion geometry and resolution; one transition collapses clean-flawed discrimination, placing 93% of pool scores on a single value. Supplying identical facts does not close the version gap, placebo-controlled interventions show that observed packet effects are largely format-driven rather than content-driven, and global recalibration repairs the mean while explaining little object-level dispersion. We organize these failures with a measurement model in which a judge replacement can change its origin, criterion geometry, or resolution. A small stratified anchor audit of about 200 calls identifies the failure class before deployment, and frozen thresholds correctly diagnose two post-registration API judge replacements. We release six preregistration locks and the full audit trail of 14882 judge calls.

[NLP-207] Skip the Compressor: Coding Agents Fix More Issues When They Pick Whole Files

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 在处理大型代码仓库时面临的上下文窗口限制问题，即如何在有限的上下文长度内有效支持代码修复（patch generation）。现有方法如提示压缩器（prompt compressors）和检索器（retrievers）存在根本性缺陷：检索器依据代码与问题的语义相似性排序文件，但无法保证所选文件是真正需要修改的；压缩器虽能适应上下文预算，却通过删减文本降低信息完整性，导致模型无法准确复现原始代码行，从而影响修复质量。本文提出的关键解决方案是采用一种基于精确文件选择的策略——CQ2-CARE，其核心在于将固定上下文预算全部用于选择并完整呈现必须修改的文件，而非压缩或检索部分代码片段。该方法无需依赖复杂的压缩模型，确保模型可直接引用原始代码，提升编辑准确性。实验表明，在300个SWE-rebench近期问题上，使用GPT-5.6和Claude Opus 5时，CQ2-CARE分别解决了43.7%和46.7%的问题，显著优于三种压缩器（+6.3点）和三种检索器（+9.3至12.7点），甚至超过两个专门训练用于问题修复的方法（SweRank和SWE-Pruner）。分析揭示，传统方法失败的主要原因在于：检索器常遗漏关键修改文件，而压缩器虽保留文件但改变其内容，导致修复补丁失效。CQ2-CARE通过精确文件选择机制，实现了更高的修复成功率与可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21073
作者: Xiaocong Yang,Rishit Chatterjee,Himanshu Udupi,Vikram Ramavarapu,ChengXiang Zhai
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign(伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A coding agent works on repositories that can be far larger than its context window can hold. Prompt compressors and retrievers offer solutions to this problem, but patching an issue needs two things at once: the files that must change, and their code exactly as written, since the model must reproduce the lines it edits. Retrievers rank code by its similarity to the issue rather than by whether it must change, and compressors delete text to fit the budget. We show that at an equal token budget, an agent resolves more issues when the budget goes to choosing which files to show verbatim, as our simple selector CQ2-CARE does, than when it goes to pruning tokens or retrieving chunks. We fit every context to the same per-issue budget on 300 recent SWE-rebench issues and grade each patch with the benchmark’s tests. With GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5, CQ2-CARE resolves 43.7% and 46.7% of the issues, 6.3 points more than the best of three compressors with either model, and 9.3 and 12.7 points more than the best of three retrievers. CQ2-CARE even resolves more issues than two methods trained for issue resolution, SweRank (by 0.7 and 1.7 points) and SWE-Pruner (by 2.0 and 7.3). Our analysis shows the defects of the baseline methods: retrievers often miss the files to edit, and compressors keep them but alter their text, so fewer patches apply. Exact-file selection needs no compression model and shows every line as the repository has it, so the model can quote the code it edits.

[NLP-208] Integrate the Reward Dont Sample It: Window Likelihood for Interruptions and Backchannels in Full-Duplex Speech Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决全双工语音对话系统中用户打断与回音确认（backchannel）行为的精确控制问题，即模型需在用户主动打断时及时让出话语权（yield），而在用户仅进行非言语回应时保持持续倾听（hold）。现有方法通常采用基于序列级强化学习的时机奖励（GRPO），但实验发现其在四个开源模型上存在双重缺陷：一是二值窗口奖励在最需学习的关键窗口处产生零梯度（零梯度陷阱），二是单个回合的奖励得分被分散至多个听觉状态决策中，导致信用分配偏差（credit leakage），引发模型“对静默说话”或“提前停止回答”的错误行为。这些问题的本质源于奖励函数是少数二值控制决策的已知函数，导致采样不具区分性。为此，作者提出窗口似然（Window Likelihood, \WL）：针对每个时间窗口独立采样话语延续路径，但通过闭式积分对所有可能的停止决策进行整合，并最大化正确动作的对数概率——其中“让出话语权”建模为噪声或（noisy-OR），而“保持倾听”则建模为生存乘积（survival product）。在HumDial-FDBench基准上，\WL在六种结构不同的开放模型上均取得最优的yield/hold F1性能，超越了使用不同数据训练的Kyutai发布的GRPO检查点，且未引入任何额外的发言权重新开放现象。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35581
作者: Guoqiang Hu,Lichao Zhang,Yizhou Peng,Yuhao Luo,Haifeng Hu,Sallen Sun,Will Yang,Eng Siong Chng
机构: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore(南洋理工大学, 新加坡); Tencent(腾讯)
类目: Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A full-duplex spoken dialogue model must yield when the user cuts in and hold when the user merely backchannels. Sequence-level RL with a timing reward (GRPO) is the usual recipe; we test its whole-rollout form on four open models and find two failures. A binary window reward gives zero advantage on exactly the windows that most need learning (a zero-gradient trap), and the one score per rollout is spread over listening-state decisions the reward is not written in terms of (credit leakage), so the model talks into silence or stops answering. Both come from sampling a reward that is a known function of a few binary control decisions. We propose \emphwindow likelihood (\WL): sample a continuation per window, but integrate in closed form over the stop decisions it visits and maximise the log-probability of acting correctly—a noisy-OR for yielding, a survival product for holding. On HumDial-FDBench, \WL\ gives the best yield/hold F1 on all six structurally different open models we post-train, exceeds Kyutai’s released GRPO checkpoints (trained on different data), and adds no re-opening of the floor on any model.

[NLP-209] Wave Is All You Need: A Quantum Language Model Based on Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统生成式人工智能（Generative AI）模型中自注意力机制（self-attention mechanism）依赖于离散矩阵运算所带来的计算冗余与资源消耗问题，尤其在处理连续语义流时需进行显式离散化分解，导致信息损失与效率低下。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine, FC-QBM）的自注意力机制，通过在语义量子态上施加幺正演化（unitary evolution），隐式实现位置编码与自注意力计算，无需将连续语义流显式分解为离散矩阵进行乘法运算。该机制的测量结果天然满足归一化条件，且数学推导表明其与经典自注意力机制在理论上等价。研究进一步建立了FC-QBM语言模型（FC-QBM-LM）的训练与生成算法，并构建了8量子比特规模的模型，在唐诗语料上完成训练。实验表明，该量子层仅用44个参数即可完整实现位置编码与自注意力计算流程，在无噪声环境下表现出良好收敛性；同时，采用Y轴旋转门终止的量子电路相较于X轴旋转门具有更优收敛性能。在小样本及多种噪声强度下，模型保持超过99%的噪声无关性能，展现出强鲁棒性。五言绝句生成实验初步验证了模型具备联想性与发散性思维、意象层面的内容生成能力以及符合人类语序习惯的词序组织能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34492
作者: Jun Liu
机构: Hunan University of Finance and Economics (湖南财经工业学院)
类目: Quantum Physics (quant-ph); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 44 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, 2 algorithms

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This work proposes a self-attention mechanism based on the fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine (FC-QBM), and further constructs a fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine language model (FC-QBM-LM) using the mechanism as the core engine. By performing unitary evolution on semantic quantum states, the mechanism implicitly implements positional encoding and self-attention computation, eliminating the need to decompose continuous semantic streams into discrete matrices for explicit matrix multiplication, with the measurement results naturally satisfying the normalization condition. Specifically, this work rigorously derives the computational principle of the self-attention mechanism based on FC-QBM, and demonstrates that this mechanism is mathematically equivalent to the classical self-attention mechanism. The mathematical principles governing the training and generation of FC-QBM-LM are thoroughly derived, and the two corresponding algorithms are subsequently developed. An 8-qubit FC-QBM-LM is finally constructed and trained on the corpus of Tang poetry. Under the 8-qubit setting, the quantum layer implements the entire positional encoding and self-attention computation pipeline with only 44 parameters. In the noiseless scenario, the model exhibits favorable convergence. Furthermore, the quantum circuit proposed in this work, which terminates with Y-axis rotation gates, achieves better convergence than the counterpart terminating with X-axis rotation gates. Under the small-sample regime and across eight distinct noise intensity levels, the model demonstrates strong noise robustness, retaining over 99% of its noiseless convergence performance. Experiments on five-character quatrain generation reveal that the model preliminarily exhibits three core capabilities: associative and divergent thinking, content generation across imagery and human-aligned word ordering.

[NLP-210] Automated auditable dating of the Babylonian Astronomical Diaries with language models and astronomical tools

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决古代巴比伦天文日记（Babylonian Astronomical Diaries）中大量残缺文书因缺失日期公式而导致的年代判定难题。其核心挑战在于如何在缺乏明确时间标记的情况下，仅依靠天文观测记录对数以百计的残损泥板进行精确年代推定。解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于规则的解析系统与语言模型协同工作的自动化框架：首先通过规则引擎将观测文本转化为结构化的逻辑条款（clause），再利用语言模型识别并补全遗漏的天文观测信息；随后借助天文计算工具对公元前626年至公元75年共701个年份逐一验证这些条款的符合度，并依据匹配程度对各年度进行排序。该系统在未公开已知年代的120个泥板上实现了96%的正确率，其中84个案例中唯一最优候选年份即为已发表的正确年份。此外，系统还为ADART IV中的56个无年代泥板提供了按置信度排序的候选年份列表，清晰展示了纯天文学证据所能达到的年代约束精度。整个流程可交互追溯，配套代码、协议与结果均开放共享。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34297
作者: Lucas Carrit Delgado Pinheiro,Yuan-Sen Ting,Jon Clindaniel,Lu Li,Yingbin Liang,Ness Shroff
机构: The Ohio State University (俄亥俄州立大学); Max-Planck-Institut für Astronomie (马克斯·普朗克天文研究所); The University of Chicago (芝加哥大学); The Hebrew University (希伯来大学)
类目: Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics (astro-ph.IM); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); History and Philosophy of Physics (physics.hist-ph)
备注: 15 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, including the SI Appendix. Code, data and interactive page: this https URL and this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The Babylonian Astronomical Diaries record the sky over nearly six centuries. Many tablets are broken and have lost their date formula. Experts dated many of them one tablet at a time in the standard edition, Astronomical Diaries and Related Texts from Babylonia (ADART). They used the recorded sky and other evidence, such as year formulas and royal names. Our system automates the astronomical part for all tablets with the same rules. A rule-based parser turns the recorded observations into clauses, short statements with fixed fields. A language model checks them against the text and adds observations that the parser missed. Astronomical tools test the clauses in all 701 years from 626 BCE to AD 75. The system ranks the years by how well they agree with the clauses. The system withholds published dates until its results are final, and the output lists the passages and computed positions behind each candidate year. On 120 dated tablets, the years tied at the top of the ranking include the published year in 96% of cases. For 86 of them, this top group is a single year, the published year in 84. In 119 of the 120, the reported candidate set contains it. For 56 undated entries of ADART IV, the system gives ranked candidate years. For each tablet, the results show how far astronomy alone narrows the year. An interactive page at this https URL follows each tablet and links the code, protocol and results.

[NLP-211] LLM s Can Tackle High Energy Theoretical Physics yet Gaps Remain: Part I Quantum Field Theory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在高能理论物理领域中对复杂量子场论（Quantum Field Theory, QFT）问题的求解能力边界不明确的问题，尤其是评估大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在需要深度推理与推导的高阶QFT问题上的实际表现。其解决方案的关键在于构建并发布首个系统性的基准测试工具 QFT-Bench，包含75道涵盖核心QFT子领域的研究生至研究级难度问题，每道题均具备明确目标和闭式参考答案。通过结合符号验证与基于LLM的评判机制进行综合评估，研究发现前沿模型在非平凡的QFT计算中已展现出接近95%的准确率，但依然存在对计算细节、规范约定及指令理解的错误；更关键的是，模型在思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）中表现出显著的推理不忠实现象——即虽能得出正确答案，但其推理过程缺乏逻辑自洽与有效支持。这一工作为当前LLMs在量子场论中的能力提供了量化评估，并为未来在高能理论物理领域的广泛评测奠定了基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33134
作者: Tong Liu,Bohan Li,Gongrui Cheng,Zixiong Yu,Yulan He,Volker Tresp
机构: 未知
类目: High Energy Physics - Phenomenology (hep-ph); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Beyond math and code, Large language models (LLMs) are beginning to tackle problems that have traditionally required substantial training for theoretical physicists, but it remains unclear how far this capability extends and where it might break. As a first step toward pushing LLMs in high-energy theoretical physics, we introduce QFT-Bench, a benchmark of 75 graduate- to research-level problems requiring extensive reasoning and derivation across core Quantum Field Theory (QFT) subareas. Each question has a well-defined target and closed-form reference answer. Evaluation combines symbolic verification with LLM-based judge. Across 39 proprietary and open-source models, frontier models already demonstrate substantial capabilities on nontrivial QFT calculations, with the strongest models exceeding 95% accuracy. At the same time, clear gaps remain. Even strong models still make errors in calculations, conventions, and instruction following, while weaker models often fail at the level of physical concepts or derivations. We further monitor models’ CoTs and show that current models exhibit nontrivial reasoning unfaithfulness, i.e., they could reach correct answers but the reasoning itself does not justify and logically support them. These results provide a quantitative assessment of current LLM capabilities in QFT and a first step toward broader evaluation in high-energy theoretical physics.

[IR-0] ACARE: Agent -Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35840
作者: Sahel Sharifymoghaddam,Yauhen Babakhin,Reza Esfandiarpoor,Oliver Holworthy,Jimmy Lin,Bo Liu
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user’s original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent’s reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker’s mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.

[IR-1] Do Similarity Measures Measure Similarity? How User Activity Creates Phantom Correlation in Recommender Systems

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35765
作者: Marco Favier,Noah Daniëls,Jens Leysen,Sander Marinus,Bart Goethals
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Item-item similarity is one of the oldest and most foundational signals in recommender systems: two items are assumed to be similar when the same users consume them. Despite the sparsity and scale of interaction data, the implicit assumption across the field is that item co-occurrence reflects genuine shared preference, capturing what users like together. In this paper, we demonstrate that a substantial fraction of observed item-item similarity is an artifact of variance in user activity rather than shared taste. Even if every user consumed items completely independently, differing only in their total consumption volume, standard similarity measures still detect strong associations between items. We term this phenomenon phantom correlation: spurious item association that emerges strictly from heterogeneous user activity in the complete absence of preference structure. Starting from minimal formal assumptions, we show that independent consumption under varying activity is described by a Rasch model, and we derive how the resulting association depends on item popularity for each similarity measure. By comparing our theoretical baseline against real-world benchmark datasets, we reveal the extent to which popular similarity measures reflect phantom correlation, which bears on how item co-occurrence is interpreted and used in collaborative filtering.

[IR-2] owards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35695
作者: Chaohua Yang,Fuyuan Lyu,Xing Tang,Dugang Liu,Xiuqiang He,Zhong Ming
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 13 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. To explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels, OptIDC further introduces a selection-weighted Optimal Transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures, thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. Moreover, OptIDC is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTR models. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that OptIDC consistently achieves higher AUC than existing input-side selection methods, validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.

[IR-3] Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer CIKM’26

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35550
作者: Abdulaziz Samra,Nikita Sukhorukov,Alexey Grishanov,Alexey Vasilev,Evgeny Frolov
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC)
备注: Accepted in CIKM’26 - full paper track

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to improve next-item prediction in a target domain by leveraging user behavior from auxiliary source domains. However, real-world deployment faces two critical challenges: business constraints that isolate interaction data across domains, and user heterogeneity, where many users lack cross-domain activity. This makes existing cross-domain methods difficult to apply. In this paper, we propose a simple and practical framework for cross-domain sequential recommendations that transfers information exclusively through learned user representations, without sharing raw interaction data or item embeddings across domains. We introduce a lightweight adapter that projects the source-domain user representation into the target-domain embedding space and integrates it with the target interaction sequence. Importantly, when source data is unavailable (i.e., the user observed only in the target domain), the model seamlessly defaults to a robust target-only sequential recommender, retaining benefits from joint training across all users. Extensive experiments were conducted under two setups; one targets benchmarking against previous baselines, while the other focuses on realistic and scalable conditions. Both sets of experiments demonstrate consistent performance gains for shared and unshared users.
